For 25 years, Infront has been empowering financial market experts to make faster, smarter, compliant decisions. About the Role The Tech Lead for Portfolio & Advisory (PAS) provides senior technical leadership for the PAS business line. This role is part of the CPO Leadership Team. The role operates at leadership-team level, aligns product and technology stakeholders, and makes pragmatic technical trade-offs between architecture quality, time-to-market, customer commitments and investment priorities. Translate PAS roadmap priorities into robust technical execution, with particular focus on scalability, API-first integration, cloud/SaaS readiness, AI-enabled workflows, interoperability, security, maintainability and performance. Current PAS strategy explicitly requires scaling PMS platforms, positioning PMS products as integration layers, API-first support for data/risk tools and AI-powered digital workflows. Drive engineering standards and quality across development, testing, release and production readiness. The role ensures code quality, technical debt management, CI/CD, observability, resilience, testing discipline, security/compliance alignment and incident follow-up are embedded in day-to-day delivery. Act as the technical decision-maker for architecture and design trade-offs, especially where delivery pressure, technical debt, interoperability, release readiness or operational risk require clear technical judgement. Coordinate technical dependencies across teams and CBCs, ensuring PAS solutions align with cross-business architecture, engineering excellence, QA, Dev/Ops, security/compliance, data engineering and UI/UX standards. Ensure predictable engineering execution: planning, estimation, build/test/release discipline, delivery transparency, early risk escalation and continuous improvement within the agreed CPO operating model. Who you are Senior engineering leader with a strong background in software architecture, modern software development, system design and engineering leadership; the Engineering Manager profile references 8+ years in software engineering with leadership experience as a baseline. Proven ability to lead architecture and engineering decisions across cloud/SaaS platforms, APIs, integration, DevOps, observability, security/compliance, quality and release readiness. title: Junior Consultant to Valuation & Modeling - Jan 2027
description: Company Description Deloitte is a global leader in Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal and Consultative Services. With more than 470,000 employees in over 150 countries, we help our clients and our communities solve complex problems and achieve ambitious goals through domain and industry expertise, global reach and alliances with the largest tech providers. What defines Deloitte is our drive to make a meaningful difference. For us, this means long-term development and results for our clients and their companies, ideas and actions that also contribute to positive societal development. It is also about empowering our people and promoting their development. Job Description In Valuation & Modeling we advise our clients to help uncover and quantify value in a number of situations including M&A, investments, disputes and tax and financial reporting purposes. We provide financial analyses and valuations of businesses, equity investments, financial instruments and intangible assets. Moreover, we develop tailor-made financial models which are used for e.g. acquisitions, business planning, structuring of complex transactions, project finance and evaluation of strategic options. As a Consultant in our Valuation & Modeling team you'll contribute to the team with valuation analyses (e.g. DCFs, multiples, Monte Carlo simulations, etc.) through financial, economic and industry research as well as in-depth financial analysis. We value teamwork and team spirit highly and always work collaboratively. You will work and learn alongside other more senior team members building advanced financial models in Excel, analyzing key value drivers, participate in client meetings and prepare valuation reports. Qualifications A successful candidate has the following qualities: A graduate degree, MBA/Master's degree or equivalent, preferably with focus on finance and accounting with good academic results Great communication skills both in English and Swedish and proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint (you will quickly become exceptional!) A genuine interest in the financial markets and valuation, and a strong curiosity, drive and willingness to be challenged and develop A flexible attitude is an advantage since we often work with multiple projects simultaneously, where leveraging a structured approach in managing multiple tasks and delivering within deadlines is essential Deloitte is a multi-cultural organization where the individual employees background, experience and competence is regarded an asset. Additional Information We offer As a part of Deloitte, you will have access to the world's largest consulting network, connecting you with colleagues worldwide to support your growth, our clients, and the business. Together with skilled colleagues, clients and strong alliances, we solve the most complex challenges of tomorrow for some of Sweden's largest organizations. Growth & Development: We invest in your development through hands-on experience on real engagements, personal coaching and continuous feedback from experienced colleagues. You'll have the opportunity to push your boundaries, learn new skills and build a career that grows in line with your ambitions. Collaboration & Impact: With shared values and a strong drive to make an impact, the combination of our opportunities and your goals give you the chance to influence, and to build important relationships and networks together with colleagues from across the globe. We believe in the power of bringing people, technology and industries together to create meaningful change. Let your drive create meaningful impact. How to apply Submit your application online as soon as possible. Your application should contain your: CV University grades - The grade document you upload should have been retrieved no more than 2 months ago. Upload grades from both your bachelor and masters, if applicable. In the first step, you upload your CV. Next, you upload your university transcripts (for completed courses) and answer questions related to the role. Both your CV and complete transcripts must be uploaded for your application to be considered complete. Apply as soon as possible as we review applications on an ongoing basis. After submitting your CV, you will receive a confirmation email. If you do not receive one, please submit your application again. If you are applying for multiple roles, please indicate which role you are most interested in. At Deloitte, we value different skills, perspectives, and experiences, as it enables us to effectively solve complex challenges for our clients. We encourage you to apply for the position if you believe your skills can contribute to our team's success. As part of Deloitte's recruitment, final candidates undergo background checks with ToFindOut ( https://tofindout.se/en/background-check/ ) to ensure employee awareness, workplace safety, and regulatory compliance. For roles requiring university grades, these are verified during the recruitment process. For questions, contact the responsible recruiter. Questions? If you have any questions regarding the application process, please contact William Lim, Recruiter, at [email protected] . We look forward to your application! What impact will you make? Every day, your work will make an impact that matters, while you thrive in a dynamic culture of inclusion, collaboration and high performance. We do not just aspire to make solutions. We wish to create an impact that makes a positive and crucial difference for the people around us, our clients and our society. Deloitte is where you'll find unlimited opportunities to succeed and realize your full potential. title: Pressechef søges til Forsvarsministeriet
description: Vil du være med til gennemførelsen af en historisk styrkelse af forsvaret? Har du et stærkt politisk kompas, er du på forkant med nyhedsbilledet og i stand til at præge de forsvars- og sikkerhedspolitiske dagsordener i medierne? Kan du udvikle og eksekvere brandingstrategier og politiske budskaber på tværs af presse, SoMe og kommunikation? Er du en god samarbejdspartner, handlekraftig og evner du at skabe overblik, selv når tempoet er højt? Så kan du være Forsvarsministeriets kommende pressechef! Om os Europa og Danmark står i en skærpet sikkerhedspolitisk situation, og det danske forsvar er i gang med en omfattende strategisk forandring, der indebærer en historisk styrkelse. Tryghed for Danmark og danskerne i et stadig mere komplekst trusselsbillede betyder, at der er behov for at øge hastigheden i opbygning af Forsvarets kampkraft, indkøbe materiel for store milliardbeløb, styrke internationale alliancer – ikke mindst NATO – samt styrke forsvaret i Arktis og Nordatlanten. Forsvarets presseenhed er en del af Minister- og Ledelsessekretariatet, der består af fire enheder: Presse, Kommunikation, Ministersekretariatet samt Koordination og Policy. Minister- og Ledelsessekretariatet arbejder tæt sammen om at understøtte ministeren og direktionen bedst muligt og der er et godt kollegialt sammenhold på tværs. Om stillingen Forsvarsministeriets presseenhed planlægger og fører ministeriets presseindsatser ud i livet. Du får ansvaret for at lede departementets pressearbejde og presserådgivningen af ministeren. Derudover får du personaleansvar for presseenhedens medarbejdere: tre presserådgivere og en taleskriver. Enheden har bl.a. til opgave at: Koordinere og håndtere henvendelser fra mediern i tæt samarbejde med departementets medarbejdere. Skrive pressemeddelelser og have dialog med medierne vedr. interviews mv. Sikre en stærk fortælling om ministerområdet på tværs af medieplatforme. Udarbejde debatindlæg, kronikker, taler o.lign. Producere opslag, billeder og video til sociale platforme. Ledsage ministeren på rejser i ind- og udland med ansvar for pressedækning og opdatereringer på Forsvarsministeriets sociale medier. Du vil have tæt dialog med forsvarsministeren, de særlige rådgivere og departementets øverste ledelse. Koordinationen af ministerområdets pressehåndtering sker i tæt samarbejde med departementets medarbejdere og underliggende myndigheder. Derudover er gode relationer til medier og i særdeleshed Christiansborg-redaktionerne en vigtig forudsætning i det daglige arbejde. Gode samarbejdsevner og opbygningen af relationer er således afgørende for stillingen. Du får fagligt og personalemæssigt ansvar for presseenhedens fire ansatte og tager del i pressevagten. Du refererer til vicedirektøren for Minister- og Ledelsessekretariatet. Om dig Vi lægger vægt på, at du evner at sætte retning, skabe overblik og motivere enhedens dygtige medarbejdere. Du har fokus på samarbejde, holdånd og fælles ansvarsfølelse. tager ansvar for og initiativ til løbende at sikre gode processer for pressearbejdet på ministerområdet. har en stærk faglighed, således at du kan vurdere, hvordan historier vil udvikle sig og reagere rettidigt, vinkle nyheder og udmeldinger og dermed være dagsordensættende; og sikre tydelig formidling af komplekse sager trives i en hverdag, der ofte er hektisk og omskiftelig. Stillingen kræver, at du er fleksibel, har en stor arbejdskapacitet og navigerer sikkert under pres har en stærk politisk forståelse, en veludviklet situationsfornemmelse og evner at bygge bro i en politisk styret organisation med mange interessenter kan sikre produkter af høj kvalitet. Du skriver godt, hurtigt og fejlfrit og tager også gerne selv ansvar for produktionen af både kortere og længere tekster Vi forestiller os, at du har en relevant uddannelsesbaggrund som cand.comm., journalist eller lignende. Du har desuden erfaring med pressearbejde – gerne fra centraladministrationen, Christiansborg eller en politisk styret organisation. Det er en fordel, hvis du har ledelseserfaring, men du kan også være en stærk kandidat, hvis du har et tydeligt ledelsestalent. Ansættelsesvilkår Du ansættes efter gældende overenskomst. Som udgangspunkt vil løn- og ansættelsesvilkår forhandles efter rammeaftalen om kontraktansættelse af chefer i staten. Stillingen er indplaceret i løngruppe 1. Ansættelsen vil ske på åremål. Hvis du er journalist vil du ansættes efter overenskomstens gældende regler. Derudover er der mulighed for at forhandle tillæg efter kvalifikationer. Hvis du ønsker at vide mere om løn- og ansættelsesforhold, er du velkommen til at kontakte HR konsulent Toke Rasmussen på tlf. 32 66 59 91. Som ansat i Forsvarsministeriet er du omfattet af nogle særlige vilkår. Det betyder blandt andet, at du skal kunne sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde denne godkendelse under hele ansættelsesforløbet. Dit daglige tjenestested er Holmens Kanal 9, 1060 København K. VI SER FREM TIL AT HØRE FRA DIG! Hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Vicedirektør for Minister- og Ledelsessekretariatet Anne Assenholm Nielsen på tlf. 9132 6161. Ansøgningsfristen er onsdag den 20. august. Ansættelsessamtaler afholdes løbende. Vi håber på at kunne byde vores nye pressechef velkommen senest den 1. oktober. Vi vil bede dig om at sende CV, motiveret ansøgning samt relevante eksamensudskrifter via linket. Hvis det ikke er muligt for dig at scanne og vedhæfte relevante dokumenter, må du gerne tage dem med til en eventuel samtale. I Forsvarsministeriets organisation tror vi på, at forskellighed udvikler opgaveløsningen. Derfor opfordrer vi alle interesserede uanset baggrund til at søge stillingen. Vi ser frem til at få dig med om bord, så vi sammen kan gøre en væsentlig forskel for alle vores kollegaer i Forsvarsministeriets koncern – både dem i felten og dem bag skrivebordene. Læs mere om Forsvarsministeriet som arbejdsplads på www.fmn.dk I Forsvaret kæmper vi for Danmarks sikkerhed. Vi har modet, evnen og viljen til at kæmpe for fællesskabet og for de centrale værdier, vores samfund hviler på. Vi løser opgaver for Danmark, som ingen andre kan. Vi gør det til hverdag, og når der kræves noget ekstraordinært. Vi er stolte af at passe på Kongeriget Danmark. Vi gør det sammen. Og vi gør det nogle gange med livet som indsats. Vi gør det, fordi det er en del af vores militære identitet. Vi gør det, fordi noget er værd at kæmpe for.

title: Student til HBS Economics
description: Vil du omsætte din faglighed til analyser, der gør en forskel? I HBS Economics arbejder vi for at skabe viden om og løsninger på de store samfundsudfordringer. Vi bruger en bred vifte af samfundsvidenskabelige metoder og fordyber os i både tal og fortællinger. Vi tør udfordre – både vores kunder og os selv – for at finde de bedste løsninger. Vi søger dygtige og engagerede studenter, der brænder for analyser om centrale samfundsdagsordener. Hvem er du? Du læser økonomi, sociologi, statskundskab eller en anden samfundsvidenskabelig uddannelse, er blandt de dygtigste og har mindst 1 år tilbage af dit studie. Du er analytisk stærk og har erfaring med kvantitative og/eller kvalitative metoder som redskaber til at forstå mennesker, samfund og strukturer. Du interesserer dig for de brede samfundsdagsordener inden for fx velfærd, klima, beskæftigelse og sundhed, og du er nysgerrig på, hvordan din viden kan bidrage til løsninger på virkelige udfordringer. Du værdsætter samarbejde, men kan også arbejde selvstændigt og tage initiativ. Du søger et studiejob i et ambitiøst og entreprenant konsulenthus, hvor du kan fordybe dig i meningsfulde projekter – og hvor et stærkt socialt fællesskab og en uformel atmosfære vægter højt. Hvad tilbyder vi? Du bliver en del af et dedikeret og inkluderende team, hvor du arbejder med både danske og internationale kunder på projekter, der skaber reel værdi. Du dykker ned i analyser, der spænder fra kvantitative dataanalyser til kvalitative studier, og udvikler dine kompetencer gennem skræddersyede opgaver og tæt sparring med vores erfarne konsulenter. Vores arbejdstempo er ofte højt, og du vil med garanti blive udfordret, men uanset hvor travlt vi har, så hjælper vi hinanden. Vi tilbyder samtidig en arbejdsplads med en fri og uformel omgangstone og et socialt miljø med højt til loftet. Dit kernearbejdsområde vil være at bistå vores konsulenter med at udarbejde samfundsøkonomiske analyser. Du vil bl.a. arbejde med: Udvikling af opgaveløsninger, der inddrager de nyeste metoder og data Forskellige former for kvantitative og kvalitative analyser Præsentation af resultater og udarbejdelse af rapporter Tilbudsskrivning og deltagelse i kundemøder Vi lægger stor vægt på, at du tager ansvar for dine opgaver og er fleksibel i travle perioder. Din arbejdstid vil som udgangspunkt være omkring 15 timer om ugen fordelt på 2-3 dage, men den kan variere med opgaverne. Vi tager hensyn til dine studiebehov, herunder eksaminer.   • Perform all aspects of the sales process and input & update all relevant activities utilizing CRM daily

  • Solid PC operational knowledge along with Microsoft Office applications experience
  • Knowledge of international commercial transportation (air and ocean freight required)
  • Bachelor degree desired
  • Outgoing, upbeat and resourceful personality!

description: About Millennium Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium’s mission is to deliver results for our investors. Meet the Team The Portfolio Manager will support a Senior Portfolio Manager in the systematic trading of interest rate derivatives, cross-currency products, and long-dated currency derivatives across developed and emerging markets, generating high-quality risk-adjusted returns through the effective deployment of allocated Firm capital. What You’ll Do Formulate and implement relative value investment strategies across global fixed income and macro markets. Manage a multi-currency, multi-product portfolio with a focus on generating strong risk-adjusted returns through disciplined risk-taking and scalable capital deployment. Identify and execute trading opportunities across linear and non-linear rates products, including swaps, options, cross-currency instruments, sovereign rates products, and related macro instruments. Conduct fundamental and quantitative analysis across macroeconomic, geopolitical, central bank, and market-technical factors to generate trade ideas and inform portfolio positioning. Develop and enhance analytical infrastructure, data frameworks, and tools, including PnL analytics, PCA modelling and back testing, to support investment decision-making, portfolio construction, and risk management. Build and maintain relationships with internal stakeholders and external counterparties to support effective portfolio implementation, market access, and trading outcomes. Monitor positions, exposures, liquidity, and risk limits on an ongoing basis, and optimize execution and trade efficiency on a cost-adjusted basis. Maintain compliance with all applicable regulatory, legal, and internal policy requirements. Qualifications/ Skills Required At a minimum a Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Finance, Mathematics, or a closely related quantitative discipline. Minimum of 10 years of experience trading global fixed income rates and macro markets (including G10 markets with a specific focus on Japan and Australia), with substantial expertise in interest rate derivatives, cross-currency products, and related relative value strategies - specifically Interest Rate Swaps (IRS), Cross-Currency Swaps (Xccy), and Bonds. Minimum of 2–3 years of portfolio management experience managing a macro / interest rate / FX relative value investment strategy within an institutional trading environment. Experience operating successfully in a high-performance trading environment and working collaboratively within a team of investment professionals. Demonstrated experience managing multi-currency, multi-product portfolios across both developed and emerging markets. Experience conducting independent research into market trends and activity across global cross-currency markets. Strong expertise in trading and portfolio management of linear and non-linear rates products, including interest rate swaps, options, cross-currency derivatives, and sovereign fixed income instruments. Strong analytical, mathematical, portfolio construction, and risk management skills, with the ability to evaluate complex exposures across multiple products and market regimes. Experience building, enhancing, or applying quantitative models, risk analytics, and trading tools to support portfolio optimization and investment decision-making is essential. Excellent English verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with internal stakeholders, sell-side counterparties, data providers, and senior management.

title: Quality Engineer
location: Westville, Oklahoma, United States of America
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Quality Manager

__

The work model for the role is: Onsite #LI-Onsite

Your role and responsibilities:

The Quality Engineer is responsible for leading and executing quality assurance activities across product, process, and manufacturing operations to drive a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence. This role ensures compliance with internal and external quality standards while improving key performance metrics such as First Pass Yield (FPY), Scrap, Warranty, Defect rates.

The position supports quality activities across winding, assembly, and machining operations, partnering closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, and Supply Chain to resolve complex problems, reduce variation, and improve overall product quality and reliability. This role acts as a steward for quality management systems, processes, and tools within the local organizational unit, supporting the deployment of ABB's quality strategy and promoting a vision of zero defects and prevention-focused quality management.

Our Team Dynamics

Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters - because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Lead quality strategy and continuous improvement initiatives across manufacturing operations by driving defect prevention, improving key quality metrics (FPY, DPPM, scrap, rework, warranty), and fostering a culture of operational excellence through Lean Six Sigma methodologies.
  • Own and enhance the Quality Management System (QMS) by ensuring ISO compliance, supporting audits, managing APQP/PPAP activities, leading root cause and corrective action processes, and establishing robust quality controls, documentation, and standardized processes.
  • Provide technical quality leadership through data-driven analysis, statistical methods, supplier quality management, cross-functional collaboration, and workforce training to improve product quality, process capability, customer satisfaction, and overall business performance.
  • Drive quality and process improvements across winding, assembly, machining, and finishing operations by enhancing defect detection and test reliability, reducing process variation, standardizing work methods, and ensuring compliance with dimensional, surface finish, electrical performance, and product quality specifications.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering with 2+ years of experience in quality, manufacturing, or operational excellence within a manufacturing environment – Required.
  • Strong knowledge of core quality tools and methodologies, including 8D, PPAP, FMEA, Control Plans, and SPC
  • Experience with Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma principles, with the ability to lead data-driven continuous improvement efforts
  • Proficiency in statistical analysis and data trending (e.g., Minitab) and ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and test procedures
  • Working knowledge of ISO 9001 or equivalent Quality Management Systems, including audit readiness and compliance practices
  • Preferred Experience Includes: ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or Six Sigma certification – Experience with winding, assembly and machining manufacturing processes – ISO auditor experience or QMS ownership – Project management experience or PMP certification
  • Candidates must already have work authorization that would permit them to work for ABB in the US.

title: PreMaster Programm - Produktcontrolling
description: Du hast deinen Bachelor erfolgreich abgeschlossen und brennst darauf, dein theoretisches Wissen in die Praxis umzusetzen, bevor du dein Masterstudium startest? Dann bietet dir unser PreMaster Programm im Produktcontrolling die ideale Möglichkeit, wertvolle Praxiserfahrung zu sammeln, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln. Hier gestaltest du aktiv mit, bringst eigene Ideen ein und entwickelst dich in einem dynamischen Umfeld kontinuierlich weiter. Im Rahmen des PreMaster Programms erhältst du umfassende Einblicke in das Controlling im Werksumfeld und baust dein Fachwissen gezielt aus. Während des einjährigen Programms übernimmst du eigenverantwortlich kaufmännische Aufgaben, beispielsweise das monatliche Reporting, und erarbeitest spannende Analysen für das Management. Du koordinierst die Schnittstelle zwischen der Zentrale (Geschäftsbereich) und unserem Produktionswerk, fungierst als wichtige Ansprechperson und verantwortest die Übermittlung unserer Kennzahlen. Im Produktcontrolling unterstützt du die Wirtschaftsplanung und erstellst Prognosen sowie Projekt- und Investitionsrechnungen. Du gewinnst Einblicke in andere Bereiche durch funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit im Werk. Bei Interesse ist außerdem eine bis zu zweimonatige Rotation in andere Abteilungen möglich (z. B. in die HR oder ins Supply Chain Management). Nicht zuletzt kannst du deine Kreativität und Eigenverantwortung in spannenden Controlling-IT-Projekten und Sonderthemen aktiv einbringen und weiterentwickeln. Ausbildung: überdurchschnittlich abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (Bachelor) im Bereich Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder Betriebswirtschaftslehre (idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Finance/Controlling) sowie die konkrete Absicht im Anschluss ein Masterstudium aufzunehmen Erfahrungen und Know-how: Praktika oder berufliche Erfahrung in Bereichen Controlling oder Finanzen von Vorteil Persönlichkeit und Arbeitsweise: du kombinierst analytisches Denken mit einer hohen Zahlen- und IT-Affinität und gehst Herausforderungen strukturiert an; mit deinem souveränen Auftreten und deinem Durchsetzungsvermögen treibst du Themen aktiv voran und übernimmst Verantwortung; dabei setzt du auf eine vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit und überzeugst durch Teamgeist sowie ausgeprägte Kooperationsbereitschaft Sprachen: sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift
description_en: Have you successfully completed your bachelor's degree and are eager to put your theoretical knowledge into practice before you start your master's degree? Then our PreMaster program in product controlling offers you the ideal opportunity to gain valuable practical experience, take on responsibility and develop professionally and personally. Here you actively participate, contribute your own ideas and continuously develop in a dynamic environment. As part of the PreMaster program, you will gain comprehensive insights into controlling in the factory environment and specifically expand your specialist knowledge. During the one-year program, you will take on responsibility for commercial tasks, such as monthly reporting, and develop exciting analyzes for management. You coordinate the interface between the headquarters (business area) and our production plant, act as an important contact person and are responsible for transmitting our key figures. In product controlling, you support economic planning and create forecasts as well as project and investment calculations. You gain insights into other areas through cross-functional collaboration in the factory. If you are interested, a rotation of up to two months in other departments is also possible (e.g. in HR or Supply Chain Management). Last but not least, you can actively contribute and further develop your creativity and personal responsibility in exciting controlling IT projects and special topics. Education: above-average university degree (bachelor's degree) in the field of industrial engineering, business information technology or business administration (ideally with a focus on finance/controlling) as well as the specific intention to subsequently take up a master's degree Experience and know-how: internships or pro

title: Manažer/ka - Forenzní služby
description: To nejdůležitější v pár větách Pomáháme organizacím zvládat situace spojené s podvody, korupcí, praním špinavých peněz či porušováním mezinárodních sankcí a nastavovat efektivní preventivní a compliance mechanismy. Pokud se tedy pohybujete v oblasti auditu nebo compliance, a integrita a odpovědnost jsou pro Vás klíčovými hodnotami, jste na správném místě. Jako Manažer ve forenzním týmu budete součástí širší manažerské skupiny, která je odpovědná za řízení projektů a projektového týmu. Dáme vám příležitost pracovat na rozmanitých poradenských projektech, a budete částečně odpovědní i za obchodní strategii a cíle týmu. Budete spolupracovat s předními globálními korporacemi a finančními institucemi na řešení komplexních a často exponovaných případů. Stanete se součástí zkušeného leadership týmu a multioborové skupiny odborníků, která zahrnuje specialisty na finance, rizika, technologie i bývalé zástupce regulačních a vyšetřovacích orgánů. Ve své roli budete ekonomicky a operativně řídit projekty, pracovat s důkazním materiálem, analyzovat složité transakce a pomáhat klientům chránit a obnovovat jejich finanční i reputační hodnotu. Vedle řešení krizových situací se budete podílet i na nastavování preventivních opatření a posilování etické kultury organizací. Čeká vás i práce v mezinárodním prostředí s našími zahraničními forenzními týmy, vysoká míra odpovědnosti a skutečný dopad vaší práce. Dáme vám příležitost účastnit se odborných konferencí a seminářů a aktivně přispívat ke zlepšování podnikatelského prostředí v České republice. Vaše role v týmu Vedení a řízení forenzních projektů v oblasti vyšetřování podvodů, neetického jednání, posuzování compliance programů nebo řešení sporů a regulatorních záležitostí. Odpovědnost za plánování, koordinaci a úspěšné dodání projektů v požadované kvalitě, rozsahu a termínech. Poskytování odborného poradenství klientům, jejich právním zástupcům a interním týmům v citlivých a komplexních situacích. Řízení a realizace revize dokumentů, finančních a datových analýz v rámci forenzních projektů. Úzká spolupráce s klíčovými stakeholdery, včetně klientů, právníků, auditorů, pojišťoven, regulátorů a partnerů. Příprava, revize a prezentace zpráv, expertních stanovisek a dalších odborných výstupů pro klienty. Spolupráce s multidisciplinárními týmy v rámci organizační struktury EY (finance, risk, technologie, regulatory, legal) na komplexních řešeních pro klienty. Aktivní přispívání k rozvoji metodik, procesů a kvality poskytovaných služeb. Podpora rozvoje týmu prostřednictvím vedení, mentoringu a systematického předávání know-how. Zapojení do rozvoje obchodních příležitostí, přípravy nabídek a budování vztahů s klienty. Sledování regulatorních, technologických a tržních trendů v oblasti forenzních služeb, integrity a řízení rizik. Co je pro nás důležité Minimálně 4-5 let relevantní praxe v oblasti auditu, forenzních služeb, compliance, řízení rizik nebo příbuzných oborů. Výborné komunikační dovednosti a jistota při jednání s managementem, právníky i dalšími stakeholdery. Ochota se dále odborně rozvíjet, vzdělávat a sledovat nové trendy v oboru. Znalost anglického jazyka na úrovni umožňující každodenní profesionální komunikaci v mezinárodním prostředí. description:
About the role:

PwC's Alternative Investment Funds (AIF) team sits within our wider Financial Services Tax team. The team consists of tax, legal and regulatory specialists focusing on assisting alternative investment fund managers with a range of services across their business, covering the manager, the key people, the funds, investors and investments.

Whilst the team is UK based, the nature of the AIF industry means that a large amount of our work is international meaning there are many opportunities to work with the wider PwC AIF network.

As a Manager you will work as part of a team to provide excellent quality advisory and compliance services to a high-profile portfolio of both UK and multinational clients. You will have the opportunity to work on a range of AIF clients, covering strategies including Private Equity, Private Credit, Infrastructure, Hedge Funds and Real Estate.

You will be given the opportunity to develop your skills, drive your ambition and work with experienced Partners, Directors and Senior Managers across the team. The team will provide you with the opportunity to put into practice your tax technical skills in a stimulating and challenging environment.

What your days will look like:

  • The alternative investment funds industry is dynamic, technically demanding and offers opportunities to work on large complex international projects as well as interesting UK tax matters

  • You will be responsible for helping to manage a portfolio of clients, taking responsibility for researching and summarising technical analysis on a broad range of issues covering the manager/advisor, the fund, the fund executives, investors, investments and tax reporting

  • You will work closely with other parts of the business, including the wider Financial Services Tax team and Deals tax and international PwC member firms

  • You will be responsible for building close relationships with a wide range of clients, working as part of a team to deliver the full suite of AIF propositions to clients

  • You will have key relationship responsibilities for tax compliance work that is delivered from our compliance centres, with responsibility for liaising with the compliance centre for a portfolio of clients by participating in client meetings, ensuring timetable adherence, supporting the compliance team with any tax analysis before undertaking a technical review of the work prepared

  • You will coach and support junior members of the team, encouraging everyone to have a voice and inviting opinions from all

This role is for you if:

  • You have strong compliance and advisory focused tax experience in both UK Income and Corporate Tax

  • You are interested in building strong client relationships, owning day-to-day deliverables and managing and developing junior team members

  • You are commercially and operationally proactive and agile and are keen to work in a fast paced, exciting and ever-changing environment, with the support of experienced Partners, Directors and Senior Managers

  • You have a track record of delivering quality work for clients, demonstrating an understanding of the client's business and relevant professional standards and maintaining excellent client relationships. Ideally you will have practical experience of working within one or more of the asset classes (private equity, hedge funds, private credit), but this is not essential

  • You possess an accounting or tax qualification (or an international equivalent) or have equivalent work experience. This includes international candidates who qualify through experience in their home country.

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions. We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

description: Du hast die Steuerberater:innenprüfung absolviert (oder stehst kurz davor) und möchtest deine Karriere im Steuerrecht gezielt weiterentwickeln? In diesem Team bei Deloitte berätst du Familienunternehmen sowie nationale und internationale Unternehmensgruppen in vielfältigen steuerlichen Fragestellungen. Dich erwarten ein abwechslungsreiches Aufgabengebiet , enge Mandant:innenkontakte und vielfältige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten . Was dich erwartet: Du arbeitest eng mit dem verantwortlichen Partner zusammen und wirst frühzeitig in anspruchsvolle Mandate, Akquisitionsprojekte und strategische Fragestellungen eingebunden . Dadurch erhältst du einen tiefen Einblick in die steuerliche Beratung auf höchstem Niveau und übernimmst rasch Verantwortung Du unterstützt bzw. übernimmst die laufende steuerlichen Beratung von Familienunternehmen, Körperschaften sowie nationalen und internationalen Unternehmensgruppen und arbeitest an spannenden Projekten in den Bereichen Ertragsteuern, Umsatzsteuer, Gemeinnützigkeitsrecht und Rechtsformplanung Du unterstützt aktiv beim Ausbau bestehender Mandatsbeziehungen und identifizierst gemeinsam mit dem verantwortlichen Partner neue Beratungsfelder. Dabei entwickelst du ein Gespür für unternehmerische Zusammenhänge und trägst dazu bei, unseren Kundenstamm nachhaltig weiterzuentwickeln Für engagierte Persönlichkeiten bieten wir die Möglichkeit, mittelfristig Führungsverantwortung zu übernehmen und sich in Richtung Manager:in, Senior Manager, Director oder Partner zu entwickeln Qualifikationen Du denkst über die fachliche Lösung hinaus und erkennst Chancen, wie unsere Mandant:innen nachhaltig unterstützt werden können Du gehst gerne auf Menschen zu, kommunizierst auf Augenhöhe und hast Freude daran , langfristige Beziehungen zu Mandant:innen aufzubauen . Du möchtest Verantwortung übernehmen und suchst eine Position, in der du selbst gestalten und Entscheidungen vorbereiten kannst Du hast ein facheinschlägiges Studium (z. B. Rechtswissenschaften, BWL oder Wirtschaftsrecht) erfolgreich abgeschlossen Du hast die Steuerberaterprüfung bereits erfolgreich abgelegt oder stehst kurz vor ihrem Abschluss. Erfüllst du nicht alle genannten Kriterien? Kein Problem! Uns ist bewusst, dass nicht jede:r alle Anforderungen erfüllen kann, deshalb sind wir bereit, in deine Entwicklung zu investieren. Zusätzliche Informationen Jahresbruttogehalt mit abgeschlossener Steuerberaterprüfung ab € 77.000,- (All-In). Deine Vergütung orientiert sich selbstverständlich an deiner individuellen Qualifikation und positionsrelevanten Berufserfahrung. Darüber hinaus erwarten dich attraktive Zusatzleistungen und Benefits. Make an impact that matters. 💚 Wir ermutigen dich, neue Verantwortungen zu übernehmen, dich aktiv in spannende Projekte einzubringen und wertvolle Erfahrungen zu sammeln. Im Gegenzug bieten wir dir exzellente Trainingsprogramme, um deine Karriereziele zu erreichen und dein volles Potenzial zu entfalten. Unsere Unternehmenskultur ist geprägt von starkem Zusammenhalt und unseren gemeinsamen Werten . Dabei ist uns das Wellbeing unserer Mitarbeitenden besonders wichtig. Außerdem bieten wir flexible Arbeitszeiten (4-Tage-Woche möglich) sowie die Möglichkeit im Home Office oder im Büro im Stadtzentrum zu arbeiten. title: Internship - Korporátní finance & Restrukturalizace
description: To nejdůležitější v pár větách V týmu Korporátních financí a restrukturalizací poznáš do hloubky hned několik odvětví a naučíš se komunikovat s bankami a investory. Zapojíme tě do příprav finančních plánů a modelů pro účely restrukturalizací nebo nezávislých hodnocení obchodních plánů. Dozvíš se, jak funguje financování velkých firem, ale i dílčích projektů nebo akvizic a poznáš, jak to chodí ve světě transakcí. Práce sice bude hodně, ale my se postaráme o to, aby ti nic nechybělo. Tvoje role v týmu „Budeš součástí týmu, jehož cílem je záchrana firem, které se i kvůli pandemii dostaly do finančních potíží a jejich management i akcionáři se mohou spolehnout, že uděláme maximum pro to, abychom je dostali z nejhoršího. Častokrát to znamená detailní analýzu klientova businessu a hledání správných míst, kde ušetřit nebo vyjednat lepší podmínky s věřiteli nebo bankami. Naposled se nám to povedlo se společností Smartwings. Studujeme oblast podnikání našich klientů do hloubky. Díky tomu třeba víme, jak fungují letadlové motory, jak se vyrábí elektřina nebo recyklují odpady těmi nejmodernějšími metodami. Taky se díváme na to, jak se trh vyvíjí, vytváříme podrobné finanční plány a modely. V konečné fázi prezentujeme příběhy našich klientů přímo v bance nebo u investorů. Zastupujeme jejich zájmy, argumentujeme a získáváme peníze pro rozjezd, expanzi nebo udržení jejich podnikání. V mém týmu tě čeká zajímavá práce, která současně představuje investici do tvé budoucnosti. Za pár měsíců si osvojíš obrovské množství dovedností, které budeš mít možnost dál rozvíjet a aplikovat v různých projektech. Zaplatíme ti mezinárodní certifikaci CFA (k ní ti dáme placené studijní volno) a umožníme ti podívat se do světa.“ - David Zlámal, Partner, tým Korporátních financí a restrukturalizací Co je pro nás důležité Víme, že jsi teprve na začátku kariéry. Ale tady je několik věcí, které jsou pro tuhle práci podstatné: Studuješ magisterské studium ekonomického zaměření a jsi v posledním nebo předposledním ročníku. Máš čas pracovat minimálně 20 hodin týdně . Orientuješ se v korporátních financích . Finanční modelování, bankovní financování a řízení cash-flow jsou náš denní chléb. Čím víc o tom víš, tím snazší budou tvé začátky. Nemáš strach z angličtiny . Používáme ji opravdu často – při schůzkách s klienty i při práci se zahraničními kolegy. Chceš pestrou práci , protože každý den se budeš učit nové věci. Během dne tě čeká práce na více projektech současně, a tak se ti hodí i chladná hlava a dobrý time-management. Vzájemná chemie . Dobře víme, že kde to nefunguje lidsky, to drhne i po pracovní stránce. A tak je pro nás důležité, abychom si rozuměli. Náš tým tvoří parta mladých lidí, kteří začínali jako teď ty. Baví nás spolu pracovat, ale i trávit čas po práci nebo na týmových nebo firemních akcích. Jak se ti odměníme Nástupní mzda 200 Kč/hod., smlouvu na HPP (zkrácený úvazek) a k tomu benefity, které ti zaručeně udělají radost. Tady je pár z nich: Volno : Placená dovolená dle odpracovaných hodin. Odměna za doporučení kandidáta : Získej od 10 do 70 tisíc Kč za doporučení nového kolegy. Benefitní body v Cafeterii můžeš utratit podle sebe. Třeba si pořídit Multisport kartu, nakoupit dárky nebo si užít odpočinek na Slevomatu. Profesionální rozvoj : U nás se neustále učíš a rozvíjíš své schopnosti. Nabízíme ti jedinečný program profesního rozvoje a pestrou paletu kurzů v naší learningové mapě. Můžeš využívat přístup ke vzdělávacímu portálu Udemy.com a k jazykovým kurzům. Naši kolegové ti poskytnou podporu v podobě counselingu a interního koučinku. iPhone a laptop i k soukromému používání. Slevy pro zaměstnance : Užij si skvělé zvýhodněné nabídky na širokou škálu služeb. Využij slevy ve Fruitisimo, Sushi Time, optice, fitness centru BodyBody a na dalších místech. Zdraví a péče : Získej přístup k rychlému a pohodlnému online poradenství uLékaře.cz od kvalifikovaných lékařů. Navíc ti zaplatíme i životní pojištění. Týmová spolupráce a zábava : U nás nejde jen o práci, ale také o zábavu a týmovou spolupráci. Nejen po úspěšném dokončení velkých projektů tě čekají odměny ve formě večeří, bowlingu, firemních večírků a dalších skvělých akcí, které posilují naši týmovou atmosféru. Můžeš se také zapojit do CSR aktivit. Co tě čeká po odeslání přihlášky Prvním krokem jsou online vstupní testy , které vyplníš doma. Budou celkem tři: z angličtiny, z numerického myšlení a deduktivního myšlení. Na tyto testy budeš mít týden a budeme rádi, když je stihneš vyplnit včas.

title: Specialist inom risk och kvalitet
description: Hos oss på division Nät är du med och bygger ut samt underhåller stamnätet – en avgörande del av Sveriges elektrifiering. För att lyckas med vårt samhällsviktiga uppdrag behöver vi varje år bygga 30 mil ledningar och driftsätta 20 stationer. Tillsammans skapar vi en stabil och hållbar energiinfrastruktur för framtiden. Om tjänsten Vi söker nu en eller flera specialister inom risk och kvalitet som vill vara med och bidra till utvecklingen av Sveriges transmissionsnät. Våra anläggningsprojekt omfattar luftledningar, kablar och stationer och är avgörande för att möta framtidens behov av en trygg och säker elförsörjning. Som specialist inom risk och kvalitet ger du kvalificerat stöd till program och projekt genom hela genomförandet. Rollen kan ha inriktning mot risk, kvalitet eller en kombination av båda områdena, beroende på din kompetens och erfarenhet. Du är en viktig samarbetspartner till program- och projektledare och bidrar till att stärka projektens styrning, uppföljning och måluppfyllelse. Inom riskområdet arbetar du bland annat med att planera, leda och dokumentera riskanalyser samt stödja program och projekt i arbetet med att identifiera, hantera och följa upp risker och åtgärder. Du bidrar även till rapportering, analyser av riskbilder och uppföljning av trender för att skapa goda beslutsunderlag. Inom kvalitetsområdet stöttar du program och projekt i planering, genomförande och uppföljning av kvalitetsrelaterade arbetssätt och processer. Du bidrar till att säkerställa att styrande krav, rutiner och metoder tillämpas på ett effektivt och ändamålsenligt sätt samt verkar för ett strukturerat förbättringsarbete. En del av rollen är att planera, leda och delta i workshops där arbetssätt utvecklas, implementeras och följs upp. Du bidrar även till erfarenhetsåterföring och spridning av kunskap inom verksamheten. Arbetsuppgifterna varierar beroende på programmens och projektens behov, men kan bland annat innebära att du: Planerar, genomför och dokumenterar riskanalyser enligt Svenska kraftnäts styrande dokument. Stödjer program- och projektledare i operativ riskhantering och uppföljning av åtgärder. Sammanställer, analyserar och följer upp riskbilder, trender och utvecklingsområden. Bidrar till styrning och uppföljning av kvalitetsarbetet i program och projekt. Ger stöd och utbildning i ledningssystem, processer och arbetssätt. Introducerar nya medarbetare i risk- och kvalitetsrelaterade arbetssätt. Bidrar vid framtagande av program- och projektplaner samt etablering av risk- och kvalitetsarbete. Utvecklar strukturer och metoder för uppföljning ur ett risk- och kvalitetsperspektiv. Medverkar i utveckling och ständiga förbättringar av arbetssätt och processer. Stödjer arbetet med erfarenhetsåterföring och organisatoriskt lärande. Som specialist inom risk och kvalitet blir du en del av enheten Program och Projektstöd som består av specialister inom risk, kvalitet, tidsplanering och projektekonomi. Enheten tillhör avdelningen Anläggningsinvesteringar med uppdrag att säkerhetsställa strukturerade och effektiva genomförande av våra investeringsprojekt med fokus på tid, kostnad och resultat. För dig som har erfarenhet av och intresse för verksamhetsutveckling erbjuder rollen goda möjligheter att bidra till den fortsatta utvecklingen av Svenska kraftnäts arbetssätt inom risk och kvalitet. Genom ditt arbete är du med och stärker vår projektverksamhet och bidrar till ett robust och framtidssäkert transmissionsnät för Sverige. Om dig Skallkrav: Personliga egenskaper: För att trivas i rollen ser vi att du är samarbetsorienterad och har lätt för att anpassa dig och hitta lösningar tillsammans med kollegor med fokus på det gemensamma målet. För att bli framgångsrik i den här rollen tycker du om att arbeta i en organisation i förändring och blir stimulerad av att hitta nya lösningar och arbetssätt. Du tar gärna egna initiativ och du har såväl helhetsperspektiv likväl som strategiskt perspektiv på frågor. Som person är du strukturerad och organiserar ditt arbete väl med fokus på mål och resultat. Du ska också leva upp till https://www.statskontoret.se/forvaltningskultur/den-statliga-vardegrunden/ I denna rekrytering lägger vi stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper. Utbildning: Du har en akademisk utbildning inom relevant ämnesområde eller motsvarande kompetens förvärvad på annat sätt som vi bedömer likvärdig. Du har även: Flerårig erfarenhet av att arbeta med risk- och/eller kvalitetsarbete inom större infrastruktur- och/eller anläggningsprojekt. God förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska. title: Associate Director, Private Capital Tax, Financial Investors
description: Connect to your Industry The Private Capital Tax team combines market-leading tax expertise in credit transactions, fund structuring, investment manager advisory and investor tax reporting. The client base includes some of the largest global asset managers and alternative investment funds. The team works with all alternative asset classes and includes Deloitte’s credit and restructuring tax specialists. We are looking for Associate Directors to support our work with alternative asset managers across private equity, debt, real estate, infrastructure and hedge funds. This role will include advising asset management firms on the structure of the fund, the structure and remuneration of the fund manager, and the taxation of investment returns to investors and the senior management teams. We work alongside credit transactions specialists in our team, and closely with our M&A and Real Estate tax teams, to provide joined-up comprehensive solutions to our clients. You will be working alongside partners and directors in non-hierarchical client teams as well as within wider global project teams. Deloitte takes your development very seriously. You'll benefit from continuous training and a transparent, interactive appraisal process. You'll be empowered to manage your own workload and achieve career goals that you set yourself, in a team with a proven track record for strong progression. We encourage consideration of flexible ways of working, both formal and informal arrangements that allow for the best outcomes for our people and our clients. If this opportunity is of interest to you with some flexibilities, please do discuss it with us. Connect to your career at Deloitte Deloitte drives progress. Using our vast range of expertise, we help our clients' become leaders wherever they choose to compete. To do this, we invest in outstanding people. We build teams of future thinkers, with diverse talents and backgrounds, and empower them all to reach for and achieve more. What brings us all together at Deloitte? It’s how we approach the thousands of decisions we make every day. How we behave, our beliefs and our attitudes. In other words: our values. Whatever we do, wherever we are in the world, we lead the way , serve with integrity , take care of each other , foster inclusion , and collaborate for measurable impact . These five shared values lead every decision we make and action we take, guiding us to deliver impact how and where it matters most . Connect to your opportunity In this team, your role in the group could encompass some or all the following: Advising on a broad array of tax issues relating to the advisor/manager of private equity, credit, real estate, infrastructure or hedge funds, ranging from structuring global carried interest and co-investment plans to structuring the fund and the fund management business. Providing bespoke tax advice in relation to long-term incentives and complex fund investments for fund management staff. Reviewing corporate and partnership tax computations, as well as carry/co-investment reporting schedules prepared by the team for investors or the fund management team. Advising fund managers on the potential tax implications for their clients of making investments in certain Funds of Funds. Managing diverse teams (including from other Deloitte member firms) within an inclusive and collaborative team culture, where people are recognised for their contribution. Contributing to the eminence of our team within the wider Deloitte tax practice and in the market through knowledge sharing and thought leadership. Contributing to the growth and success of our team by engaging in the professional development of our junior team members. PwC Consulting is seeking a Senior Manager to lead our Underwriting Transformation efforts in the Insurance sector. You will work with senior leaders across London Market and global carriers to define and deliver strategic underwriting and product modernisation initiatives.

You will shape best practices in building standardised product models, transforming underwriting operations, and implementing platforms such as underwriting workbenches and core policy administration solutions for commercial and specialty insurers. No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

You will contribute to strategic initiatives such as the S/4HANA rollout, support international projects, and collaborate with diverse teams across regions. Working within a motivated, international team, you will be part of a journey that shapes the future of Continental Tires’ digital landscape. As a key member of our CKU team, you will manage and optimize sales-focused EDI connections, ensuring smooth operations and supporting critical business processes within the Tire division. Working closely with global colleagues, you will drive the strategic development of EDI capabilities and ensure successful implementation of initiatives related to support, development, training, and continuous improvement across all regions. Maintain and enhance global Order-to-Cash processes aligned with strategic and operational needs, ensuring compliance with EDI standards. Represent Continental EDI globally in IT and business projects. Coordinate projects and requirements with business, IT, LKUs, CKUs, and SAP module teams. Vi bidrager til, at Danmark har en stærk stemme i de internationale organisationer på sundhedsområdet, og for at dansk ekspertise bidrager til håndteringen af globale sundhedsudfordringer. Vi er i Center for det behandlende sundhedsvæsen herudover ansvarlige for en række centrale områder og initiativer. Inden for sygehuspolitik beskæftiger vi os bl.a. med kræftområdet, demens, akutberedskab, udvikling af sundhedstilbud i Grønland og videreuddannelse af læger. Som praktikant hos os vil du arbejde med og få indsigt i de politiske, økonomiske og juridiske rammer for kerneopgaverne i sundhedsvæsenet. Du vil blive tilknyttet et af centerets tre områder (sygehuspolitik, psykiatri eller det borgernære sundhedsvæsen) med mulighed for opgaver på tværs af centeret. Kontor for Sundhedsstruktur I Kontor for Sundhedsstruktur arbejder vi med den overordnede udvikling i sundhedsvæsenet, herunder hvordan sundhedsvæsenet skal indrettes i fremtiden. Konkret understøtter vi arbejdet med sundhedsreformen, hvor det er kontorets opgave at understøtte og følge op på reformens implementering, og derigennem bidrage til et mere lige, nært og sammenhængende sundhedsvæsen. Det er også i vores center, at vi har ansvaret for at udarbejde politiske beslutningsgrundlag til regeringen, udvalgsarbejder og koordination af større økonomiske forhandlinger og aftaler, der bidrager til en bedre incitamentsstruktur, styring og ressourceanvendelse på sundhedsområdet. Vi har ansvaret for styringen af regionernes økonomi, både ift. opfølgning på regionernes sygehusbyggerier og aftaler om regionernes økonomiske drift. Vi har ansvaret for en stabil og tidssvarende it-infrastruktur. Vi arbejder med en bred og mangfoldig interessentkreds, og arbejder for at styrke brugeroplevelsen gennem digital udvikling. description:
About the Role:

As a quant developer within the team, you will direct the architecture, extension and maintenance of our Python codebase that performs valuation of financial instruments. This is an individual contributor role that requires expertise in both the mathematical modelling of financial instruments, across asset classes, and python software engineering.

What your days will look like:

  • Maintenance and extension of an existing codebase, written primarily in Python with .Net components which maps/transforms trade static data between various formats: XML, JSON, CSV, Excel, etc.
  • Extend code base through addition of :
    • new derivative valuation and risk models
    • updates and improvements to user interfaces
    • other add hoc incremental features
  • Maintain and extend a RESTful API server application
  • Maintenance and extending a internal model base and help the team on-board third party provided models and artificial intelligence.
  • Lead in discussions to help drive software architecture/design.
  • Provide support in estimating clients financial instrument valuations (private credit, debt and derivative), across a wide range of instrument types.
  • Assist in areas of business development, practice development and strategy – due to the high growth nature of Artificial Intelligence & Modelling this will be a key component of the role.

This role is for you if:

  • Advanced experience and knowledge of Python software development in industry or academia
  • Degree in computer science, engineering, physics, or mathematics or equivalent work experience . This includes international candidates who qualify through experience in their home country.
  • Experience working on large codebases
  • A deep understanding of derivative pricing including the related XVAs
  • Theoretical understanding of and hands-on experience in developing mathematical models
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail but tempered with an ability to think laterally.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to present complex issues in a clear and articulate way to a non-technical audience.
  • Familiarity with software engineering best practices.
  • Familiarity with source control (ideally Git).

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions. We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

description: At Franklin Templeton, we believe success is built through powerful partnerships. As a forward thinking asset manager, we build dynamic relationships with clients, understand their goals, and navigate complex markets together. We leverage cutting edge strategies and deep insights to unlock opportunities for long term wealth creation. Our talented, global teams bring expertise that is both broad and unique. From our welcoming, inclusive, and supportive culture to our globally diverse business, we offer opportunities not only to help you reach your potential, but also to contribute to our clients’ success. HYBRID schedule in our Baltimore or New York office 2 Opportunities Available! About the Department The Equity Risk function plays a critical role in providing independent oversight of the firm’s equity business by delivering rigorous portfolio analytics and actionable risk insights. The team ensures that portfolio risks align with investment objectives, client expectations, and industry standards, with a strong focus on liquidity, market, and concentration risks. Working closely with portfolio managers and senior stakeholders, the group combines deep technical expertise with sound judgment to identify key drivers of risk, distinguish long-term structural exposures from short-term market movements, and continuously enhance the firm’s risk framework and analytical capabilities, including the implementation of advanced risk systems such as Aladdin. How You Will Add Value You will identify and assess key risks and trends by conducting in-depth risk analysis across style, sector, country, cap-size, and other dimensions using tools such as Barra, Aladdin, or similar risk systems. You will translate complex quantitative output into concise insights and message to communicate with portfolio managers and senior executives. You will apply advanced analytical methods, including AI and visualization, to improve the efficiency, consistency, and insightfulness of risk monitoring. You will stay abreast of industry trends, market developments and emerging risk themes to proactively identify potential vulnerabilities and strengthen the risk oversight function. You will help lead the team’s transition to Aladdin, including analytics validation, model comparison, interpretation of outputs, and dashboard enhancements. What Will Help You Be Successful in This Role Experience, Education & Certifications 10+ years of direct experience in asset management, ideally focused on equity market risk, investment risk, or investment departments; direct equity risk experience highly preferred. Quantitative or scientific degree preferred; CFA, FRM, or PRM progress/completion preferred. Technical Skills Experience with volatility, tracking error, factor/security/sector risk decomposition, and portfolio risk profiles. Experience with industry-standard risk modeling, specifically MSCI BarraOne or Aladdin Green Package Demonstrated ability to process, analyze, and visualize data; programming skills in common visualization, languages/statistical packages, with Power BI, Python preferred. Soft Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Clear communication with technical and non-technical audiences. High level of ownership and sound judgment. Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining focus on high impact initiatives. title: Trusts Tax Compliance | Senior Associate
description:

Our Tax Compliance team is a leading provider of technology enabled compliance and integrated advisory services, working across an unrivalled range of prestigious clients. The variety of work, size of our team and focus on learning and development brings about opportunities to specialise in particular industries or technical areas.

Our team is agile and open to new ways of working. The investment in automation and robotics enables us to be at the forefront of change and innovation. Together, we produce technical excellence, innovative solutions and an outstanding client experience.

Within this overall Tax compliance team, our specialist trust compliance team is responsible for the delivery of trust accounts, trust returns and Inheritance Tax returns for some significant UK trusts alongside a varied offshore trust portfolio. title: Graver søges til Ans-Grønbæk Sogn med primært tjenestested ved Grønbæk Kirke
description: Da vores graver gennem mange år har valgt at gå på pension, søger vi en ny graver. Der er tale om en graverstilling på fuld tid inkl. kirketjeneste. Der er på kirkegården, udover graveren, ansat to gravermedhjælpere. Søndagsgudstjenester sker i tæt samarbejde med de øvrige medarbejdere ved vore to kirker. Grønbæk Kirke er en gammel middelalderkirke med en stor kirkegård. Dine opgaver er: Pleje og vedligeholdelse af kirkegårdens gravsteder, hække og grønne områder. Koordinering: planlægning af arbejdsopgaver (begravelser vedligeholdelse, sæsonarbejde) i samarbejde med graverteamet, menighedsrådet og den personaleansvarlige Opgaver i forbindelse med begravelser, bisættelser og urnenedsættelser, herunder også kontakt med de pårørende. Kirketjeneste: medvirken ved gudstjenester og kirkelige handlinger i tæt samarbejde med præst, organist og kirkesanger. Administrative opgaver med gravstedsaftaler, indkøb og indhentning af tilbud, overordnet ansvar for vedligehold af maskinpark Vi søger en profil, der: Har uddannelse eller erfaring indenfor det grønne område, og gerne med erfaring fra arbejde på en kirkegård Arbejder struktureret, har et godt overblik, og sætter en ære i, at både kirke og kirkegård fremstår velvedligeholdt og imødekommende. Er udadvendt, rummelig og møder kirkegårdens gæster og kirkegængere med empati og respekt. Besidder gode samarbejdsevner og har lyst til at indgå i et aktivt og positivt arbejdsfællesskab med såvel kollegaerne ved Grønbæk Kirke som med graver og gravermedhjælper ved Ans Kirke. title: PhD Research Scholar positions - Department of Finance
description: The PhD specialisation NHH is pleased to announce openings in the PhD specialisation in Finance. Candidates admitted to the PhD programme will receive the title of PhD Research Scholar. The Department of Finance has 23 faculty members, two-thirds of whom are international. Research at the department spans all major fields of finance, including corporate finance, asset pricing and market microstructure. Faculty regularly publish in the top academic journals and are one of the leading finance groups in Europe. The department has an active research seminar series featuring invited top scholars and an internal brown bag seminar series. The PhD specialisation in Finance gives PhD research scholars the theoretical knowledge and methodological skills necessary to become successful researchers. It combines a one-year intensive course portfolio with ample time to do research and write a dissertation. PhD research scholars work closely with their thesis advisors and receive feedback by presenting their research in internal seminars. The department offers a stimulating research environment and encourages PhD research scholars to participate in its many research activities. We have a strong record of placing graduates in international academic institutions. Research and conference travels are strongly encouraged and funding for these purposes is usually available. The Department of Finance is well connected internationally and is a member of the Nordic Finance Network. Many of our PhD research scholars spend a semester or a year abroad visiting another university. The PhD specialisation in Finance, which has a total of 10 to 12 PhD research scholars, is an important integrated part of the department’s research environment. See the department’s website here: Department of Finance | NHH Start date: August 2027 The PhD programme The PhD programme at NHH is a four-year fully-funded programme, which combines an intensive course component with research and relevant work experience, preparing the school’s graduates for scholarly positions at recognised international institutions and positions in knowledge-intensive institutions and firms outside of academia. Former PhD graduates have been hired by renowned institutions such as Harvard University, The University of Sydney’s Business School, University of Amsterdam, Tilburg University, Hanken School of Economics, Norwegian universities and business schools, as well as by government, banking, finance and consulting industries. The PhD research scholars will be included in a highly stimulating and rewarding research environment, working closely with faculty members and other PhD research scholars at the school. PhD research scholars participate actively in faculty and research seminars, as well as in workshops. As part of the position, the PhD research scholars allocate 25% of their time to career promoting work such as teaching assistance. They also receive pedagogical training. The place of work is at NHH in Bergen, where the PhD research scholars will have their own office space at their department. The PhD programme gives preference to applicants who address research questions that align with the department’s research interests and the available resources for supervision. As the school aspires gender balance and diversity, female applicants will be given preference if applicants are otherwise equally qualified. NHH offers annual salary of NOK 570 000 (equivalent to approximately EUR 50 741 or USD 58 121) pr. August 2027. For particularly well-qualified applicants, a higher salary may be considered. Thereafter annual adjustment of minimum 3%. The salary ensures a fair standard of living in Norway and is subject to Norwegian taxes and benefits, including public health care benefits and pension savings career guidance and an individual career development plan opportunity to take basic Norwegian language courses research funds for travels and funding for conference participation and research stays abroad to build a wider network and strengthen the research of the PhD research scholar The city of Bergen offers a mild coastal climate and hosts rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities, as well as a family-friendly environment. Note that public healthcare, public schooling for children, and most other public services are free in Norway. To explore Norway and the city of Bergen, go to visitnorway.com . Eligibility requirements Applicants must meet the eligibility requirements for the PhD programme. Applicants must normally have completed a five-year Master of Science (MSc) degree in Economics and Business Administration or a comparable degree. The average grade must normally correspond to a minimum of B (4.0) in the Norwegian grade system. The Department of Finance requires you to demonstrate both an adequate level of academic skills and an adequate level of English language proficiency (unless you are exempt). We accept the following tests: GMAT or GRE tests to measure your academic skills TOEFL, IELTS or PTE Academic to measure your English language proficiency When applying, you are required to upload a copy of your unofficial test scores in Jobbnorge before the deadline. If you are shortlisted, NHH will ask you to give us access to your official test scores without delay. Exemptions: You are waived from the GMAT or GRE tests if you hold a qualifying master’s degree from a Nordic institution. You are waived from TOEFL, IELTS or PTE Academic tests if you are a native English speaker, if you have a qualifying master’s degree from a Nordic institution or if you have a qualifying master’s degree where the language of tuition was English. For more detailed information about the tests and their minimum scores, please visit our webpage: Admission to the PhD programme| NHH . If you have questions, you may contact phd@nhh.no . Application requirements You are required to upload the following documents with your application in Jobbnorge: Certificate of your master’s degree or equivalent, including transcripts of records. You need to have completed your master’s degree prior to the starting date for the position. If you have not completed your degree when applying for the position, please attach a transcript of records of the courses and grades that you have completed so far. Certificate of your bachelor’s degree or equivalent, including transcripts of records. Other relevant certificates or transcripts (e.g. courses completed at the PhD level). If the issuing authority of grades and degrees does not use the ECTS grading scale, include an official description of the grading scale used. Statement of purpose describing your motivation for applying for this position (250-300 words). A research proposal (2000-4000 words). The research proposal should describe the aims, research questions, and motivation of the proposed research. Please note that your research proposal is tentative and often needs adjustments after your acceptance into the programme. Curriculum vitae. A list of all publications and/or other documented research activities. Please upload the documents in separate files, not combined in one single file. Letters of recommendation and contact details of references: Letters of recommendation and/or contact details of references may strengthen your application, but they are not mandatory. If you choose to include letters of recommendations, the references should send their letter of recommendation in PDF format to hr-phd@nhh.no by latest 15 September 2026. Contact details of references may be included in Jobbnorge when you apply. General information For more information on the PhD programme and the submission procedure, please consult the NHH PhD website . Incomplete applications will not be considered. Please note that applicants for the PhD research scholar position do not need to apply separately for admission to the PhD programme. NHH emphasises diversity and encourages qualified candidates to apply for the position regardless of gender, cultural background, age and disabilities. In accordance with §25 (2) of the Freedom of Information Act, information about applicants may be made public even if they have requested not to have their names entered on the list of applicants. Applicants will be notified if their request is not granted. As part of the recruitment process, a background check may be conducted with the candidates' consent. For questions and inquiries about the NHH PhD programme, please contact phd@nhh.no . Applications must be submitted through the Jobbnorge online portal. To open the application, please click ‘Apply for this job’. For the English version, go to the menu at the top right side. Application deadline: 15 September 2026 PhD programme at NHH Let a PhD from NHH be your next career step! Video: https://youtu.be/uALqnX_Lqio

title: Senior Enhanced Index Portfolio Manager
description: Please note this position is based in London and this will be the contractual location of the successful candidate, other locations cannot be considered. Senior Enhanced Index Portfolio Manager This is a great job for someone who has deep knowledge of passive equity investing with sophisticated quantitative and engineering capabilities. A bit about the job: We are seeking a highly experienced Enhanced Index Portfolio Manager to join our Portfolio Implementation & Investment Engineering team. With deep expertise in managing passively constructed equity beta solutions, the successful candidate will play a leading role in shaping the evolution of our Enhanced Index strategies, driving process innovation, and ensuring strong alignment between portfolio outcomes and investment intent. The Enhanced Equity business has experienced significant growth in AUM over the last 3 years to £65bn under management and expected to double over the next few years. The new addition to the team will combine deep knowledge of passive equity investing with quantitative and engineering capabilities, contributing to the design, optimisation, and day-to-day implementation of our strategies. As a senior practitioner, you will provide both thought leadership and hands-on portfolio management execution within a collaborative team environment. In this role, you will lead enhancements to our investment processes—refining models, strengthening portfolio construction, overseeing liquidity and cash equitisation, rebalancing, corporate actions, guideline compliance, and ongoing risk and performance monitoring. You will also drive index methodology and event analysis, translating changes such as additions, deletions, IPOs, free‑float adjustments, and sector reclassifications into proactive portfolio positioning and efficient implementation across mandates. Working closely with Investment Engineering and Trading, you will help design and industrialise scalable tools that improve risk management, liquidity assessment, portfolio construction, execution quality, and operational efficiency. Additionally, you will contribute to innovation across the wider investment platform by challenging established approaches and embedding best‑practice principles that support business growth through next‑generation automation. Skills and experience we’re looking for: Proven track record managing passive and enhanced‑index equity portfolios across regional and global markets, using advanced portfolio‑optimisation tools and an engineering mindset to deliver low‑risk equity beta solutions for clients. Deep understanding of equity instruments, trading mechanics, market microstructure, benchmark construction, index methodologies and end to end investment processes applied to managing large portfolios (>GBP 100bn). Confidence to challenge established processes constructively. Propose evidence-based improvements and ability to translate complex technical ideas into clear concepts for non-specialist stakeholders. Naturally inquisitive and innovative, with a passion for solving complex portfolio‑construction, implementation and trading challenges in a team‑based environment. This means that we’ll need to complete some regulatory background checks on you before you take up your role and we’ll need to ask you some questions on an annual basis to make sure you remain ‘fit and proper’ and competent to carry out your role. We’ll provide training on what holding a SMCR role means when you join us and annually thereafter. Aviva is for everyone: We’re inclusive and welcome everyone – we want applications from all backgrounds and experiences. Excited but not sure you tick every box? description: Do you want to work at the intersection of quantitative finance, technology, and client delivery? As a Quantitative Analyst in Risk & Valuation Services, you will develop and deliver advanced models, systems, and services in close collaboration with sophisticated institutional clients. You will combine analytical depth with practical problem solving and contribute directly to how quantitative solutions are designed, implemented, and used in real world decision making. Founded in 1856, SEB is a leading Northern European financial services group with a strong focus on long term client relationships. We support corporates, financial institutions, and investors with advisory, financing, and post trade services. Risk & Valuation Services is part of SEB's post trade and portfolio solutions offering, providing independent risk measures, valuations, and quantitative services to institutional clients across funds, insurance companies, pension institutions, banks, and corporates.
