title: Business controller till Platzer, Göteborg
description: Om rollen Som Business controller har du en viktig roll i att stärka bolagets ekonomistyrning och bidra med uppföljning, analys och beslutsstöd. Du arbetar tvärfunktionellt och fungerar som en brygga mellan ekonomi, verksamhet och system – med särskilt fokus på visualisering och pedagogisk kommunikation av finansiell information. Du utvecklar arbetssätt och rapporteringsstrukturer som gör data mer tillgänglig, tillförlitlig och användbar, samtidigt som du säkerställer hög kvalitet i återkommande leveranser. Eftersom Platzer är börsnoterat omfattar rollen analyser och underlag till extern rapportering, vilket ställer höga krav på struktur, precision och kvalitet inom givna tidsramar. Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter Bidra till vidareutveckling av budget-, prognos- och uppföljningsprocesser, samt analys och rapportering av resultat och nyckeltal för bolaget som helhet. Ta fram finansiella analyser, rapportpaket och beslutsunderlag till ledning, styrelse och extern rapportering. Vara drivande i att utveckla hur verksamheten använder data, BI och visualisering för att skapa insikter, effektivisera arbetssätt och möjliggöra bättre affärsbeslut. Systemförvalta och vidareutveckla vårt rapporteringssystem Insikt och andra analysverktyg för att skapa effektiva och verksamhetsanpassade processer och stöd. Utforska och driva initiativ inom AI, analys och automatisering. Du arbetar nära dina två controllerkollegor som ansvarar för varsitt affärsområde och du rapporterar till vår controllerchef Caroline. Din bakgrund Vi söker dig som har flerårig erfarenhet från en affärsnära controllerroll, gärna bolagsövergripande. Mycket goda kunskaper i Excel i kombination med gedigen erfarenhet av BI-verktyg, exempelvis Power BI är en självklar del av din kompetens. Erfarenhet av att arbeta med större datamängder och omsätta dessa till tydliga beslutsunderlag, insikter och rekommendationer som skapar affärsvärde är en viktig del av din bakgrund. Likaså att kunna presentera information på ett strukturerat och pedagogiskt sätt, gärna med hjälp av visualiseringar. Du har ett stort intresse för ny teknik och ser möjligheter i hur AI och automatisering kan användas i analys- och rapportarbete. För att trivas och lyckas i rollen är det viktigt att kunna kombinera analys med en tydlig affärsförståelse. Ett initiativrikt och nyfiket förhållningssätt, med förmåga att driva frågor framåt- både självständigt och i samverkan med andra, är viktiga egenskaper. Kommer du från fastighetsbranschen med kunskap inom fastighetsekonomi är det värdefullt och i grunden har du akademisk examen inom ekonomi eller motsvarande. Hos oss behöver du vara prestigelös och uppskatta en miljö där alla processer inte är färdigdefinierade och där du får utrymme att bidra med idéer och utveckla hur vi arbetar. Vi värdesätter ett klimat där det är okej att testa, fråga och utmana – och där vi hjälper varandra att bli bättre. Vad vi erbjuder dig Vi är cirka 90 medarbetare med olika bakgrund och kompetens, samlade på vårt huvudkontor i Lilla Bommen. Kulturen präglas av samarbete, öppenhet och ansvarstagande. Vi har höga ambitioner och ett starkt fokus på långsiktigt värdeskapande, samtidigt som vi värdesätter ett gott arbetsklimat och goda relationer. Vi erbjuder marknadsmässiga villkor, kollektivavtal, tjänstepension, extra ledighet i form av arbetstidsbank, friskvårdsbidrag och möjlighet till bonus. Ansökan Välkommen med din ansökan! Lead the commercial management of a portfolio of high-value operational contracts, ensuring performance, contractual compliance, risk mitigation, and value delivery throughout the contract lifecycle. Lead complex commercial negotiations, major contract amendments, claims, disputes, and other high-impact contractual matters with strategic suppliers and contractors. Drive commercial performance by identifying opportunities to improve contract outcomes, reduce lifecycle costs, manage risk, and strengthen supplier collaboration across the portfolio. Provide clear commercial, contractual, and financial recommendations that support robust decision-making and long-term asset value creation. Shape and continuously improve commercial governance, contract management standards, reporting, and best practices across Offshore Wind Operations. Coach and support commercial colleagues while acting as a subject matter expert for complex commercial and contractual issues across the business. Who are you? You are an experienced commercial professional who combines strong commercial judgement with the ability to influence complex business decisions. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, balancing stakeholder interests and managing high-impact contractual matters in a large-scale operational environment. You enjoy working across functions and are recognised for your ability to build trust, challenge constructively and create sustainable business value. Next to this you bring: A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Economics, Law, Engineering, or a related discipline. Extensive experience in contract management, commercial management, procurement, supplier management, or a comparable commercial discipline. Proven success leading complex commercial negotiations and managing high-value supplier and service agreements within asset-intensive industries. Strong expertise in contract strategy, contract changes, claims management, dispute resolution, and commercial risk management. Experience within offshore wind, renewable energy, utilities, maritime, infrastructure, oil & gas, or other complex operational environments. The ability to influence senior stakeholders, build trusted relationships across functions, and translate complex commercial matters into practical business decisions. Native-level German and fluent English language skills, with the ability to lead negotiations, manage contractual discussions, and to operate effectively in an international environment. Location Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam or Kolding.

title: Senior Consultant Public Sector - Finanzen und Controlling (w/m/d)
location: Berlin, DE · Frankfurt, DE · München, DE · Düsseldorf, DE · Hamburg, DE · Köln, DE · Stuttgart, DE · Mannheim, DE · Nürnberg, DE · Hannover, DE · Leipzig, DE · Bielefeld, DE · Bremen, DE · Essen, DE · Münster, DE · Dortmund, DE · Mainz, DE · Ulm, DE · Dresden, DE · Karlsruhe, DE · Saarbrücken, DE · Augsburg, DE · Friedrichshafen, DE · Jena, DE · Kiel, DE · Neuss, DE · Regensburg, DE
description: Du willst Deine Expertise im Bereich Finanzen und Controlling aktiv einbringen und unsere Mandant:innen beraten und unterstützen? Dann kannst Du Dich hier aktiv einbringen: Du übernimmst die Betreuung unserer Mandant:innen aus allen Bereichen des öffentlichen Sektors bei kleinen wie großen Transformationsprojekten im Finanz- und Rechnungswesen. Du wirkst bei der Einführung neuer Rechnungslegungsgrundsätze, neuer IT-Systeme und eines neuen Berichtswesens aktiv mit. Die Analyse und Optimierung der Buchhaltungs- und Abschlussprozesse unserer Mandant:innen und die Dokumentation und Visualisierung von Organisations- und Prozessanalysen gehören ebenfalls zu Deinem Aufgabengebiet. Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung von handelsrechtlichen Einzel- und Konzernabschlüssen nach aktuellen Bilanzierungsstandards. Die Entwicklung von Ziel- und Steuerungskonzeptionen mittels Kennzahlen, Implementierung von Business Intelligence- und Data & Analytics-Lösungsansätzen treibst Du weiter voran. Darüber hinaus hilfst Du bei der Einführung von Systemen der Kosten- und Leistungsrechnung und Performanceoptimierung. Du arbeitest an Studien und bei der Veröffentlichung von Fachartikeln mit sowie bei der Durchführung von Vorträgen in Fachkreisen.
description_en: Do you want to actively contribute your expertise in the area of ​​finance and controlling and advise and support our clients? Then you can get actively involved here: You will be responsible for supporting our clients from all areas of the public sector in small and large transformation projects in finance and accounting. You will be actively involved in the introduction of new accounting principles, new IT systems and new reporting systems. The analysis and optimization of our clients' accounting and closing processes and the documentation and visualization of organizational and process analyzes are also part of your area of ​​responsibility. You support the preparation of individual and consolidated financial statements under commercial law in accordance with current accounting standards. You will continue to drive forward the development of goal and control concepts using key figures and the implementation of business intelligence and data & analytics solution approaches. In addition, you will help with the introduction of cost and performance accounting and performance optimization systems. You will work on studies and publish specialist articles as well as give lectures in specialist circles.

Für Dich, für die Gesellschaft, für die Unternehmen, für die Region Rhein-Nahe und Umland. Wichtig für Mensch und Wirtschaft Seit der Gründung im Jahr 1835 sind wir die S für alle Menschen im schönen Rhein- und SooNahe-Land. Wir sammeln Einlagen in der Region und vergeben Kredite vor Ort. Damit halten wir den regionalen Geld- und Wirtschaftskreislauf in Schwung und tragen dazu bei, Wachstum und Arbeits- und Ausbildungsplätze zu schaffen und zu sichern. title: Senior Business Controller
description: Senior Business Controller till BST BST Group är Nordens ledande installations- och servicekoncern inom brandteknik, installation, service, rådgivning och säkerhetslösningar med Norvestor som PE-ägare. BST ser till att det brandskydd som skyddar våra samhällen och infrastrukturer är av världsklass samtidigt som vi värnar om hållbarhet. BST befinner sig på en stark tillväxtresa och präglas av en entreprenöriell och affärsnära kultur där medarbetare ges stort ansvar, goda utvecklingsmöjligheter och möjlighet att påverka både verksamheten och framtida arbetssätt. Koncernen består idag av över 700 medarbetare, 29 bolag och omsätter cirka 2,2 miljarder kronor. BST sitter i fina lokaler i Hägersten. Rollen som Senior Business Controller ingår i koncernens controller- och finansteam. Tjänsten innebär deltagande i forum på koncernnivå, med huvudsakligt fokus på att stötta verksamheten inom BST AB (Service, Installation). Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med ledning och verksamhetschefer där du fungerar som bryggan mellan koncern och verksamhet. Som medlem i BST AB:s ledningsgrupp får du en nyckelroll i bolagets utveckling genom att proaktivt ta fram insikter och beslutsunderlag som driver lönsamhet, effektivitet och tillväxt. title: Senior Business Controller sökes i Stockholm!
description: Om oss Hej! Det är vi som är Clockwork. Vi har lång erfarenhet från rekrytering – och bemanningsbranschen och vi vet hur viktigt det är med lokal närvaro. Rollen innebär även att aktivt utveckla och effektivisera ekonomiprocesser, rapportering och styrmodeller med fokus på digitalisering, automatisering och datadrivna arbetssätt. Vi söker dig som snabbt kan sätta dig in i komplexa verksamheter och agera som en proaktiv, strategisk och affärsorienterad partner till organisationen. Du trivs med att driva förändring, skapa struktur och bidra till långsiktiga förbättringar inom ekonomi och verksamhetsstyrning. Uppdragets längd: oktober 2026 - september 2027. Din profil Vi söker dig som har: - 5-10 års erfarenhet som Business Controller, Senior Controller eller i en liknande kvalificerad controllingroll. - Gedigen kompetens inom bokslut, budgetarbete, prognoser och ekonomisk uppföljning. - Stark analytisk förmåga och vana att omvandla ekonomisk data till affärsmässiga insikter. -Erfarenhet av att stötta chefer och ledning som strategisk och affärsnära partner. -Mycket goda kunskaper i Excel samt erfarenhet av att arbeta i ERP- och BI-system. -Förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i nya verksamheter, processer och systemmiljöer. -Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga i både svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift. -Ett självständigt, strukturerat och resultatorienterat arbetssätt. Det är meriterande om du även har: - Erfarenhet av förändringsarbete, processutveckling samt digitaliseringsinitiativ inom ekonomiområdet. - Kunskap inom automatisering, datadriven analys och moderna verktyg för rapportering och uppföljning. - Praktisk erfarenhet av AI-baserade lösningar inom ekonomi, analys eller verksamhetsstyrning. - Erfarenhet från större organisationer eller koncernstrukturer. - Goda kunskaper i Power BI eller liknande analys- och visualiseringsverktyg. Så vänta inte, ansök via vår hemsida www.clockworkpeople.se så snart som möjligt. För frågor, kontakta ansvarig konsultchef. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Als unabhängige Non-Profit-Organisation sind wir nur unseren Anlegern verpflichtet. Aktuell verwaltet die IST ein Vermögen von über CHF 10 Mrd. über traditionelle und alternative Anlageklassen hinweg. Unsere Abteilung Immobilien Direktanlagen verwaltet ein Portfolio von rund CHF 1 Mrd. und wächst kontinuierlich. Zur Verstärkung unseres Asset-Management-Teams suchen wir eine unternehmerisch denkende, umsetzungsstarke Persönlichkeit. Für die Verstärkung unserer Immobiliensparte suchen wir für den Standort Zürich oder Lausanne einen PORTFOLIO- & ASSETMANAGER IMMOBILIEN SCHWEIZ (M / W) 80 - 100% mit mehrjähriger Immobilienerfahrung im Bereich Bewirtschaftung und / oder Asset Management. Objektstrategien zur langfristigen Substanzerhaltung Erstellung und Einhaltung des Jahresbudgets für den Unterhalt sowie Überwachung der Umsetzung Überprüfung und Optimierung der Ertrags- und Kostenstruktur des Portfolios Steuerung der externen Bewirtschaftungsorganisationen sowie der Erst- und Wiedervermietungsprozesse Initiierung und Umsetzung von Asset-Management-relevanten Projekten und Strategien auf Stufe Liegenschaft und Portfolio Steuerung und Überwachung von Erst- und Wiedervermietungen sowie von Rechts-, Inkasso- und Versicherungsfällen Vertretung der Eigentümerinteressen gegenüber Behörden, Dienstleistern etc. Initiierung und Umsetzung von Nachhaltigkeits- und ESG-Massnahmen auf Liegenschaftsebene Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Transaktions- und Construction Management bei Akquisitionen, Portfolioübernahmen und Bauprojekten Reporting und Performance-Analyse (Rendite, Leerstand, EBIT) zuhanden Leiter Immobilien Ihr Profil Höhere Ausbildung im Immobilienbereich (z.B. description: Connect to your Industry Deloitte's Engineering practice is at the forefront of transforming businesses by bringing together cutting-edge tech programme delivery, quality assurance, and testing expertise. These five shared values lead every decision we make and action we take, guiding us to deliver impact how and where it matters most . Help develop Deloitte’s QE propositions for the Investment Management and Wealth market through pre-sales, bids, and client presentations. Support practice growth and contribute to a diverse and inclusive culture. Strengthen Deloitte’s QE capability by coaching junior team members and helping define and implement QE accelerators and standards. title: M&A Operations - Software - Technology - Senior Manager
description:
About the role

S& MA& Operations focuses on providing support for potential / actual M&A transactions and assists clients in all operational aspects of the transaction, pre and post deal, including:
  • Pre-deal value creation advisory (i.e. helping clients to prepare their business, or parts of their business for sale)
  • Buy and sell side operational due diligence (i.e. reviewing and reporting on the technology risks and value opportunities for the business)
  • Synergy development and review (i.e. helping to develop or providing an external independent review on the level of synergies available from putting two or more businesses together)
  • Carve out and divestment support (i.e. helping to develop the standalone operating model, one-off costs and standalone operating costs of a divestment)
  • Taking control and 100 day planning (i.e. helping our clients to safely take control of the business, manage risks and deliver ‘quick wins’ during the first 100 days of ownership)
  • Mergers & Acquisitions Integration (i.e. helping our clients protect and grow the value of an acquisition, develop a robust and realistic integration plan and then executing on it)
  • Post-acquisition performance improvement (i.e. reviewing where the value might lie in the business and how realistic and sustainable cost savings can be achieved)
​
What your days will look like:
We are looking for individuals who have industry experience with developing and implementing software platforms and who can help answer the following questions that are typically asked by clients when considering an investment in a technology business or one that is tech-enabled:
  • Is the platform well invested or will I need to spend cash in the short term to address ‘tech debt’?
  • Is the platform well designed and can it support the planned business growth (either through increased scale, acquisition or addressing adjacent markets / territories)?
  • Is the platform (and associated underlying infrastructure) robust and what are the implications in terms of uptime, availability and cost to serve?
  • Do the roadmap initiatives align with and support the business plan?
  • What is the competitive ‘moat’ when it comes to both features and functionality vs peers and the potential that others (such as AI) can address the same market at lower cost?
N.B. Whilst we expect candidates to be able to answer the questions above, we acknowledge and appreciate that candidates may not have experience in all areas (e.g. we expect some will have more experience with software vs infrastructure or product management vs software development).
This role is for you if:
You are a technology expert who currently operates in a technical role (i.e. product owner / manager, business analyst, scrum master (or equivalent) or development / UX) within a software / tech-enabled business.
Specific requirements
  • Have a broad technical understanding of product management and / or software development processes, concepts (especially in an agile environment) roadmaps and timelines;
  • Developed and executed a technology product strategy and vision;
  • Managed one or more development budgets and developed / evaluated R&D return on investments;
  • Planned new features and changes to a product (including research on use cases, market positioning and competitor analysis) and experience in business case creation, detailed functional specifications and wire-frames;
  • Prototyped and demonstrated new product ideas / features to stakeholders and built consensus for approval; and
  • A track record of developing and launching products, including customer implementation and / or supporting technical sales and support functions.
What you’ll receive from us:
No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you

title: Business Controller - Battery & Charging
description: TRATON is a group of strong brands with a shared mission: transforming transportation together to create the future of sustainable transport solutions. Within TRATON, we include MAN, Scania, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International. As part of a global team of industry experts, you get to think bigger, experience more, and reach further. Together, we have the power to transform transportation - Let´s make a difference together. Find out more: www.traton.com Our values - customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste - are at the heart of everything we do. Role Summary Are you passionate about combining finance, technology, and business to shape the future of sustainable transport? We are looking for an experienced Business Controller who wants to play a key role in supporting Battery & Charging within TRATON R&D. In this role, you will act as a trusted Business Partner to R&D leaders, providing financial insights that support strategic decision-making and contribute to the successful development of future battery and charging solutions. Research & Development is currently undergoing major changes in ways of working, systems, and roles - and Controlling is evolving accordingly. Operating in a global context, Controlling plays an important role as a Business partner. You will actively contribute to designing and implementing the future financial management model. Job Responsibilities The position includes a variety of ongoing responsibilities within finance and Controlling, such as: Financial planning, budgeting, and forecasting Support decision-making through financial analysis, business cases, and scenario assessments. KPI follow-up, reporting, and presentations. Contribute to the development of future Controlling processes, methods, and tools across TRATON R&D. You will report to the Head of R&D Controlling Battery & Charging and serve as a trusted Business Partner to R&D leaders, contributing to strategic decision-making, financial steering, and business performance as an active member of global management teams. You will work across networks and leadership teams and maintain regular contact with TRATON R&D and other Controlling functions. Who You Are To be successful in this role, you have: Master's degree in Economics, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, or a related field. At least 3-5 years of experience in Business Controlling An interest in electrification, battery technologies, and the transformation of the commercial vehicle industry, with a desire to contribute to TRATON's sustainable transport solutions. Proven ability to translate financial data into actionable insights and drive business performance in a structured and analytical way. Experience partnering with senior stakeholders and management teams in a complex and international environment. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust and influence decisions across both finance and operational functions. Excellent analytical and digital capabilities, including advanced skills in Excel, Power BI, and PowerPoint. Experience with SAP is considered a strong advantage. High integrity, curiosity, and an interest in understanding products, technology, operations, and the key business drivers behind successful R&D organizations. A collaborative mindset and the ability to create value through teamwork, networking, and cross-functional cooperation. Professional fluency in English is required; fluency in Swedish is beneficial. This Is Us The core team consists of two Business Controllers and the manager. We work closely together and support the Battery & Charging organization throughout strategic and operational decision-making. As part of the team, you will interact daily with engineering leaders, project managers, and finance colleagues across TRATON R&D, giving you a broad network and excellent opportunities for professional development. Within TRATON Group R&D, you are an important part of something bigger. Joining us means gaining access to the ins and outs of the entire transportation industry. TRATON Offers We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions. With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, TRATON Group R&D supports your professional growth both locally and internationally. Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. We also arrange events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje. Application We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV (in English) and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties. Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-09-01. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role. If you have questions or would like more information, please contact: Martin Leinestrand, Head of R&D Controlling Battery & Charging, martin.leinestrand@scania.com. We look forward to your application! This recruitment process is handled by Scania for TRATON Group R&D. title: Junior konzultant - Daně
description: To nejdůležitější v pár větách Chceš zajímavou a kreativní práci? Přidej se k nám do týmu. Můžeš se specializovat na daně z příjmů právnických osob, transakční poradenství, nebo zdanění fyzických osob. Pomůžeme ti vybrat tu správnou specializaci právě pro tebe. Tvoje role v týmu Práce v našem oddělení je rozmanitá, naše projekty mají často přesah do zahraničí. Daňová pravidla se neustále mění a na nás je najít správné řešení pro nejrůznější situace, které přináší podnikání i život. Nevadí, pokud se v daních teprve rozkoukáváš, nebo o nich nevíš vůbec nic. Během interních školení se dozvíš vše potřebné. Pracuje se vždy v týmu, ve kterém budeš obklopen zkušenými kolegy, kteří Ti rádi pomohu, a každý den se naučíš něco nového. Vzdělávání a rozvoj patří mezi hlavní principy, na kterých stavíme naši firemní kulturu. „Žádná firma nedělá významná rozhodnutí bez zvážení daňových dopadů jednotlivých plánovaných kroků. Klientům pomáháme s restrukturalizacemi, akvizicemi či přesunem podnikání ve spolupráci se zahraničními kancelářemi sítě EY, ale řešíme i každodenní provozní otázky. Děláme projekty po celém světě jak pro velké mezinárodní skupiny, tak i pro start-upy a domácí podniky. Hned od nástupu budeš součástí týmu, na který klient spoléhá. Pokud chceš být u toho, napiš nám a na viděnou ve Florentinu.“ Martina Kneiflová, Partner, Daně Co je pro nás důležité Víme, že jsi teprve na začátku kariéry. Několik věcí je ale pro tuto práci podstatných: Máš čerstvě dokončené studium inženýra nebo magistra , nebo jsi studentem posledních dvou ročníků vysoké školy. Tvůj obor nemusí být zaměřený na ekonomii nebo finance. Máš analytické schopnosti , dokážeš analyzovat informace a data. Projekty našich klientů jsou rozmanité a práce není rutina. Máš dobré komunikační schopnosti . Dokážeš vyjádřit své myšlenky a názory v ústní i písemné formě. Domluvíš se anglicky . Angličtinu používáme při schůzkách s klienty, při práci se zahraničními kolegy, i v běžné emailové komunikaci. Jak se ti odměníme Nástupní mzda 60 000 korun měsíčně. Hned první den dostaneš k dispozici laptop a iPhone 14 nebo 15. K tomu benefity, které ti zaručeně udělají radost: Volno: 6 týdnů volna, abys mohl/a načerpat nové síly. Benefitní body: 30 000 v Cafeterii můžeš utratit podle sebe. Třeba si pořídit Multisport kartu, nakoupit dárky nebo si užít odpočinek na Slevomatu. Profesionální rozvoj: U nás se neustále učíš a rozvíjíš své schopnosti. Nabízíme ti jedinečný program profesního rozvoje a pestrou paletu kurzů v naší learningové mapě. Můžeš využívat přístup ke vzdělávacímu portálu Udemy.com a k jazykovým kurzům. Podpora při přípravě na zkoušky daňového poradce: Zaplatíme ti registrační poplatek ke zkouškám a veškeré další náklady včetně cesty a ubytování v Brně. description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

Engineering Manager

Your role and responsibilities:

The Tool Room Manager will lead the design, engineering, and fabrication operations of a specialized tool room supporting ABB's St. Louis stamping plants for the motor lamination and parts departments.

In this role, you will oversee the creation and maintenance of carbide progressive stamping lamination dies, as well as associated metal components used in the manufacture of electrical motors. You will manage a team of tool and die makers and 1 tool and die designer, direct all tool room operations, troubleshoot complex stamping die processes, manage capital investments, and ensure adherence to standardized work procedures and quality standards.

Our Team Dynamics

Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters - because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Lead and develop the Tool Room organization by supervising, training, mentoring, and evaluating toolmakers, machinists, and apprentices while fostering a culture of safety, accountability, continuous improvement, and succession planning.
  • Direct the design, fabrication, maintenance, repair, and lifecycle management of stamping dies and tooling, ensuring compliance with engineering specifications, quality standards, traceability requirements, and production objectives.
  • Drive operational excellence through root cause analysis, process optimization, and corrective actions that improve die performance, tool life, first-pass yield, equipment reliability, and overall manufacturing productivity.
  • Manage Tool Room operations, resources, budgets, capital investments, inventory, equipment, preventive maintenance, and documentation while collaborating with engineering, production, and quality teams to support engineering changes, reduce downtime, and achieve safety, quality, and performance targets.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Technology, or a related discipline with 8+ years of tool and die manufacturing experience including 5+ years of supervisory or leadership experience.
  • Proven leadership experience managing tool and die operations and leading teams in high-volume manufacturing environments.
  • Extensive expertise in stamping and tooling processes, including progressive die design, carbide tool fabrication, troubleshooting, maintenance, and tool life optimization.
  • Strong technical knowledge of CNC machining, wire EDM, manual machining equipment, precision measurement, quality control systems, and engineering drawing interpretation.
  • Experience with maintenance planning, equipment lifecycle management, project execution, and capital budgeting in a manufacturing environment.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with a strong commitment to safety, continuous improvement, operational excellence, and managing multiple priorities.
  • Candidates must already have work authorization that would permit them to work for ABB in the US.

ABB’s NEMA Motors Division is the global leading electric NEMA motors manufacturer. NEMA Motors Division is a trusted leader with the shortest lead time and the broadest modularized product offering.

description: Working in Corporate Strategy The Corporate Strategy function supports the CEO and Corporate Management in setting and driving Statkraft’s strategic agenda. The Corporate Strategy team develops the Group’s corporate strategy, evaluates corporate portfolio perspectives, and advises on capital allocation, strategic priorities, and selected early-phase M&A opportunities. The team works closely with senior leadership and business areas to shape Statkraft’s future direction and translate strategic choices into action. We are looking to strengthen the team with two new senior team members. Both positions report to the Vice President Corporate Strategy. As a Senior Manager in Corporate Strategy, you will: Shape group-level strategy and portfolio direction by developing ambitions, priorities and strategic choices for Statkraft in close interaction with Corporate Management and business leaders Lead complex strategic projects from problem framing and workstream design to senior-level recommendations, decision material and execution plans Assess strategic opportunities and portfolio trade-offs , including business area priorities, capital allocation implications and selected early-phase M&A topics Translate strategy into action by working with business areas and functions to define implementation priorities and ownership and by ensuring rigorous follow-up Develop high-quality executive communication , including clear storylines, analytical materials and recommendations for senior decision forums We are looking for an experienced strategic leader who combines strong analytical capabilities with sound judgement, collaboration skills and the ability to influence senior stakeholders. You are motivated by solving complex business challenges and helping shape the future direction of Statkraft. We believe this includes: 5-10 years of relevant experience in corporate strategy, management consulting, business development, M&A, finance, or other strategic roles. Solid experience as a strategy project leader, with a demonstrated ability to lead complex strategy projects with multiple stakeholders and workstreams Experience from renewable energy or other capital-intensive industries is an advantage, but not a requirement. Master’s degree in business, finance, economics, engineering, or similar Fluency in English. Proficiency in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language is considered an advantage. Personal skills that will be useful in your role: Strong strategic acumen and ability to navigate complex and ambiguous challenges. Excellent analytical skills, with the ability to turn fragmented input into clear conclusions and recommendations Strong relationship builder with the ability to challenge constructively, influence stakeholders and collaborate across business areas Confident communicator who can develop clear and compelling storylines for senior audiences Proactive and self-driven, with a strong sense of ownership, a practical mindset and a focus on turning strategy into action

DHL Supply Chain is Hiring! At DHL, you will play a part in one of the world’s most essential industries. There has never been a better time to join DHL Supply Chain. In a global business like ours, the opportunities are endless. So, join us. Work with us. Grow with us.

Position: Forklift Operator
Shift: 1st shift
Pay: $19.50 per hour

In addition to the general job description below, the ideal candidate will also possess the following skills and/or experience:

-A minimum of 6 month’s experience operating stand-up material handling equipment is required. Experience operating other material handling equipment such as Order (Cherry) Picker, Sit-down, Clamp, Electric Pallet Jack is also a plus.

Be part of the world’s largest logistics company!DHL Supply Chain hasbeen certified as a Great Place to Work® in the US and Canada! Our excellent benefits packages includes:
- Affordable medical, dental, and vision coverage available beginning on your 30thday

Grow your skills. Shape your world.


Role Purpose:

What will you do in this role? Our Forklift Operators are responsible for moving stock from one area to another within our warehouse environment. You’ll load and unload shipments of various sizes, and you may use certain types of equipment such as stand-up, sit-down, or clamp forklifts and electric pallet jacks.Our environment is team oriented, fast paced and safety focused. We move products that people need and want. At DHL, YOU will be an essential part of everyday life.

  • Load, unload, move, stock, and stage products and materials using various types of forklifts or other power equipment 80% of specified shift.

  • Comply with all OSHA and MSDS standards.
  • Verify load accuracy; check the load count, stability, and product damage, report variances as necessary.
  • Change equipment battery or LP tank and monitor power source as necessary.
  • Maintain the facility’s equipment and materials in a neat, clean, and orderly fashion.
  • Assist in physical inventories.
  • Complete daily inspection of equipment.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Education and Experience:

  • Forklift operator certificate or satisfactory completion of a forklift-training program within the first 30 days of employment
  • High School Diploma or Equivalent, preferred
  • Six months warehouse experience, preferred
  • Six months forklift operation experience

title: Trustee and Chair of the Finance and Audit Committee
company: British Institute of International and Comparative Law
description: The opportunity The Finance and Audit Committee (FAC) provides BIICL's Board of Trustees with oversight and assurance on our finances, controls, investments, and audit. We're looking for a chartered accountant or senior finance leader to chair the Committee and join our Board of Trustees at a pivotal moment: a new Director and CEO, a new Director of Operations in post, and a new strategy launching in 2027. You'll bring real technical credibility and the judgement to translate financial detail into confidence for a Board whose backgrounds are mostly legal and academic. In return, you'll help shape the next chapter of one of the world's most respected independent legal institutes. The current Chair's term ends in December 2026. We are seeking a successor to join in October, allowing time for handover and induction ahead of the November FAC meeting and the December Board meeting. Purpose of the role The Chair of the Finance and Audit Committee provides strategic, non-executive financial oversight rather than day-to-day accounting. As a trustee , you hold joint legal and fiduciary responsibility for the charity's overall governance, strategic direction and financial health. As Committee Chair , you will act as a trusted advisor and critical friend to the Director and Chief Executive and the Director of Operations, ensuring that BIICL's income is robustly governed, financial risks are mitigated, and resources are deployed optimally to deliver maximum social impact. BIICL outsources financial management to a specialist non-profit accountancy firm, overseen internally by the Director of Operations; you'll evaluate how well that arrangement is working and recommend change if needed. Key responsibilities Strategic financial oversight Budgetary scrutiny: oversee the annual £2.5m operational budget and financial forecasts provided by the executive team. Performance monitoring: review quarterly management accounts, analysing variances, cash flow health, and performance against key performance indicators (KPIs). Reserves management: champion the regular review of a robust Reserves Policy to safeguard the charity against sudden funding fluctuations. Investment assets: oversee the performance of the charity's cash reserves and any investment portfolios, ensuring alignment with ethical investment strategies. Audit, risk and internal controls Statutory reporting: lead the FAC in reviewing the Annual Report and Accounts, ensuring compliance with Charity SORP FRS102 and statutory filing deadlines. External audit: manage the relationship with the External Auditor, leading on the tender process and reviewing the post-audit management letter. Risk mitigation: oversee the financial section of the organisation's risk register, ensuring internal controls are sufficient to prevent fraud and compliance failures across complex funding streams, and ensure FAC oversight of the wider Risk Register. Fiscal compliance: monitor compliance with complex tax regimes relevant to this scale, including VAT, Gift Aid, and trading subsidiary operations (as applicable). Committee leadership and Board reporting Meeting governance: set the agenda and chair quarterly FAC meetings, fostering an environment of collaboration, constructive, and high-quality challenge. Board communication: report clearly to the full Board of Trustees, translating complex financial positions into strategic insights for non-financial board members. Statutory trustee duties Legal compliance: ensure the charity complies with charity law, company law, and all other relevant legislation or regulation. Strategic direction: contribute actively to the Board of Trustees in setting the charity's overarching vision, mission, values, and strategic goals. Asset protection: act as a responsible custodian of the charity's assets, ensuring funds are spent solely in furtherance of its charitable objectives. Effective governance: attend and actively participate in full quarterly Board meetings, the Annual General Meeting (AGM), and strategic away days. Collective decision-making: maintain the principle of collective board responsibility, upholding and supporting decisions made by the wider board. Legal and regulatory frameworks The postholder is required to understand, uphold, and apply the following core regulatory frameworks: The 6 Essential Trustee Duties (Charity Commission Guidance CC3): You share collective legal liability to ensure the charity carries out its purpose for the public benefit, complies with its governing document, acts in the charity's best interests, manages resources responsibly, acts with reasonable care and skill, and remains fully accountable. Financial Reporting Standards 102 and the Charities SORP: Because our annual income exceeds £250,000, the accounts must be compiled under the Statement of Recommended Practice (Charities SORP), transparently separating restricted, unrestricted, and designated funds. The Charity Governance Code: Our Board intends to benchmark itself against this code. You will directly champion Principle 5 (Board Effectiveness) and Principle 6 (Risk and Control) to ensure internal controls are regularly evaluated. Person specification Experience and qualifications Financial qualification: chartered status (eg ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CIPFA) is essential. Senior leadership: proven experience operating as a CFO, Finance Director, or partner in a professional services practice in an organisation of similar or larger scale. Sector expertise: strong working knowledge of Charity SORP, restricted and unrestricted funding, and UK charity law is highly desirable. Governance background: previous experience as a trustee, non-executive director, or committee member is advantageous. Core skills and attributes Strategic clarity: ability to look past the numbers to see systematic risks and strategic opportunities. Collaborative challenge: ability to robustly hold senior staff and third-party advisors to account while maintaining a supportive, professional working relationship. Communication: ability to explain intricate financial matters plainly to non-financial audiences. Commitment to the cause: a demonstrable passion for the charity's core mission and alignment with its values. Terms of appointment Term: Trustee appointments are for a three-year term, renewable for a maximum of two consecutive terms. Time commitment: Trustees are required to commit approximately 8-10 days per year. There are four board meetings, four FAC meetings per year, a strategy day, plus approx. 2-3 hours per month for executive consultation. Location: London/Hybrid - FAC meetings usually take place online; Board meetings and strategic away days are in-person, usually at our London office. Remuneration: This is a voluntary role and is not accompanied by any financial remuneration; however, all reasonable travel and out-of-pocket expenses are reimbursed. Reporting to: Board of Trustees/Chair of the Board How to apply To apply formally, please submit a CV and supporting statement, each no more than two sides of A4, clearly outlining your suitability for the role against the criteria in the person specification and your motivation for applying. Please include your home address, contact email, and mobile number. We aim to acknowledge receipt within 2-3 days. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. We expect to interview candidates from mid-September with a view to appointing by the end of October. For further information about the role or to arrange an informal discussion, please contact Tom Asher, Director of Operations

title: Client Advisor Specialist
description:

Hos oss på Swedbank har du en möjlighet att:

  • Samarbeta och bidra till merförsäljning genom att identifiera kundbehov och presentera relevanta lösningar för att överträffa kundernas förväntningar.

  • Utveckla din kompetens inom bank och finanssektorn där du dagligen möter nya situationer och utmaningar.

I denna roll behöver du: 

  • Ha ett service- och affärsdrivet fokus samt trivas i mötet med människor.

  • Ha tidigare arbetslivserfarenhet från service- och/eller finansrelaterat arbete.

  • Tala och skriva flytande svenska samt ha goda kunskaper i engelska.

  • Vara trygg i kundmötet per telefon samt i kundmötet på kontor.

  • Arbeta målinriktat med fokus på att skapa värde för kunden.

  • Inta ett pedagogiskt förhållningssätt och kommunicera tydligt för att guida kunden i bankens digitala verktyg samt hitta kundanpassade lösningar.

  • Visa intresse för att fördjupa din kunskap om hur banken motverkar penningtvätt och finansiering av terrorism, och kunna tillämpa denna kunskap i varje kundmöte.

  • Gilla problemlösning och försäljning, med förmåga att identifiera kundens behov och presentera lösningar som passar kundens situation.

Hos oss kan du uppleva:

  • Personlig och professionell utveckling genom självledarskap och kontinuerlig utveckling.

  • Meningsfullt arbete som positivt påverkar vår arbetsplats, våra kunder och samhället.

  • En öppen och samarbetsinriktad kultur som uppmuntrar tvärfunktionellt teamarbete och erbjuder nätverksmöjligheter.

  • En stöttande och inkluderande miljö som främjar en balanserad och hållbar arbetslivssituation, med flexibla arbetsförhållanden när det passar rollen.

  • Förmåner såsom vårt erbjudande för bankprodukter för anställda, tjänstepensionsplan, aktiebaserade belöningsprogram Eken, och friskvårdsbidraget.

"Bli en del av vårt team och...

Inled din utvecklingsresa inom våra kundmötande tjänster. Du får jobba i direkt kundkontakt och hjälpa människor nå lösningar på sina ärenden. Du är Swedbanks ansikte utåt och en oerhört viktig del av vår verksamhet. Vi tror att du kan vara dig själv och samtidigt utvecklas till en framgångsrik kundrådgivare. Om du känner igen dig i denna beskrivning är vi mycket intresserade av dig. Vi värnar om ditt välmående och erbjuder en hållbar arbetsmiljö. På Swedbank är medarbetarna vår största tillgång. Vi har en kultur som bygger på respekt, inkludering och öppenhet, där varje medarbetares röst är viktig. Vi lever bankens värderingar; Öppen, Enkel och Omtänksam” -Christina Karjalainen, din framtida chef

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan senast den 2026-09-18. 

Tjänsten avser ett vikariat till och med 2027-08-31

Placeringsort: Ängelholm

Rekryterande chef: Christina Karjalainen

  • Knowledge of regulatory requirements related to data privacy and protection.

  • Understanding of data lifecycle management and data retention policies.

  • Hands-on experience with auditing data access and data activity monitoring.

  • Advanced knowledge of encryption technologies and secure data storage practices.

  • Experience with conducting data protection impact assessments (DPIAs) and managing data breach incidents.

  • Familiarity with industry standards and frameworks such as GDPR, CCPA, ISO 27001, and NIST.

  • Project management skills.

  • Proficiency in German language.

Benefits and Fun

  • Concentrated experience and rapid career growth. It may sound like a platitude, but it really is.

Monitor and manage financial risks such as FX, interest rate, and commodity exposures, including executing hedging transactions in line with Treasury Policies. Support funding activities including loan drawdowns, repayments, and related documentation processes. Drive or contribute to treasury-related projects such as system implementations, process automation, and infrastructure improvements. At Stegra, we value people who take initiative, build trust, and help create a workplace where everyone can do their best. Experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders and external financial institutions. Understanding of project financing structures is considered an advantage. You’ll receive fair, competitive compensation aligned with collective agreements, along with benefits like up to 30 days of paid vacation, occupational pension, parental benefits, and insurance. If you need support with relocation or immigration, our relocation department will help guide you through the process, whether it’s permits, housing or other practical matters. You can also enjoy perks like subsidized gym memberships and bike leases. Read more about Benefits at Stegra here. This is Stegra Stegra is on a mission to change the global steel industry by producing green hydrogen, iron, and steel - with the goal of eliminating CO₂ emissions. Instead of coal, we use green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity, meaning our primary emissions will be water and heat. By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitized, and sustainable plant in Boden, Northern Sweden - currently under construction. But this is just the beginning. Our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize industries beyond steel, paving the way for a cleaner future. Whether you're visiting regularly or working hybrid, you'll be part of a vibrant office culture with easy access to the city’s energy and amenities.

description:
About the role

The Guidewire Technical Lead plays a pivotal role in driving the successful implementation, configuration, and optimisation of Guidewire solutions within an organisation. The Technical Lead brings deep expertise in Guidewire modules (such as PolicyCenter, ClaimCenter, or BillingCenter), facilitates requirements gathering, and leads Technical design and delivery.

As a Technical Lead, the role is there to ensure the solution capabilities in our Guidewire programmes are the right capabilities to meet customer outcomes, articulated in the right way to align to Guidewire solution standards and best practise.

This role needs to look forward, working with customer on coming Guidewire ski releases and ensuring our projects are aware and informed of what to plan in and working with customers to ensure they are aware of the value in each release as it maps to this business needs.

This role involves Technical and technical leadership, mentoring of others, and collaborating with stakeholders/customers to deliver scalable, high-quality insurance applications.

What will your day look like:

  • Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with business users, project managers, and technical teams to understand requirements, translate business needs into Technical specifications, and ensure alignment throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Solution Design: Lead the Technical design of Guidewire solutions, ensuring that configurations and customisations meet business objectives and comply with industry best practices. This will be across several workstreams ensuring end to end designs are robust and well rounded.

  • Supporting the Business Analysis teams on requirements Gathering, especially where the capabilities needed need customisation as opposed to configuration. Facilitate workshops and interviews to gather, analyse, and document business and Technical requirements related to Guidewire implementations.

  • Configuration Oversight: Oversee the configuration of Guidewire modules, working closely with technical teams to ensure Technical requirements are accurately implemented.

  • Issue Resolution: Act as the primary point of escalation for Technical issues, troubleshooting problems, and working with cross-Technical teams to resolve them efficiently.

  • Documentation: Prepare and maintain comprehensive documentation, including Technical specifications, process flows, and user guides.

This job is for you if:

  • Extensive experience in Guidewire implementations (PolicyCenter, ClaimCenter, and/or BillingCenter).

  • Strong understanding of insurance industry processes and terminology and proven ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills and experience with Agile and Waterfall project methodologies.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail and ability to lead and motivate a team of Technical analysts.

  • Background in business process reengineering or change management and demonstrated adaptability in fast-paced project environments and proactive approach to identifying and resolving potential challenges.

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

title: Producent
description: Kunne du tænke dig at være med til at bestemme, hvad danskerne har i slikposen om to år? Og har du lyst til at følge idéen hele vejen, fra første forsøg til den dag produktet står på hylden? Der er fuld fart på udviklingen i Toms Gruppen, Danmarks største producent af slik og chokolade. Det samme gælder ambitionerne om at styrke vores internationale position som en konkurrencedygtig og innovativ virksomhed. Vi søger derfor en ny kollega til rollen som produktudvikler. Om jobbet Toms Gruppen er Danmarks største producent af slik og chokolade med fabrikker i Danmark og Polen. Du bliver en del af produktudviklingsteamet, der udvikler slik, og har din dagligdag i Hvidovre, hvor du refererer til Product Development Manager Louise Richter Olsen. Vi er et mindre produktudviklingsteam, der organisatorisk ligger som en del af marketing. I vores team er der en faglig, uformel og god stemning, og det er nemt at gå til hinanden i løbet af dagen for sparring og hjælp. Som produktudvikler får du en central rolle i udviklingen af nye produkter samt optimering af eksisterende produkter. Du vil arbejde tæt sammen med Marketing, Indkøb og produktion for at sikre, at nye produkter udvikles effektivt, struktureret og i overensstemmelse med gældende kvalitets- og fødevaresikkerhedsstandarder. description:
About the Team

For us, SOC is not just a ticket or detections „washing machine “. We perceive incident response as a mandatory part of our services, along with other proactive activities such as: Threat Hunting, Threat Intelligence, Vulnerability Management, as well as post-incident activities like Forensic Analysis and more.

Threat Management team consists of cybersecurity professionals focused on prevention of the cyberattacks via detection and responding to cyber threats. The key pillars consist of incident response, threat hunting, threat intelligence, security monitoring, vulnerability management, engineering and consulting services.

About your Manager

Lubomír has over 10 years of cyber security experience with different projects related to mainly cyber security managed services, building and operating Security Operation Centers (SOC), Threat Hunting & Intelligence and Vulnerability Management. Lubomír is also responsible for team leading, project management, designing of cyber security managed services, creation and development of training plans and is a proven coach to train other team members or client staff. Outside of work, he is involved in teaching, science, and research at the University of Hradec Králové, where he guarantees and teaches the course Surveillance Systems and Forensic Analysis.

Job Description & Summary

We are building a new, compact delivery team (2-3 FTE) focused on Threat Detection & Response (TDR), which will be the backbone of our professional services offering. This team does not operate purely as a specialized "tool team" nor solely as an advisory team without technical depth.

We are looking for individuals who want to combine hands-on technical work with a consulting overlay—a skill set that includes structuring problems, designing solutions, communicating them effectively to clients, and seeing projects through to completion. If you are looking for a role where you spend 80% of your time on slides and only 20% on technology, this position is not for you. if you also prefer to work exclusively in a SOC and have no interest in client context, this role is also not suitable.

As a Senior Associate in our TDR team, you will be a key member of our delivery team, combining technical depth with a consulting approach. You will work directly on client projects, handling everything from technical analysis and implementation, to preparing deliverables and presenting findings to the client. You are not just a "tool operator" – you are a "security thinker" who understands not only technology but also its impact on our clients' business.

Technical Delivery (50% of Time)

  • Engage in hands-on work with SIEM (primarily Splunk, secondarily Microsoft Sentinel) including configuration, optimization, and troubleshooting.

  • Develop and refine detection rules/use cases based on threat landscapes and client requirements.

  • Conduct threat hunting activities by proactively searching for threats within client environments.

  • Support incident response processes, including analyzing incidents and recommending remediation actions.

  • Work with log management architectures, data sources, and log onboarding.

  • Assess the maturity of clients' detection and response capabilities.

Client Communication (30% of Time)

  • Independently lead technical workshops and working sessions with client security teams.

  • Present technical findings and recommendations with the ability to translate technical jargon into understandable conclusions.

  • Participate in status meetings, discussing scope, priorities, and next steps.

  • Build and maintain working relationships with client security teams.

Documentation and Business Development (20% of Time)

  • Prepare high-quality deliverables: assessment reports, solution proposals, recommendations, and roadmaps.

  • Compile executive summaries and outline business impacts of technical findings.

  • Assist in proposal preparation—providing technical input, labor estimation, and scope definition.

  • Contribute to the internal knowledge base and aid

title: Finance and Operations Officer
description: Job title: Finance and Operations Officer Manager: Head of Finance Location: London Salary: Starting salary £30,500 (Salary band: £30,500 to £33,500 inclusive of London weighting) Hours: Full time, 37.5 hours per week Contract: Permanent Overall purpose As the Finance and Operations Officer, you will play a key role in making sure the charity's expenditure is well managed, accurately recorded, properly authorised and fully auditable. The post holder will have day-to-day ownership of purchase ledger processing, supplier payments, staff and client expenses, payment runs and expenditure controls. They will ensure that all expenditure is coded correctly, supported by appropriate documentation, treated correctly for VAT and recorded in line with internal policies, accounting requirements and funder restrictions. The postholder will work closely with the Head of Finance and colleagues across the organisation to make expenditure processes clear, efficient and well controlled. This includes supporting staff to understand purchasing, expenses, authorisation and supplier processes, and helping teams to manage spending in line with budgets, funding restrictions and organisational procedures. The role also includes practical operational support, helping to make sure colleagues have the equipment, technology set-up, office resources, basic systems access and clear guidance they need to do their jobs effectively and safely. This will include creating and maintaining guidance that helps the organisation run smoothly, such as office guidance, health and safety information and equipment policies. You will also be expected to contribute to and uphold our outstanding culture by living and demonstrating our values of being mission-led, welcoming, entrepreneurial and collaborative. Key responsibilities Finance responsibilities - expenditure focus (65%) Process purchase invoices, staff expenses and client payments accurately and promptly, ensuring all expenditure has the correct approval, coding, VAT treatment and supporting documentation. Maintain day-to-day ownership of the purchase ledger, ensuring supplier accounts are accurate, up to date and reconciled where needed. Ensure staff and client expenses are captured and recorded accurately, comply with the relevant expense policy and are paid in a timely manner. Prepare supplier, staff and client payment runs ready for approval and payment by the finance team. Verify supplier details and changes to bank details in line with finance controls, escalating any concerns or unusual activity. Support checks on expenditure completeness, including identifying missing invoices, outstanding approvals, unprocessed expenses and unmatched payments. Support month-end expenditure processes, including reviewing expenditure coding, posting accruals and prepayments, and helping to ensure the monthly income and expenditure position is accurate by agreed deadlines. Allocate shared costs across cost centres and projects, ensuring expenditure is coded accurately and consistently Reconcile expenditure-related control accounts and third-party platforms where relevant, ensuring differences are investigated and resolved promptly. Ensure fundraising platform fees are recorded properly alongside income from those platforms. Work with budget holders to resolve expenditure queries and improve the quality of coding, descriptions and supporting information. Work with the Head of Finance to help colleagues understand purchasing, expenses, authorisation, supplier set-up and other expenditure processes. Undertake expenditure control activities, including checking supplier set-up, verifying supplier detail changes, reviewing payment evidence and supporting compliance with delegated authorities. Provide support for income processing where needed, particularly where this links to restricted fund expenditure, funder evidence or month-end processes. Support year-end audit by preparing expenditure evidence, responding to sample requests and ensuring finance records are complete and easy to trace. Support ad hoc finance projects, including improvements to expenditure processes, system changes and policy or procedure updates. Maintain and regularly update the organisation's asset register, mobile phone inventory and user allocation records. Identify and implement improvements to finance and operational processes to strengthen controls, improve efficiency and enhance user experience. Work collaboratively with operational teams to review outstanding financial items, resolve queries and improve compliance with finance procedures. Operational responsibilities (35%) Act as the secondary administrator for Vodafone services, maintaining user records, managing SIM allocations, coordinating account changes, resolving supplier queries, and reviewing monthly charges. Coordinate the procurement, allocation and recovery of company equipment, including laptops, headphones, mobile phones, monitors and other IT assets, ensuring records and costs are accurate. Monitor contracts, usage and costs linked to operational platforms, telecommunications and office services, highlighting issues or opportunities for savings. Support onboarding and offboarding by ensuring equipment, access requirements and related records are in place, returned or updated promptly. Ensure operational records, policies and procedures linked to expenditure, assets and procurement remain accurate and up to date. Create and maintain practical guidance, policies and procedures that help the organisation run smoothly, including office guidance, health and safety information and equipment policies.

description:
About the role:

Shape the future of business transformation with PwC

At PwC, we're growing one of the leading SAP consulting practices in our global network. Our multidisciplinary teams bring together deep SAP expertise across Finance, Supply Chain, Human Capital and Business Change, complemented by Data, AI and Cloud capabilities, working alongside specialists from across PwC to help clients deliver complex business transformation programmes.

Our team partners with some of the world's leading organisations to deliver complex, multinational SAP transformation programmes spanning Finance, Supply Chain, Human Capital and business adoption. We work across the full transformation lifecycle, from strategy and business case through solution design, implementation and business adoption, helping clients realise long-term value from their SAP investments.

As our practice continues to grow, we're looking for people who are excited by the opportunity to develop their consulting careers whilst taking on increasing responsibility. We're looking for individuals who enjoy solving complex business challenges, building trusted client relationships, leading workstreams and developing the leadership skills that will shape the next stage of their career.

Our people have the opportunity to work on some of the world's largest SAP transformation programmes, learn from experienced leaders and build long-term relationships with global organisations. We're looking for people who want to grow with our practice, develop into future leaders and help shape the next phase of our success.

Whether you're leading a workstream, supporting a major client transformation or helping bring innovative AI-enabled solutions to market, you'll be encouraged to challenge conventional thinking, embrace new technologies and make a meaningful contribution from day one.

If you're looking for a career where you can combine deep SAP expertise with continuous learning, leadership development and business transformation, we'd love to hear from you.

  • Coach junior consultants whilst continuing to develop your own consulting, Business Change and leadership capability.

  • You have practical experience delivering Business Change activities including Change Impact Assessments, Business Readiness, Stakeholder Engagement, Communications, Training and Business Adoption.
  • You understand how successful SAP transformation depends on people adopting new processes, technologies and ways of working, not simply implementing new systems.
  • You have experience supporting multinational transformation programmes across multiple business units, functions or geographies.
  • You build trusted relationships with business stakeholders and enjoy facilitating workshops, influencing senior leaders and supporting organisational change.
  • You are curious about emerging technologies and understand how SAP Business AI, Joule and intelligent automation will influence the future of work and business

description: Line of Service Advisory Industry/Sector Not Applicable Specialism Deals Management Level Senior Associate Job Description & Summary Do you want to help clients create value in a deal (M&A) context using AI? Do you want to work on high-impact problems across due diligence, valuation, integration, separation, and post-deal value creation? Do you enjoy building practical solutions using modern AI tools and techniques, while working closely with deal teams and clients? Does it appeal to you to turn ambiguous business challenges into working products and workflows at speed? Then apply immediately! What does your work look like? As a Deals AI Forward Deployed Engineer, you will work as part of a team of problem solvers with extensive consulting, analytics, and industry experience, helping our clients address complex business issues across the deal lifecycle. You will be embedded in deal teams where AI is playing an increasingly important role in how we generate insight, improve workflows, and create value for clients. You will work closely with Deals professionals and clients to identify opportunities where AI can solve real business problems. The work involves designing, building, and deploying bespoke solutions using a range of modern technologies, including Python, MCPs, APIs, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic patterns, and other AI tools and frameworks. You will focus not on theory for its own sake, but on applying the right techniques to solve practical problems in fast-moving deal environments. In your daily job, your tasks will be the following: Designing, building, and iterating AI-powered tools, workflows, and applications for live deal and value-creation contexts; Working across the full solution cycle: problem framing, prototyping, testing, deployment, and refinement; Communicating technical ideas and outputs clearly to non-technical stakeholders, including clients and senior deal professionals; Identifying and addressing client and deal team problems where AI can create meaningful value; Working with the broader deal team (including financial due diligence, valuation and modelling, carve-out and integration, etc.) to incorporate AI-enabled solutions into the wider PwC offering; Contributing to internal innovation projects, helping identify reusable patterns, improve current ways of working, and build knowledge around new AI techniques and tools; You will get the chance to be part of a growing team in one of the most successful Deals (M&A) practices in the market. You will work in multidisciplinary deal teams consisting of colleagues with different backgrounds and expertise, in which you are responsible for designing and delivering AI-enabled solutions. You will work on projects for both corporate and private equity clients, giving you unique exposure to Danish and international businesses and to the practical application of AI in high-value situations. Who are you? Your passion is to build technology that solves real business challenges while working in a dynamic environment. You are curious by nature, enjoy learning new tools and techniques, and are motivated by turning ideas into working solutions. You are comfortable working hands-on in code, but also enjoy understanding the commercial value behind the technical task. Furthermore: You have relevant education and experience in applied AI in a business context, technical consulting and equivalent, or have a background in business and economics with a strong technical foundation; You have strong hands-on programming skills, especially in Python, and experience working with APIs, testing, version control, and modern deployment practices; You have practical experience with AI technologies such as large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, workflow automation, AI agents, or similar tools and techniques; You are comfortable building prototypes quickly and refining them based on user needs and feedback; You can communicate concisely technical concepts and AI-driven insights to non-technical audiences, including senior stakeholders; You are willing to learn about the commercial and financial side of Deals; You are a team player and enjoy in-person interactions, but you are also naturally-driven and can work autonomously in a fast-moving environment; You have strong written and verbal communication skills in English; Danish is not a requirement but is an advantage; We are recruiting across different grades, including Associate

title: M&A Operations - Integration - Manager
description:
About the role:

The M&A Operations team consists of c.250 people who advise clients on the operational and strategic aspects of merger and acquisition (M&A) projects, acting as a strategic and trusted advisor to both Corporate and Private Equity clients on transactions ranging from £50 million to over £5 billion. M&A Operations is a market leading team that sits within PwC’s Strategy& Value Creation Business Unit and provides a highly complex, fast paced, challenging yet rewarding environment for those who aspire to grow and develop in their careers. Within M&A Operations sits the Integration team, a specialist group of c.16 professionals working cross-sector and focused specifically on supporting clients through complex integration programmes.

As a Manager in the M&A Operations Integration team, you will manage day-to-day delivery of M&A integration engagements, supporting Senior Managers and Directors on complex transactions and supporting junior staff within the engagement team. You will help translate integration strategy into executable plans whilst managing teams and client interactions. The role offers exposure to high-profile transactions across a range of sectors, alongside responsibility for business development, team leadership and capability building.

We comprise both career-consultants and individuals with experience gained in industry and actively seek diversity of experience in our new team members.

What your days will look like:

You will help our clients focus on the right priorities at the right time in their M&A integration projects. Leading and working with a number of stakeholders to make a meaningful, hands-on contribution and engaging deeply with our clients to define integration strategies and target operating models to deliver in line with the deal value case. As a Manager in the M&A Integration team, your role responsibilities will largely cover:

  • Supporting with designing and building client integration programmes, including strategy definition, target operating model, value creation (synergy) assessment, integration planning (Day 1 and "100-Day"), and post-acquisition execution.

  • Supporting with developing a combined operating model and defining the level of integration required across business functions.

  • Managing day-to-day client interactions, working with C-suite executives and their teams to deliver high-quality work and relevant recommendations.

  • Supporting the creation of proposals and client presentations in collaboration with other PwC functional and sector teams.

  • Driving the growth of the M&A Integration team by forging strong business relationships with clients.

  • Collaborating with the team to build and share knowledge, support the continuous development of best practices, and introduce relevant new ideas (e.g., digital tools).

title: Intern Transaction Service Product Management – Wholesale Banking (f/m/x)

description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Center Manager-AUPI West Region

__

ABB’s Automation business area enables customers to operate some of the world’s largest and most complex industrial infrastructures, helping them outrun – leaner and cleaner.

We offer a broad range of automation, electrification and digital solutions for process, hybrid and maritime industries, including industry-specific integrated control and software as well as measurement and analytics solutions and services.

As a Resident Service Technician, you will be responsible for delivering high-quality technical support and service to our customers. You will perform installations, maintenance, and repairs on equipment, ensuring optimal performance and customer satisfaction.

The work model for the role is: onsite at customer site.

Key Responsibilities

  • In this role, you will have the opportunity to execute service work as per work instructions and in accordance with ABB quality and safety guidelines for our Quality Control Systems (QCS). Each day, you will deliver quality customer service planning and execute service work as per customer order and expectation. You will also showcase your expertise by ensuring customer retention by effectively communicating service work timeline and expectations.

  • Working with the customer (while on-site) to identify opportunities to improve the customer’s operations and eliminate pain points.

  • Performing field service tasks, identifying technical issues, and performing analysis through remote or on-site activity in service categories and products for which they are certified to perform.

  • Preparing material lists needed for service activity and ensuring that all materials, parts, and equipment are available and of appropriate quality for service activities.

Qualifications

  • Associate’s degree in a related field and 5+ years of electrical/electronics, instrumentation or process control related work/military experience required. Or HS diploma/GED and 7+ years of related work/military experience required.

  • Ability to use electrical test equipment such as voltmeters or multi-meters. Candidate should know how to identify voltage systems that are above the level 240 VAC/870 VDC.

  • Mechanical/Electrical aptitude including a basic understanding of electrical theory and electrical safety.

  • Ability to read electrical drawings and utilize for troubleshooting electrical systems, and to diagnose malfunctioning electrical systems up to 240 VAC/870 VDC and perform preventive maintenance using electrical test equipment.

  • This role will be a resident position working out of the customer location, however needs to be able to travel up to 15% for required training and assisting other sites.

  • Knowledge of the pulp & paper industry is a nice to have.

We empower you to take the lead, share bold ideas, and shape real outcomes. You’ll grow through hands-on experience, mentorship, and learning that fits your goals. Here, your work doesn’t just matter, it moves things forward

We want you to bring your full self to work—your ideas, your energy, your ambition. You’ll have the tools and freedom to grow your skills, shape your path, and take on challenges that matter. Here, your work creates impact you can see and feel, every day.

Position: Forklift Operator
Shift: Night Shift, 7:00 PM - 7:00 AM, on a rotating day schedule.
Pay: $19.70 per hour + $1 shift premium

In addition to the general job description below, the ideal candidate will also possess the following skills and/or experience:

-Warehouse, General Labor, Forklift, Quality Control, Material Handler, Machine Operator, Loader/Unloader

- Affordable medical, dental, and vision coverage available beginning on your 30th day

- 401(k) with generous company match
- Tuition reimbursement program
- Excellent training and career advancement opportunities

Grow your skills. Shape your world.


Role Purpose:

What will you do in this role? Our Forklift Operators are responsible for moving stock from one area to another within our warehouse environment. You’ll load and unload shipments of various sizes, and you may use certain types of equipment such as stand-up, sit-down, or clamp forklifts and electric pallet jacks.Our environment is team oriented, fast paced and safety focused. We move products that people need and want. At DHL, YOU will be an essential part of everyday life.

Key Accountabilities:

  • Load, unload, move, stock, and stage products and materials using various types of forklifts or other power equipment 80% of specified shift.
