description:
About this role

We are looking for an experienced Guidewire Test & Delivery Lead to play a pivotal role in the successful delivery of complex Guidewire programmes across the insurance lifecycle. This role combines end‑to‑end testing leadership with broader delivery oversight, working closely with business stakeholders, technical teams, and third‑party vendors to ensure high‑quality, predictable outcomes.

You will be responsible for defining and executing the testing strategy while also contributing to overall programme delivery, governance, and risk management across Guidewire implementations.

What your days will look like:

Testing Leadership

  • Own and drive the end‑to‑end testing strategy across Guidewire implementations, including functional, integration, UAT, non‑functional, and regression testing. Lead test planning, design, execution, defect management, and reporting across multiple delivery phases. Ensure alignment of testing activities with programme milestones, delivery plans, and release schedules.

  • Establish and maintain quality standards, test governance, and entry/exit criteria. Oversee test environments, data readiness, and defect triage with delivery and technical leads. Manage onshore and offshore testing teams, including test leads, manual testers, and automation resources.

Delivery & Programme Oversight

  • Act as a senior delivery lead within the Guidewire programme, supporting predictable and high‑quality outcomes. Working closely with programme, product, and technical leads to identifying delivery risks early and defining mitigation strategies. Contribute to delivery planning, dependency management, and cross‑workstream coordination. Provide clear, confidence‑building status reporting to senior stakeholders and leadership. Support mobilisation, go‑live readiness, and post‑deployment stabilisation activities.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

  • Engage with business stakeholders to ensure testing and delivery priorities align with business outcomes. Act as a key interface with Guidewire and other vendors, ensuring responsibilities and support boundaries are clearly defined. Build trusted relationships with client teams through clarity, transparency, and delivery judgement.

Continuous Improvement

  • Drive improvements in testing processes, tooling, automation coverage, and delivery ways of working. Embed a quality‑led mindset across the broader delivery team. Support coaching and development of testing and delivery team members.

This role is for you if:

  • You have strong experience leading testing and quality assurance on large‑scale Guidewire implementations. Hands‑on knowledge of Guidewire ClaimCenter, PolicyCenter and BillingCenter.

  • Experience delivering complex insurance transformations in Personal, Commercial, or Specialty Lines with a proven ability to manage end‑to‑end testing lifecycle within agile, hybrid, or waterfall delivery models.

  • Experience working with onshore and offshore teams, including third‑party vendors.

  • Strong understanding of delivery risk, governance, and quality management within large programmes contributing too excellent stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills.

  • Desired Guidewire cloud (SaaS) implementation experience.

  • Desired Test automation experience and familiarity with Guidewire test frameworks.

  • Desired Non‑functional testing leadership (performance, resilience, security).

  • Desired Experience supporting mobilisation, go‑live, and service readiness.

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions. ​

​

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more. ​

title: Assistant Professor in Business Administration, Corporate Finance
description: With approximately 3,700 full-time students, 470 employees, 160 international partner universities and four departments, the School of Business, Economics and Law offers exceptional breadth and is Triple Crown accredited through EQUIS, AACSB and AMBA. The Department of Business Administration is the School’s largest department and conducts extensive research and education at first-cycle, second-cycle and doctoral levels. The position is based in the Industrial and Financial Management & Logistics (IFEL) section, which conducts research and education in areas including corporate finance and collaborates closely with research environments such as the Centre for Finance (CFF), Northern Lead and Lighthouse. Subject area Business Administration, specialising in Corporate Finance. Subject area description Corporate Finance examines firms’ financial decision-making, with a focus on investment decisions, financing strategies, and mechanisms for ensuring a market-based return for both shareholders and lenders. Central to the field is the development of theoretically and empirically grounded frameworks that facilitate profitable investments and efficient financing while taking risk and the cost of capital into account. Particular emphasis is placed on analyzing the factors that influence firms’ choices of capital structure and investment strategies, especially in environments characterized by asymmetric information and transaction costs. A clear grounding in financial theory is essential for understanding, explaining, and analyzing these decisions and their consequences. The field has a strong methodological orientation, employing quantitative tools such as discounted cash flow models, real and financial option models, as well as statistical and econometric methods, to analyze how external market conditions affect firms’ financial decisions. Duties The position comprises a maximum of 50% teaching and a minimum of 50% research. Research is expected to focus on Corporate Finance, align with the subject area description above, and be of a quality suitable for publication in high-quality international scientific journals. Research is also expected to be actively disseminated through research seminars and academic networks. The Assistant Professor will teach at first-cycle and second-cycle (Master’s) levels and is also expected to contribute to doctoral education and contract education, as well as course development and administrative duties. Teaching will primarily concern courses in Corporate Finance, including Corporate Valuation, Advanced Corporate Finance, Financial Management, or similar courses, as well as supervision of Bachelor’s and Master’s theses in finance and within Accounting and Financial Management. The position also requires active efforts to apply for external research funding during the employment period and to contribute to the development of the department’s educational and research environment. Employment Type of employment: Fixed-term employment for five years Extent: Full-time (100%) Location: Department of Business Administration, School of Business, Economics and Law, University of Gothenburg Starting date: By agreement An appointment as Assistant Professor is a fixed-term career-development position. The purpose is to provide the successful candidate with the opportunity to develop independence as a researcher and strengthen scientific and pedagogical qualifications in order to meet the requirements for eligibility for appointment as Senior Lecturer. The appointment may be extended, but for no more than a total of two years, if additional time is required to fulfil the purpose of the appointment due to sick leave, parental leave, or other special circumstances. title: PhD Candidate in AI-assisted asset management of coastal infrastructure
company: NTNU - Norwegian University of Science and Technology
description: This is NTNU NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim. At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world. You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here. About the position Climate change influences the magnitudes and return periods of heavy rainfall, storm surges, landslides, and many other stressors and shocks with dire consequences for civil infrastructure. The research group within civil engineering focuses climate resilient infrastructure using measurement data to support the assessment of the resilience of critical infrastructures in waterfront communities. Fjordlab Ålesund is an important and rapidly growing sensor and observation platform that contain a wealth of data in the domain of met-ocean, stormwater system, water supply system, structural systems, energy systems, ecosystem, acoustics and more. This position aims to develop a hazard and resilience assessment platform for selected ports focusing on AI-empowered asset management using drone inspections and available asset management historical data. The aim is to enhance the asset and network resilience of ports by training an AI model on ferry quay data and in turn apply it to generic port structures. The position will be in close collaboration with the Structural Engineering department at NTNU, international research groups and directly involved in ongoing research projects at the department. The candidate will also play an important role in strengthening the interdisciplinary collaboration across NTNU. Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? As a PhD Candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a further career in higher education and research, in and outside academia. Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department. About the project The candidate will be working on the project "AI-empowered asset management for port structures". Norwegian ports are critical infrastructure - vital to national logistics, maritime trade, and the livelihoods of coastal communities. Yet unlike roads and bridges, most port structures fall outside any regulated asset management system: there are no common inspection guidelines, no shared database of structural condition, and no systematic basis for assessing how resilient these assets are to hazards. As climate change drives increases in extreme weather, storm surges, and flooding along the Norwegian coast, this gap is becoming increasingly consequential. This PhD project addresses that challenge head-on by developing an AI-powered asset management framework for Norwegian port structures. The approach leverages the BRUTUS database - Norway's national asset management system for ferry quays, containing labelled damage data as training material for a machine learning model capable of automatically classifying structural damage from drone inspection images. The project aims to bring automated, cost-effective damage detection to port structures that have historically lacked any formal monitoring. The research is anchored at the Magerholm Research Quay (MRQ), a unique full-scale laboratory established as part of Fjordlab Ålesund through a collaboration between Møre og Romsdal County and NTNU. MRQ provides unparalleled access to real-world structural and operational data, including met-ocean conditions and ferry impact loads - an ideal testbed for developing and validating the AI and drone-based inspection methods at the core of this project. The project is funded by the Faculty of Engineering and a collaboration between the Department of Ocean Operations and Civil Engineering and the Department of Structural Engineering. Duties of the position Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above Academic publications and popular science dissemination Participate in the smart infrastructure research group Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment. The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position. Preferred selection criteria Familiar with structural health monitoring or non-destructive evaluation techniques Experience with fieldwork Experience with signal and image processing Has driving license approved according to Norwegian regulations Personal characteristics To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: Work independently Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them Present and discuss your research with other professionals Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity Show curiosity and a strong motivation for the subject Analyze data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. The employment period is 3 years for the doctoral work. title: Junior Managers Program (Trainee) - Starte deine Leadership Journey im Bereich Controlling
description: Bereit, die Performance von Bosch zu steuern? Wir suchen analytisch starke Master-Graduates, die mit uns im Junior Managers Program die datengestützte Unternehmenssteuerung gestalten und eine Leadership-Karriere mit Startpunkt im Controlling anstreben.​ In 12-24 Monaten rotierst du durch zentrale Controlling- und Finanzbereiche in Deutschland und im Ausland. Deine Mission: Geschäftsmodelle verstehen, Expertise im operativen sowie strategischen Controlling aufbauen und in Projekten – von der Performance-Analyse bis zu M&A-Deals – erste Führungsverantwortung übernehmen, begleitet von Top-Führungskräften.​ Was Du bei uns lernen und entwickeln wirst:​ Du lernst, wie die globalen Unternehmensziele in messbare Kennzahlen übersetzt und die finanzielle Performance eines Tech-Unternehmens gesteuert wird, um datengetriebene Entscheidungen zu ermöglichen.​ Du gestaltest aktiv die finanzielle Planung, das Reporting und die Analyse für unsere Geschäftsbereiche mit und evaluierst strategische Projekte wie M&A-Transaktionen.​ Du arbeitest mit modernen Controlling-Instrumenten, BI-Systemen und agilen Methoden, um die finanzielle Steuerungsarchitektur von Bosch weiterzuentwickeln. Dabei wirst du von einem persönlichen Mentor auf Managementebene begleitet, um dich gezielt auf deine zukünftige Rolle als Führungskraft im kaufmännischen Umfeld bei Bosch vorzubereiten. Dein Karrierepfad beginnt im Controlling und entwickelt sich hin zu ersten Führungsaufgaben im kaufmännischen Umfeld oder auch der Leitung von strategischen M&A-Projekten. Dein akademisches Fundament: Ein sehr guter (Vollzeit-)Master-Abschluss in Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten Bereich. Dein Fokus liegt auf Themen wie Controlling, Finanzen, Rechnungswesen oder Corporate Finance. Vielleicht hast du bereits einen MBA, PhD oder erste relevante Berufserfahrung erworben.​ Deine Begeisterung für die digitale Transformation im Finanzbereich: Du bist von Natur aus neugierig und bereit, schnell neue Methoden und digitale Tools im Controlling zu lernen und anzuwenden. Erste Erfahrungen mit BI-Tools, SAP oder Datenanalyse-Projekten sind ein großes Plus.​ Dein Blick für das große Ganze: Du findest es faszinierend zu verstehen, wie ein globales Unternehmen funktioniert, und bist motiviert, die Unternehmensziele durch effektive kaufmännische Steuerung zu unterstützen.​ Dein Verständnis für Human-centric Leadership: Du lebst die Überzeugung, dass herausragende Ergebnisse nur durch die Befähigung von Menschen entstehen. Wertvolle erste Einblicke in die Unternehmenssteuerung, gern auch durch Praktika oder Werkstudententätigkeiten, konntest du bereits sammeln.​ Deine kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung: Du setzt in unserem dynamischen Umfeld deine Fähigkeit, schnell zu lernen, täglich ein und entwickelst dich so kontinuierlich weiter – ein Growth-Mindset, das wir aktiv fördern.​ Deine sprachliche Gewandtheit: Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Englisch und bringst gute Deutschkenntnisse (B2-Niveau) mit, um dich in unserem internationalen und lokalen Umfeld sicher zu bewegen.

title: Senior Financial Risk Manager
description: Brocc is a specialised niche bank embarking on a bold and transformative growth journey, fuelled by strong institutional backing and a clear strategic vision. Positioned at the forefront of the European credit market, Brocc combines deep heritage in consumer finance with cutting-edge technology and expertise in NPL acquisition and restructuring, building a best-in-class debt finance platform that supports clients across the full credit lifecycle. With substantial capital resources, an ambitious growth agenda, and a collaborative, entrepreneurial culture, Brocc is uniquely placed to shape the future of the credit ecosystem. As we scale across new markets and asset classes, building a robust, forward-looking risk function is central to how we operate, and to how we earn the trust of clients, partners, and supervisors. Now, we're looking for a Financial Risk Manager to join our growing team within our Group Risk Control Function and take ownership of how we identify, assess, and manage financial risks and play a key role in capital and liquidity planning across the organisation. You will work closely with Treasury, Credit, Finance, and executive management, and present regularly to the Board Risk Committee. This is a broad, hands-on role in a growing Swedish bank, combining quantitative analysis with regulatory engagement and strategic advisory to the business. What you'll do You'll lead the second-line financial risk function, partnering with the business to design and embed a framework that scales with us. In practice, that means: Lead independent identification, measurement, monitoring, and reporting of credit, market, and liquidity risks across the balance sheet Maintain and develop the risk appetite framework, limits, and early-warning indicators, escalating breaches and driving remediation Independently validate and challenge risk models built by the first line (PD/LGD/EAD, IFRS 9 ECL, liquidity and IRRBB), and own the model risk management framework Oversee liquidity and funding metrics (LCR, NSFR, survival horizon) and challenge deposit behavioural and funding concentration assumptions Evaluate the risk components of the ICAAP and ILAAP, including internal stress testing, scenario design, and capital and liquidity adequacy Deliver timely, decision-ready reporting that gives the CRO, executive management, and the Board Risk Committee a forward-looking view of market risks Translate regulatory developments (CRR3/CRD VI, BRRD, EBA guidelines, FFFS) into policies, appetite, and methodology Provide second-line challenge on new products, policy changes, business and funding plans, and strategic initiatives Coach other risk analysts and build risk awareness across the organisation as a trusted partner, not a blocker Who you are You've built financial risk frameworks in regulated financial institutions and know how to make them practical, not bureaucratic. You're as comfortable challenging a financial risk owner as you are presenting to the Board, and you bring the judgment to know when to push and when to partner. More specifically, you bring: Several years of experience in financial risk management within a bank, credit institution, or consultancy serving financial institutions MSc in Finance, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, or an equivalent quantitative field Deep knowledge of the EU banking regulatory framework - CRR3/CRD VI, EBA guidelines, and Finansinspektionen's regulations (FFFS) Hands-on experience with ICAAP/ILAAP, stress testing, and regulatory reporting (COREP/FINREP a plus) Strong quantitative and modelling skills, with proficiency in Excel and at least one of Python, R, or SQL Experience with IFRS 9 expected credit loss modelling or credit portfolio analytics is a strong plus The ability to translate complex quantitative results into clear, decision-ready messages for the Board, management, and regulators The independence to provide constructive challenge to the first line and senior management, with high integrity and sound judgment under regulatory scrutiny A pragmatic, hands-on mindset - comfortable in a smaller bank where you build as well as oversee Fluent in English and Swedish FRM, PRM, or CFA certification is a plus Why Brocc? We're a ~50-person team backed by Cerberus Capital Management, with local presence in Stockholm, Helsinki, and London and operations across 15 European markets. You'll join at a pivotal moment in our growth, with real ownership of your area and direct visibility to senior leadership, including the CRO, CEO, and Board. We move fast, we value people who take initiative, and we're building a credit institution that genuinely changes how consumers and counterparties experience finance. Sound like you? We'd love to hear from you - send us your application and let's talk. Department Risk Locations Stockholm

Experience in process design and development within hydrometallurgical operations or the chemical process industry. The ability to evaluate process solutions and participate in the technical specification and procurement of process equipment. Strong collaboration and communication skills and the ability to work effectively in an international project environment. Fluency in Finnish and English. International procurement, supplier selection, tendering, and contract negotiations. Procurement of process equipment for chemical processing plants or similar industrial facilities. Coordinating Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and related supplier activities. Working in process industry production environments or industrial investment projects. Serving as a Project Engineer or Project Manager in industrial capital investment projects. Participating in EPC and EPCM projects or large-scale engineering projects. We generate and deliver reliable energy to our customers and the Nordic energy system while at the same time helping industries decarbonise their processes and grow. Our core operations comprise efficient and best-in-class low-carbon power generation, customer services, and heating and cooling. description: Vill du arbeta i en verksamhetsnära roll där analys, affärsförståelse och utveckling står i fokus? Till Kvd Group söker vi nu en engagerad Junior Business Controller som vill ta ett helhetsgrepp om verksamhetens ekonomiska uppföljning, bidra med värdefulla insikter och vara en viktig partner i att driva lönsamhet och effektivitet framåt. Om rollen Du kommer att arbeta med ett brett spektrum av arbetsuppgifter, från budgetering och finansiella prognoser till att stötta verksamheten med beslutsunderlag och analyser. I rollen ingår såväl avstämningar och kostnadsuppföljning som bokslutsarbete och framtagande av uppföljningsrapporter. Du kommer även att bidra med lönsamhetsanalyser och ta fram business case som stöd för strategiska beslut inom koncernens olika projekt och verksamhetsområden. title: Client Advisor Generalist
description:
Swedbank arbetar för att skapa en trygg och hållbar ekonomi för våra kunder. Med hög tillgänglighet, stort engagemang och affärsfokus kan du vara med att forma fram framtidens kundmöten samt en attraktiv och positiv arbetsplats.

Hos oss på Swedbank har du en möjlighet att:

  • Erbjuda bästa möjliga bemötande och affärsmässiga service till Swedbanks kunder som besöker det lokala bankkontoret samt ringer in till banken från samtliga delar av Sverige.

  • Skapa tillgänglighet till bankens tjänster och produkter där guidning i digitala verktyg och personlig service samverkar för god kundnöjdhet.

  • Besvara frågor gällande bankens produkt- och tjänsteutbud samt slussa vidare kunder där licenser krävs för djupare rådgivning.

  • Samarbeta och bidra till merförsäljning genom att identifiera kundbehov och presentera relevanta lösningar för att överträffa kundernas förväntningar.

  • Utveckla din kompetens inom bank och finanssektorn där du dagligen möter nya situationer och utmaningar.

I denna roll behöver du: 

  • Ha ett service- och affärsdrivet fokus samt trivas i mötet med människor.

  • Ha tidigare arbetslivserfarenhet från service- och/eller finansrelaterat arbete.

  • Tala och skriva flytande svenska samt ha goda kunskaper i engelska.

  • Vara trygg i kundmötet per telefon samt i kundmötet på kontor.

  • Arbeta målinriktat med fokus på att skapa värde för kunden.

  • Inta ett pedagogiskt förhållningssätt och kommunicera tydligt för att guida kunden i bankens digitala verktyg samt hitta kundanpassade lösningar.

  • Visa intresse för att fördjupa din kunskap om hur banken motverkar penningtvätt och finansiering av terrorism, och kunna tillämpa denna kunskap i varje kundmöte.

  • Gilla problemlösning och försäljning, med förmåga att identifiera kundens behov och presentera lösningar som passar kundens situation.

Hos oss kan du uppleva:

  • Personlig och professionell utveckling genom självledarskap och kontinuerlig utveckling.

  • Meningsfullt arbete som positivt påverkar vår arbetsplats, våra kunder och samhället.

  • En öppen och samarbetsinriktad kultur som uppmuntrar tvärfunktionellt teamarbete och erbjuder nätverksmöjligheter.

  • En stöttande och inkluderande miljö som främjar en balanserad och hållbar arbetslivssituation, med flexibla arbetsförhållanden när det passar rollen.

  • Förmåner såsom vårt erbjudande för bankprodukter för anställda, tjänstepensionsplan, aktiebaserade belöningsprogram Eken, och friskvårdsbidraget.

"Bli en del av vårt team och...

Inled din utvecklingsresa inom våra kundmötande tjänster. Du får jobba i direkt kundkontakt och hjälpa människor nå lösningar på sina ärenden. Du är Swedbanks ansikte utåt och en oerhört viktig del av vår verksamhet. Vi tror att du kan vara dig själv och samtidigt utvecklas till en framgångsrik kundrådgivare. Om du känner igen dig i denna beskrivning är vi mycket intresserade av dig. Vi värnar om ditt välmående och erbjuder en hållbar arbetsmiljö. På Swedbank är medarbetarna vår största tillgång. Vi har en kultur som bygger på respekt, inkludering och öppenhet, där varje medarbetares röst är viktig. Vi lever bankens värderingar; Öppen, Enkel och Omtänksam” Matilda Winglander, din framtida chef

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan senast den 2026-09-10. 

Placeringsort: Vetlanda

Rekryterande chef: Matilda Winglander

Vi kan komma att påbörja urvalet under ansökningstiden och välkomnar din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

Vi vill göra dig uppmärksam på att bakgrundskontroll och drogtest kan komma att genomföras för denna roll om du går vidare i processen.

Vi har gjort vårt medieval för rekrytering och undanber oss därför kontakt med annonssäljare eller säljare av andra rekryteringstjänster.

Swedbank är en inkluderande arbetsgivare och diskriminerar ingen utifrån kön, ålder, sexuell läggning eller sexuell identitet, etnicitet, religion eller funktionsnedsättning - alla är välkomna.

title: Investment Manager (m/w/d) AOB Invest GmbH
description: Finance München Full Time Company Overview AOB Invest GmbH is a Munich-based single-family office pursuing a broad, endowment-style investment strategy across private equity, hedge funds, infrastructure, listed equities, commodities, real estate, and direct investments. The office is simultaneously building a dedicated late-stage investment track with potential to broaden beyond the family office itself over time. The environment is lean, entrepreneurial, and international. We operate with high standards, low bureaucracy, and a strong bias toward ownership and execution. A significant part of the platform is still being built - therefore we are looking for the right candidate to take ownership in this role. Role Overview The Investment Manager is a core member of the investment team, responsible for the full investment lifecycle - from strategy development and opportunity sourcing through due diligence, execution, and ongoing portfolio oversight. The role requires genuine range across public and private markets, fund investments and direct deals, portfolio construction and process buildout. The successful candidate will operate with a high degree of independence, bring structured thinking to complex investment questions, and translate analysis into clear recommendations for the Managing Director. This is a role for someone who combines investment judgment with a builder's mentality and who is comfortable both shaping long-term strategy and executing within an environment that is entrepreneurial, fast-moving, and not fully pre-structured. Key Responsibilities Investment Strategy Support the development and continuous refinement of the overall investment strategy, across asset classes, geographies, and time horizons, and translate strategic considerations into structured, decision-ready materials for management Conduct deep-dive research and market analysis on new and existing asset classes, including venture investments (mostly direct), public equities, hedge funds, private equity, real estate (direct), infrastructure funds, commodities, to build a differentiated and fact-based investment view Evaluate portfolio construction choices across liquidity, correlation, allocation targets, and commitment pacing; develop clear recommendations with scenario analysis and risk considerations Prepare well-structured investment proposals, IC decision templates, and management summaries that enable fast, informed decision-makin Sourcing, Due Diligence, Execution & Portfolio Oversight Actively source and screen investment opportunities across our entire investment universe Lead or support commercial, financial, and strategic due diligence, including financial modelling, business model assessment, competitive positioning, financing structures, fund terms, and transaction logic Coordinate with external advisors (legal, tax, structuring) and own the integration of their input into internal diligence files and decision documents; manage execution from initial screening through closing Monitor existing investments across the portfolio: track performance, capital calls, distributions, and thesis adherence; flag material developments and prepare structured update materials for the Managing Director Own public markets portfolio work: screener and optimizer development, monthly rebalancing, and daily/weekly performance reporting Investment Infrastructure & Process Improvement Build and continuously upgrade the investment infrastructure: screening frameworks, diligence checklists by asset class, tax diligence playbooks, pipeline management (Affinity), and portfolio reporting routines (Qplix/Addepar) Drive the setup and adoption of tools that make investment workflows more efficient, transparent, and repeatable — including AI-based solutions for research, documentation, and reporting Late-Stage Investment Track Buildout Support the continued development of the family office's late-stage direct investment strategy — from defining the investment thesis and target profile to building a repeatable sourcing and evaluation process Develop and maintain a structured pipeline of late-stage opportunities; support in establishment of relationships with founders, co-investors, and intermediaries relevant to this strategy Build the analytical and institutional foundation required for this track: evaluation frameworks, deal scoring, diligence standards, and decision documentation tailored to late-stage transactions Help assess and prepare reporting standards, process quality, and investment materials consistent with institutional expectations Candidate Profile At least 7 years of relevant experience in investing, transaction execution, or analytical roles within high-performance environments such as a sophisticated family office, private equity or venture capital firm, hedge fund, asset manager, investment bank, transaction advisory practice, or leading strategy consultancy. Breadth across asset classes and across the investment process, with proven ability to assess opportunities rigorously, lead execution, and operate effectively in a lean, entrepreneurial setting. Proven track record of evaluating investment opportunities, building analytical materials, and leading diligence and execution Outstanding academic background in Finance, Economics, Business, Engineering, or Mathematics Excellent financial modelling skills and a strong grasp of business models, market structures, and value creation drivers Very strong understanding of financing structures, capital structures, fund mechanics, and transaction logic Fluency across asset classes, both liquid and illiquid, without retreating into a single product lane High proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; strong AI fluency and the practical ability to use it to improve speed, quality, and repeatability in investment workflows Clear, mature communication style with the ability to synthesize complexity into high-quality internal materials English: Fluent, written and spoken, with full confidence in international professional settings German: Fluent, written and spoken Highly ambitious and performance-oriented, with genuine intellectual curiosity across markets and asset classes. Entrepreneurial and hands-on, willing to execute what the role requires. Loyal, discreet, and trustworthy, with the judgment to operate in a confidential environment. Commercially minded and numerically strong, without losing sight of the bigger picture. Comfortable with ambiguity and capable of creating structure where minimal yet exists. Why This Role This is an opportunity to join a highly selective, entrepreneurial single-family office in a role with real breadth and influence. The Investment Manager will not be confined to one strategy or one process lane. The role offers cross-asset investing, proximity to decision-making, and direct ownership of how the investment platform is built, including the continued development of a late-stage investment capability with potential for external relevance. The Investment Manager reports directly to the Managing Director and works in close coordination with the broader internal platform, including finance and operations. The role involves regular engagement with external managers, founders, advisors, banks and peer family offices across jurisdictions.

title: Projekt-Portfolio-Manager (m/w/d)
description: Die S-Markt & Mehrwert GmbH & Co. KG ist als zentrale Servicegesellschaft der Sparkassen-Finanzgruppe mit über 1.150 Mitarbeitern für Sparkassen, deren Verbundpartner und weitere Auftraggeber bundesweit tätig. Wir liefern leistungsstarke und kundenzentrierte Lösungen, die immer auf der Höhe der Zeit sind. Das heißt: digital, individuell und innovativ. Wir suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt für unseren Standort in Halle (Saale) in Vollzeit einen Projekt-Portfolio-Manager (m/w/d) Deine Aufgaben Projektleitung: Du leitest und steuerst eigenverantwortlich IT-Projekte mit unterschiedlicher Komplexität, von der Initiierung bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Dies umfasst die detaillierte Planung, Koordination und Überwachung von Projektumfang, Zeitplan, Budget und Ressourcen sowie die effiziente Führung interdisziplinärer Projektteams aus IT, Fachbereichen und externen Partnern. Hierzu gehören die Bewertung, Priorisierung und Auswahl von Projekten basierend auf Geschäftswert, Risikoprofil und Ressourcenverfügbarkeit über das gesamte Portfolio hinweg. Du verantwortest das übergeordnete Ressourcenmanagement und die kontinuierliche Optimierung der Portfolioleistung. Dies beinhaltet ein konsolidiertes Reporting über den Status und die Performance von Einzelprojekten und des Gesamtportfolios an alle relevanten Stakeholder und das Top-Management. Strategische Entwicklung: Du unterstützt die Entwicklung von Produkten und Lösungen mit IT-Bezug (z. B. digitale Services, Plattformlösungen, Automatisierung) und stellst deren strategische Einordnung und Beitrag zum Gesamtportfolio sicher. Potenzialanalyse & Entscheidungsfindung: Du identifizierst Optimierungs- und Digitalisierungspotenziale in Prozessen und Systemlandschaften und erarbeitest Entscheidungsvorlagen für das Management, die sowohl Einzelprojekte als auch die strategische Ausrichtung des Portfolios berücksichtigen. Du verfügst über exzellente Kenntnisse in klassischen und/oder agilen Projektmanagementmethoden (z. B. PRINCE2, PMI, Scrum, hybride Modelle). Nachgewiesene Portfoliomanagement-Kompetenz: Praktische Erfahrung in der Definition, Analyse und Steuerung von IT-Projektportfolios. Du verstehst es, strategische Unternehmensziele in ein kohärentes Projektportfolio zu übersetzen und dessen Wertbeitrag kontinuierlich zu maximieren. Technologisches Verständnis: Tiefgehendes Verständnis für IT-Architekturen, Systemlandschaften und digitale Plattformlösungen sowie Erfahrung im Umfeld digitaler Produkte, Kundenlösungen oder IT-gestützter Geschäftsprozesse. Starke Kommunikations- und Moderationsfähigkeiten sowie ein sicheres Auftreten gegenüber allen Hierarchieebenen. title: Production finance controller
description: Vill du ta nästa steg i din controllerkarriär och vara med och utveckla framtidens ekonomifunktion? Vi söker en produktionscontroller till Tarkett i Ronneby Som produktionscontroller får du en central och verksamhetsnära roll där du kombinerar analys, affärsförståelse och utvecklingsarbete. Du blir en viktig partner till produktionen och ledningen genom att bidra med insikter, uppföljning och beslutsunderlag som driver både effektivitet och förbättring. Rollen passar dig som vill arbeta nära verksamheten, påverka utvecklingen och vara med på resan när ekonomifunktionen tar nästa steg genom ökad digitalisering, smartare arbetssätt och moderna verktyg. Vi söker dig som har högskoleutbildning med inriktning ekonomi och några års erfarenhet, gärna från process- eller tillverkande industri. Du har ett genuint intresse för verksamhetsstyrning, analys och förbättringsarbete, och du motiveras av att utveckla arbetssätt, digitala verktyg och ekonomiprocesser. Erfarenhet av SAP eller liknande affärssystem är meriterande, liksom goda kunskaper i Excel. Som person är du analytisk, nyfiken, noggrann och strukturerad. Du trivs med att ta eget ansvar, samarbeta nära verksamheten och arbeta mot uppsatta mål och deadlines. Legal Counsel - Corporate Finance Stegra is seeking a Legal Counsel - Corporate Finance to join our Legal team and support both our equity financing activities and our large-scale project debt financing, together with more general corporate legal work. Reporting to the Head of Legal - Corporate Finance & Company Secretary, and working closely with our Lead Counsel - Project Finance, you will play a central role across the full spectrum of the company's financing activities, from equity raises and governance matters to debt documentation and compliance on our major project financing package, including ECA and public funding arrangements. This is an opportunity for a commercially minded lawyer who wants broad exposure across both equity and debt finance, working alongside senior stakeholders on some of the company's most important legal and financial matters. It is also a unique opportunity to work closely across and learn from all financing aspects of a one-of-a-kind project with an interesting and extensive capital stack enabling an ambitious and meaningful project. As Stegra continues to grow, the role offers significant exposure to a broad range of legal and finance matters, close collaboration with senior stakeholders, and the opportunity to help shape how legal support is delivered within a rapidly expanding international organization. Key Responsibilities As a fast-growing company with cross-over functions between teams, the scope of this role will evolve, however, core responsibilities include: - Supporting equity financing transactions, including capital raises, share issuances, stakeholder management and related governance and shareholder documentation. - Supporting the company's activities within M&A and joint ventures, including due diligence, transaction structuring, and negotiation and execution of transaction documentation. - Supporting the company's activities within off-balance sheet financing transactions and outsourcings. - Assisting with company secretarial matters, including preparing board materials, board resolutions, and compliance with governance documentation. - Supporting on the company's project debt financing, including loan agreements, security documents, and compliance with ECA and public funding conditions; as well as overseeing covenant compliance processes across multiple lending tranches. - Coordinating and managing direct agreements with project counterparties and supporting intercreditor arrangements and multi-party lender coordination. - Efficiently liaising with lenders' counsel, ECA counsel, technical advisers, insurance advisers, and other external specialists under tight drawdown deadlines. - Coordinating and building strong relationships with internal stakeholders (finance, tax, treasury, project delivery) and external parties (lenders, investors, law firms, ECAs, and regulatory bodies) on financing-related matters. - Monitoring ongoing compliance with financing covenants, reporting obligations, and regulatory requirements across both equity and debt workstreams. - Preparing summaries and reports on financing status, risks, and compliance for internal stakeholders and management. - Contributing to the development of scalable legal processes, templates, and playbooks to support the company's financing operations as it grows. Minimum Qualifications We are looking for candidates who meet the following criteria: - A Master of Laws (LL.M. or equivalent) with strong academic credentials. - Minimum 5 years of relevant legal experience at a leading law firm, within M&A, corporate finance, banking and finance, or capital markets. Relevant in-house experience is also a merit. - Demonstrated ability to independently manage transactional workstreams, from term sheet to complete documentation through drafting, negotiation, and execution. - Strong analytical and drafting skills, with a commercial mindset. - Effective communication and stakeholder management skills across both legal and finance functions. - A collaborative team player, comfortable working and learning across two related but distinct financing disciplines. Demonstrated ability to manage and organize high-volume transactional document sets, maintain accurate tracking of open items and workstream status, and coordinate effectively across multiple external advisers simultaneously, particularly under deadline-driven transaction timelines. - Fluency in English (written and spoken); additional languages are a plus. What Will Set You Apart: - Experience in both equity and debt financing transactions and M&A. - Experience in project finance, structured finance, or capital-intensive projects. - Experience with or exposure to joint venture structuring and negotiation. - Experience with or exposure to off-balance sheet financing transactions and outsourcings. - Familiarity with export credit agency (ECA) or public funding financing structures. - Experience with company secretarial or corporate governance matters. - Familiarity with project finance security structures, including pledges, assignments of contract rights, and direct agreements, and with intercreditor or coordination agreement mechanics in multi-tranche lending structures. Personal Qualities We value people who take initiative, build trust, and contribute to a collaborative workplace. You are curious, open to challenging established approaches, and treat others with respect. You are proactive, adaptable, results-driven, and able to prioritize and work independently with full ownership of your responsibilities. As a person you are likely independent, resilient, proactive and organized. You like to solve complex problems, work in a highly complex environment and have the a bility to thrive in a fast-paced and evolving business environment. Benefits at Stegra At Stegra, you'll join a company where your work has real impact on the climate, the industry, and future generations. We're building a culture rooted in safety, trust, and inclusion, where people feel supported to grow and thrive. You'll receive fair, competitive compensation aligned with collective agreements, along with benefits like up to 30 days of paid vacation, occupational pension, parental benefits, and insurance. If you need support with relocation or immigration, our relocation department will help guide you through the process, whether it's permits, housing or other practical matters. You can also enjoy perks like subsidized gym memberships and bike leases, plus the everyday benefits of life closer to nature. Read more about Benefits at Stegra here. Our Stockholm Office Our modern Stockholm office is located on Norra Stationsgatan, close to Karolinska University Hospital in central Stockholm. Here, you'll find a bright, collaborative workspace where cross-functional teams connect, share ideas, and drive progress. Whether you're visiting regularly or working hybrid, you'll be part of a vibrant office culture with easy access to the city's energy and amenities.

About the role:

You’ll be joining PwC’s Risk Line of Service, within our AI & Modelling team, working at the forefront of AI-enabled transformation in the insurance sector.

This role is for people who understand technology deeply enough to shape and execute a vision, not just talk about it. You will help insurance clients design, build and embed Generative AI, agentic and advanced analytics solutions across finance, actuarial, pricing, capital and risk functions, operating in an environment where technologies, architectures and regulatory expectations are evolving rapidly

As a Manager / Senior Manager, you will sit close to the technology: shaping solution architecture, guiding engineering and modelling teams, and ensuring that AI solutions are robust, scalable, explainable and fit for purpose in a regulated insurance environment. Leading the design and delivery of AI-enabled solutions, from problem definition through to deployment, across insurance pricing, reserving, capital modelling, finance transformation and risk analytics.

Shaping solution architectures for Generative AI and agentic systems, including decisions around data, models, orchestration, controls and integration into existing platforms.

Working hands-on with technical teams (engineers, data scientists, actuaries) to translate vision into buildable, testable and scalable solutions.

Navigating fast-moving technology landscapes, assessing emerging tools and approaches, and making informed trade-offs between innovation, risk, cost and time-to-value.

You have strong experience delivering technology-enabled transformation, in insurance or financial services, but with clear hands-on involvement in solution design and delivery.

You have practical experience with modern AI and analytics approaches, such as: Generative AI and large language model–based systems, Agentic or decision-automation architectures, Advanced analytics and modelling in regulated environments

You understand how AI solutions are built and operated, including: Data pipelines and feature engineering, Model lifecycle management (development, testing, monitoring), Integration with enterprise systems and workflows

You are comfortable making architectural and design decisions in situations where there is no single “right answer”, and technology choices evolve rapidly.

You understand insurance finance, actuarial, pricing, risk or capital well enough to design solutions that work in practice, not just in theory.

You can lead technical teams without needing to be the deepest specialist, providing direction, challenge and structure while enabling others to do their best work.

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions. ​

​

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

description:
About the Role:

Our Microsoft business here at PwC UK, within our Consulting mid-market transformation practice, has seen some significant growth and prospects over the last few months, and we are looking to grow our capabilities further to meet growing market demands.

Our Microsoft practice is engaged in helping small to medium-sized entities deliver successful Microsoft-based implementations and transformations, along with helping existing customers on Microsoft optimise and make the most of their investment in the technology.

● Be involved in anywhere between 2-5 Microsoft implementation or optimisation projects simultaneously across industry verticals and business process areas as an SME;

● Being overall responsible for Microsoft D365 implementation from a technical, functional, and/or organisational change management standpoint;

● Participating in business process mapping, including process analysis and design, gap analysis, functional system design and specifications, system configuration, and the development of system tests, procedures, and documentation.

● Analysing business/technical requirements and objectives, performing fit/gap analysis, and providing recommendations.

● Reporting to a partner or director, you will deliver Microsoft-related work to a varied portfolio of organisations in the UK across different targeted industries.

● Pushing the boundaries of what is possible, creating and leading new ideas and concepts through to fruition.

● Building and maintaining deep and long-lasting relationships with client personnel.

● Leading business development activity, including writing client proposals, facilitating our show home or model office, preparing and delivering client pitches with support from the team.

Developing the careers of the teams working with and reporting to you and raising the profile of the team externally by expanding the network, including with external bodies.

This role is for you if:

Extensive experience of Microsoft D365 experience as a Solution Architect and senior/lead consultant

● Experience of Microsoft architecture design for custom Microsoft solutions

● Strong exposure to finance, supply chain and manufacturing and warehouse management processes implementation.

● Experience in architecting Microsoft integrations with third-party systems.

● Develop innovative solutions for our rapidly expanding client base across a range of industries.

title: Forensic Technology Experienced Senior Consultant or Manager (Data Analytics focused)
location: Brno, Česká republika · Praha, Česká republika
description:
About the team

Our team of forensic professionals helps clients in difficult situations related to all kinds of fraud and employee misconduct. By combining data analytics, computer forensics, financial and investigative expertise with cutting-edge technology, we advise multinational corporates across sectors and countries that are involved in corporate investigations into fraud, corruption or other wrongdoing.

Joining our team as a Manager (or experienced Senior Consultant), you will be part of the CEE (Central and Eastern Europe) Forensic Technology team, working across a diverse portfolio of forensic data analytics, eDiscovery, complex investigations, compliance reviews and crisis response throughout the EMEA region, in collaboration with global colleagues and leading law firms.

About your Team Leader

Jakub Javorský is the head of PwC’s CEE Forensic Technology team, with 16 years of experience in fraud investigations and fraud risk prevention. He values a strong, close-knit team, positive motivation, continuous upskilling, and multidisciplinary collaboration.

Job description & summary

  • • Lead end-to-end forensic data analytics projects, extracting and analyzing transactional data from ERP systems, payment platforms, and other enterprise sources.

  • Design and automate forensic workflows and data processing scripts using Python, SQL, Alteryx, and Databricks to streamline client deliverables and accelerate insights.

  • Manage digital forensics (DFIR) engagements, including forensic data collections from laptops, mobile devices, servers, and databases. Oversee eDiscovery projects using RelativityOne and other leading platforms.

  • Advise clients on complex matters such as employee fraud, intellectual property theft, and third-party risk management.

  • Manage economics of individual projects, manage internal risk management and independence checks.

  • Mentor and supervise team members, manage stakeholder expectations, and translate complex technical findings into clear, outcome-focused reports for diverse audiences.

  • Communicate directly with clients and other stakeholders, ensuring secure and defensible outcomes.

  • Uphold the highest standards of integrity, professionalism, and personal accountability.

Requirements of the role

  • 5+ years of experience in forensic data analytics or risk analytics, ideally within a Big Four firm, consultancy, or large corporate forensic environment.

  • Strong proficiency in SQL (T-SQL, PL/SQL) and advanced Python programming for data extraction, analysis, and automation.

  • Expertise with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Qlik, or Power BI, and experience with Databricks.

  • Working knowledge of Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Natural Language Processing.

  • Ability to work under tight deadlines and adapt with flexibility.

  • Fluency in English required; Czech or Slovak language skills are a plus.

  • Ability to travel for work freely and on short notice within EU.

  • Applicants must be authorized to work and travel in the EU without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Nice to have, but not required skills

  • Experience conducting financial crime, employee fraud, IP theft, or data breach investigations, including sanctions screening and regulatory compliance.

  • Experience conducting forensic data analytics investigations, sanction screenings, automated 3rd party due diligence or similar.

  • Experience with scripting, AI, and software engineering principles—particularly designing automated solutions for data analytics, eDiscovery, and forensic workflows.

  • Familiarity with eDiscovery platforms (e.g., Relativity) and digital forensic tools (e.g., EnCase, Axiom, FTK, Cellebrite, XRY).

  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to produce forensic reports in English.

Our benefits and Fun

  • You will not get bored – you will learn new things at every new project.

  • You will be heard – we are looking for a candidate with curious and open mind and will listen to what he or she says.

description:
About the Role:

The UK transport sector is undergoing once-in-a-generation reform — from rail transformation and devolution to major capital investment, digitalisation, data-led decision making and workforce change. We help our clients navigate this complexity, design better operating models, and deliver transformation that improves outcomes for passengers, freight, places and the economy.

We are a highly motivated, capable, collaborative, diverse and caring team. We have grown significantly in recent years and have welcomed a wealth of talented individuals to the organisation. However, we have bold ambitions and see an even greater opportunity in the market. We are looking for more brilliant people to join our brilliant team. As a Senior Manager you’ll work as part of a team of problem solvers with extensive consulting and industry experience, leading projects to help our clients solve complex business issues and deliver enterprise wide transformation

What your days will look like:

  • Managing the design and delivery of iconic, technology-enabled transformation programmes for some of the largest public sector clients in the UK.

  • Contributing to the development of the market for large scale transformation delivery – identifying and researching opportunities to work with new / existing clients and helping to bring new offers to the market.

  • Helping to grow our multi-specialism Enterprise Transformation team, developing the tools and techniques that will help our clients transform their ways of working and secure better outcomes for the people and places they serve.

  • Leading on the management of engagement economics, risk and issue management, performance, project and programme management.

  • Owning senior stakeholder relationships to support the delivery of engagements and build your own networks in the market.

This role is for you if:

  • You have experience of scoping and leading transformation programmes in the Transport Sector.

  • You have experience of operating model design and implementation / transformation programme management / transformation communications and engagement / change and adoption management.

  • You have experience of interpreting clients’ strategic, operational and external drivers for change, gaining respect, building trust and inspiring stakeholders and ability to forecast costs and manage to programme timelines and budget.

  • You understand of transformation opportunities in the Transport sector and what are the general factors to be considered while designing and implementing complex transformation programmes.

  • You have experience in developing requirements across process, people, organisation, technology and information

  • You have the ability to articulate the business benefits of adopting digital and cloud technologies as part of wider transformations

  • Successful track record of delivery leadership in Government and Transport sectors as a consultant or working directly in the sector.

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions. We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

title: Product Manager Specific Solutions
description: DECTRIS is a successful and expanding high-tech company that develops and produces X-ray and electron detectors. Our detectors are used worldwide in large-scale research facilities and in industry. Their unique properties enable scientific breakthroughs in life sciences and material sciences. Our more than 170 employees are located in Switzerland, the United States and Japan. At DECTRIS, we combine innovation and development with agile industry practices. As a spin-off of the Paul Scherrer Institute and by focusing on the needs of our customers, we are able to combine scientific excellence with qualified service and industrial know-how. Our scientists as well as our technical and commercial experts ensure that our customers benefit from the latest technologies. DECTRIS values collaborative working rather than traditional hierarchy and is guided by the principles of Sociocracy 3.0. Your Tasks Proactive Customer Interaction: Systematically track customers' upgrade cycles and facility roadmaps to engage in technical design dialogues pre-tender, influencing specifications early, and harvesting the full potential of our markets Strategic Portfolio Balancing: Strategically qualify Specific Solutions projects when standard options are unviable or selectively to demonstrate DECTRIS' cutting-edge custom capabilities Strategic Evaluation: Evaluate whether a customer request should be handled as a customized detector or if it signals the need for a new standard product Requirements Engineering: Coordinate with customers and Area Sales Managers to determine detector requirements, setup details, and application backgrounds Technical Feasibility: Collaborate with technical experts to estimate feasibility, risks, effort, time, and costs for novel designs Proposal Management: Provide Sales with technical concepts, price estimations, and lead times to create winning offers Project Oversight: Maintain a clear overview of ongoing projects and keep all internal and external stakeholders informed Balancing Interests: Find pragmatic solutions that match the customer's timeline and budget while protecting DECTRIS' interests and technical standards Visibility and Outreach: Represent Specific Solutions at conferences, user meetings, and facility visits; turn completed custom builds into reference cases and application stories that seed the next generation of requests Your Skills Science/engineering degree or similar, previous experience in product management or project management is an asset Strong understanding of X-ray technology, vacuum systems, and related equipment. You can quickly grasp the capabilities and boundaries of our standard products Excellent skills in interacting with various stakeholders, from scientists in international research facilities to internal cross-functional teams Ability to identify and reduce technical risks and suggest pragmatic solutions Understanding of how market trends and customers' needs can be leveraged to enhance business outcomes You understand where the X-ray markets, its applications, and customer needs are heading, and you can translate that into which custom requests are worth pursuing Proven ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple customer requests simultaneously while meeting tight deadlines You are precise in creating and updating project and product documentation Average travel requirement around 15% We Offer A successful and growing high tech company in an international, scientific environment To join the global leader in HPC X-ray detectors for science and industry. Our Developers design cutting-edge detectors to support the state of the art science and technology An international work environment formed by more than 170 experienced engineers, scientists and other professionals. The company languages are German and English Excellent, flexible working arrangements to enable professional development and personal life balance An attractive working environment: modern infrastructure with wheelchair-accessible rooms, small fitness room, underground car park, subsidised meals, free snacks and drinks, various company events, internal and external training, home office options, after-work beers and other joint leisure activities X-ray Markets Team The purpose of the X-ray Markets Team within DECTRIS is to drive DECTRIS' market leadership and competitiveness in the synchrotron and laboratory markets. The team deeply understands customer needs and our competencies, identifies market trends and opportunities, and formulates a comprehensive market strategy. They create a roadmap for product development and market penetration, aligning it with DECTRIS' overall business goals. Through collaborative efforts across functions such as sales, marketing, product management, operations, and research and development, the team ensures that DECTRIS remains at the forefront of the X-ray market by providing innovative solutions that meet customer demands, outpace the competition, and drive business growth.

Advanced Manufacturing Engineering Manag

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role you will be responsible for providing the technical lead and coordination of process improvements for the US – Motion - System Drives Production Lines in the areas of Safety, Delivery, Internal Logistics, Lean Manufacturing, Change Management, Automation and Quality.


The work model for the role is: onsite in New Berlin, WI.

This role is contributing to the High-Power Motion division in North America.

This may include contractor management, requirement specification development, or other project management tasks of the change.


Our team dynamics
Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters - because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

  • Basic understanding of CAD Software (Autodesk/AutoCAD preferred) .

  • Working knowledge of ERP software, preferably SAP.

title: Strategic Finance
description: TL;DR: You'll be the analytical engine behind Lovable's fastest-moving finance decisions. Working directly with the team that built our financial infrastructure from scratch, you'll model vendor economics, build scenario analyses, reconcile messy data into clean insights, and give our leadership the numbers they need to move fast and move right. This is not a back-office role. You'll be in the room where the decisions happen. Why Lovable? Lovable lets anyone and everyone build software with any language. From solopreneurs to Fortune 100 teams, millions of people use Lovable to transform raw ideas into real products - fast. We are at the forefront of a foundational shift in software creation, which means you have an unprecedented opportunity to change the way the digital world works. Over 2 million people in 200+ countries already use Lovable to launch businesses, automate work, and bring their ideas to life. And we’re just getting started. We’re a small, talent-dense team building a generation-defining company from Stockholm. We value extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We seek out people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. What we’re looking for In one sentence: Build the models, pull the data, and surface the insights that drive Lovable's most consequential financial decisions. Own the analytical heavy lifting: Build and maintain financial models across vendor economics, unit cost attribution, scenario planning, and investment tradeoffs. You'll be the person who turns ambiguous data into something our team can act on. Drive vendor and cost intelligence: We spend a significant portion of our operating expenses annually across LLM providers, cloud infrastructure, and SaaS tools. You'll model the commercial economics, track spend against commitments, and flag opportunities before they become problems. Support strategic finance across the business: From headcount planning to revenue modeling to partnership economics, you'll provide analytical leverage wherever the highest-priority question is. One week it's an LLM cost attribution model. The next it's a pricing scenario for a new revenue stream. Context-switching is the job. Reconcile the chaos: Lovable moves fast and the data doesn't always keep up. You'll dig into billing data, accounting records, and operational metrics to find the truth in the noise. Investigative rigor is non-negotiable. Build for an AI-native function: We don't do things the old way. You'll use AI tools aggressively to accelerate your own work and help us design the finance function of the future. About you 1-3 years of experience: In investment banking, management consulting, private equity, or operational finance at a high-growth company. You’ve built strong analytical foundations and you’re ready to apply them to building something real. Exceptional modeler: You can build a financial model from a blank sheet and a messy data set. Excel and Google Sheets are second nature. SQL or BI tools (Hex, Looker, etc.) are a strong plus. Comfortable in chaos: You don't freeze when the data is incomplete, the timeline is tight, and the question keeps changing. You've worked in environments where "figure it out" is the brief. AI-native mindset: You use AI tools daily, not as a novelty but as core workflow. You're the person who finds a way to automate the tedious part before anyone asks you to. Hungry, not entitled: You understand that in-house finance is not high finance. You're not the product here — the product is. You bring the rigor from your training but you're energized by getting your hands dirty, not by the prestige of where you sit. Bonus points for: experience with SaaS or usage-based business models, exposure to cloud/LLM cost structures, or having built something yourself (side project, startup, Lovable app — anything that shows builder instinct). About your application Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join. We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: Indkøbskonsulent
description: Vil du være med til at opbygge en professionel indkøbsfunktion fra bunden? Kalundborg Forsyning søger en kollega, der får en central rolle i arbejdet med at etablere og udvikle vores nye indkøbsfunktion. Har du erfaring med indkøbsprocesser, samarbejde på tværs af organisationen og implementering af indkøbssystem – og motiveres du af at være med til at opbygge noget nyt? Så er du måske den kollega, vi søger. Rollen får stor betydning i arbejdet med at skabe mere struktur, ledelsesinformation og enklere arbejdsgange – herunder implementering af et indkøbssystem. Du bliver en del af økonomiafdelingen, hvor vi er 11 kolleger med forskellige faglige baggrunde, og hvor vi vægter samarbejde, høj faglighed og fleksibilitet. Du vil indgå i et tæt samarbejde med jura afdelingens udbudsjurister samt på tværs af virksomhedens fagområder. Ansvarsområder og opgaver Du får en vigtig rolle i arbejdet med at opbygge en mere professionel og sammenhængende indkøbsfunktion, det er en spændende og udfordrende opgave, hvor du har stor indflydelse på forløbet. Du vil samarbejde med ledere, driften, projektledere og øvrige stabsfunktioner, og du vil være med til at omsætte ambitioner til konkrete løsninger. Som vores kommende kollega vil dine opgaver bl.a. være at opbygge og forankre Kalundborg Forsynings indkøbsfunktion, herunder skabe struktur, roller og gode arbejdsgange – Kalundborg Forsyning er ISO certificeret at understøtte implementeringen af et indkøbssystem, så bestilling, godkendelse og opfølgning bliver mere ensartet og effektiv at udvikle ledelsesinformation og relevante nøgletal, der giver overblik over indkøb, aftaleanvendelse, compliance og forbrug at samarbejde med organisationen om at analysere nuværende indkøbsmønstre, identificere forbedringsmuligheder og understøtte implementering af nye løsninger at medvirke til opfølgning på leverandører, aftaler og processer, så indkøbsområdet udvikles på et datadrevet og forretningsnært grundlag Faglige og personlige kvalifikationer Vi forestiller os, at du har en relevant uddannelsesmæssig baggrund og erfaring med indkøb, økonomi, procesudvikling eller lignende. Det vigtigste er, at du kan kombinere analytisk forståelse med evnen til at få nye processer og løsninger til at fungere i praksis. Vi lægger vægt op, at du: er god til at indgå i tværgående samarbejde med forskellige fagområder har erfaring med indkøbsprocesser og indkøbssystemer trives med at opbygge nye arbejdsgange og holde fokus på både drift, kvalitet og forankring er stærk analytisk og kan omsætte data til relevant ledelsesinformation og konkrete forbedringer har lyst til at gøre en forskel i en rolle, hvor du både skal udvikle, koordinere og følge op kan arbejde struktureret og selvstændigt, samtidig med at du formår at skabe gode samarbejdsrelationer på tværs af organisationen med fordel kan have erfaring med Business Central eller BI-værktøjer – men det er ikke et krav Vi kan tilbyde Kalundborg Forsyning er en moderne forsyning, hvor du som medarbejder har indflydelse på dine arbejdsopgaver og udførelsen af dem. Du bliver en del af en arbejdsplads med en vigtig samfundsopgave, høj faglighed og en uformel kultur, hvor samarbejde og udvikling er en naturlig del af hverdagen Vi tilbyder blandt andet: mulighed for at arbejde hjemmefra op til 2 dage om ugen fleksibel arbejdstid sundhedsforsikring, fuldtidsulykkesforsikring fysisk træning i firma regi, hvor du må bruge en halv time om ugen af din arbejdstid fælles morgenbrød og deling af relevant information hver fredag. Ønsker du flere informationer Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte: Økonomichef Tina Ottesen på 40 28 73 31. Stillingen er fuldtid på 37 timer. Der afholdes to samtaler og 1. samtalerunde er onsdag den 23. september og 2. samtalerunde er mandag den 28. september 2026. Vi forventer ansættelse fra den 1. november 2026. Kalundborg Forsyning er en virksomhed med plus hundrede medarbejdere, og vi vokser fortsat. Vi anses for at være blandt frontløberne inden for forsyningsbranchen. Gennem de senere år har vi bygget innovative løsninger inden for vand og varme, og vi er langt fra færdige. Vi er ikke bange for at gå foran og vise vejen for branchen. Vi leverer drikkevand og fjernvarme til husstande og virksomheder i Kalundborg – samt rensning af spildevand fra hele Kalundborg Kommune. Vi er en matrix-organisation, hvor vi samarbejder på tværs, og hvor der er korte beslutningsveje. Vi har stor fokus på arbejdsmiljø og er certificeret i dette. Kalundborg Forsyning er en central aktør i den internationalt anerkendte Kalundborg Symbiose. Trivsel er i højsædet, og vi har stor fokus på work-life balance. Vi har flere forskellige tiltag for at sikre det psykiske og fysiske arbejdsmiljø.

Production Engineering Manager

__

In this role, you will have the opportunity to optimize the Production organization’s assembly methods, processes, and equipment to minimize labor hours in accordance with business strategies related to quality, efficiency, costs, and safety.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Defines the working phase sequence of a new production process to achieve the targeted product cost and equipment investment budget.

  • Bachelor degree in engineering

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in a manufacturing or distribution facility

  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office, AutoCAD, and SAP (or similar ERPs) is strongly preferred

  • Experience with project management and proven history of driving and sustaining change.

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. title: Ekonom till Svenska Livräddningssällskapet Göteborg
description: Varje år lär sig tusentals barn att simma genom Svenska Livräddningssällskapet Göteborgs verksamhet. Bakom varje simskola, livräddningsutbildning och insats för ökad vattenkompetens finns människor som får verksamheten att fungera. Nu söker vi en ekonom som vill ta ett helhetsgrepp om vår ekonomi och kombinera sitt ekonomiska kunnande med ett genuint samhällsengagemang. Om rollen Det här är en bred och operativ roll där du hanterar ekonomin i en organisation med många verksamhetsgrenar och olika intäktsflöden. Du blir personen som ser till att ekonomin fungerar idag, samtidigt som du bidrar med underlag och insikter för morgondagens beslut. I rollen arbetar du hands-on i vardagen och säkerställer att ekonomiprocessen fungerar, från löpande bokföring, löner och deklarationer till månadsbokslut, budgetarbete, ekonomisk uppföljning och rapportering till styrelse. Du hanterar även avtal, försäkringar, kapitalförvaltning enligt styrelsens riktlinjer samt bidragsredovisning kopplat till delar av verksamheten. Som ensam ekonom blir du också organisationens självklara bollplank i ekonomiska frågor. Du hjälper kollegor och ledning genom att förklara, förenkla och skapa trygghet kring siffror och ekonomiska sammanhang. Vårt verksamhetsår följer inte ett traditionellt affärsår. Simskolor, utbildningar och projektfinansierade satsningar skapar variationer över året, vilket ställer krav på både framförhållning och helhetsperspektiv. Om dig Du trivs i en roll där många vänder sig till dig för råd och vägledning. Med ett lugnt och pedagogiskt sätt bygger du förtroende och hjälper andra att känna sig trygga i ekonomiska frågor. Samtidigt är du självgående, strukturerad och van vid att ta ansvar för ditt område. Du har lätt för att växla mellan detaljer och helhetsperspektiv och trivs i en bred roll där du får kombinera eget ansvar med nära samarbete i verksamheten. Dessutom uppskattar du det engagemang och den gemenskap som kännetecknar föreningslivet och känner dig hemma i en organisation där människor drivs av ett gemensamt syfte. Vi tror att du uppskattar en arbetsplats där hjärta, engagemang och samhällsnytta är lika viktiga som resultat och kvalitet. Här blir du en viktig del av en organisation som varje dag arbetar för att fler människor ska känna sig trygga i, vid och på vatten. Flerårig erfarenhet av självständigt ekonomiarbete med löpande bokföring, månadsbokslut, löner och rapportering Erfarenhet från en ideell organisation, förening eller annan medlemsstyrd verksamhet Van att rapportera och presentera ekonomi för ledning eller i andra beslutsfattande forum Eftergymnasial utbildning inom ekonomi Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift Varför Svenska Livräddningssällskapet Göteborg? Hos oss får du en central roll i en organisation där människor stannar länge, där engagemanget är äkta och där arbetet gör skillnad. Svenska Livräddningssällskapet Göteborg är en ideell organisation med ett tydligt syfte: att minska antalet drunkningar och öka säkerheten i, vid och på vatten. I snart 185 år har vi arbetat för ett tryggare samhälle genom simundervisning, livräddning och utbildning. Du får möjlighet att påverka, utveckla och bidra med din kompetens samtidigt som du blir del av en varm och prestigelös kultur där människor hjälper varandra och arbetar mot samma mål. Tillsammans driver vi verksamhet året runt, från simskolor och sommarsatsningar till utbildningar och andra viktiga funktioner inom vatten- och säkerhetsområdet.
