title: Data Architect – Technology Consulting
description:
About the team

Join us at PwC Technology Consulting, where we blend business and technology! Be part of a team that crafts innovative solutions across Europe, diving into diverse company cultures and technologies.Our journey doesn't stop at client projects. Dive into our six knowledge-rich communities, from New Technologies to Digital Strategies and beyond. At PwC, it's not just about growing; it's about thriving and leading the tech revolution.

About your manager

Tomáš Karas is a senior manager who leads our team of data experts and business intelligence projects. On projects, he works as a data architect and project manager in one and, together with his teams, helps build large data warehouses, or uses data to simplify and automate processes, thus saving our clients 1000 days of boring operational work. When he is not working, you can either see him with the team somewhere after work for a drink, or he takes care of a small home zoo, including two children and about 80 guinea pigs from their family farm.

Job description & summary

Are you passionate about data and eager to expand your skills and knowledge? Do you aspire to lead and guide others in your field? Dive deeper into the realms of implementation, data modeling, and ETL processes with our dynamic team. Come, grow and lead with us!

You will look in large databases for specific data. You will lead young engineers, and you will be the main intermediary for communication with the client. Thanks to that we have been able to redesign customer data quality processes and reduce boring operative manual work to our clients by thousands of hours per each month.

  • Define cloud solution architecture design in data solutions.

  • Definition of data governance standards and processes.

  • Leading teams of data analysts and engineers for end-to-end delivery of data solutions.

  • Data transformation rules definition and implementation

  • Report design and implementation

  • Functional and technical design preparation

  • Lead and guide junior colleagues

Requirements of the role

  • University degree

  • At least 5 years of experience

  • Cloud knowledge and practical experience with one of the following - Azure, AWS, Google Cloud

  • Practical experience with at least one of the following tools - Databricks, Kafka, Snowflake, Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Azure Pureview, BigQuery, AWS Glue, or similar cloud ETL or cloud data management tools

  • Practical experience with at least one of the following programming language - Python, Spark, PySpark, Java, Scala, R, C#

  • Experience with at least one of the following data management capabilities as data mesh architecture, master data management, data modeling in data vault, data governance

  • Strong analytical thinking, communication and presentation skills

  • Attention to detail, accuracy and punctuality

Our Benefits and Fun

  • Stable, but challenging working environment providing plenty of opportunities for your continuous professional growth.

  • Fair salary and flexible working hours.

  • Paid time off 30 days, 3 wellbeing days and 2 extra days off from the company at the end of the year.

  • High-end Ultrabook and iPhone with unlimited data.

  • Benefit program with 45.000 points that you can use for holidays, education, food vouchers, sports, health... Simply on what you enjoy.

  • Supporting your development and education: business and digital skills training (e.g. Alteryx, Power BI, Tableau), ongoing training and certifications, e.g. Microsoft (Azure, PowerApps), project management (Prince2, PMI), service management (ITIL), agile development (Scrum, SAFe), DAMA, Salesforce, coaching and presentation skills and more. And various training within our technology communities.

  • Opportunity to work in the future at a foreign PwC office, for example in the USA,

description:
About The Role:

We are recruiting a Director to join our Retail, Consumer and Leisure Corporate Finance team, a market-leading group of sector specialists advising on high-profile mid-market transactions. You will play a central role in originating and executing deals, working with entrepreneurs, private equity and corporates across a fast-evolving, dynamic consumer landscape.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of complex transactions, shape client outcomes and contribute to the continued growth of a high-performing team. We are looking for an experienced dealmaker with strong commercial judgement, an established network and a track record of delivering successful transactions end-to-end.

As a Director, you will combine transaction expertise and origination leadership to drive client outcomes and the growth of the team. Your day-to-day will include:

  • Building and maintaining a strong origination pipeline, identifying opportunities and leveraging your network to generate new business

  • Leading end-to-end transaction execution, managing timelines, stakeholders and delivery risk

  • Applying deep sector insights to shape client strategy and positioning across transactions

  • Providing leadership across the team, coaching and developing junior talent, and fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture

This role is for you if:

  • You have a proven track record of originating M&A transactions, ideally within the Retail, Consumer and Leisure sectors

  • You have extensive end-to-end transaction experience, with an ability to execute complex deals with multiple stakeholders

  • You have built and maintained senior client relationships across entrepreneurs, private equity and corporates, acting as a trusted adviser

  • You lead, develop and inspire high-performing teams, providing clear direction, coaching and structured development to junior colleagues.

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions. We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

title: Corporate Finance Specialist
description: Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. At Stegra, we're building an impact-driven, sustainable company - and we need a diverse, inclusive team to make it happen. If you share our passion but don't meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the perfect fit for this role, or another as we grow. At Stegra, we're not just building a plant, we're proving that sustainable industry is possible. And to do that, we need people like you. Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life. Corporate Finance Specialist We are looking for a highly analytical and commercially minded Corporate Finance Specialist to join our growing finance team. This is an exciting opportunity for an ambitious finance professional who wants to play a key role in fundraising, capital markets activities, financial modelling, and strategic decision-making within a fast-paced and growth-oriented business. Working closely with the Corporate Finance Lead, Head of Corporate Finance, CFO, and senior leadership team, you will provide critical financial insights, support funding initiatives, and contribute to the company's long-term growth strategy. What you'll do As a Corporate Finance Specialist, you will support a wide range of strategic finance activities, including: Maintaining and enhancing integrated cash flow and financial models used for fundraising, forecasting, valuation, and business planning. Performing financial analysis, valuation assessments, investment appraisals, scenario modelling, and sensitivity analysis. Supporting debt and equity fundraising processes through preparation of financial materials, presentations, and analysis. Assisting with due diligence processes, coordinating information requests, and managing documentation requirements. Supporting financing transactions and capital markets activities, ensuring timely execution of key workstreams. Preparing reports, presentations, and analytical materials for Executive Leadership Team and Board meetings. Supporting lender and investor reporting requirements and governance processes. Monitoring financing obligations, covenant compliance, and financing-related risks. Analysing asset performance, forecast assumptions, and transaction trigger metrics. Partnering with Finance, Operations, Commercial, and other business functions to ensure consistency and quality of financial data and forecasts. Building strong relationships with lenders, investors, advisors, and key stakeholders. Contributing to the continuous improvement of financial models, reporting processes, and analytical tools. Who you are You are a curious and detail-oriented finance professional with strong analytical capabilities and a passion for solving complex business problems. You thrive in dynamic environments and enjoy working with senior stakeholders on high-impact projects. Qualifications and experience We are looking for someone with: A Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, Business, or a related field. 2-5 years of experience in Corporate Finance, Investment Banking, Transaction Advisory, Infrastructure Finance, Project Finance, Treasury, FP&A, or a similar analytical role. Strong financial modelling, forecasting, valuation, and financial analysis experience. Exposure to debt financing, capital markets, fundraising, lender reporting, or transaction execution activities is advantageous. Experience supporting senior stakeholders with financial insights and recommendations. Progress toward, or completion of, a professional qualification such as CA, CPA, ACA, ACCA, CFA, or equivalent is considered beneficial. Skills and competencies You bring: Advanced Microsoft Excel and financial modelling skills. Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving abilities. Knowledge of corporate finance principles, valuation methodologies, and financial statement analysis. The ability to translate complex financial information into clear recommendations. Excellent communication and presentation skills. Experience preparing management, investor, or Board-level materials. Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities. Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, and financial reporting systems. Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. Personal attributes You are: Analytical and commercially minded. Proactive and results-oriented. Highly organised with excellent attention to detail. Collaborative and team-focused. Adaptable and comfortable managing multiple priorities. Professional, reliable, and able to exercise sound judgement. Benefits at Stegra At Stegra, you'll join a company where your work has real impact on the climate, the industry, and future generations. We're building a culture rooted in safety, trust, and inclusion, where people feel supported to grow and thrive. You'll receive fair, competitive compensation aligned with collective agreements, along with benefits like up to 30 days of paid vacation, occupational pension, parental benefits, and insurance. If you need support with relocation or immigration, our relocation department will help guide you through the process, whether it's permits, housing or other practical matters. You can also enjoy perks like subsidized gym memberships and bike leases, plus the everyday benefits of life closer to nature. Read more about Benefits at Stegra here. This is Stegra Stegra is on a mission to change the global steel industry by producing green hydrogen, iron, and steel - with the goal of eliminating CO₂ emissions. Instead of coal, we use green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity, meaning our primary emissions will be water and heat. By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitized, and sustainable plant in Boden, Northern Sweden - currently under construction. But this is just the beginning. Our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize industries beyond steel, paving the way for a cleaner future. Our Stockholm Office Our modern Stockholm office is located on Norra Stationsgatan, close to Karolinska University Hospital in central Stockholm. Here, you'll find a bright, collaborative workspace where cross-functional teams connect, share ideas, and drive progress. Whether you're visiting regularly or working hybrid, you'll be part of a vibrant office culture with easy access to the city's energy and amenities.

title: Operational Delivery Lead - Claims Management
description:
About the Role:

The Senior Manager – Claims Management Delivery Lead is responsible for owning service performance and leading the end-to-end execution of claims management across pre‑assessment, case handling, and final review within the financial services sector. The role is accountable for ensuring delivery across in-scope service areas meets contractual KPIs, SLAs, and quality expectations in a highly regulated environment. As a senior, client-facing leader, you will drive operational excellence, protect customer outcomes, and maintain robust controls and quality standards while fostering strong internal and external stakeholder relationships.

What Your Days Will Look Like:

  • Lead daily claims operations, overseeing delivery across pre-assessment, case handling, and final review while managing performance against KPIs and SLAs.
  • Oversee Team Leads/Managers, ensuring strong leadership alignment, performance, and delivery across production and quality.
  • Analyse MI to identify trends, risks, and opportunities, driving continuous improvement and remediation actions.
  • Engage regularly with clients and internal stakeholders to manage relationships, resolve issues, and remove delivery blockers.
  • Embed strong controls, quality frameworks, and support change initiatives within a regulated FS environment.

This Role Is for You If:

  • Proven experience leading financial services claims operations within a managed service environment.
  • Demonstrated leadership in regulated environments, with a focus on performance, quality, and control frameworks.
  • Strong MI and analytical capability, with experience driving performance improvements and remediation.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including client-facing experience and handling complex conversations.
  • Proven people leadership with experience building and managing high-performing teams and leading change initiatives.

What you'll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

title: Data, AI, Analytics & Platforms Manager (m/w/d)
description: Salary Range: €66,918.00 - €104,400.00 Job Description Summary #LI-Hybrid As DAP Manager (Data, AI, Analytics & Platforms), you will act as the local technical expert for data, analytics, automation and AI within the Execution Excellence function at Novartis Pharma Austria. In this role, you will take ownership of driving value from data and AI across Commercial, Value & Access (V&A), and Medical Affairs teams - ensuring that global Novartis strategy and capabilities are translated into impactful solutions. You will work across the core Novartis analytics and platform stack - including Python, Azure, Snowflake, and Power BI - to design and deliver applied automation solutions, AI/GenAI use cases, and scalable data products. GenAI and agentic AI, will serve as a strategic acceleration layer on top of a strong data and analytics foundation, supported by platform localization and operational readiness. Job Description Major Accountabilities Execution Excellence Data, AI, Analytics and Platforms manager supports Commercial, Value & Access and Medical Affairs teams across the following listed accountabilities. Data and Analytics Act as a hands-on data and analytics expert within Execution Excellence, developing production-grade solutions in Python and SQL for data transformation , statistical modeling, machine learning, and automation - working closely with technically strong Integrated Insights Managers. Design, build, and own local data models, transformation logic, and scalable SQL pipelines in Snowflake , applying global data architecture standards to local business needs in close collaboration with DDIT and International CLS DAP. Take full accountability to integrate local data sources (e.g. CRM, SFMC, financial and market data platforms) into the global Snowflake ecosystem , ensuring high standards of data quality, lineage, governance, and compliance with local data privacy regulations. Co-create Power BI solutions, lead the end-to-end design and enable dashboarding and reporting solutions. Build and maintain robust, scalable Power BI semantic models on Snowflake, ensuring high performance, reliable refresh cycles, and a consistent single source of truth for business-critical metrics. Leverage Azure, Open AI data and novel AI services to enable data integration, model development, deployment, and AI use cases - ensuring full alignment with the global Novartis platform landscape. AI/Gen AI Collect and prioritize local business requirements for AI/GenAI, agentic AI and advanced analytics; co-define the country AI roadmap with the Head Integrated Insights & DAP, International CLS DAP and BSI DAP Ops. Drive local adoption and impact of AI/GenAI and agentic AI products aligned with International DAP strategy and the Novartis AI Strategy , including AI-driven recommendations, Next Best Action, execution orchestration tools, content and campaign optimization, and emerging agentic AI workflows that autonomously plan and execute multi-step analytical or operational tasks. Define and apply measurement frameworks for AI use cases (adoption, recommendation quality, time saved, autonomy levels for agentic solutions, business impact on key KPIs) and consolidate learnings to inform future roadmap decisions. Champion responsible and ethical AI use locally, ensuring all AI/GenAI and agentic deployments respect data privacy, the Novartis Code of Ethics, functional separation requirements (including medical/commercial boundaries) and emerging AI governance standards. Coordinate with Capability Building to plan and deliver AI/GenAI and agentic AI training and enablement, ensuring users understand how to interpret, oversee and safely act on AI-generated insights and AI agent outputs. title: Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Senior Manager
description:
About the role:

We are seeking a Senior Manager to join our Risk and Resilience team to focus on Enterprise Risk Management. If you would like to work with the senior management teams of some of the UK’s leading non-financial services companies, have strong problem solving skills, intellectual agility and can build deep and productive relationships, our practice could be the right opportunity for you.

What your days will look like:

You’ll have experience in designing and implementing enterprise risk management (ERM) frameworks and be passionate about the value that can be derived from effective risk management. The successful applicant will have practical experience, ideally gained within a large consultancy or client organisation, of conducting some or all of the following activities:

  • Developing bespoke ERM frameworks and processes
  • Leading risk identification interviews and risk assessment workshops, including at executive management levels
  • Developing key risk indicator suites
  • Practical articulation of risk appetite
  • Designing risk reporting templates and dashboards
  • Conducting risk analytics, such as horizon scanning, scenario and strategic risk analysis etc.
  • Delivering impactful risk management training
  • Providing on-going risk monitoring support
  • Developing thought leadership and new propositions to help our clients
  • Managing and leading teams to deliver client facing, and internal engagements, including monitoring engagement progress and budget
  • Working as part of a team or independently depending on the size of the assignment
  • Developing and managing relationships with key client and internal stakeholders
  • Identifying and developing new client opportunities
  • Partial and full-time client secondments
  • Leading on the development of sales and marketing materials, including proposals and thought leadership
  • Providing input into the development of PwC’s ERM proposition

The role is for you if:

  • Highly confident and resilient, comfortable asserting yourself with senior clients (Executive and Board level)
  • Strong technical enterprise risk management knowledge (i.e. 7 years + experience) and proven ability developing and implementing practical risk management processes and frameworks
  • Familiarity with common risk analysis techniques, understanding of scenario modelling etc.
  • Experience using data and analytics to strengthen ERM insights (e.g. designing data-driven KRIs, dashboarding, trend/outlier analysis, and scenario/early-warning indicators)
  • Practical understanding of GenAI/LLM use cases in risk management (e.g. risk identification, horizon scanning, control/testing support, report drafting and synthesis)
  • Practical experience in one or more of the key risk areas that are relevant to our clients organisations (e.g. resilience, cyber security, geopolitical risks)
  • Knowledge of prevailing corporate governance requirements
  • Solid financial and commercial acumen and understanding
  • Excellent presentation skills and experience planning and facilitating workshops / risk exercises with senior level audiences
  • Robust diligence and ability to pay close attention to detail, including impeccable report-writing skills
  • Ability to innovate and think laterally
  • Strong interpersonal communication skills with ability to build trust and rapport with diverse internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Proven team management skills, including coaching and development of junior team members
  • Ability to work as part of a team and independently with little management oversight
  • Commercially focused and strong business development skills

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

These include flexible working, a hybrid office/client/home model, private medical cover, access to a virtual GP, volunteering days and a strong focus on wellbeing, inclusion and development.

title: Biträdande universitetslektor, Corporate Finance
description: Göteborgs universitet erbjuder en forskningsmiljö där internationellt erkänd forskning i världsklass förenas med en öppen och samarbetsdriven akademisk kultur. Här får forskare i början av karriären möjlighet att utvecklas, bygga internationella nätverk och bidra till forskning med global betydelse.Denna anställning är en del av universitetets satsning University of Gothenburg Global Scholars Initiative. Läs mer om satsningen och Göteborgs universitet här: https://www.gu.se/node/190161/ Vetenskapsrådet kommer att utlysa en attraktiv finansiering för biträdande universitetslektorer med internationell bakgrund i slutet av 2026. Universitetets ambition är att nominera konkurrenskraftiga kandidater från denna satsning till Vetenskapsrådet. Handelshögskolan vid Göteborgs universitet har cirka 3 700 heltidsstudenter, 470 medarbetare, 160 internationella partneruniversitet och fyra institutioner. Handelshögskolan är Triple Crown-ackrediterad genom EQUIS, AACSB och AMBA. Institutionen för företagsekonomi är Handelshögskolans största institution och bedriver omfattande forskning och utbildning på grundnivå, avancerad nivå och forskarnivå. Anställningen är placerad vid sektionen för Industrial and Financial Management & Logistics (IFEL), som bedriver forskning och utbildning inom bland annat corporate finance och har nära samarbeten med forskningsmiljöer såsom Centre for Finance (CFF), Northern Lead och Lighthouse. Ämne Företagsekonomi med inriktning mot Corporate Finance. Ämnesbeskrivning Corporate Finance behandlar företags finansiella beslutsfattande med fokus på investeringsbeslut, finansieringsstrategier och mekanismer för att säkerställa en marknadsmässig avkastning för både ägare och långivare. Centralt för området är utveckling av teoretiskt och empiriskt grundade ramverk som möjliggör lönsamma investeringar och effektiv finansiering med beaktande av risk och kapitalkostnad. Särskild vikt läggs vid analys av faktorer som påverkar företags val av kapitalstruktur och investeringsstrategier, särskilt i miljöer som präglas av asymmetrisk information och transaktionskostnader. En tydlig förankring i finansiell teori är central för att förstå, förklara och analysera dessa beslut och deras konsekvenser. Ämnesområdet har en stark metodinriktning där kvantitativa verktyg, såsom diskonteringsmodeller, reala och finansiella optionsmodeller samt statistiska och ekonometriska metoder, används för att analysera hur externa marknadsförhållanden påverkar företags finansiella beslut. Arbetsuppgifter Anställningen omfattar högst 50 procent undervisning och minst 50 procent forskning. Forskningen ska huvudsakligen bedrivas inom Corporate Finance, ligga i linje med ämnesbeskrivningen ovan och hålla sådan kvalitet att resultaten kan publiceras i högkvalitativa internationella vetenskapliga tidskrifter. Forskningen förväntas också aktivt presenteras och diskuteras vid forskningsseminarier och i akademiska nätverk. Undervisning sker på grundnivå och avancerad nivå, och den anställde förväntas även bidra till forskarutbildning och uppdragsutbildning samt till kursutveckling och administrativa uppgifter. Undervisningen avser främst kurser inom Corporate Finance, exempelvis Corporate Valuation, Advanced Corporate Finance och Financial Management eller motsvarande kurser, samt handledning av kandidat- och masteruppsatser inom finans och Accounting and Financial Management. I arbetsuppgifterna ingår även att aktivt söka externa forskningsmedel under anställningsperioden och att bidra till utvecklingen av institutionens utbildnings- och forskningsmiljö. Anställning Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning under fem år Omfattning: 100 % Placering: Institutionen för företagsekonomi, Handelshögskolan vid Göteborgs universitet Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse En anställning som biträdande universitetslektor är tidsbegränsad och definierad som en meriteringsanställning. Syftet är att den sökande ska ges möjlighet att utveckla sin självständighet som forskare och meritera sig såväl vetenskapligt som pedagogiskt för att uppfylla kraven på behörighet som universitetslektor. Anställningen får förnyas, dock högst sammanlagt två år, om det på grund av sjukfrånvaro, föräldraledighet eller andra särskilda skäl krävs ytterligare tid för att uppnå syftet med anställningen. Ansökan Du söker anställningen via Göteborgs universitets rekryteringsportal genom att klicka på knappen ”Ansök”. Du som sökande ansvarar för att ansökan är komplett i enlighet med annonsen och att den är universitetet tillhanda senast sista ansökningsdag. Vi ber dig att skriva din ansökan på engelska då ansökan granskas av externa sakkunniga där arbetsspråket är engelska. Alla meriter ska dokumenteras och intyg ska vara bestyrkta. Bilagor ska namnges så att innehållet tydligt framgår. Ansökan ska vara inkommen senast: 30 oktober 2026 För fullständig annons och för att söka tjänsten, se hemsidan: https://web103.reachmee.com/ext/I005/1035/job?site=6&lang=SE&validator=3038fcf1516ea1184a6da70a891f87da&job_id=41320

description:
About the role:

This role sits within the Sales and Marketing function, supporting one of the firm’s Lines of Service to strengthen pipeline management and contribute to overall growth ambitions.
The individual will work closely with market teams, building trusted relationships with key stakeholders to understand pipeline dynamics and provide timely insights into sales performance. These insights will inform targeted interventions, improve opportunity qualification, and ensure effective mobilisation of the wider Sales and Marketing function.

title: Head of Finance
description: About us Monava turn sound into intelligent action on the battlefield. Our patented technology replaces radar with microphones to detect flying drones: passive and undetectable, energy-efficient and cost-effective. We are a highly motivated team of 16+ FTEs spread across Gothenburg, Stockholm, Helsinki and Kyiv, wich is now entering a unique growth phase we have a revenue from paying customers of above EUR 4M, are well funded and have systems live on the battlefield today where it matters. The role As Head of Finance you own the financial agenda end-to-end. This is our first dedicated finance hire, and you will build the function from the ground up: planning and forecasting, cash and working capital, business modelling, and the reporting that the management team, the board and our investors run the company on. You work closely with the CEO and are the finance counterpart to the board. The role is deliberately broad and hands-on: one week you build the operating model for a new market, the next you are securing payment terms in a framework agreement and preparing the board pack. Accounting, tax and payroll are outsourced, so your time goes into forward-looking finance rather than bookkeeping - but you own the relationship and the quality of what comes out of it. The same applies to legal and HR, which you drive together with the CEO through external expertise. Our customers work with long decision processes and contracts that pay out over time, while we scale the team and the business at pace. Balancing growth speed against cash is at the core of the role. The position is based in Gothenburg. Your responsibilities Own the budget process, rolling forecasts and the long-term financial plan Build and maintain the financial model: revenue, headcount, hardware costs, unit economics and scenarios Define the KPI framework and run the monthly business review Own cash forecasting and runway management Drive working capital: contract payment terms, invoicing discipline, supplier terms and inventory Own banking relationships, currency exposure and treasury Secure non-dilutive funding such as grants and public R&D programmes Build the commercial models: pricing, licensing, cost-to-serve and margin structure Develop business cases for new products, segments and markets Support the CEO in strategic initiatives, negotiations and larger tenders Produce board material and monthly and quarterly reporting, and present to the board Drive financing rounds with the CEO: materials, model, data room and due diligence Own investor reporting, the cap table and relationships with auditors and banks Own the external accounting partner relationship and ensure timely closings and a smooth annual audit Build scalable internal controls, processes and system support With the CEO, own legal and compliance - policies & governance through external counsel With the CEO, own HR administration: employment terms, payroll, benefits, warrant programme We are looking for you who You are commercially minded, structured and comfortable making decisions on incomplete information. You combine hands-on execution with strategic thinking, and you are equally at home in the model and in the room where the decision is made. The role requires independence, high integrity and the ability to build long-term trust with the board, investors and external partners. Your background Degree in finance, economics, business administration, engineering or similar At least 5 years of relevant experience from management consulting, transaction services, a startup or scale-up, or another financial leadership role Proven ability to build and own complex financial models, and to manage cash and working capital in a growth environment Experience of board reporting and of working with investors and external partners Understanding of Swedish accounting, tax and corporate law, and experience of working with external accounting partners and auditors An AI-first mindset - you use modern tools to automate and sharpen the finance function rather than adding manual work Very good Swedish and English, spoken and written Meriting Experience from defence, dual-use, or another security-critical industry with large deals and complex decision processes Experience from companies with a hardware component and a physical supply chain Experience of completed financing rounds, grant funding or public research and development programmes Experience of building a finance function from scratch, including system and ERP implementation Experience of international operations and subsidiaries The position is security classified and approved security clearance under the Swedish Protective Security Act is required. What we offer A key role in a fast-growing company where you build the finance function from the ground up. With us you will: Work with technology of direct relevance to national defence capability Take significant ownership of the company's financial agenda, from daily cash to the board table Work in an organisation with short decision paths and real influence on our long-term position Compensation is fixed, and for the right candidate there is the opportunity to participate in the upcoming option programme. Apply today and become part of the commercial backbone of a European defence company in an early scaling phase.

title: Client Advisor Holistic Advice (Private)

Swedbank arbetar för att skapa en trygg och hållbar ekonomi för våra kunder. Med hög tillgänglighet, stort engagemang och affärsfokus kan du vara med att forma fram framtidens kundmöten. Tillsammans med kollegor skapar vi en attraktiv och positiv arbetsplats.

  • Säkerställa att varje kundmöte, oavsett kanal, håller hög kvalitet och är behovsbaserat – med målet att skapa värde, förtroende och en positiv kundupplevelse i varje kontakt

  • Samarbeta nära kollegor och specialister för att hitta de bästa lösningarna för kunden, driva försäljning på ett ansvarsfullt sätt samt aktivt bidra till kontorets gemensamma mål och framgång

  • En genuin vilja att kontinuerligt utvecklas, hålla dig uppdaterad om bankens produkter, marknadstrender och rådgivningsmetoder för att alltid kunna ge bästa möjliga kundvärde

Hos oss kan du uppleva:

  • Personlig och professionell utveckling genom självledarskap och kontinuerlig utveckling.

  • Meningsfullt arbete som positivt påverkar vår arbetsplats, våra kunder och samhället.

Inled din utvecklingsresa inom våra kundmötande tjänster. Du får jobba i direkt kundkontakt och hjälpa människor nå lösningar på sina ärenden. description: Vanguard’s Internal Audit & SOX (IAS) department is seeking an Internal Audit Practices Quality Specialist to join the Center for Audit Practices and Enablement (CAPE) team. Demonstrated ability to work across stakeholders and contribute to audit-related initiatives, such as quality reviews, annual planning, or methodology/guidance development required. This is a hybrid role — candidates must be commutable to Vanguard's Malvern, PA office. CIA (Certified Internal Auditor), CPA (Certified Public Accountant), CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor), or other relevant certification preferred. From Malvern to Melbourne, our mission drives us forward and inspires us to be our best. title: Business Controller
description: Jouw rol: de financiële sparringpartner van de business Als Business Controller rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de CFO. Je bent de financiële partner voor de Business Line Managers en helpt hen de relatie te leggen tussen: commerciële ambities projectresultaten serviceprestaties capaciteit kosten en rendement strategische keuzes Je maakt complexe informatie concreet voor mensen die niet dagelijks met financiën werken. Goede business control gaat hier niet alleen over cijfers. Het gaat over begrijpen wat erachter zit en op tijd handelen. Waarom deze rol anders is: Dit is geen functie waarin je alleen rapportages maakt. Je zit dicht op de operatie en bent betrokken bij de keuzes die bepalen hoe Bosch presteert. Je werkt met: project- en serviceorganisaties technische en commerciële teams Business Line Managers projectcontrollers de CFO collega’s in Duitsland en binnen Bosch Je analyseert niet alleen afwijkingen, maar stelt ook de vraag: Wat moeten we nu doen om het resultaat te verbeteren? De context waarin jij werkt. Je standplaats is bij voorkeur Berkel en Rodenrijs, waar belangrijke financiële en operationele kennis van AFAS aanwezig is. Tegelijkertijd heeft Bosch ook een vestiging in Nieuwegein. Heb je een duidelijke voorkeur voor Nieuwegein? Dan bespreken we graag hoe we dit passend kunnen maken. In eerste instantie werk je voor een groot deel vanuit de gekozen hoofdlocatie om de organisatie, systemen en collega’s goed te leren kennen. Daarna ontstaat meer flexibiliteit voor hybride werken. Het inwerktraject wordt zorgvuldig ingericht. De huidige interim Business Controller en de CFO zorgen samen voor een uitgebreide overdracht en blijven beschikbaar voor vragen tijdens jouw eerste periode. Je begint dus niet alleen. Je krijgt begeleiding van mensen die de organisatie en financiële processen goed kennen. Jouw impact: Van financiële data naar duidelijke besluiten Planning en budgettering Begeleiden van het jaarlijkse budgetproces Ondersteunen van meerjarenplannen Opstellen en verbeteren van financiële modellen Vertalen van de bedrijfsstrategie naar concrete financiële doelstellingen Forecasting en resultaatbewaking Opstellen en onderhouden van doorlopende prognoses Analyseren van omzet, kosten, winstgevendheid en werkkapitaal Vergelijken van werkelijke resultaten met budget en prognose Verklaren van afwijkingen en signaleren van oorzaken Ontwikkelen van vroege signaleringen voor risico’s en kansen Analyse en rapportage Opstellen van heldere managementrapportages Maken van dashboards en stuurinformatie Uitvoeren van analyses voor project- en serviceorganisaties Benoemen van verbeterkansen en concrete vervolgstappen Ondersteunen van de CFO en het management met betrouwbare inzichten Business partnering en verbetering Fungeren als financieel sparringpartner voor Business Line Managers Vertalen van financiële informatie naar begrijpelijke acties Bevorderen van financieel bewustzijn in de organisatie Verbeteren van processen en datakwaliteit Bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van financiële systemen en hulpmiddelen Jij zorgt dat de organisatie niet alleen weet wat er gebeurt, maar ook begrijpt waarom. Wat jij meebrengt: Must-haves Bachelor in Finance, Accountancy, Economie, Bedrijfskunde of vergelijkbaar Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in controlling, financiële analyse of planning Ervaring met project- of servicegerichte organisaties Gevorderde kennis van Excel Ervaring met ERP-systemen, bij voorkeur AFAS Nederlands is je eerste taal of je beheerst het vloeiend. De beheersing van het Engels is een vereiste. Sterk gewenst Ervaring met Power BI of vergelijkbare hulpmiddelen Ervaring in system integration, bouw of technische dienstverlening Kennis van projectresultaten, onderhanden werk en margesturing Inzicht in Nederlandse verslaggevingsregels Ervaring met het verbeteren van financiële processen Wie jij bent. Je ziet verbanden in complexe gegevens Je durft kritisch door te vragen Je communiceert helder Je bent zelfstandig en proactief Je werkt zorgvuldig en betrouwbaar Je kunt schakelen tussen detail en grote lijn Je krijgt energie van verbetering Jij bent niet iemand die alleen met cijfers werkt. Jij maakt cijfers waardevol voor mensen. Groei met Bosch mee. De organisatie ontwikkelt zich en jij krijgt de ruimte om daarin mee te groeien. Je hoeft niet alles al te beheersen. Wat wij belangrijk vinden, is dat je nieuwsgierig bent, verantwoordelijkheid neemt en wilt blijven leren.

description:
Mutares SE & Co. KGaA, Munich (www.mutares.com), as a listed private equity holding company, acquires medium-sized companies in special situations, which show significant operational improvement potential and are sold again after undergoing a repositioning and stabilization process. Mutares actively supports its portfolio companies with its own investment and operations teams and through strategic add-on acquisitions.   • Establishing the management governance and coherent tracking and reporting within the portfolio company

What Mutares offers

title: Become a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Finance Transformation
description: What can you expect as a consultant at Deloitte? In the role as a Senior Consultant, you will work together with our clients in developing their finance function. This involves a wide range of tasks; from optimizing daily operations to developing finance strategies for the finance function of the future. In the role as a Senior Consultant, you will work closely with other experienced colleagues and by knowledge sharing and continiously improvement in how we work, make great solutions for the challenges our clients are facing. At Deloitte, learning and development is one of our highest priorities. You will therefore be assigned a Talent Manager when you start, who, among other things, will help frame your everyday life and ensure that this can align with your private life and your goals for professional development. No two career paths at Deloitte are the same, so whether you want to become a specialist, the CFO of the future or something completely different, we are ready to help you get there. In addition, you will participate in an internal training program that is based on your experience and skills. The Consulting Academy focuses on preparing you for the work as a senior consultant, while the Finance Transformation Academy is tailored for consultants who will work with accounting and financial tasks in everyday life. We work from both Copenhagen and Aarhus, which is why the position can be filled from both locations. Exciting tasks await you From your first day at work, you will work as a consultant at our clients. Based on the client's needs and your experience and skills. The tasks will typically involve: Assisting and advising client's finance and accounting functions Optimization of core processes within finance and accounting KPI and management reporting using e.g. Power BI Development of methods or models that streamline the client's everyday life or can form the basis for strategic decisions Data analysis and processing in, for example, Excel, VBA or Python Transforming the finance function and developing financial strategies Implementation of new systems, such as ERP systems. You get the opportunity to shape your everyday life, and we make a great effort to match you with the right tasks, based on your skills and preferences. You have the following skills and experience We are looking for candidates who identify with the qualities listed below, who are passionate about strengthening our ability to help our clients improve their finance functions. You have a Masters degree such as cand.merc.aud or similar and have 2-6 years of experience as an auditor Most importantly, you want to make a difference for our clients. Come with your perspective on what you can contribute – and we will be happy to listen. You have analytical skills and an interest in accounting, processes and financial management, as we help our clients solve problems that they cannot solve alone. It is important that you feel comfortable working with other people, are able to put yourself in other people's shoes and understand that there may be different interests that needs to be met. Your everyday life will place great demands on your social skills, ability to communicate clearly and effectively across different levels in the client's organization and internally at Deloitte.

description:
About the role

Our Insurance & Asset & Wealth Management Finance Transformation Advisory team works with insurers and retirement providers to modernise finance functions, strengthen financial reporting and respond to significant accounting change. The team is collaborative and multidisciplinary, bringing together finance, actuarial, data and technology specialists to deliver integrated solutions.

As a Manager, you will lead the delivery of finance transformation and accounting advisory engagements, supporting clients through complex change including IFRS 17 implementation and post‑implementation activity.

What your days will look like

You will deliver value to clients through hands‑on leadership and technical expertise, including:

  • Managing the day‑to‑day delivery of finance transformation and accounting advisory engagements
  • Supporting IFRS 17 implementation, optimisation and post‑implementation change activities
  • Providing technical accounting and financial reporting advice to insurance finance teams
  • Working with actuarial, data and technology specialists to deliver integrated solutions

This role is for you if:

  • Possess accounting certifications or have equivalent work experience. This includes international candidates who qualify through experience in their home country.
  • You have delivered finance transformation or accounting advisory projects within insurance or retirement markets
  • You have a strong understanding of insurance accounting frameworks, including IFRS 17
  • You have prepared or reviewed technical accounting papers or accounting policy documentation
  • You are comfortable managing multiple workstreams and stakeholders
  • You can explain complex accounting issues clearly to non‑technical audiences

What you’ll receive from us

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

description:
Für unseren Geschäftsbereich Assurance Solutions suchen wir dich zum 1. Oktober 2026 als Praktikant Projektmanagement Office (w/m/d).

Das erwartet dich

Vertragsmanagement - Du überprüfst Kundenverträge, pflegst Datenbanken und stellst Datenintegrität sicher.
Daten - Du korrigierst und kontrollierst Dashboards, analysierst Budgets und erstellst Ad-hoc-Auswertungen im Rahmen des Projektcontrollings.
Prozesse - Du führst On- und Offboarding-Prozesse in verschiedenen Systemen durch und unterstützt Mitarbeitende bei Fragen zu Ressourcen- und Projektmanagement.
Koordination - Du organisierst Meetings, pflegst Kalender und bereitest Unterlagen für Kundentermine vor.
Projektcontrolling - Du überwachst Rechnungsstellungsprozesse, prüfst Budgets und erstellst Reports für Stakeholder.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du studierst Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftspädagogik oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang und hast mindestens das dritte Fachsemester abgeschlossen.
  • Du verfügst über erste Erfahrung in Vertragsprüfung, Controlling oder Dateneingabe und gehst souverän mit Zahlen, Datenbanken und Prozessen um.
  • Du bringst Kenntnisse in der Microsoft Power Plattform und weiteren Tools der Projektsteuerung mit.
  • Du beherrschst die Sprachen Deutsch und Englisch fließend in Wort und Schrift.

Kultur – Wir möchten, dass du dich bei uns wohl fühlst. Deshalb pflegen wir eine offene und moderne Unternehmens- sowie Führungskultur, in der wir geleistete Arbeit gemeinsam anerkennen und feiern.
Flexibilität – In Abstimmung mit deinem Team erwartet dich ein Mix aus gemeinsamen Bürotagen und Home Office. Dabei gibt es keine Kernarbeitszeiten – im Rahmen der betrieblichen Anforderungen und arbeitsrechtlichen Vorgaben kannst du deine Arbeitszeit flexibel gestalten. Zusätzlich hast du die Möglichkeit, temporär in über 40 Ländern zu arbeiten.
Masterförderung – Durch unsere interne Academy, internationale Erfahrungen durch Secondments und kontinuierliches Mentoring entwickelst du dich stetig weiter. Darüber hinaus bieten wir die Möglichkeit einer Masterförderung für Examensmaster und Spezialisierungsmaster an.
KiT – Mit unserem Programm "Keep in Touch" (KiT) bleiben wir auch nach Praktikumsende mit unseren Praktikant:innen und Werkstudierenden in Kontakt und bieten dir viele Vorteile, wie z.B. exklusive Einladungen zu Seminaren und Workshops sowie umfangreiche Informationen zu den Einstiegsmöglichkeiten.

title: Commercial Finance Business Partner
description: MERITUS are recruiting for 2x Commercial Finance Business Partner's to join our client in initial 6 month contracts to support within the SaaS space. COMMERCIAL FINANCE BUSINESS PARTNER - INSIDE IR35 - £500/£600 PER DAY - LONDON (HYBRID WORKING - SOUTHBANK) - 6 months - FAST MOVING PROCESS - SECTOR: Consultancy MERITUS are recruiting for an experienced Commercial Finance Business Partner to join a large, established technology organisation on a contract basis. This is an excellent opportunity for a qualified accountant or highly experienced commercial finance professional to take a strategic partnering role within a complex organisation of 5,000+ employees , working closely with senior leaders across Customer & Services, Product, Technology and Finance. The role will sit at the heart of key commercial and strategic decisions, providing financial insight, constructive challenge and analysis to support investment, transformation, technology planning and business performance. The Role You will act as a trusted finance partner to senior stakeholders, helping them understand the financial impact of strategic decisions and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, productivity and value. You'll work across a broad range of areas including technology investment, product planning, transformation, cloud and infrastructure costs, supplier spend, resource planning and business cases . This is a role for someone who enjoys operating beyond traditional reporting and wants to influence where and how a large technology business invests its money . Key Responsibilities Partner with senior Customer & Services leaders, providing commercial insight, financial challenge and actionable recommendations . Support Product and Technology planning, including investment prioritisation, roadmap decisions, resource planning and cost-benefit analysis . Provide financial leadership across transformation initiatives, including business cases, cost modelling, scenario analysis and benefit tracking . Own and enhance monthly performance reporting, clearly communicating financial performance, risks, opportunities and key cost drivers . Lead and support budgeting, forecasting and rolling planning , ensuring assumptions are robust and aligned with strategic priorities. Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, productivity and return on investment across Product and Technology. Provide financial analysis covering areas such as development expenditure, cloud and infrastructure costs, technology suppliers and transformation programmes . Constructively challenge business cases and investment requests, ensuring expenditure is commercially justified and appropriately governed. Translate complex financial and operational information into clear, concise recommendations for senior non-finance stakeholders . Contribute to the continued improvement of finance partnering, reporting and planning processes. About You We're looking for a commercially minded finance professional who can operate confidently with senior stakeholders in a large and complex organisation. Essential: Qualified accountant or equivalent level of commercial finance experience . Strong experience across budgeting, forecasting, management reporting and financial modelling . Experience working within a large organisation , ideally with 5,000+ employees. Proven ability to partner with and influence senior stakeholders . Strong commercial judgement and the confidence to provide constructive challenge. Excellent analytical and Excel/modelling capability. Ability to turn financial and operational data into meaningful commercial insight . Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex financial information to non-finance audiences. Comfortable working across multiple stakeholders, priorities and projects in a fast-moving environment. Desirable: Experience within SaaS, software, technology, digital or technology-enabled businesses . Experience supporting Product and Technology functions . Background in transformation, investment appraisal, benefits tracking or operating model change. Experience analysing cloud, infrastructure, development or technology supplier costs .

title: Senior Group Financial Controller
description: Vi söker en erfaren Senior Financial Controlling Lead med gedigen kompetens inom koncernredovisning, IFRS och finansiell controlling. I rollen blir du en central del av en organisation under förändring. Du ansvarar för att skapa struktur, säkerställa kvalitet i den finansiella rapporteringen och självständigt driva frågeställningar från analys och identifierat problem till lösning och genomförande. Uppdraget passar dig som har ett starkt intresse för redovisning och tycker om att förstå sambanden bakom siffrorna. Du är bekväm med att arbeta både på detaljnivå och ur ett koncernperspektiv – från löpande redovisning och koncernjusteringar till kassaflöden, investeringar och finansiell rapportering. En viktig del av uppdraget är att analysera finansiella utfall, identifiera och förklara avvikelser samt säkerställa att rapporteringen håller hög kvalitet. Du kommer även att bidra till att utveckla struktur och arbetssätt i en miljö där alla processer och rutiner ännu inte är fullt etablerade. Kvalifikationer Gedigen erfarenhet av koncernredovisning och IFRS samt mycket god förståelse för redovisning och bokföring. Stark analytisk förmåga och vana att granska finansiella utfall, identifiera avvikelser och analysera bakomliggande orsaker. God förståelse för koncernrapportering, intercompany samt öppnings- och stängningsdifferenser. God kunskap om kassaflödesanalys och finansiell utveckling, inklusive exempelvis drawdowns. Förmåga att självständigt hantera och driva nya frågeställningar som uppstår i verksamheten. Erfarenhet från större organisationer, gärna i en internationell miljö. Erfarenhet från tillverkande, investeringsintensiva eller CAPEX-tunga verksamheter är meriterande. Vana att arbeta i föränderliga miljöer där processer och rutiner behöver utvecklas och struktureras. Trygg och professionell i dialog med revisorer, ledning och andra seniora intressenter. God systemförståelse och erfarenhet av ERP-system och finansiella rapporteringssystem. Självgående, analytisk och prestigelös med ett genuint intresse för koncernredovisning. Förmåga att växla mellan detalj och helhet och snabbt omsätta finansiell analys till konkreta slutsatser och åtgärder. Sway Sourcing är en innovativ rekryteringspartner som specialiserar sig på att matcha rätt talang med rätt företag – snabbt och effektivt. Vårt huvudfokus ligger inom Ekonomi, Administration, HR, Marknad och IT, men vi har även den breda expertis och flexibilitet som krävs för att leverera skräddarsydda rekryteringslösningar inom alla branscher. Trots att vi är en relativt ny aktör har vi redan byggt förtroende hos många av Sveriges största företag och arbetar både nationellt och internationellt. Med baser i Sverige och Spanien erbjuder vi en unik kombination av lokal expertis och global räckvidd. Vårt starka nätverk och djupa branschinsikter gör oss till en självklar partner för företag som vill ligga steget före i sin rekrytering.

title: AI Marketing & Social growth Assistant Manager
description: We are looking for an AI-native Brand & Social growth manager to lead social content, brand storytelling and content-driven growth for digital business. This role will translate product benefits and scenarios into engaging social strategy and digital campaigns across Wechat, RedNote and other social platforms to support traffic and conversion growth. This is not a traditional social media posting role, we are looking for someone with strong content and marketing sense, consumer understanding, creative spirit and the ability to use AI tools naturally in daily digital and marketing workflows. Key Responsibilities: 1. AI marketing workflow Use generative AI tools to improve the efficiency of content ideation, copywriting, video scripting, visual briefing, competitor analysis and campaign adaptation. Build and optimize reusable content assets, such as prompt templates, headline libraries and campaign content templates. Proactively explore new AI tools and content production methods to improve marketing productivity and execution speed. 2. GEO&AI Search optimization Lead and support GEO and AI search optimization by working with channel owners to structure brand and product content in a way that is AI-friendly and searchable within AI environments. Improve discoverability across AI platforms. 3. AI-powered Insight & Testing Use AI tools to support social listening, competitor review, customer insight generation and campaign performance analysis. Develop AI testing ideas for content angles, creative formats and customer journeys, and turn findings into actionable plan for digital growth. 4. Social Media & Content Strategy Manage social content planning, daily operation and campaign execution across WeChat, RedNote and other relevant platforms. Adapt content angles, headlines, social copy and short video scripts based on different platform formats and user behaviors. Track content performance, including views, clicks, engagement, saves, shares, traffic contribution and assisted conversion, and provide optimization recommendations. 5. Brand Storytelling Translate brand strengths, product benefits and service capabilities into consumer-friendly, engaging and credible content. Support brand campaigns, product campaigns, seasonal travel campaigns and social activations with creative concepts and content execution. Ensure content is not only informative, but also emotionally relevant, easy to understand and aligned with the brand tone. 6. Cross-functional & Agency Collaboration Work with product, legal, compliance, performance marketing, website, IT and external agencies to ensure content is engaging, compliant and conversion-oriented. Coordinate social agencies, designers, video vendors, KOLs and KOCs to ensure content quality, brand consistency and execution efficiency. Provide hands-on feedback and content judgment instead of only managing timelines and processes. Requirements: 1. 3 to 6 years of experience in digital marketing, social media, brand marketing or e-commerce operation 2. Experience in consumer goods, travel, lifestyle, content commerce, OTA, airline, hotel, credit card benefits or other consumer-facing industries is preferred. Insurance or financial services experience is not required, but compliance awareness is a plus. 3. AI Capability AI mindset, with hands-on experience using generative AI tools to improve marketing productivity. Familiarity with tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Kling, Canva, Feishu AI is a plus. Ability to use AI not only for copywriting, but also for ideation, content creation, competitor analysis, campaign review and workflow improvement. 4. Data & Business Sense Basic data sense, with the ability to optimize content based on views, clicks, engagement and conversion-related metrics. Understanding of how social content can support traffic generation, brand trust and digital sales conversion. Experience in DTC, e-commerce, private traffic, official websites or online store conversion is a plus.

title: Director Strategic Advice - Quality Science & Strategy
description: Do you want to shape how artificial intelligence is adopted responsibly in a global, science-led biopharmaceutical company? Come join us at AstraZeneca in the role as a Director Strategic Advice - Quality Science & Strategy . This is a rare opportunity to define, from the ground up, how a regulated organization adopts and governs artificial intelligence responsibly. You will set the guardrails, build the framework, and act as the trusted bridge between the technical realities of AI and the regulatory, quality, and business considerations that shape our industry. If you enjoy translating complex technology into clear, workable strategy — and influencing senior leaders to make sound decisions in a fast-evolving field — this role gives you the scope and impact to do exactly that. What you’ll do Provide proactive and strategic quality leadership in AI and data integrity : Lead the development of quality strategy and oversight approaches for AI-enabled, data-driven, and digitally supported activities across R&D, with a particular focus on trustworthy, reliable, and transparent use of data and algorithms. Establish guardrails — requirements, policies, and standards — for how AI is deployed in a regulated setting, including how data must be handled, governed, and used. Influence and build alignment with senior leaders , guiding strategic decision-making on AI adoption. Shape governance for AI- and data-related risk by providing clear insight, reporting, and recommendations to relevant decision-making forums. Maintain an external focus on AI, digital regulation, and data governance: Drawing on expert communities and networks to stay current with evolving AI regulations, standards, and industry practices, and translating these into practical guidance for the organization. Collaborate with and influences external stakeholders and regulatory bodies , representing AstraZeneca’s quality position and helping to shape expectations in evolving areas of science and technology. Provide expert input into quality and compliance risk management , including identification, assessment, mitigation planning and monitoring. Lead or support due diligence activities, inspections, audits and critical quality issue management , ensuring timely resolution and organizational learning. Essential Skills/Experience Significant experience in a regulated industry — pharmaceutical is preferred, but we welcome candidates from medtech, IVD, diagnostics, digital health, or other highly regulated sectors with transferable governance experience. Expertise in regulatory requirements relevant for the pharmaceutical and healthcare industry Strong knowledge of AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, digital systems, and data lifecycle management Strong understanding of data integrity principles, data governance, and risks associated with computerized and AI-enabled systems Proven ability to influence senior leaders and provide strategic advice in complex, rapidly evolving scientific and technological environments A collaborative working style, comfortable partnering across functions and disciplines High ethical standards, trustworthy, operating with absolute discretion Location: Gothenburg, Sweden About AstraZeneca AstraZeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused biopharmaceutical company. We focus on discovering, developing and commercialising prescription medicines for some of the world’s most serious diseases. AstraZeneca Sweden plays a pivotal role in our shared global purpose - to better patients' lives. That’s why every one of us is motivated to make a difference. With a heritage that stretches back more than a century, we are extremely proud of our local reputation in Sweden. This is a place where the history and future of medicine come together. So, what’s next? Are you already imagining yourself joining our team? Good, because we can’t wait to hear from you. We will go through the applications continuously so please apply as soon as possible but no later than August 20th, 2026. Welcome with your application! We're a team of finance professionals who deliver bespoke and standard finance solutions to our clients on an insourced, outsourced or co-sourced basis. We use our tech-enabled platforms to deliver a first class service to our clients which include running all or part of their finance function, or providing interim support to their teams. In the Finance and Tax Solutions team, you will work as a qualified accountant supporting delivery of finance functions to our clients.

This could include a range such as transactional finance delivery, finance transformation, restructuring as a result of mergers/ acquisitions. This role is for you if:

Due to the nature of our projects, our day to day roles will heavily be defined by our specific client requirements which can include working on site with them or co-located in your home PwC office. On occasion those clients may have overseas entities and you and the team will travel there typically for knowledge exchange and integration.

  • Must possess ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CIPFA qualified (or international equivalent)

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

In the field of technology consulting at PwC, it’s not just about being part of a large company; it’s about seeing how things work in different companies. title: Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Manager
description:
About the role:

We are seeking a Manager to join our Risk and Resilience team to focus on Enterprise Risk Management. If you would like to work with the senior management teams of some of the UK’s leading non-financial services companies, have strong problem solving skills, intellectual agility and can build deep and productive relationships, our practice could be the right opportunity for you.

You’ll work across a diverse range of well-known clients and have the opportunity to build experience designing and implementing risk management frameworks to help Boards identify, assess and manage the most significant risks in their organisation.

What your days will look like:

  • Developing bespoke Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) and resilience frameworks and processes
  • Conducting risk identification interviews and facilitating risk assessment workshops, including at executive management levels
  • Developing key risk indicator suites
  • Practical articulation of risk appetite
  • Design of risk reporting templates and dashboards
  • Conducting risk analytics, such as horizon scanning, scenario and strategic risk analysis etc.
  • Delivering impactful risk management training
  • Providing on-going risk monitoring support
  • Managing and delivering assignments
  • Working as part of a team or independently depending on the size of the assignment
  • Developing and managing client relationships
  • Identifying and developing client opportunities
  • Partial and full-time client secondments
  • Providing input into the development of PwC’s Risk and Resilience propositions

The role is for you if:

We're looking for motivated, passionate and enthusiastic individuals who will relish the opportunity to work in a growing team, with a portfolio of varied assignments and with significant possibilities to progress within the firm. The successful applicant will have practical experience, ideally gained within a large consultancy or client organisation.

  • Highly confident and resilient, comfortable asserting yourself with senior clients (Executive and Board level)
  • Strong technical enterprise risk management knowledge (i.e. 4 years + experience) and proven ability developing and implementing practical ERM processes and frameworks in non-FS businesses
  • Knowledge of prevailing corporate governance requirements
  • Solid financial and commercial acumen and understanding
  • Excellent presentation skills and experience planning and facilitating workshops / risk exercises with senior level audiences
  • Robust diligence and ability to pay close attention to detail, including impeccable report-writing skills
  • Familiarity with common risk analysis techniques, understanding of scenario modelling etc.
  • Working knowledge of ERM data and reporting (e.g. maintaining KRI packs, building/refreshing simple dashboards, and producing trend/outlier commentary to support risk reviews)
  • Awareness of GenAI/LLM applications in risk management
  • Ability to innovate and think laterally
  • Strong interpersonal communication skills with ability to build trust and rapport with diverse internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects
  • Proven team management skills, including coaching and development of junior resources
  • Ability to work as part of a team and independently with little management oversight
  • Commercially focused and strong business development skills

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

These include flexible working, a hybrid office/client/home model, private medical cover, access to a virtual GP, volunteering days and a strong focus on wellbeing, inclusion and development.

title: Penetration Tester / Red team Specialist (f/m/x)
description: RBI Group Cyber Defense Services is seeking an experienced Red Team Specialist to operate in a large, complex enterprise environment spanning multiple business units, network banks, and subsidiaries. This role combines hands-on offensive security with defender enablement: you will simulate realistic attack paths, validate security controls, and translate offensive findings into concrete improvements for detection and response teams across the Group. The successful candidate will help raise capability on both the red and blue sides by running high-value exercises, documenting attack chains clearly, and turning technical findings into actionable improvements for defenders. Your mission at RBI: Plan and execute red team and purple team engagements across enterprise, endpoint, identity, network, cloud, and web environments. Conduct realistic attack-path exercises against Group units and subsidiaries, aligned with approved scope and business context. Perform offensive activities including privilege escalation, lateral movement, persistence, defense evasion, and identity abuse in enterprise and cloud environments. Assess internal infrastructure, Active Directory, cloud identity, and web application attack surfaces. Document attack chains in a defender-centric manner, including techniques used, expected telemetry, detection gaps, and specific detection engineering recommendations. Work closely with blue teams, detection engineers, and incident responders to validate controls and improve detection and response coverage. Translate findings into prioritized remediation guidance, detection use cases, and practical follow-up actions. Develop or customize offensive tooling, scripts, and test scenarios where required. Your core competencies: Proven hands-on experience delivering red team, purple team, or advanced penetration testing engagements in large enterprise environments. Experience in offensive operations beyond tool usage, including privilege escalation, lateral movement, persistence, defense evasion, and identity abuse in enterprise and cloud environments. Hands-on experience in web application exploitation techniques, such as authentication bypass, session abuse, SSRF, deserialization, injection flaws, and OAuth/SAML abuse. Deep understanding of the internals of at least one operating system (Windows or Linux), authentication mechanisms, service and process relationships, and system telemetry. Prior knowledge of Active Directory abuse paths and enterprise identity attack techniques. Understanding of how web attacks manifest in application logs, web logs, WAF telemetry, and identity providers. Proficiency in at least one scripting language, preferably PowerShell or Python. Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Nice to have: Experience working in Blue Team functions such as Detection Engineering or Incident Response. Experience building, tuning, or validating detections in SIEM and EDR platforms. Familiarity with Atomic Red Team, Caldera, or similar adversary simulation frameworks. Knowledge of Azure AD / Entra ID and cloud identity attack techniques. Experience in the financial services or other regulated industries (banking, insurance, critical infrastructure). Knowledge of SWIFT security controls and attack surfaces. Familiarity with TIBER-style or threat-led testing approaches, DORA (Digital Operational Resilience Act). title: Resursedirektør til SOSU H
description: En organisation i bevægelse. Nye muligheder i sigte. Og en central rolle i at skabe rammerne for det SOSU H, vi er på vej til at blive. På SOSU H uddanner vi mennesker til nogle af de vigtigste opgaver i vores velfærdssamfund. Som landets største SOSU-skole har vi samtidig en ambition om at være med til at udvikle sektoren og gå forrest, når nye muligheder tager form. De kommende år bringer nye uddannelser, nye samarbejder og nye uddannelsesmiljøer og det stiller krav til både vores organisation og den måde, vi bruger vores resurser på. Derfor søger vi en ny resursedirektør. Du træder ind i en veldrevet organisation, men også i en organisation i bevægelse. EPX, et bredere og mere differentieret uddannelsesudbud og nye samarbejder åbner muligheder og stiller samtidig nye krav til økonomi, bygninger, teknologi, administration og organisation. Som resursedirektør får du et bredt ansvar og en central plads i direktionen. En af dine første opgaver bliver at skabe tydelighed om roller, ansvar og snitflader på resurseområdet. Rollen har hidtil haft mange tråde ind i uddannelsesområdet, og sådan skal den ikke nødvendigvis se ud fremover. Du får derfor reel mulighed for at præge både rollen og området og være med til at skabe de rammer, SOSU H har brug for i de kommende år. Økonomi og styring bliver en vigtig del af opgaven. SOSU H har taget de første skridt mod mere lokale budgetter og ønsker at udvikle økonomistyringen og skabe en tættere sammenhæng mellem aktivitet, bemanding, økonomi og ansvar. Samtidig venter væsentlige beslutninger om bygninger og kapacitet, ligesom der er brug for en tydeligere strategisk retning for IT, data, digitalisering og AI. Du kommer til en organisation med erfarne chefer og stærke fagligheder – og en kultur, hvor dialog og involvering har reel betydning. Vi tænker ikke meget i hierarkier, men i fælles løsninger, og vi forventer, at du både kan lytte, skabe relationer og sætte retning. Du skal have respekt for det, der fungerer, men også lyst og mod til at udfordre os og bringe nye perspektiver ind. Stillingen er for dig, der kan se helheden i et bredt resurseområde og motiveres af at skabe resultater gennem andre. Dig, der har et sikkert blik for økonomi og styring, men som ikke kun ser organisationen gennem regnearket. Og dig, der har lyst til at være med til at forme de organisatoriske og økonomiske rammer om et SOSU H, der ikke står stille. Vil du vide mere om rollen, SOSU H og de opgaver, der venter, kan du gå på opdagelse i vores rekrutteringsunivers. Her finder du også den uddybende kompetenceprofil. Link til rekrutteringsunivers: https://rekrutteringsunivers.com/sosuh/ Ansøgningsfristen er den 13. september 2026. Du søger stillingen ved at indsende dit CV med en kort beskrivelse af din motivation samt din besvarelse af den strategiske lederopgave via rekrutteringsuniverset. Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte partner i Bridge Consulting Mia Hvilshøj på tlf. 2245 1576. Du kan også kontakte direktør i SOSU H Jeppe Rosengård Poulsen på tlf. 2913 4567.

description:
About the role:

PwC's Alternative Investment Funds (AIF) team sits within our wider Financial Services Tax practise.

The team consists of specialists focusing on assisting alternative investment fund managers with a range of services across their business, covering the manager, the key people, the funds, investors and investments.

Whilst the team is UK based, the nature of the AIF industry means that a large amount of our work is international meaning there are many opportunities to work with the wider PwC AIF network.

As a Senior Manager you will work as part of a team to provide excellent quality advisory and compliance services to a high-profile portfolio of both UK and multinational clients. You will have the opportunity to work on a range of AIF clients, covering strategies including Private Equity, Private Credit, Infrastructure, Hedge Funds and Real Estate.

You will be given the opportunity to develop your skills, drive your ambition and work with experienced Partners and Directors across the team. The team will provide you with the opportunity to put into practice your technical skills in a stimulating and challenging environment.

What your days will look like:

  • The alternative investment funds industry is dynamic, technically demanding and offers opportunities to work on large complex international projects as well as interesting UK tax matters

  • You will be responsible for managing a portfolio of clients and advising on a broad range of issues covering the manager/advisor, the fund, the fund executives, the investors, the investments and tax reporting

  • You will work closely with other parts of the business, including the wider Financial Services Tax team and Deals tax and international PwC member firms

  • You will manage client teams and will coach and support junior members of the team, encouraging everyone to have a voice and inviting opinions from all

  • You will contribute to the growth of the team, through developing junior members of the team and through contributing to marketing activities and thought leadership
