description:
As a Private Equity Independence Manager, you’ll play a pivotal role in safeguarding the firm’s integrity while enabling growth. This is your chance to influence how we navigate a complex, evolving regulatory landscape—balancing commercial ambition with ethical responsibility. You’ll be at the heart of decision-making, ensuring independence and protecting our reputation, all while supporting the firm’s success in the private equity space. If you’re passionate about problem-solving, thrive under pressure, and want to contribute to something that truly matters, this i the role for you.

What your days will look like:

  • Monitor independence risks across private equity groups, including changes from investments, divestments, and restructuring.
  • Apply independence rules (FRC, SEC, Global Policy) to private equity structures across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Advise teams and partners on independence issues for complex relationships and portfolio companies.
  • Lead and document independence assessments for private equity clients, covering services, relationships, and investments.
  • Communicate confidently with senior stakeholders, providing clear guidance and delivering difficult messages when required.
  • Support training and knowledge-sharing initiatives for teams working with private equity clients.
  • Refine internal policies, procedures, and tools to strengthen independence compliance.

The role is for you if:

  • you have a working knowledge of private equity structures, audit processes, and independence regulations (FRC, SEC, GIP, etc.).
  • you have proven analytical, organizational, and project management skills, with the ability to make sound judgments and manage detailed information accurately.
  • you have excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence to deliver clear, sometimes challenging messages and interact effectively at all levels.
  • you have strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, support, and empathize with client-facing practitioners.
  • you are a conscientious, ambitious team player, demonstrating strong self-management and the ability to take initiative in a fast-paced, changing environment.
  • you have experience in coaching and supporting colleagues, with a collaborative approach to problem-solving and strong people management capabilities.

What you'll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

description: Är du redo för en större uppgift? Polismyndigheten är Sveriges största myndighet med ca 40 700 medarbetare över hela landet. Hos oss får du möjlighet att bidra till Polisens uppdrag – att öka tryggheten och minska brottsligheten i samhället. Enheten för Controlling och redovisning Enheten controlling och redovisning omsätter ekonomistyrningen från nationell nivå till regional- och avdelningsnivå. Enheten skapar förutsättningar för regioner och avdelningar att hushålla väl med statens medel genom effektiva och ändamålsenliga processer för budget, uppföljning, analys och prognoser. title: Business Controller till MedHelp Care
description: Om företaget MedHelp Care utvecklar en AI-driven hälsoplattform som hjälper arbetsgivare att arbeta förebyggande med sjukfrånvaro, rehabilitering och medarbetarhälsa. Genom att samla sjukanmälan, chefsstöd, frånvaroinsikter och rehabiliteringsstöd på ett ställe får organisationer bättre förutsättningar att upptäcka tidiga signaler på ohälsa och agera i tid. Företaget kombinerar teknik, data och hälsa för att bidra till ett mer hållbart arbetsliv och lägre sjukfrånvarokostnader. MedHelp är ett ungt och framåtlutat bolag med korta beslutsvägar, hög kompetens och en prestigelös kultur. Här arbetar medarbetare nära varandra i en miljö där idéer välkomnas, samarbete är centralt och teknik används för att skapa konkret nytta för kunder och samhälle. Vi på Asta Agency samarbetar med Medhelp i den här rekryteringsprocessen. Vi söker en Business Controller till huvudkontoret i Stockholm. Processen sker genom Asta och du blir sedan anställd direkt hos Medhelp. Om tjänsten Som Business Controller får du en central roll i MedHelps fortsatta utveckling och blir en nära samarbetspartner till CFO. Du kommer initialt att ta ett stort ansvar för redovisning, koncernredovisning och rapportering, samtidigt som du successivt får en djupare förståelse för verksamheten och interna stakeholders. Rollen är bred och kombinerar operativt ekonomiarbete med analys, utveckling och affärsstöd. Du arbetar med löpande redovisning, månadsbokslut, koncernkonsolidering och rapportering till ledning och styrelse. Du får även bidra i budget-, prognos- och bonusuppföljning samt stötta organisationen med relevanta beslutsunderlag. MedHelp befinner sig i en fas där ekonomifunktionen ska fortsätta moderniseras och effektiviseras. Därför finns ett tydligt utrymme för dig som vill utveckla arbetssätt, systemstöd och rapportering med hjälp av AI och digitala verktyg. På sikt är ambitionen att du ska kunna växa in i ett bredare CFO-ansvar i samband med en planerad generationsväxling. Rollen passar därför dig som vill ta nästa steg i karriären, utvecklas samt få en bred roll med foten i både de operativa och strategiska arbetet och på sikt ta ett helhetsansvar över funktionen ekonomi. Kvalifikationer och egenskaper För att trivas i rollen är du strukturerad, analytisk och trygg i att ta ansvar för detaljer utan att tappa helhetsperspektivet. Du har ett databaserat och noggrant arbetssätt, samtidigt som du är kommunikativ och trivs i nära samarbete med kollegor från olika delar av verksamheten. Du är prestigelös, nyfiken och vill förstå affären bakom siffrorna för att kunna bidra med relevanta insikter och stöd. Därtill har du: 3–5 års erfarenhet av arbete inom redovisning, med förståelse för månadsbokslut, avstämningar och rapportering. Gärna med bakgrund från byrå, koncernmiljö eller en bred ekonomiroll i ett tillväxtbolag. Erfarenhet av koncernredovisning och koncernkonsolidering. Goda kunskaper i Excel och vana att sammanställa beslutsunderlag. God systemvana och intresse för att utveckla och effektivisera arbetssätt. Intresse för AI och hur digitala verktyg kan användas inom ekonomifunktionen. Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift. Övrig information Start: Enligt överenskommelse. Plats: Stockholm. Omfattning: Heltid. Lön: Enligt överenskommelse. Vi tillämpar löpande urval i denna process vilket innebär att tjänsten kan tillsättas innan annonsen avpubliceras. Vi rekommenderar dig därför att ansöka så snart som möjligt! Har du frågor eller funderingar kring Asta Agencys rekryteringsprocess, tveka inte att höra av dig till ellen@astaagency.se. Om Asta Agency Asta Agency är ett rekryterings- och bemanningsföretag som hjälper företag att hitta rätt tjänstemän i hela Sverige med fokus på Stockholm, Göteborg och Malmö. Vi rekryterar och hyr ut specialister och generalister inom försäljning, marknad, HR, kundservice, ekonomi, administration, IT och tech. Med fokus på kvalitet, långsiktighet och smarta lösningar stöttar vi både företag och kandidater i nästa steg. Läs mer om hur vi arbetar med rekrytering, bemanning och hyrrekrytering på astaagency.se.

description:
Job Description

About the role:

At PwC, we help organisations transform how they attract, develop, engage and manage their people. Workday is often a key enabler of this transformation, but our work goes beyond technology implementation. We help clients simplify processes, improve employee experience, strengthen data foundations and realise measurable value from their workforce technology investments.

As a Workday Manager within our Workforce Transformation practice, you will play a delivery-focused role on Workday programmes, leading client delivery teams while also contributing hands-on to the work. You will manage complex workstreams, guide and support Workday teams, shape practical solutions and remain close enough to the detail to review design decisions, resolve delivery issues and help ensure high-quality outcomes across the programme lifecycle.

This is a role for someone who enjoys working with and leading Workday delivery teams, building trusted client relationships and developing others, while continuing to deepen their own hands-on expertise in Workday, HR technology and workforce transformation.

What your days will look like:

  • Lead Workday delivery teams and workstreams across HCM, Talent, Recruiting, Learning, Compensation, Payroll, Absence, Time, Reporting, Integrations, Security and Data Migration, while providing hands-on input to solution design, configuration, testing and issue resolution.

  • Act as a Functional, Solution or Workstream Lead, owning delivery planning, quality, stakeholder engagement, risks and issues to ensure successful programme outcomes.

  • Facilitate client workshops, challenge requirements constructively and help design future-state processes that improve ways of working rather than replicate existing practices.

  • Translate business requirements into practical Workday solutions that support strategic objectives, enhance user experience and deliver measurable business value.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and guide clients through all programme phases—from discovery and design to deployment, adoption and optimisation—bringing strong problem-solving skills and delivery discipline throughout.

This role is for you if:

  • Current Workday certification with strong delivery experience across one or more Workday product areas and a proven track record in implementation, optimisation or transformation programmes.

  • Experience leading Workday workstreams or teams, with responsibility for delivery quality, project planning, risk management and successful outcomes.

  • Strong understanding of HR processes and the ability to translate business needs into practical technology solutions that deliver business value.

  • Excellent facilitation, communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge requirements constructively and influence decision-making.

  • Commercially aware team player who is passionate about developing others, building high-performing teams and contributing to practice growth and business development.

What you will get from us

You will join an established Workday and Workforce Transformation practice with access to challenging client work, experienced colleagues and the wider PwC network. You will have opportunities to develop your consulting, technology, leadership and commercial skills while contributing to work that helps clients transform the way their people experience work.

We offer a range of benefits designed to support you at work and outside work, including empowered flexibility, hybrid working across office, home and client site, private medical cover, access to wellbeing support and volunteering days.

title: Director, Simulation and Evaluation - Autonomous Driving
description: As the Director for Simulation and Evaluation, you will sit at the center of the Global AI Backbone, architecting the multi-level simulation ecosystems required to train, evaluate and validate next-generation Foundation Models. You will bridge the gap between high-fidelity sensor simulation and generative world models, ensuring our AI systems are statistically proven to be safe and robust before hitting the road. This is a global role that requires you to define and manage a global simulation and evaluation ecosystem that enables continuous development and deployment of our ADAS systems. Key Responsibilities: Lead AI Simulation & Foundation Model Strategy: Define the roadmap for high throughput, closed-loop simulation. Research and propose new methodologies to assess the quality, safety, and realism of ML models used for training, evaluation and validation of L2++ and L4 automated driving stacks. Architect Evaluation Frameworks: Build the infrastructure. Develop tools that allow for rapid iteration of Foundation Models, ensuring model improvements translate into measurable gains in fleet-wide performance. Drive Generative AI Innovation: Lead the development of World Models to predict and generate complex, realisticedge cases. Build data pipelines for signal discovery, data labeling, and metric computation based on large-scale simulations. Production Release Authority: Establish the "gold standard" for evaluation that informs SoP (Start of Production) and model release decisions. Translate complex simulation data into technical strategy documentation for executive decision-making. Global Technical Leadership: Lead, mentor and inspire a cross-functional global team of SWEs, Data Scientists, and ML experts, fostering a culture of rigorous statistical validation and innovative engineering. Basic Qualifications: Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, Statistics, Physics, or a related quantitative field. 10+ years of experience in software engineering, with a specific focus on embedded systems, automotive, or robotics. 7+ years of experience leading complex software projects from concept to production within the ADAS or Autonomous Driving domain. Direct, hands-on experience with L2++ or L4 system Start of Production (SoP), specifically overseeing simulation, testing, and validation protocols for high-stakes deployments. 5+ years of involvement with the development or evaluation of large-scale AI, LLMs, or World Models/Generative AI models for simulation and behavioral prediction. Expert-level understanding of multi-level simulation platforms, including high-fidelity sensorlevel simulation for perception and scalable object-level simulation for behavioral training. Proven mastery of data-driven report writing and technical strategy documentation designed for executive decision-making and safety case justifications. Preferred Qualifications: 5+ years of experience with high-throughput simulation, GPU-accelerated technologies (CUDA), parallel computing, and Reinforcement Learning (RL). Mastery of C++ and Python. Experience building automated data pipelines for signal discovery, data labeling, and large-scale metric computation. 5+ years of experience managing and mentoring global, multi-disciplinary teams of Software Engineers, Data Scientists, and ML experts. Working knowledge of automotive industry safety standards and regulations (e.g., ISO 26262, SOTIF) as they apply to virtual validation.

title: Financial Controller to Ascilion
description: Are you a highly capable finance professional who wants to build and manage the financial backbone of a rapidly growing deep-tech and medical technology company? Ascilion is now recruiting a Financial Controller to the company. The position is full-time and based at our headquarters in Kista. At Ascilion we are singularly focused on solving one of medicine’s big challenges: providing real-time access to molecular biomarkers. Ascilion’s proprietary, industry-leading microneedle technology enables quick, reliable, and painless access to molecular biomarkers. Ascilion is entering a phase of significant international growth with substantial investor involvement, increasing reporting requirements, expanding operations, and likely future subsidiaries and / or international sales entities. We already work with strong external partners in bookkeeping and audits, but we now need an internal financial leader who owns the full picture and ensures the company operates at a world-class level financially and operationally. The Financial Controller is a key leadership position responsible for the overall financial management of the company, ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and compliance of our financial reporting. Depending on profile and experience, the role may develop into a CFO position and become part of the senior management team with responsibility for strategic financial planning and board-level reporting. This is an excellent opportunity for you to join a dedicated and highly competent team and a growing company with an exciting journey ahead. If this sounds interesting to you, please contact us using the details below! We will interview candidates continuously for the position and welcome your application today. Responsibilities As our Financial Controller, you will drive the company’s financial success by ensuring reporting accuracy, robust compliance, and strategic control over day-to-day financial operations. You will report directly to the CEO. Your main responsibilities will be to: Own and manage the company’s financial operations and reporting structure Ensure high-quality financial reporting towards investors, board, auditors, and authorities Prepare board material, financial presentations, forecasts, and KPI reporting Coordinate and manage relationships with bookkeeping firms, auditors, banks, investors, and external financial partners Develop and improve internal financial processes, controls, and reporting systems Support international expansion including subsidiaries, sales offices, and cross-border financial structures Drive budgeting, liquidity planning, cash flow management, and long-term financial planning Ensure audit readiness, regulatory compliance, and professional financial governance Support operational scaling of the company together with management and technical leadership Potentially take responsibility for HR administration, contracts, insurance, and internal operational processes depending on profile and interest Your Profile Key qualifications for the position include: Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or Economics. Several years of experience in accounting, with a strong focus on financial reporting, accounting, controlling, and compliance Experience working with investors, boards, auditors, and external financial stakeholders Strong understanding of financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and corporate governance A deep understanding of Swedish GAAP. Direct experience with US GAAP or IFRS is a competitive advantage Experience from scaling companies, international operations, startups, medtech, deep-tech, or manufacturing environments is highly valuable Experience with subsidiaries, international reporting structures, or US operations is a strong plus Fluency in Swedish and English We are looking for a structured, reliable, and highly detailed-oriented professional who enjoys taking ownership and creating order and clarity in a dynamic and fast-paced environment. As a person, you are analytical, strategic, pragmatic and execution-focused, with a strong ability to work with both details and the bigger picture. You have strong communication and collaboration skills, and you are comfortable operating close to both management and technical teams and presenting financial information clearly to both investors and engineers. Importantly, you thrive in an ambitious, high-performance environment and want to help build a globally significant company, not just manage spreadsheets At Ascilion, you will have the opportunity to make an impact not only in your own area of responsibility, but also on the development of the company as a whole. About Ascilion Ascilion was founded in 2012 with a mission to solve the problem of sampling dermal interstitial fluid in an efficient and pain-free way. A team of engineers with deep experience in MEMS technology and microfluidics took on the challenge of solving what turned out to be a very complex problem. We exist to bridge the worlds of precision engineering and biomarker science, creating innovative microneedle technologies that make dISF accessible, reliable, and painless; empowering researchers, clinicians, and companies to unlock the full potential of health monitoring and diagnostics. We are currently in a very exciting expansion phase where we grow all aspects of the organization from R&D to sales. Our customer base is increasing with numerous close collaborations in Europe, the US, and Asia. Come, join our journey! To learn more about us please visit www.ascilion.com For more information about this position, please contact: Krishan Johansson Haque, PhD Sr Recruitment Consultant, QRIOS Life Science & Engineering T: 0720701653 E: krishan.johansson-haque@qrios.se

title: CIPD - Financial Controller
description: CIPD is the professional body for HR and people development. We champion better work and working lives and support a global community of people professionals to make a positive difference to organisations and the people who work within them. We are looking for a Financial Controller to join us at an important time for CIPD and our Finance team. Reporting to the Finance Director and managing four direct reports, you will take responsibility for financial control across the organisation and our international entities. There is a lot happening at CIPD. We are changing some of our core systems, including those supporting our membership and qualifications, and we want to use this as an opportunity to improve the way Finance works across the organisation. The Financial Controller will be central to this. You will lead on financial controls, statutory reporting and audit, treasury, cash management and the integrity of our balance sheet and ledgers. Just as importantly, we want you to look at how we do things today and help us make them better - strengthening processes, improving controls and making sure we get the most from our systems (Netsuite and Salesforce). This is a hands-on role. We aren't looking for someone who wants to manage from a distance. You will need to be comfortable getting into the detail, understanding where something isn't working and seeing it through to resolution. At the same time, you'll lead and develop a team of eight, helping them take greater ownership and continue to raise standards across the function. You will also work closely with the Head of FP&A and colleagues across CIPD. A big part of the role will be building good relationships outside Finance and helping people understand why strong financial management matters. About you You will be a qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or CIMA) with strong technical accounting knowledge and experience of working in a complex organisation. You'll have a good grounding in financial control and statutory reporting, but we're particularly interested in people who have improved things rather than simply maintained them. You may have strengthened a control environment, improved a year-end process, introduced better balance sheet disciplines, supported a finance system implementation or redesigned financial processes. You'll understand what good looks like and be able to bring people with you when things need to change. You'll also be an experienced people manager. We want someone who enjoys developing a team, sets clear expectations and is prepared to roll their sleeves up when needed. Experience of working across multiple entities or international operations would be valuable, as would experience of NetSuite, Salesforce or finance transformation. Why join CIPD? This is a good opportunity for someone who wants to have a genuine influence on a finance function. There is already a clear direction of travel, but there is plenty still to do. You'll have the backing of the Finance Director to challenge how things are done, improve processes and controls and help develop a finance function that is fit for the future. And you'll be doing that within an organisation with a clear purpose. The work CIPD does ultimately comes back to improving people's experience of work. As Financial Controller, you will make sure we have the strong financial management, controls and systems needed to support that work. For someone who enjoys getting the detail right, developing people and making things better, there is a lot to get stuck into. We reserve the right to close the process early and as such, an early application is highly recommended.

description: Als Senior Consultant / Manager (w|m|d) berätst du unsere Kunden aus Banken und Finanzdienstleistung bei anspruchsvollen Fragestellungen rund um Liquiditäts- und Marktrisiken. Du analysierst ihre Ausgangslage, erkennst neue Anforderungen frühzeitig und entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinem Team passgenaue Lösungen – von der ersten Idee bis zur Umsetzung. So bringst du die Weiterentwicklung des Liquiditätsrisikomanagements unserer Kunden wirksam voran und ermöglichst fundierte Entscheidungen. Dabei übernimmst du fachliche Verantwortung, steuerst die Zusammenarbeit im Projekt und prägst die inhaltliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Beratungsansätze. Deine Aufgaben: Du begleitest spannende (Teil-)Projekte bei Banken und Finanzdienstleistern im Bereich Liquiditätsrisiko- und Marktrisikomanagement und leitest sie eigenverantwortlich – von Gap-Analysen über die Konzeption kundenspezifischer Lösungen bis hin zu deren Umsetzung. Du entwickelst integrierte Steuerungsansätze für Liquiditäts- und Marktpreisrisiken, bankweite Liquiditätsrisiko‑Stresstests sowie quantitative Modellierungslogiken, z. B. zur Risikomessung, oder Zins-, Margen- und Liquiditäts-Cashflow-Analysen. Darüber hinaus konzipierst du methodische Frameworks (z. B. im ILAAP-Kontext) und entwickelst Lösungen zur Umsetzung von IRRBB-/CSRBB-Anforderungen sowie NII-Simulationen. Im Rahmen deiner Arbeit stellst du zudem die wirksame Einbindung regulatorischer Anforderungen z. B. in Bezug auf ICAAP/ILAAP und IRRBB/CSRBB sicher. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Arbeitsergebnisse sowie für die deines Teams und treibst Themen proaktiv voran. Mit deiner ausgeprägten Teamorientierung und Professionalität stärkst du eine vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit – im Team und mit unseren Kunden. Außerdem förderst du jüngere Kolleg:innen, entwickelst sie gezielt weiter und trägst so zum Wachstum des Teams bei. Du bringst dich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unseres Beratungsportfolios ein, identifizierst frühzeitig relevante Marktpotenziale und leitest daraus konkrete Impulse ab. Mit deiner Expertise begleitest du die Entwicklung neuer Angebote und die Gewinnung neuer Mandate. Deine Skills: Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Mathematik, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Physik, Statistik oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften – idealerweise ergänzt durch Zertifizierungen wie FRM oder CFA. Du bringst mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung im Beratungsumfeld oder in der Finanzbranche mit. Erfahrungen in der Leitung bankfachlicher Umsetzungsprojekte im Liquiditäts- und Marktrisikomanagement sind von Vorteil; erste Berührungspunkte mit fachlicher Führung (z. B. bei der Steuerung von Teammitgliedern) runden dein Profil ab. Du hast ein gutes Verständnis von der Steuerung von Liquiditäts- und Marktpreisrisiken sowie vom ICAAP- und ILAAP-Rahmenwerk. Deine analytischen und quantitativen Fähigkeiten setzt du in der Modellierung und der Datenanalyse sicher ein; Programmierkenntnisse in Python oder R sind dabei ausdrücklich willkommen. Du kennst die relevanten europäischen und deutschen regulatorischen Anforderungen (z. B. EBA-Guidelines zu IRRBB und CSRBB, SREP-Anforderungen, ICAAP und ILAAP). Erste Erfahrungen im professionellen Umgang mit externen Audits sind ein Plus. Du arbeitest strukturiert, denkst lösungsorientiert und kommunizierst klar. Eine kunden- und teamorientierte Arbeitsweise ist für dich selbstverständlich – besonders wenn du im Team Verantwortung übernimmst und dich auf unterschiedliche Menschen und Situationen einstellst. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1-Niveau, verhandlungssicher) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse (mindestens B2-Niveau, fließend) in Wort und Schrift. #LI-LARA #LI-hybrid #diversity bei zeb: Entdecke bei zeb, wie wir uns für mehr Chancengleichheit einsetzen - sei es durch unsere women@zeb -Initiative, bei der du Kolleginnen wie Alexandra und Helena kennenlernen kannst, oder durch unser #proutz Netzwerk, das sich für eine offene und inklusive Arbeitskultur einsetzt und dir ermöglicht, bei zeb zu zeigen, wer du bist! KGaA, Munich (www.mutares.com), as a listed private equity holding company, acquires medium-sized companies in special situations, which show significant operational improvement potential and are sold again after undergoing a repositioning and stabilization process. Mutares actively support its portfolio companies with its own investment and operations teams and through strategic add-on acquisitions. The focus is on companies with revenues ranging from USD 120 million to USD 850 million, across various industries. The aim is to achieve a clear value increase with a focus on sustainable, long-term growth of the portfolio company.

This role involves on-site work at portfolio companies located across US territory.

Your Tasks

  • As part of the Transformation Management Office (TMO) team, supporting our portfolio companies throughout their turnaround journey by working closely with the management board and the Mutares team

  • Establishing a business plan incl. a turnaround concept and driving the implementation together with the Operations team and the portfolio company, including the management of different stakeholders

  • Assessment of strategic decisions (e.g. Insourcing/Outsourcing) together with the local teams and the Mutares team

  • Supporting the acquisition and integration process of add on acquisitions

  • Establishing the management governance and coherent tracking and reporting within the portfolio company

Your Profile

  • Successfully completed a degree in the field of economics, engineering, science or similar with outstanding results

  • At least 6 years of experience in transformations, restructuring or turnaround situations

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with an entrepreneurial mindset and hands-on approach

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite

  • Business fluency in English, with the ability to communicate in a well-structured and concise manner

  • Willingness to travel up to 4 days per week (typically Monday – Thursday) and to work in an international environment

What Mutares offers

  • Work in a highly motivated, international, committed, and agile team that enjoys working together

  • Exciting work environment with varied challenges, strategic influence, and tasks for continuous personal and professional development

  • Flat hierarchies, fast decision-making processes, and room for your own ideas

  • Regular team events and offsites

  • Pievilcīgu labumu grozu: iemaksas pensiju fondā, atlaides bankas produktiem, veselības apdrošināšanu, papildu brīvdienas un citas priekšrocības

esi daļa no starptautiskas profesionāļu komandas, kas, strādājot kopā, īsteno izaicinošus projektus, ceļot mūsu pakalpojumu vērtību klientu acīs un sekmējot Swedbank konkurētspēju.” Jana Kovaļevska, Kvalitātes vadītāja Klientu sadarbības atbilstības daļā

description: Werden Sie Teil eines international geprägten Forschungsteams, das sich durch tiefgehende Expertise und langjährige Erfahrung in der Entwicklung hochsensitiver Quantensensoren auszeichnet. Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Flexible Arbeitsmodelle und ein internationales Team mit Experten aus unterschiedlichsten Disziplinen. title: Analyst - Deals Desk
description: Main Purpose The Deals Desk is a middle office team providing market and risk analysis globally. The team’s primary responsibilities revolve around monitoring all elements of the risk and exposures related to commercial activity and report it directly to the Management Board on a daily basis. Commercially, the team adds value by providing traders with risk assessments and analysis which highlight their exposure, optionality and P&L. These reports are essential to help them make the right commercial decisions and optimize the opportunities their portfolios generate, all the while providing Deals Desk employees with an unprecedented office learning experience in the world of trading. The deals desk team is responsible for maintenance and enhancement of core P&L data to increase accuracy and timeliness of the daily trading results. Knowledge and Skills & Abilities Candidates preferably with at least 1-5yrs work experience with the following: • MBA in Finance Degree in Engineering is desirable Should be meticulous and innovative Have reasonable market analysis skills Should be proficient excel abilities Familiarity with using multiple systems is a plus Strong organisationalskills Should have excellent English communication skills Ability to work in a fast paced high pressure environment Key Responsibilities Be responsible for the production and reporting of daily trading positions and management P&L, production and monitoring of daily trading P&L and volumetric exposure reports, post deal review and system reconciliation. Enter inception P&L for all new trading strategies, and maintain the economics on these strategies from cradle to grave Independently justify the economics applied to each trading strategy. Apply forward curve on daily basis for physical and derivative markets to current position and to explain the impact on the trading P&L. Produce daily commentary for board of directors / traders to explain the change in the trading profit and loss due to market changes/change in estimated / actual economics for each deal. Analyse exposure and M2M profit and loss on physical/derivative portfolios Ensure all market price risk is captured and hedge actions executed Assess implication of changes to future physical deliveries and report and discuss impact of hedge strategy Creation and maintenance of ad-hoc reports to assist in any area of position reporting /structure /hedging ( data integrity / trade entry / irregular business structures). Full responsibility for integrity of data in trading systems that is used to generate the above items Key Relationships Deals Management, Physical/Derivative Traders, Operators, Finance Dept, Chartering Dept, Demurrage Dept, Deals Team Reporting Structure Deals Desk Manager at TGS

description: Trivs du i en roll där du får utnyttja dina kunskaper som privatrådgivare för att ge kunden den bästa helhetsrådgivningen? Vårt mål är att skapa förtroende och långsiktiga affärsrelationer mellan Danske Bank och våra kunder. Vi är en modern arbetsgivare så vi har därför beslutat om att även i framtiden ge möjligheten att blanda hemarbete och att vara på plats på kontoret. Om dig Vi söker dig som vill fortsätta arbeta med att ge förstklassig rådgivning och inspireras av mötet med kunden. Du ska också gilla att komma till avslut och hitta affärer i samförstånd med kund. Sista ansökningsdag är den 4 september 2026. About Us Danske Bank är en nordisk bank med broar till omvärlden. I 150 år har vi stöttat människor och företag att frigöra sin potential. En karriär hos oss är en möjlighet att bli en del av en gemenskap med 22 000 kollegor i en kultur som präglas av Team Up, Own It och Be Open. Målet för vår gemensamma resa är att transformera Danske Bank till en bättre bank. För våra kunder, våra medarbetare och samhällena runt omkring oss.

title: Head of Finance
description: We're looking for an ambitious, commercially minded Head of Finance to join YMCA South Midlands at an exciting stage of our growth. This isn't a role where Finance sits on the sidelines reporting what happened last month. You'll help us make better decisions, challenge our thinking and ensure our ambitions are backed by strong financial insight, robust governance and a clear understanding of risk. You'll work closely with our CEO in a high-support, high-challenge relationship and be a key financial partner to our Finance Committee and Board of Trustees. You'll have autonomy, access to key decisions and the opportunity to genuinely influence the future direction of the organisation. We want someone who will own the numbers, understand what's driving them and have the confidence to ask the questions others might not. Just as importantly, you'll be able to communicate the financial position clearly and credibly, giving our CEO, leadership team and trustees confidence in the information they receive and the decisions they make. The opportunity We're an ambitious organisation with plans to continue growing our impact, income and reach. Alongside leading our Finance function, you'll have the opportunity to get involved in some genuinely interesting work, from strengthening our commercial and trading performance to assessing new opportunities, property acquisitions and potential M&A activity. You'll be responsible for ensuring the financial fundamentals are strong, but we're looking for much more than technical excellence. We want someone who can look forward. Someone who can spot a risk before it becomes a problem, see an opportunity in the numbers, scrutinise a business case and help us make well-informed decisions about where we invest, where we grow and where we need to exercise caution. A key part of the role will also be building a strong and trusted relationship with our Head of Income Generation, Finance Committee and wider Board. You'll ensure trustees have timely, accurate and meaningful financial information, understand the implications behind the numbers and have confidence in the organisation's financial management, controls and planning. What you'll be doing You'll lead our Finance function and take ownership of: Budgeting, forecasting and longer-term financial planning Management accounts, cash flow and financial reporting Commercial and trading performance Financial modelling and scenario planning Financial controls, compliance, audit and statutory reporting Supporting property purchases, investment decisions and potential M&A opportunities Developing and leading our Finance team Just as importantly, you'll partner with leaders across the organisation, helping them understand and take ownership of their financial performance. You won't simply highlight a problem. We'll want you to help us understand why it is happening, what our options are and what we should do next. About you We value expertise, curiosity, ideas and healthy debate. You'll be a Head of Finance who brings professional judgement to the table, challenges assumptions when necessary and is prepared to offer a different perspective. You'll also understand that excellent financial leadership is about trust and communication as much as technical competence. You'll be comfortable working with trustees and senior stakeholders, able to explain complex financial matters without jargon and confident answering challenging questions. If you like being given a narrow brief and simply delivering what's asked, this probably isn't the role for you. But if you enjoy autonomy, pace, solving problems, challenging thinking, building trusted relationships and making things happen, you will thrive here. You'll be a qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) with strong financial leadership experience and excellent commercial judgement. You'll be someone who: Is curious about the story behind the numbers Builds trust and credibility with key stakeholders including Board Members Enjoys working in a growing, changing organisation Is confident challenging and influencing senior leaders Can turn complex financial information into clear recommendations Thinks commercially while maintaining strong financial discipline Brings solutions rather than simply identifying problems Enjoys taking ownership and being accountable Builds strong relationships without shying away from difficult conversations Can move comfortably between the strategic picture and the detail Wants to make a difference Experience of property investment, M&A, due diligence, commercial operations or a high-growth environment would be particularly valuable. Charity-sector experience is welcome, butit isn't essential. We're more interested in finding someone with the right financial expertise, commercial mindset and appetite to help us grow. Why Join YMCA South Midlands? Because this is an opportunity to use your financial expertise for something that matters. You'll join an ambitious organisation where Finance has a genuine voice, where good ideas are welcomed and where you'll be trusted to make an impact. As well as joining a supportive and collaborative team, you'll have the opportunity to: Make a genuine difference in a purpose-driven organisation Work in a varied finance role with plenty of responsibility Help improve systems and processes Develop your finance skills within a supportive environment Work flexibly around a part-time schedule Everyone is Welcome Here At YMCA South Midlands, we believe everyone should feel they belong. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and communities. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce that reflects the people we serve and where everyone is treated with dignity, respect and fairness. As a Christian charity, our faith inspires our values and our commitment to serving others. We welcome people of all faiths and none, and appointments are made on merit. Reasonable Adjustments We want every candidate to have the opportunity to perform at their best throughout our recruitment process. If you have a disability, long-term health condition or are neurodivergent and would benefit from any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know when you apply or contact us at any stage. We'll be happy to discuss how we can support you. Ready to Apply? If that sounds like the kind of Head of Finance role you've been looking for, we'd love to hear from you. Click Apply Now and submit your application.

description:
About the Role

Our national practice works with large international listed and inbound businesses. You will work primarily on a complementary portfolio of Tax Accounting and Audit of Tax clients, with the opportunity to explore more general advisory projects.

Our Tax Accounting Services (TAS) team works nationally, assisting advisory clients with complex tax account preparation and provisioning amid growing deal activity and heightened regulatory focus. We serve a diverse client base, ranging from FTSE 100 companies and overseas-listed groups to UK mid-tier businesses across various industries. You will have the opportunity to contribute end-to-end, from client proposals through to technical delivery.

Our Audit of Tax Specialists (ATS) team sits at the intersection of tax technical expertise and audit quality. We lead and oversee the delivery of complex audits of tax for some of the UK’s largest and most internationally diverse businesses. There are also opportunities to play to your strengths, be that in shaping best practice, driving technical training, or contributing to the strategic growth of the specialism within the firm.

We seek to attract the best people from a diverse talent pool and encourage a culture where people can be themselves and be valued for their strengths. With colleagues in over 10 offices nationwide, we offer flexibility on location.

We offer a clear career path through to Director, with a potential pathway to Partner, supported by strong investment in coaching and professional development at every level. This role offers particularly varied, challenging work and the opportunity to build an extensive network across specialist teams including Audit, Accounting Structuring, Corporate Reporting Services, Legal, and Valuations.

What your days will look like:

  • As a Senior Manager, you will manage close relationships with a wide range of clients. You will support and develop your teams and should expect the same for your peers, Directors and Partners. You will have a key role in ensuring high-quality, technically rigorous, and timely delivery of audit of tax and tax accounting assignments.
  • You will also explore opportunities to develop deeper knowledge in particular areas of interest, including international structuring, wider tax advisory work, or certain industry sectors.

Your responsibilities will include but are not limited to:

  • Managing a client portfolio of audit of tax and tax accounting work, liaising internally with technical specialists and externally with client teams, and reporting to the local and wider Partner/Director group
  • Leading and overseeing teams to deliver complex audits of tax, liaising with internal specialists, clients and client tax advisors, and the core audit team as required
  • Advising on the tax aspects of GAAP transitions (e.g. to IFRS or US GAAP), the tax accounting aspects of acquisitions and disposals, and the tax elements of adopting new standards, and assisting advisory clients nationally with complex tax account preparation and provisioning
  • Advising on or reviewing deferred tax asset recoverability, uncertain tax positions and tax accounting methodology and approach
  • Assisting with the tax accounting for carve-out financial statements and tax accounting preparation work under IFRS, FRS102 or US GAAP

The Role is for you if:

  • You must have a UK professional qualification (eg ACA, CTA, ATT, CA, ACCA, solicitor) or overseas equivalent.
  • You have gained significant international and UK corporate tax advisory experience working on complex transactions, with experience in tax accounting and/or audit of tax; strong technical knowledge of UK corporate tax, tax computations, and tax accounting is essential (IFRS and FRS102 essential, US GAAP optional).
  • You will need strong analytical skills and a flexible approach, combined with the ability to work as part of a number of client teams simultaneously.
  • You will have experience of developing and maintaining strong relationships with clients and internal stakeholders, together with proven leadership skills managing senior stakeholders and large teams.
  • You will have experience of project managing and delegating work within a team context, and will be commercially aware, with business development experience and confidence discus

title: Assistant Finance and Operations Manager
description: The Assistant Finance and Operations Manager is a new role for The Christie Charity (Charity) and a fantastic opportunity for an individual looking to work for a fast moving, growing organisation. We are looking for an enthusiastic individual to take ownership in the finance team for day-to-day transactional processing for The Christie Charity group. This position provides an excellent opportunity to develop an understanding of charity and commercial finance. You will play a key role in supporting robust financial controls across the Charity group. This is a hands-on role with responsibility for coordinating and overseeing day-to-day transactional activity undertaken by the Finance Officers, including purchase-to-pay, supplier payments, accounts receivable, banking, income reconciliation, corporate credit cards and other routine financial processes. The postholder will ensure work is completed accurately and within required timescales, review key reconciliations and outstanding items, and provide support and guidance to the Finance Officers where issues arise. They will remain actively involved in transactional processing where required, particularly in relation to more complex matters, periods of high workload and the transition of activities into the Charity. The postholder will act as the first point of escalation for transactional matters which cannot be readily resolved by the Finance Officers and as a key point of contact for routine finance queries from external third parties. They will work closely with colleagues across the Charity to ensure financial processes operate effectively while maintaining appropriate controls and segregation of duties. The Assistant Finance and Operations Manager will be an important day-to-day user of the Charity's finance and purchase-to-pay systems and will take a lead operational role in ensuring these systems are used consistently and effectively. The postholder will support Finance Officers and wider Charity colleagues with system and process queries, monitor compliance with agreed financial procedures and identify recurring issues or opportunities to improve processes. Working with the Charity Financial Controller and Funds and Finance Business Partner, they will contribute to the continued development of efficient, proportionate and well-controlled financial processes across the Charity group. Additional information Upon joining The Christie Charity, day-to-day financial transaction processing will continue to be delivered by The Christie NHS Foundation Trust during the initial months of the role, therefore, the postholder will be expected to work closely and collaboratively with their finance team to ensure seamless operations and continuity across the Charity group. These functions are anticipated to transfer to the Charity group with the postholder taking ownership of these responsibilities within the first 3 months in role. The postholder will be expected to work autonomously to ensure the smooth transition of activities to the Charity. This post would suit an individual who enjoys working in a dynamic, evolving environment, where responsibilities may shift in response to organisational priorities. The postholder must be comfortable navigating ambiguity, demonstrating flexibility, initiative, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. The postholder will also provide support to the team on an ad-hoc basis as required. The postholder will complete a shift approximately every four to six weeks at the Charity's hub in Withington to support charitable activity at The Christie NHS Foundation Trust.

description:

M&A Operations is a market-leading team within the Strategy& business unit in PwC Deals, supporting corporate and private equity clients through high-impact M&A and transformation engagements. description: Job Beschreibung: An der Universität Wien arbeiten über 10.000 Persönlichkeiten gemeinsam an den großen Fragen der Zukunft. Rund 2.900 Mitarbeiter*innen tragen mit ihrer Expertise in Administration und Organisation dazu bei, exzellente Forschung und Lehre zu ermöglichen. IVa Stellen ID: 5921 Das CIO Office gestaltet die strategische Weiterentwicklung der IT-Landschaft der Universität und verantwortet die Governance des universitätsweiten IT-Portfolios. Die Position ist – wie an der Universität Wien üblich – zunächst auf zwölf Monate befristet. Wir legen jedoch großen Wert auf eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit und streben die Übernahme in ein unbefristetes Dienstverhältnis ausdrücklich an. Das machen Sie konkret: Strategisches Portfolio- und Governance-Management • Weiterentwicklung und administrative Bewirtschaftung des universitätsweiten IT-Portfolios • Erarbeitung und Pflege von Richtlinien, Policies, Standards und Regelwerken im Umfeld des IT-Portfolios • Entwicklung, Dokumentation und Umsetzung von Governance-Strukturen für Services, Leistungen und Entscheidungsprozesse • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Detailportfolios in den Abteilungen des Zentralen Informatikdienstes • Vorbereitung und Begleitung strategischer Entscheidungs- und Steuerungsgremien • Entwicklung von Portfolio- und Service-Management-Prozessen zur nachhaltigen Steuerung von Leistungen und Ressourcen • Sicherstellung einer konsistenten Dokumentation von Services, Verantwortlichkeiten und Leistungsbeschreibungen • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung eines einheitlichen Verständnisses von Service-, Governance- und Portfoliostrukturen Ziel- und Leistungsmanagement • Entwicklung und Koordination von Zielvereinbarungen • Definition und Nachverfolgung strategischer Ziele, Kennzahlen und Steuerungsinstrumente • Erstellung von Berichten, Entscheidungsgrundlagen und Management-Reports für CIO und Leitungsgremien • Unterstützung bei der Priorisierung und strategischen Ausrichtung von Initiativen und Maßnahmen Vertrags- und Compliance-Management • Betreuung und Koordination von Verträgen im Umfeld von IT-Services und Dienstleistungen • Sicherstellung der Einhaltung regulatorischer, rechtlicher und organisatorischer Anforderungen • Unterstützung bei Themen wie Datenschutz, Informationssicherheit, Barrierefreiheit, Lizenzmanagement und Compliance • Koordination von Vertragsverlängerungen, Leistungsüberprüfungen und Dokumentationspflichten • Mitwirkung bei Audits sowie Vorbereitung entsprechender Nachweise und Unterlagen Wir wenden uns mit dieser Ausschreibung an qualitätsaffine, motivierte, verantwortungsbewusste und kommunikative Persönlichkeiten mit fachlich einschlägiger Ausbildung und entsprechender beruflicher Erfahrung, die hohe Einsatzbereitschaft zeigen sowie eigenverantwortlich, selbständig und genau arbeiten. Das gehört zu Ihrer Persönlichkeit: • Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (Universität/FH), vorzugsweise in Wirtschaft, Management, Rechtswissenschaften, Verwaltungsmanagement, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Portfolio-, Governance-, Service-, Compliance- oder Organisationsmanagement von Vorteil • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Richtlinien, Governance-Modellen und organisatorischen Steuerungsinstrumenten • Kenntnisse in Vertragsmanagement, Compliance-Management oder regulatorischen Fragestellungen • Ausgeprägtes Verständnis für organisatorische Zusammenhänge und strategische Steuerungsprozesse • Erfahrung im universitären Umfeld oder in komplexen Organisationen von Vorteil • Analytische und konzeptionelle Stärke sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich aufzubereiten • Hohe Kommunikations-, Moderations- und Beratungskompetenz • Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1) Ihr besonderer Arbeitsstil: Sie arbeiten gerne eigenverantwortlich und strukturiert, sind serviceorientiert und finden gerne Lösungen. Inspirierendes Arbeitsklima: Sie sind Teil eines engagierten Teams mit diversem universitären Background, in einer lockeren Arbeitsumgebung. Entfaltungsmöglichkeiten: Wir bieten Ihnen ein Umfeld, in dem das Erlernen neuer Fähigkeiten nicht nur erlaubt, sondern erwünscht ist. Gute öffentliche Anbindung : Ihr neuer Arbeitsplatz ist mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln bequem erreichbar. Interne Weiterbildung: Wir bieten Ihnen laufend die Möglichkeit, Ihre Kompetenzen zu vertiefen.Wählen Sie aus einem umfangreichen, kostenfreien Kursangebot. Faires Gehalt: Das Grundgehalt von EUR 3.450,30 (Vollzeit, brutto) erhöht sich, wenn wir Berufserfahrungen anrechnen können. Gleiche Chancen für alle: Wir freuen uns über jede zusätzliche Persönlichkeit im Team! So einfach bewerben Sie sich: Mit Lebenslauf und kurzem Motivationsschreiben Abschlusszeugnis Ihrer Qualifikation (z.B. Lehrabschluss, Matura, Studium etc.) Über unser Jobportal / Jetzt Bewerben-Button Bei inhaltlichen Fragen kontaktieren Sie bitte: Wolfgang Walzer wolfgang.walzer@univie.ac.at Wir freuen uns über neue Persönlichkeiten in unserem Team! Die Universität Wien betreibt eine antidiskriminatorische Anstellungspolitik und legt Wert auf Chancengleichheit, Frauenförderung und Diversität . Wir streben eine Erhöhung des Frauenanteils beim wissenschaftlichen und allgemeinen Universitätspersonal insbesondere in Leitungsfunktionen an und fordern daher qualifizierte Frauen ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung auf. Service Manager

title: Private Client US/UK Financial Services Tax - Senior Associate
description:
About the Role

We are looking to hire a Senior Associate based in our London office with experience of advising high net worth individuals, private equity executives and business owners on a broad range of complex US/UK tax matters.

We help our clients stay ahead of changes that impact their businesses, navigating complexity and risk. We deliver deep tax technical, people and legal expertise, while providing the critical context to make informed and compliant decisions. With clients ranging from multinational organisations and public sector bodies to entrepreneurs and family businesses, the work we do is diverse.

Our Private Client US/UK team help our clients navigate the frequently changing and complex landscape of having exposure to both US and UK taxation and manage the international tax environment related to stringent reporting requirements.

A career in our team will provide you with the opportunity to advise clients on their US and UK tax affairs, while acting as a trusted advisor feeding in on any tax considerations to be had when making financial decisions or acquiring assets. You will also help individuals understand where the primary right to tax lies in different scenarios, as well as providing advice on tax implications of movement of funds.

What your days will look like:

  • Assisting with the management of a diverse and broad portfolio of client engagements, while delegating responsibility to junior staff (Associates) and consulting Managers, Senior Managers and Directors where applicable

  • Working closely with experienced Private Client Partners, Directors, Senior Managers & Managers and having the responsibility of helping develop new client relationships and deliver complex projects, identifying and pursuing new opportunities from within our market

  • Maintaining a level of relevant US & UK tax knowledge, staying current with technical developments including changes in tax law and legislation

  • Preparing advice for clients and internal stakeholders on the latest tax technical issues, including delivering sessions with senior management at client /knowledge sharing events

  • Supervising, coaching and providing regular feedback to Associates within the team while also keeping more senior stakeholders updated on progress

This role is for you if:

  • You have relevant, detailed and up-to-date US and UK tax knowledge in the personal tax space. Experience of dealing with complex tax issues facing owners, founders and executives, as well as privately or family-owned businesses is highly relevant

  • You have strong analytical & technical skills with attention to detail to ensure accurate tax calculations and compliance

  • You have experience in researching and preparing advice on international aspects such as residence, domicile and arriving/leaving the US and the UK

  • You have strong organisational skills with the ability to meet several deadlines throughout the year and deliver high-quality work.

  • You must possess a CTA , ACA , ATT or Enrolled Agency Qualification (or an international equivalent)

What you'll receive from us:

​No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

title: Vi söker en Financial Controller till vår kund i Göteborg
description: Om tjänsten I rollen som Financial Controller blir du en viktig del av ekonomifunktionen och arbetar nära CFO, redovisningsansvarig och business controller med finansiell uppföljning, analys och rapportering. Dina ansvarsområden kan bland annat innefatta rapportering inom koncernen, analysarbete, förberedning och framtagning av nyckeltal relaterade till konsolidering och rapportering. Du kommer att ha flera kontaktytor inom organisationen. I din roll som Financial Controller kommer dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter bland annat innebära: Driva analys och månatliga uppföljningar av ekonomisk karaktär inom ditt ansvarsområde. Bidra med finansiell rådgivning och vägleda kollegor i ekonomiska frågor. Ha en aktiv roll vid bokslut, budget och forecasts. Identifiera förbättringsområden för att säkerställa kontinuerlig utveckling av finansiella och operativa processer. Supportera vid interna och externa revisioner. Observera att detta är en annons där du har möjlighet att skicka in ditt CV för att arbeta som financial controller via Adecco. Din roll och ditt fokus anpassas utifrån uppdragets behov och din kompetens. Uppdragsperioden kan variera, från kortare till längre uppdrag. Men vanligtvis inleds anställningen med en provanställning på 6 månader, med möjlighet till tillsvidareanställning för rätt person. Om dig Vi söker dig som har en högskoleexamen inom ekonomi och tidigare erfarenhet av arbete som Financial Controller. Vidare ser vi att du är van vid att hantera stora mängder data på detaljnivå och har goda kunskaper i Excel. Vi ser även gärna att du behärskar både engelska och svenska i tal och skrift. Som person ser vi att du är noggrann, strukturerad och kommunikativ. Du besitter en god förmåga att arbeta verksamhetsnära med arbetsuppgifter som sträcker sig högt och lågt. Du trivs bra med att arbeta i ett högt arbetstempo, vågar ta initiativ och hjälper dina kollegor vid behov. Vidare har du en god förståelse för redovisningsregler och finansiella processer. Viktigt för tjänsten är att : Du har en högskoleexamen inom ekonomi. Arbetslivserfarenhet som financial controller. Mycket goda kunskaper i Excel. Mycket goda kunskaper i engelska och svenska i såväl tal som skrift Goda kunskaper inom K3 och IFRS Erfarenhet av arbete i SAP eller motsvarande ERP-system Vi kommer att lägga stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet. Viktigt att tänka på vid ansökan För att vi på bästa sätt ska kunna ta del av din kompetens och erfarenhet ber vi dig att skicka in ett uppdaterat och tydligt CV, där det framgår vilka roller du haft, dina arbetsuppgifter samt hur många års erfarenhet du har inom respektive område. Vi behandlar ansökningar löpande. Tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum, skicka därför in din ansökan så snart som möjligt! title: Assistant Manager/Manager, Traded and Quantitative Risk — CCR/CVA
description: Connect to your Industry Counterparty Credit Risk (“CCR”) and Credit Valuation Adjustment (“CVA”) Risk are major risk types for Financial Institutions, particularly within the Capital Markets divisions of banks and other financial institutions that trade derivatives, securities financing transactions and other counterparty-facing products. These risks sit at the intersection of front office, risk management, finance, model risk, collateral management and regulatory capital. CCR and CVA capital can represent a material component of a bank’s prudential capital requirements, particularly for institutions with significant derivatives and securities financing activity. The drivers of CCR and CVA are complex, requiring a detailed understanding of traded products, counterparty exposure, collateralisation, netting, margining, wrong-way risk, exposure modelling, and the regulatory capital frameworks used to measure and manage these risks. As we expand our Risk Advisory business to more holistically include all risk types, the focus on CCR and CVA continues to increase. With important regulatory developments including SA-CVA, SA-CCR, advancing IMM expectations and model risk management expectations for counterparty credit risk, client-driven demand to support banks and other financial institutions in these areas is creating an increasing need for these skills. What brings us all together at Deloitte? It’s how we approach the thousands of decisions we make every day. How we behave, our beliefs and our attitudes. In other words: our values. Whatever we do, wherever we are in the world, we lead the way , serve with integrity , take care of each other , foster inclusion , and collaborate for measurable impact . These five shared values lead every decision we make and action we take, guiding us to deliver impact how and where it matters most . Providing input into, and/or leading, technical presentations to financial services clients covering CCR, CVA, key regulatory trends, technical insights and practical implementation challenges. Developing and managing a portfolio of client relationships across the financial services sector to support business growth. Managing workstreams or projects as part of a Deloitte team to support financial services clients in managing their CCR and CVA regulatory programmes, including SA-CVA implementation, BA-CVA assessment, SA-CCR optimisation, IMM development or remediation, exposure modelling and CVA risk management. Leading and managing teams and individuals to support meeting client demands, while also providing the basis for people development, mentoring and leadership. When supporting our clients, we will be looking for individuals who can work in the CCR/CVA ecosystem, either in the Front Office working with traders, XVA desks, quants or structurers, or in Risk Management, Finance, Model Risk or Quantitative Analytics working with risk managers, finance teams, model validators, credit officers or quantitative teams. Areas of work can and will vary, but the core competencies needed to support these clients remain largely the same. These include the ability to understand traded products, counterparty exposure, netting, collateral, margining, exposure profiles, valuation adjustments, regulatory capital requirements and the practical implementation of models and frameworks within large financial institutions. The candidate should have a broader perspective of potential issues encountered when managing diverse teams and the strategies to overcome them; have a clear understanding of the firm’s commitment to creating a more inclusive culture; and be able to manage diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognised for their contribution. title: Financial Controlling Lead (Senior Financial Controller)
description: Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. At Stegra, we’re building an impact-driven, sustainable company - and we need a diverse, inclusive team to make it happen. If you share our passion but don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the perfect fit for this role, or another as we grow. At Stegra, we’re not just building a plant, we’re proving that sustainable industry is possible. And to do that, we need people like you. Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life. Financial Controlling Lead We are looking for an experienced Senior Financial Controller to join our team as Financial Controlling Lead. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring high-quality financial reporting, compliance with Swedish legislation and IFRS, and driving continuous improvements across our financial processes. You will balance operational excellence with strategic insights, supporting business leaders in making informed decisions. As Financial Controlling Lead, you will: • Lead and coordinate Group reporting as required, ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant delivery. • Manage and improve and variance analysis in close collaboration with the other finance team members. • Act as subject-matter expert on IFRS, Swedish GAAP (K3), and other relevant accounting standards, as well as all audit-related matters. • Ensure effective internal controls and compliance with group accounting manuals, Swedish financial regulations, and tax legislation. • Run and quality-assure inter-company charge-out and allocation models, ensuring transparency, fiscal compliance and harmonization. • Ownership for annual reports. • Coordinate the audit process in collaboration with others. • Support productivity improvements, investment analysis, and KPI follow-up to drive financial results. • Contribute financial expertise in corporate tax and transfer pricing matters. • Collaborate on system development projects and implement improvements in ERP, BI, and financial reporting tools. • Act as business partner to key stakeholders, supporting strategy execution. You have: • A degree in Finance and Accounting. • Extensive, multi-year experience from senior accounting and/or financial controlling roles, ideally in an international environment. • Excellent expertise in IFRS, Swedish GAAP, and Swedish financial/tax legislation. • Solid experience in inter-company charge-out models, governance structures, and financial compliance. • Proven track record in leading audits, developing financial controls, and driving process improvements. • Experience from system implementation and following changes. • Experience from working in a changing environment and establishing routines, documenting processes to set structures that are currently not in place. • Experience from larger investments and manufacturing industries (CAPEX) is meriting. • Strong expertise in ERP preferably SAP S4/Hana Public Cloud, and other systems such as Business Central, Aaro, HFM/OneStream, MS BI, Excel. • Proven track record of leadership and project management experience, including change management. • Excellent communication and advisory skills, with fluency in English and Swedish. For you to thrive with us, we expect that you are an independent, proactive, and solution-oriented professional with a strong sense of ownership. You thrive in complex environments, can challenge the status quo constructively, and collaborate effectively across functions and cultures. You bring structure and clarity, while also being innovative and eager to drive efficiency through technology and process improvements. While some processes and procedures are in place, many aren't and need to be, we expect that despite seniority, you will be willing and able to pick things up and act for change, all in line with our Stegra value: We, not me - together. Read more about Benefits at Stegra here. This is Stegra Stegra is on a mission to change the global steel industry by producing green hydrogen, iron, and steel - with the goal of eliminating CO₂ emissions. Instead of coal, we use green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity, meaning our primary emissions will be water and heat. By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitized, and sustainable plant in Boden, Northern Sweden - currently under construction. But this is just the beginning. Our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize industries beyond steel, paving the way for a cleaner future. Our Stockholm Office Our modern Stockholm office is located on Norra Stationsgatan, close to Karolinska University Hospital in central Stockholm. Here, you’ll find a bright, collaborative workspace where cross-functional teams connect, share ideas, and drive progress. Whether you're visiting regularly or working hybrid, you'll be part of a vibrant office culture with easy access to the city’s energy and amenities.

Join EY and help to build a better working world. EY-Parthenon Assistant Director – Financial Diligence, TMT The TMT team at EY-Parthenon has exciting opportunities. You'll work with a high-performing, integrated team which focuses on a variety of high-profile transactions with leading Corporate and Private Equity clients undertaking Financial Diligence. You'll have a diverse range of stretching experiences which will give you continuous learning and development opportunities as well as a great sense of achievement. The opportunity At EY-Parthenon, our unique combination of transformative strategy, transactions, tax and corporate finance deliver real-world value – solutions that work in practice, not just on paper. Benefiting from EY’s full spectrum of services, we’ve reimagined strategic consulting to work in a world of increasing complexity. With deep functional and sector expertise, paired with innovative AI-powered technology and an investor mindset, we partner with CEOs, boards private equity and governments every step of the way. Continuing change and growth within all components of the TMT sector, combined with market leading credentials, means we have successfully achieved continued double-digit growth with lots of further greenfield opportunities. You will have exposure to our high profile global and leading large cap private equity clients. title: Finance and Funds Business Partner
description: The Finance and Funds Business Partner role is a fantastic opportunity for an individual looking to work for a fast moving, growing organisation. Everything we do is geared to supporting the renowned Christie NHS Foundation Trust to ensure cancer patients receive the highest level of treatment and care and have access to world leading research and technology, ensuring they have the best possible experience. We are looking for a dynamic and enthusiastic self-starter to support the Charity Financial Controller with: - The financial management of the Charity's funds and individually funded projects; and - The financial control and governance of The Christie Charity group, particularly its two wholly owned subsidiaries (The Christie Trading Company Limited and Northern Pathology Developments Limited). You will be joining The Christie Charity at an exciting time as we seek to diversify the Charity's income streams through use of innovative social investments and strategic commercial ventures. This position provides an excellent opportunity to develop a deep understanding of charity and commercial finance within a dynamic and purpose-driven organisation. Financial management In relation to the financial management of the Charity's funds, you will ensure that Individual Named Funds, containing designated funds, are utilised in accordance with their Terms of Reference. In relation to the financial management of individually funded projects, you will monitor spend against budgets through accountability mechanisms agreed with The Christie NHS Foundation Trust finance team. The postholder will be an integral part of the Charity finance team and partake in the annual budget setting process to the extent budgets relate to the Charity's Individual Named Funds or individually funded projects. As part of your role in the financial management of individually funded projects, you will act a finance business partner to the broader Charity. You will be integral in liaising with the Charity's newly appointed Grants Manager to ensure they are aware of new projects. Financial control and governance You will play a key role in ensuring robust financial control across the Charity group, with the opportunity to take ownership of its two wholly owned subsidiaries: The Christie Trading Company Limited and Northern Pathology Developments Limited. This is a hands-on role where you will be responsible for overseeing the accuracy and integrity of financial controls and reporting, supporting the Charity's aim of maintaining strong governance across both charitable and commercial operations. Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to, budget preparation and monitoring, completing month-end close, submitting quarterly tax returns, and preparing the statutory accounts for both subsidiaries, as well as supporting the Charity Financial Controller in maintaining effective financial control and oversight of the Charity's operations as required. Additional information The Finance and Funds Business Partner is a well-established role in the Charity. The successful applicant will be provided on the job training to fulfil this role by the previous postholder who now holds the role of Charity Financial Controller in the organisation. In the immediate term, day-to-day financial transaction processing will continue to be delivered by The Christie NHS Foundation Trust, therefore, the postholder will be expected to work closely and collaboratively with their finance team to ensure seamless operations and continuity across the Charity group. These responsibilities are expected to transition in full to The Christie Charity by 31 December 2026. This post would suit an individual who enjoys working in a dynamic, evolving environment, where responsibilities may shift in response to organisational priorities. The postholder must be comfortable navigating ambiguity, demonstrating flexibility, initiative, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
