description:
About the Team

For us, SOC is not just a ticket or detections „washing machine “. We perceive incident response as a mandatory part of our services, along with other proactive activities such as: Threat Hunting, Threat Intelligence, Vulnerability Management, as well as post-incident activities like Forensic Analysis and more.

Threat Management team consists of cybersecurity professionals focused on prevention of the cyberattacks via detection and responding to cyber threats. The key pillars consist of incident response, threat hunting, threat intelligence, security monitoring, vulnerability management, engineering and consulting services.

About your manager

Lubomír has over 10 years of cyber security experience with different projects related to mainly cyber security managed services, building and operating Security Operation Centers (SOC), Threat Hunting & Intelligence and Vulnerability Management. Lubomír is also responsible for team leading, project management, designing of cyber security managed services, creation and development of training plans and is a proven coach to train other team members or client staff. Outside of work, he is involved in teaching, science, and research at the University of Hradec Králové, where he guarantees and teaches the course Surveillance Systems and Forensic Analysis.

Job description & summary

As an Incident Response Expert, you will serve as a Level 3 analyst and Subject Matter Expert (SME) withing the client's operations, specializing in security incident detection, analysis, investigation and Response. Your expertise will be pivotal in leading incident response efforts to ensure timely containment and eradication of security threats. In this role, you can expect a balanced mix of long-term client engagements in operations, alongside ad-hoc projects – based assignments focused on pure incident response, threat hunting, and breach Discovery, all aimed at fortifying client security and resilience.

This is a senior role, and its additional responsibilities may include continuous improvement of the Threat Management team tradecraft and capabilities as well as sharing knowledge, mentoring and training junior colleagues.

Requirements of the role

  • 4+ years of relevant professional experience.

  • Consistent, reliable and professional personality, capable of working within international & diverse teams.

  • Previous CERT/CSIRT/DFIR/SOC (or equivalent) experience highly desired.

  • In depth understanding of varied attack vectors and adversaries’ Tactics, Techniques & Procedures (TTPs) up to the level of Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs).

  • Excellent understanding of one or more Operating Systems (Linux, Windows, …).

  • Ability to work under pressure during major security incident response situations as well as attention to detail during post-breach investigation.

  • As an Incident Response Expert, you will lead technical investigations and recovery efforts in response to cybersecurity incidents, conducting forensics, and identifying compromised systems. Previous experience in incident response is essential.

  • Ability to lead investigations in compromised environment without any previous knowledge of the environment for major incidents (eg. ransomware, APTs).

Nice to have

  • Hands-on skills within the information security field, with special focus towards Security.

  • Information and Event Management (SIEM) tools like Splunk, QRadar, Arcsight or ELK.

  • Working knowledge of the Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) tools.

  • Experience with Cyber Threat Intelligence integration into SOC environment & operation.

  • Previous consulting experience in the global enterprise environment.

  • Industry recognized certifications either in the area of general information security or focused.

  • Towards Threat Management can be plus.

  • Deeper experience in any (or more) of the following areas:

Security/Network Analysis

Incident Response

Cyber Threat Intelligence

Threat and Vulnerability Management

Digital Forensics

SIEM solutions

title: Business Process Specialist - Tax Technology (f/m/d)
description: Your career at Deutsche Börse Group\n\n Your area of work: Group Tax is responsible for all tax-related matters within Deutsche Börse Group and acts as the business owner for tax processes and tax technology requirements across the Group. As a Business Process Specialist - Tax Technology, you will work closely with your colleagues from the Tax Technology team and the Tax Compliance functions to support the design of new and the enhancement of existing tax-related processes within our SAP S/4HANA environment and associated tax solutions. The position is embedded within Group Tax and serves as an important interface between Tax, Finance, Business, and IT. While technical implementation, system development, and SAP customizing are performed by the responsible IT teams, you will contribute to the definition of business requirements, the design of tax-related process-solutions, testing activities, and the validation of implemented changes from a tax and business perspective. You will support the ongoing digitalization and automation of tax processes across the Group and gain broad exposure to indirect tax, SAP, and tax technology topics in an international environment. This position offers an excellent opportunity to further develop your expertise at the interface of taxation, business processes, and the latest SAP technology while working alongside experienced colleagues across Tax, Finance, and IT. Your responsibilities: As a member of our Tax Technology team, act as tax business representative for SAP and tax technology-related initiatives within Deutsche Börse Group. Support the definition and documentation of business requirements for tax-relevant SAP processes and tax technology solutions. Support the design of tax process requirements and coordinate their implementation together with Tax, IT, and external service providers. Contribute to the review and validation of technical solution designs from a tax and business process perspective. Plan, coordinate, execute, and document user acceptance testing (UAT), integration testing, and validation of tax-related system changes. Ensure that SAP-based processes support indirect tax compliance requirements and internal control standards. Provide functional support and issue analysis for tax-related SAP processes and coordinate resolution with IT teams. Support the automation and digitalization of tax-relevant processes, including SAP S/4HANA, tax engines, reporting solutions, and VAT allocation processes. Analyze and optimize tax-relevant data flows and interfaces between SAP and connected systems. Contribute to the continuous improvement of the indirect tax control framework and related business processes. Support the readiness and implementation of a global e-invoicing and real-time reporting requirements Please note: This is a business-facing tax technology role within Group Tax. The position does not include technical SAP development or SAP customizing responsibilities, which remain within the IT organization. Your profile: University degree in Economics, Business Administration, Information Systems, Law, or a related field. A minimum of 3 years of professional experience in Tax Technology, SAP process support, accounting systems, taxation, or comparable area. Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA and/or SAP ECC and a good understanding of SAP-supported business processes (e.g. FI, CO, SD, MM) Affinity for technology and digitalization, combined with the ability to translate business requirements into practical process solutions. Experience in requirements management, process improvement, testing, and stakeholder collaboration. Knowledge of indirect taxes (VAT) and tax-related SAP processes is an advantage. Experience with SAP tax and compliance solutions, e.g. SAP Document and Reporting compliance (DRC) is considered a strong advantage. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a business-oriented mindset, and excellent communication abilities. Highly motivated team player with the ability to collaborate effectively across Tax, Finance, Business, and IT functions. Very good proficiency in written and spoken English and German. Eagerness to learn and further develop expertise in Tax Technology, SAP-supported tax processes, and indirect taxation.

description:
About the role:

You’ll be joining PwC’s Risk Line of Service, within our AI & Modelling team, working at the forefront of AI-enabled transformation in the insurance sector.

This role is for people who understand technology deeply enough to shape and execute a vision, not just talk about it. You will help insurance clients design, build and embed Generative AI, agentic and advanced analytics solutions across finance, actuarial, pricing, capital and risk functions, operating in an environment where technologies, architectures and regulatory expectations are evolving rapidly

As a Manager / Senior Manager, you will sit close to the technology: shaping solution architecture, guiding engineering and modelling teams, and ensuring that AI solutions are robust, scalable, explainable and fit for purpose in a regulated insurance environment. You will work alongside actuaries, data scientists, engineers and insurance specialists, and will be supported by PwC’s onshore and offshore Technology and AI Centres of Excellence.

What your days will look like:

  • Leading the design and delivery of AI-enabled solutions, from problem definition through to deployment, across insurance pricing, reserving, capital modelling, finance transformation and risk analytics.

  • Shaping solution architectures for Generative AI and agentic systems, including decisions around data, models, orchestration, controls and integration into existing platforms.

  • Working hands-on with technical teams (engineers, data scientists, actuaries) to translate vision into buildable, testable and scalable solutions.

  • Navigating fast-moving technology landscapes, assessing emerging tools and approaches, and making informed trade-offs between innovation, risk, cost and time-to-value.

This role is for you if:

  • You have strong experience delivering technology-enabled transformation, in insurance or financial services, but with clear hands-on involvement in solution design and delivery.

  • You have practical experience with modern AI and analytics approaches, such as: Generative AI and large language model–based systems, Agentic or decision-automation architectures, Advanced analytics and modelling in regulated environments

  • You understand how AI solutions are built and operated, including: Data pipelines and feature engineering, Model lifecycle management (development, testing, monitoring), Integration with enterprise systems and workflows

  • You are comfortable making architectural and design decisions in situations where there is no single “right answer”, and technology choices evolve rapidly.

  • You understand insurance finance, actuarial, pricing, risk or capital well enough to design solutions that work in practice, not just in theory.

  • You can lead technical teams without needing to be the deepest specialist, providing direction, challenge and structure while enabling others to do their best work.

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions. ​

​

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

About the role:

PwC's Alternative Investment Funds (AIF) team sits within our wider Financial Services Tax team. The team consists of specialists focusing on assisting alternative investment fund managers with a range of services across their business, covering the manager, the key people, the funds, investors and investments.


Whilst the team is UK based, the nature of the AIF industry means that a large amount of our work is international meaning there are many opportunities to work with the wider PwC AIF network on both outbound and inbound clients and opportunities to travel to the US are expected.


We are looking for a Senior Manager with strong advisory and compliance focused tax experience to primarily focus on Hedge Fund and inbound clients, from start-ups all the way through to global multi-PM and multi strategy managers.

As a Senior Manager you will have the opportunity to develop your skills, drive your ambition and work with experienced Partners and Directors across the team. The team will provide you with the opportunity to put into practice your tax technical skills in a stimulating and challenging environment.

What your days will look like:

  • The Alternative Investment Funds industry is dynamic, technically demanding and creative and offers opportunities to work on major transactions, international structuring, and a range of day-to-day UK tax matters.

  • You will lead advisory focused projects for clients within the AIF team by taking responsibility for researching and summarising technical analysis.

  • You will be responsible for helping to manage the team to provide excellent advisory services to globally situated clients. You will need to understand the business and transactions undertaken by clients to enable you to provide opportunities to those clients at the right time.

  • You will be responsible for liaising with the compliance centre for a portfolio of clients by participating in client meetings, ensuring timetable adherence, supporting the compliance team with any tax analysis before undertaking a technical review of the work prepared.


This role is for you if:

  • You want a position where you will build relationships directly with senior client leadership and founders, become a real driver with day-to-day deliverables and manage and develop the existing junior team members.

  • You have experience of working with alternative investment fund managers specifically hedge funds

  • You are commercially, financially and operationally proactive and agile and keen to work in a fast paced ever changing environment.

  • You feel energised by meeting new people, enjoy working with clients who are developing their business and exploring new ideas.

  • You possess an accounting or tax qualification (or International equivalent) or have equivalent work experience. This includes international candidates who qualify through experience in their home country.

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

Operations Supervisor - Distribution

For roles in California the range is $70,304 - $82,000 and for roles in Washington the range is $80,169 - $82,000.

· Communicate clearly and effectively, with excellent attention to detail and a focus on data accuracy

title: Private Equity Senior Associate
description:
About the role

This role sits within PwC UK’s Private Equity Independence team, supporting partners and engagement teams in applying audit independence requirements across complex Private Equity structures. You’ll work with large, global PE groups, helping to analyse fund, portfolio and holding‑company hierarchies to ensure the correct independence restrictions are identified and applied.

A core part of the role is maintaining high‑quality data within PwC’s Client Entity System (CES), a critical firm‑wide system underpinning independence compliance globally. By ensuring CES accurately reflects client structures, you’ll play a key role in enabling the firm to serve its clients confidently while meeting regulatory independence obligations.

What your days will look like:

  • Ensure client entities are correctly structured and classified in CES and evaluating the restriction status of entities within the hierarchy
  • Assess and monitor independence risks across private equity groups, including ongoing changes due to investments, divestments, and restructuring. Evaluate the impact of these changes on the firm’s ability to provide audit and non-audit services
  • Initiating independence assessments to maintain the firm’s independence of its clients in the context of constantly changing hierarchies
  • Maintaining organisational structures and hierarchy, designing, updating, and managing trackers for accurate monitoring of timelines, tasks, and independence issues
  • Collaborate with internal teams to resolve hierarchy-related queries and support onboarding of new entities.

This role is for you if:

  • Ability to manage and interpret detailed information, ensuring accuracy in independence assessments and documentation.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to interact at all levels and deliver clear, sometimes challenging, messages.
  • Working knowledge of the PwC’s CES system in desirable. Knowledge of private equity structures and independence regulations (FRC, SEC, GIP, etc.) is also desirable, but a willingness to learn and adapt is essential.
  • A conscientious, ambitious team player with strong self-management skills and the ability to take initiative.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, changing regulatory environment and able to adapt to new challenges and priorities

What you’ll receive from us

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more

title: Financial Services, Tax Disputes Manager
description:
About the role:

We are seeking a Financial Services Tax Disputes Manager. Our Tax Disputes lawyers are integrated into PwC’s tax business. This enables the team to offer clients a fully integrated tax disputes offering, covering all stages of the dispute from initial enquiry and investigation to final resolution either by agreement or through the courts. Litigation is not a separate stage in the resolution process – It is part of that process. Clients come to us as we can also offer the tax technical depth of knowledge and the ability to flex how we resolve disputes; including recourse to other settlement mechanisms such as ADR or Treaty resolution as well as our recognised expertise in tax litigation.

What your days will look like:

  • Day to day management of ongoing matters as part of a wider team, from liaising with HMRC and the Tribunal to helping manage the PwC and client relationships as well as building relationships with new clients.

  • Producing written advice for the client and drafting responses to correspondence.

  • Instructing Counsel, including preparing Instructions to Counsel and Notes of Conference/Consultation

  • Drafting key documentation such as Directions, Notices of Appeal, witness statements

  • Presenting case law and technical updates to the FS tax practice and at client events

This role is for you if:

  • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • You have experience in Litigation.

  • You have previous experience with management of projects and case management.

  • You already have excellent technical skills.

  • You are able to demonstrate that you are able to work independently

  • You must possess a Legal Qualification (or an international equivalent) or have equivalent work experience. This includes international candidates who qualify through experience in their home country.

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

Merrill’s Financial Advisors and Wealth Management Client Associates help clients pursue the life they envision through a personal relationship with their advisory team committed to their needs. Merrill is committed to an in-office culture with specific requirements for office-based attendance and which allows for an appropriate level of flexibility for our teammates and businesses based on role-specific considerations. At Merrill, we empower you to bring your whole self to work. We value diversity in our thoughts, business, and within our employees and clients. Our Wealth Management team represents an array of different backgrounds and bring their unique perspectives, ideas and experiences, helping to create a work community that is culture driven, resilient, results focused and effective. As a Financial Solutions Advisor within the centralized segment of the Advisor Development Program, your journey begins by obtaining your Securities Industry licenses, where you receive dedicated and personalized classes for your Securities Industry Essentials [SIE], Series 7 and Series 66 Exams. Once you obtain your licenses, you will be taught the foundational skills needed to be an advisor – from acquiring, building and managing client relationships to considering a client’s complex financial picture and guiding them with advice and solutions to help them live their best financial lives, all while humanizing financial interactions. You will then join the centralized team as a Financial Solutions Advisor. FSA’s demonstrate knowledge of investments and financial markets and apply key principles appropriate to the individual client's investment needs. Additionally, they align Merrill and Bank of America products and services where appropriate. title: PhD Research Scholar positions - Department of Finance
description: About NHH NHH Norwegian School of Economics is one of the leading business schools in Europe. NHH is the first choice for students who want to study business administration in Norway. Our activities are characterised by high quality, strong ethical standards, and a collective drive for common goals. In close partnership with the business community and society, we generate and disseminate new knowledge and create value for a sustainable future. NHH is located in the city of Bergen and has around 3,750 students and 455 employees. The PhD specialisation NHH is pleased to announce openings in the PhD specialisation in Finance. Candidates admitted to the PhD programme will receive the title of PhD Research Scholar. The Department of Finance has 23 faculty members, two-thirds of whom are international. Research at the department spans all major fields of finance, including corporate finance, asset pricing and market microstructure. Faculty regularly publish in the top academic journals and are one of the leading finance groups in Europe. The department has an active research seminar series featuring invited top scholars and an internal brown bag seminar series. The PhD specialisation in Finance gives PhD research scholars the theoretical knowledge and methodological skills necessary to become successful researchers. It combines a one-year intensive course portfolio with ample time to do research and write a dissertation. PhD research scholars work closely with their thesis advisors and receive feedback by presenting their research in internal seminars. The department offers a stimulating research environment and encourages PhD research scholars to participate in its many research activities. We have a strong record of placing graduates in international academic institutions. Research and conference travels are strongly encouraged and funding for these purposes is usually available. The Department of Finance is well connected internationally and is a member of the Nordic Finance Network. Many of our PhD research scholars spend a semester or a year abroad visiting another university. The PhD specialisation in Finance, which has a total of 10 to 12 PhD research scholars, is an important integrated part of the department's research environment. See the department's website here: Department of Finance | NHH Start date: August 2027 The PhD programme The PhD programme at NHH is a four-year fully-funded programme, which combines an intensive course component with research and relevant work experience, preparing the school's graduates for scholarly positions at recognised international institutions and positions in knowledge-intensive institutions and firms outside of academia. Former PhD graduates have been hired by renowned institutions such as Harvard University, The University of Sydney's Business School, University of Amsterdam, Tilburg University, Hanken School of Economics, Norwegian universities and business schools, as well as by government, banking, finance and consulting industries. The PhD research scholars will be included in a highly stimulating and rewarding research environment, working closely with faculty members and other PhD research scholars at the school. PhD research scholars participate actively in faculty and research seminars, as well as in workshops. As part of the position, the PhD research scholars allocate 25% of their time to career promoting work such as teaching assistance. They also receive pedagogical training. The place of work is at NHH in Bergen, where the PhD research scholars will have their own office space at their department. The PhD programme gives preference to applicants who address research questions that align with the department's research interests and the available resources for supervision. As the school aspires gender balance and diversity, female applicants will be given preference if applicants are otherwise equally qualified. NHH offers annual salary of NOK 570 000 (equivalent to approximately EUR 50 741 or USD 58 121) pr. August 2027. For particularly well-qualified applicants, a higher salary may be considered. Thereafter annual adjustment of minimum 3%. The salary ensures a fair standard of living in Norway and is subject to Norwegian taxes and benefits, including public health care benefits and pension savings career guidance and an individual career development plan opportunity to take basic Norwegian language courses research funds for travels and funding for conference participation and research stays abroad to build a wider network and strengthen the research of the PhD research scholar The city of Bergen offers a mild coastal climate and hosts rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities, as well as a family-friendly environment. Note that public healthcare, public schooling for children, and most other public services are free in Norway. To explore Norway and the city of Bergen, go to visitnorway.com . Eligibility requirements Applicants must meet the eligibility requirements for the PhD programme. Applicants must normally have completed a five-year Master of Science (MSc) degree in Economics and Business Administration or a comparable degree. The average grade must normally correspond to a minimum of B (4.0) in the Norwegian grade system. The Department of Finance requires you to demonstrate both an adequate level of academic skills and an adequate level of English language proficiency (unless you are exempt). We accept the following tests: GMAT or GRE tests to measure your academic skills TOEFL, IELTS or PTE Academic to measure your English language proficiency When applying, you are required to upload a copy of your unofficial test scores in Jobbnorge before the deadline. If you are shortlisted, NHH will ask you to give us access to your official test scores without delay. Exemptions: You are waived from the GMAT or GRE tests if you hold a qualifying master's degree from a Nordic institution. You are waived from TOEFL, IELTS or PTE Academic tests if you are a native English speaker, if you have a qualifying master's degree from a Nordic institution or if you have a qualifying master's degree where the language of tuition was English. For more detailed information about the tests and their minimum scores, please visit our webpage: Admission to the PhD programme| NHH . If you have questions, you may contact phd@nhh.no . Application requirements You are required to upload the following documents with your application in Jobbnorge: Certificate of your master's degree or equivalent, including transcripts of records. You need to have completed your master's degree prior to the starting date for the position. If you have not completed your degree when applying for the position, please attach a transcript of records of the courses and grades that you have completed so far. Certificate of your bachelor's degree or equivalent, including transcripts of records. Other relevant certificates or transcripts (e.g. courses completed at the PhD level). If the issuing authority of grades and degrees does not use the ECTS grading scale, include an official description of the grading scale used. Statement of purpose describing your motivation for applying for this position (250-300 words). A research proposal (2000-4000 words). The research proposal should describe the aims, research questions, and motivation of the proposed research. Please note that your research proposal is tentative and often needs adjustments after your acceptance into the programme. Curriculum vitae. A list of all publications and/or other documented research activities. Please upload the documents in separate files, not combined in one single file. Letters of recommendation and contact details of references: Letters of recommendation and/or contact details of references may strengthen your application, but they are not mandatory. If you choose to include letters of recommendations, the references should send their letter of recommendation in PDF format to hr-phd@nhh.no by latest 15 September 2026. Contact details of references may be included in Jobbnorge when you apply. General information For more information on the PhD programme and the submission procedure, please consult the NHH PhD website . Incomplete applications will not be considered. Please note that applicants for the PhD research scholar position do not need to apply separately for admission to the PhD programme. NHH emphasises diversity and encourages qualified candidates to apply for the position regardless of gender, cultural background, age and disabilities. In accordance with §25 (2) of the Freedom of Information Act, information about applicants may be made public even if they have requested not to have their names entered on the list of applicants. Applicants will be notified if their request is not granted. As part of the recruitment process, a background check may be conducted with the candidates' consent. For questions and inquiries about the NHH PhD programme, please contact phd@nhh.no . Applications must be submitted through the Jobbnorge online portal. To open the application, please click 'Apply for this job'. For the English version, go to the menu at the top right side. Application deadline: 15 September 2026 PhD programme at NHH Let a PhD from NHH be your next career step!

Join PwC’s growing Valuations team within Capital Equipment (CE), where we help clients make informed decisions about their physical assets across the deal cycle and beyond. You will work with a diverse client base across sectors including Energy & Infrastructure, Industrials, Consumer and Private Equity, supporting them through transactions, financial reporting, insurance, asset-based lending and tax-related valuation needs. The role is not only about technical valuation delivery; it is about building trusted relationships, understanding client priorities, communicating complex matters clearly, and working collaboratively with specialists across PwC to deliver practical, insight-led advice.

This role offers the opportunity to accelerate your career through exposure to a wide range of clients, sectors and asset types, working on complex engagements across the UK and internationally. You will collaborate with global teams and cross-disciplinary specialists, developing your stakeholder management, project delivery, commercial judgement and client-facing skills. We also use data analytics tools and emerging technologies, including AI, to enhance how we work and deliver insights to clients. With increasing responsibility, client exposure and opportunities to contribute to business development, this role is well suited to individuals looking to further develop their careers in a dynamic and evolving valuations environment.

You will:

  • Deliver Capital Equipment valuation engagements (PPA, pre-deal, insurance, lending, tax), ensuring high-quality, timely outputs

  • Manage client relationships, including scoping, fee discussions and presenting conclusions

  • Manage multiple valuation engagements simultaneously, coordinating project plans, resources, budgets and stakeholder expectations to ensure timely and high-quality delivery.

  • Review complex valuation models and reports, applying robust challenge and judgement

  • Coordinate multi-disciplinary teams (Deals, Audit, Tax) to deliver integrated solutions

  • Develop and coach junior staff; drive quality and consistency across the team

  • Contribute to business development, including proposals, thought leadership and client networking

  • You have strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills

  • You have strong project management skills, with the ability to prioritise competing demands, manage stakeholders effectively, and deliver complex projects to deadlines.

  • You can operate in a fast-paced environment, handling multiple engagements simultaneously

  • You demonstrate commercial awareness and sound professional judgement

  • You take ownership of delivery and team development

  • You are motivated to build and grow our fixed assets valuation offering in a dynamic market

Essential requirements of the role:

  • Must possess a degree in Engineering (essential), ideally complemented by a professional qualification (e.g. ACA, CFA, MRICS) or equivalent work experience. This includes international candidates who qualify through experience in their home country

  • Demonstrable experience in capital equipment / fixed asset valuations

  • Strong Excel and modelling capability; experience reviewing complex models

  • Experience managing teams and client-facing delivery

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

description:
PwC Transaction Services – Manager (Financial Due Diligence)

At PwC we work on some of the most exciting and market-leading deals, and we pride ourselves on our inclusive culture, focus on wellbeing and commitment to development. You’ll have the opportunity to build a long-term career working with high-profile clients across a diverse range of transactions, supported by leading technology, advanced data tools, and innovative digital platforms.

Our Transaction Services practice supports private equity, investment funds and corporates throughout the deal cycle. You will work across a range of sectors, developing your commercial understanding, and gradually building deeper sector expertise as your career progresses.

About the role:

As a Manager in Financial Due Diligence, you will play a hands-on role in delivering high-quality financial and commercial analysis. You’ll work closely with teams to investigate business performance, support the preparation of diligence reports, and contribute insight that helps clients understand key drivers and risks in a transaction.

You’ll also develop your leadership capabilities by guiding day-to-day work, supporting team members, and building the confidence to take on larger areas of ownership over time. As your commercial awareness grows, you’ll increasingly contribute to client conversations and the development of opportunities across the practice. If you’re looking to build your career in deals and develop strong analytical and commercial skills within a supportive team, we’d be excited to hear from you.

What your days will look like:

  • Taking ownership and delivery of your financial due diligence areas.

  • Working with teams to analyse financial and non-financial information on buy-side and sell-side engagements.

  • Contributing to the preparation of clear, insightful financial due diligence reports.

  • Supporting interactions with senior management, business owners, and private equity investors.

  • Identifying trends, risks, deal breakers and value-creation opportunities.

  • Helping to coach and support junior team members in developing strong analytical and commercial skills.

  • Using data and analytics tools (Alteryx, PowerBI) to enhance insight and project delivery.

  • Building internal and external networks and contributing to the development of opportunities.

  • Demonstrating integrity and values-led leadership.

The role is for you if:

  • Hold ACA/ICAS (or equivalent international qualification).

  • Have strong financial due diligence and analysis skills and commercial awareness.

  • Have excellent report writing, data interpretation, and Excel skills.

  • Are experienced in managing teams and delegating effectively.

  • Can mentor and coach colleagues.

  • Hold strong verbal and written communication skills.

  • Can build trusted relationships with clients and internal teams.

  • Have a willingness to embrace data tools and new ways of working.

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Planning & Fulfillment Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to generate a detailed production schedule based on the production plan to maximize the use of resources and meet established production specifications and schedules. Each day, you will feed information on production capacity issues and material availability. You will also showcase your expertise by releasing manufacturing work orders.

The work model for the role is: #LI-onsite

This role is contributing to the Electrification Distribution Solutions in Pinetops, NC.


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Generating detailed production schedules to maximize the use of resources and meet production specifications and schedules.

  • Establishing the sequence and lead time of each operation to meet shipment dates in line with the master plan.

  • Monitoring performance, identifying root causes of any deviations and implementing relevant improvements.

  • Assisting Production Planners with clear communication of any production capacity issues, and details of material availability.

title: CryoPDP Business Development Associate
location: Huntington Beach, California, United States of America
description:
The ideal candidate needs to be based in California, United States. The salaried pay range for this position is $85,000-95,000 plus incentive potential.


CRYOPDP Business Development Associate (US-N)

Would you like to join the Logistics Company for the World? DHL Supply Chain is just that.

Become an essential part of everyday life, by contributing to an organization that is Connecting People and Improving Lives. If you have a passion for people, a desire to problem-solve, and eagerness to pursue continuous improvement opportunities… we look forward to exploring career possibilities with you!

Job Description

We are seeking a Business Development Associate to increase CRYOPDP’s client base in the United States and to develop and retain an existing business portfolio.


Responsibilities

  • Develops and generates new business leads through prospecting, cold-calling, and face-to-face meetings.
  • Contacts prospective accounts, provides technical and administrative product information, coordinates presentations, and supports proposal generation.
  • Qualifies sales opportunities using the CRYOPDP resource network.
  • Drives internal sales and customer relationship teams to collaborate for a cohesive, global solution.
  • Accelerates implementation of new business to ramp up revenues while ensuring customer commitment.
  • Sets and drives the program and project teams to ensure efficient, full implementation of the client agreement with a high return on investment in mind.
  • Presents new and existing client opportunities to the pricing team.
  • Defines and implements action plans with the customers when commitments are not in line with our agreements.
  • Prepares client-specific presentations and other data to respond to client needs.
  • Prioritizes business portfolio in meaningful segments to align resources by the US Business Development Director.
  • Analyzes relationships with key decision makers to understand their key business issues as well as assessing the competitive situation.
  • Develops a business plan for each client with proposed strategy, objectives, and value proposition with approval by the US Business Development Director.
  • Defines a plan for key decision makers and sets a schedule with key, relevant US CRYOPDP members.
  • Organizes review committees with customers to develop a mutual trust-based relationship with key decision-makers at different levels within the organization cross functionally.
  • Coordinates and contributes to any contract modification and ensures final validation according to the sales policy with the legal team.
  • Leads and controls the feasibility of the prepared offer and contracts.
  • Leverages DHL global network and infrastructure as a competitive differentiator when presenting to prospects.
  • Positions CRYOPDP's combined capabilities (cold chain expertise + DHL scale) against primary competitors.
  • Reports agreement conclusion to the organization and controls the implementation through appropriate procedures and planning.

title: Healthcare Analytics Director
location: Birmingham, West Midlands, United Kingdom · London, United Kingdom · Manchester, United Kingdom
description:
About the role

This is an exciting opportunity for you to join our growing team as a Director to lead on health analytics and modelling.

We work closely with a broad range of major NHS and other healthcare clients - developing and delivering a range of analytical and modelling solutions to NHS & private sector Providers, Commissioners, Systems, Regional and National teams.

Our work is varied and always evolving – from supporting high profile financial and performance turnaround projects to developing long term demand and capacity projections underpinning capital projects; from in-depth patient-level activity and clinical coding analysis to modelling population and system level scenarios and risks.

The demand for data analytics and modelling services is growing fast within the NHS and the wider healthcare sectors in the UK, driven in part by the planned reforms across the NHS. Data driven healthcare planning and delivery is a key growth driver for our health analytics team.

We are looking for an ambitious Director to join the health analytics leadership team and help drive this growth.

What your days will look like:

  • You’ll plan, manage and deliver a range of analytical and modelling solutions to NHS Trusts, Commissioners, Systems, Regional and National teams, leading the development and review of predictive and prescriptive analyses and models to support key financial, strategy and operational decisions, and overseeing workstreams within larger engagements, ensuring quality and alignment.
  • You’ll develop new relationships and manage existing ones with senior clients, taking a leading role understanding their strategic and day-to-day challenges and how analytics and modelling can help solve them, quickly building trust, planning and coordinating multiple concurrent workstreams, tackling difficult issues sensitively and bringing key findings to life for senior leaders.
  • You’ll leverage your existing networks to understand market need and drive the strategic direction for the team to successfully grow the business.
  • You’ll take a leading role in winning new work, shaping and drafting proposals, realistic budgets and efficient resource plans. You’ll be proactive in enhancing our existing propositions and will help identify and develop compelling new ways to solve our clients’ evolving challenges.
  • You’ll collaborate with senior PwC people from the wider healthcare advisory practice including operational, financial, governance and clinical specialists from across the firm to co-develop new propositions and go to market together.
  • You’ll support the growth of the wider health analytics team through targeted recruitment.
  • You’ll need to be agile, readily adapting your experience to lead teams in new areas, supporting them in embracing new tools including AI, navigating uncertainty and tight timelines to deliver pragmatic, robust analysis and well-evidenced, valuable insights.
  • You’ll take an active role in the development of others, guiding and supporting through on the job coaching, acting as a career coach or mentor, and through developing and delivering technical and broader health sector training.


This role is for you if:

You bring a strong understanding of, and experience in, applying data analytics and developing models in the health sector. You have extensive previous experience of leading engagements with a range of NHS clients with a focus on data analytics and modelling projects aligned to key strategic, financial and operational challenges faced by those clients.

V oblasti technologického poradenství u PwC nejde jen o to být součástí velké firmy; jde o to vidět, jak věci fungují v různých společnostech. Na koho se můžeš spolehnout?

  • Komunikace s obchodními analytiky, technickými experty a testovacími týmy

  • Vývoj a návrh procesů transformace dat z různých zdrojů

  • Vytváření nebo modifikace datových modelů

  • Implementace datových integrací

  • Optimalizace a automatizace procesů v datových platformách

  • Psaní a aktualizace technické dokumentace týkající se datových řešení a procesů

  • Ukončené vysokoškolské vzdělání

  • 1-3 roky zkušeností se zpracováním dat a automatizací procesů

  • Znalost databázových nástrojů, SQL, Python, GIT, a nástrojů na transformaci dat

  • Silné analytické myšlení, komunikační, prezentační schopnosti a chuť se učit nové věci

  • Zaměření na detail, přesnost a dochvilnost

  • Kariérní zkušenost z Big4

  • 30.000 benefitních bodů na sport, stravenky, do lékárny nebo na kulturní zážitky

  • Počítač a iPhone s neomezenými daty

  • Máme šest komunit, ve kterých se učíme o specifických tématech - Self-Mastery, Innovations and Start-up Development, Data Management, Digital Strategy, SAP, AI

Maintenance Production Technician

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support the Maintenance team. Each day, you will conduct activities according to agreed maintenance guidelines and procedures. You will also showcase your expertise by increasing the overall efficiency of the equipment and production line.

The work model for the role is: onsite at the Pinetops, NC facility.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Reporting all recurring problems with machinery and equipment.
  • Outlining problems with parts that can be identified and addressed for record-keeping.
  • Setting calibration and adjusting equipment, machinery, and instruments to comply with production specifications and instructions.

Qualifications for the role

  • 5+ years working in a manufacturing environment
  • Data Analysis & Reporting
  • Engineering & Manufacturing Processes

Working conditions

Manufacturing plant environment requires a combination of hands-on and technical tasks. Work may involve occasional lifting of materials, climbing stairs/ladders, and walking. Employees may be required to bend, twist, or stand for extended periods.

Frequent use of computers is necessary for data entry, monitoring, and communication. Employees will also handle a variety of tools and equipment, from hand tools to machinery, requiring technical skills and adherence to safety protocols.

Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), such as safety glasses, gloves, and steel-toed shoes, is required to ensure a safe working environment. Adhering to safety guidelines is essential for all team members.

The work environment requires physical endurance, technical proficiency, and a commitment to maintaining safety standards to contribute to a productive and rewarding workplace.

title: Financial Controller
description: Om oss Nova Health Group grundades 2024 med visionen att erbjuda Europas bästa utredning och behandling för personer med ADHD, autism och annan psykiatrisk problematik. Idag möter vi patienter genom varumärkena Nova Psykiatri och Karla Psykiatri, och fler bolag är på gång inom gruppen. Dagens psykiatri präglas av traditionella metoder och långsamma arbetssätt, där tekniken och patientens behov sällan står i fokus. Vi gör annorlunda: patienten i centrum och psykiatrisk vård med femstjärnig service. Vår strategi bygger på patientupplevelse, kvalitet och effektivitet, med modern teknik och innovativa arbetssätt. Teamet är kärnan i verksamheten och består främst av psykologer, läkare och sjuksköterskor. Vi är 70+ medarbetare och växer snabbt. Nu söker vi fler drivna personer som vill forma framtidens psykiatri med oss - och som trivs bättre här än någon annanstans. Om rollen Vi söker en Financial Controller som vill ta ett helhetsansvar för redovisning och rapportering på Nova – med stort fokus på AI och automatisering. Det här är inte en roll där du följer en checklista. Du förväntas utveckla rollen i takt med att vi snabbt expanderar. Du har koll på detaljerna, men lyfter blicken när något inte ser rätt ut. Du ifrågasätter, förbättrar och bygger strukturer som skalar i takt med att Nova växer i Sverige och andra marknader. Det finns goda möjligheter att växa i rollen och med bolaget. Rätt person tar successivt mer ansvar för ekonomiavdelningen som helhet och rollen utvecklas därefter. Du kommer bland annat att: Identifiera och driva processförbättringar – med AI och automation som naturliga verktyg Etablera och konsolidera bolag på nya marknader i Europa Ta helhetsansvar för löpande redovisning och säkerställa hög kvalitet i teamets arbete Producera månads-, kvartals- och årsbokslut Ansvara för revision och skatteberäkning Säkerställa att redovisningen följer gällande regelverk och K3 Ansvara för rapportering till Skatteverket och Bolagsverket Bygga skalbar infrastruktur för ekonomisk data och rapportering Vem du är Vi söker en prövad talang som drivs av att förbättra och automatisera. Du har konkret erfarenhet av att omstrukturera flöden, automatisera rapportering och frigöra manuell tid i en ekonomifunktion. Du tänker hur kan vi göra det här bättre? – och gör det sedan, snarare än att bara komma med förbättringsförslag. Eftergymnasial utbildning inom ekonomi, redovisning eller motsvarande Erfarenhet från en dynamisk och utmanande miljö, t.ex. consulting eller corporate finance Gärna erfarenhet från en scale-up som finansiell eller business controller Van att arbeta i webbaserade ERP-system som Fortnox eller Visma Erfarenhet av kvalificerat redovisningsarbete Har producerat årsredovisning och inkomstdeklaration enligt K3 God kunskap om svensk bolags- och skatterätt Avancerade kunskaper i Excel, inklusive VLOOKUP och pivottabeller Intresse och erfarenhet av AI-verktyg i arbetet – du har effektiviserat processer, automatiserat rapportering eller på annat sätt integrerat AI i ditt dagliga arbete och drivs av att göra ännu mer framöver God förståelse för och erfarenhet av att arbeta aktivt med data, gärna även utanför Excel Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska Erfarenhet av internationell redovisning och kännedom om IFRS är meriterande. Som person är du Nytänkande och tekniknyfiken – Du följer hur AI förändrar ekonomifunktionen och tar egna initiativ för att hitta smartare sätt att arbeta. Du är inte rädd för att testa nytt och delar gärna med dig av det du lär dig. Detaljskarp och pragmatisk – Du ser detaljerna som andra missar, men arbetar lösningsorienterat och framåtdrivet. Ansvarstagande och självgående – Du driver ditt arbete framåt, tar ägarskap för redovisningen och ser till att saker blir gjorda – i tid och på rätt sätt. Strukturerad – Du skapar ordning och tydlighet i processer och data och trivs med att ha kontroll över helheten. Analytisk – Du gillar att arbeta med data, vill förstå varför siffrorna ser ut som de gör och driver förbättringsområden proaktivt. Varför Nova Du får vara med på en resa där vi bygger Europas bästa bolag inom mental health – och faktiskt hjälper människor på riktigt. Stor frihet och eget ansvar, med så lite interna möten som möjligt Hybrid: möjlighet att arbeta delar av tiden hemifrån Konkurrenskraftig lön Goda möjligheter till rollutveckling i en dynamisk och snabbt växande miljö Tjänstepension Rekryteringsprocess CV-granskning – Vi granskar ansökningar löpande och bedömer erfarenhet, meriter och matchning mot rollen. Psykometriska test – Utvalda kandidater genomför ett digitalt test (ca 10 minuter) som komplement till intervjuerna för en strukturerad och objektiv bedömning. Videointervjuer – Kandidater som går vidare bjuds in till en eller två videointervjuer via Teams. Samtalen fokuserar på din erfarenhet, hur du tänker och vem du är som person. Slutintervju med case (på plats i Stockholm) – Det sista steget är en intervju på vårt kontor i Stockholm. Redo att bli en av oss? Drivs du av siffror, struktur och ständig förbättring – och använder redan AI för att ligga steget före? Då vill vi höra från dig. Vi rekryterar löpande, så sök idag och var med och forma ekonomifunktionen som tar Nova till nästa nivå!

title: Financial Services Customer-led Transformation Consultant - Manager
description:
Financial Services Customer-led Transformation Consultant - Manager

About the role

PwC’s Customer Financial Services Consulting Practice is passionate about our purpose which is to help our Financial Services clients to design and deliver impactful experiences for their customers and to create value for society.

Our team helps Financial services organisations build powerful, next-generation businesses using state-of-the-art digital technology to deliver compelling and innovative experiences to their customers. Our Financial Services Design practice is at the heart of our Customer Led Transformation offering, sitting at the intersection of business strategy, experience design, and digital technology.

We help our clients achieve sustainable growth by transforming and aligning their strategy, purpose and insight, their customer and employee experience, their operations, incentives and behaviours - all accelerated by the right technologies. We focus on transformation across all areas of our client’s businesses that interact with the customer/client including marketing, sales & distribution, service, client / broker relationship management, underwriting and pricing.

We are on the lookout for individuals who can help us design and deliver the future of digital banking and wealth for our clients.

You will work alongside a range of our strategic alliance partners (Engine by Starling, Salesforce, Guidewire, Microsoft and others), gaining exposure to the latest in financial services technology and will have the opportunity to contribute to market-transforming programmes around the world.

What your day will look like:

  • Build a detailed understanding of digital solutions and work closely with Partners and Directors to identify and convert sales opportunities

  • Develop sales materials with a deep understanding of digital banking, wealth platforms, insurance and client needs

  • Competitor analysis and market analysis to form a view of the appropriate digital solutions for target markets and clients

  • Design new go-to-market propositions, based on your knowledge of the capabilities of the latest financial services platforms (incl. banking, wealth and insurance)

  • Design target-state customer journeys / service blueprints and work with designers to bring-to-life the future experience

  • Take ownership of a key domain as a product owner (e.g. onboarding, payments, customer service, AML & Fraud, quote and buy, claims, renewals ) and work with clients to understand how they can adopt out-of-the-box capabilities from leading platforms (e.g. Engine by Starling)

This role is for you if:

  • You have worked in client-facing roles, in a consulting role, or at a technology company (ideally in Financial Services) Product owner during implementation, leading teams of business analysts, UX / UI designers and engineers to design and deliver new digital customer and colleague experiences

  • You have experience of rapidly identifying client problems and presenting solutions in a structured and informative manner and you are inquisitive and like the detail of understanding how something does and should work

  • You have a technical aptitude and curiosity and the ability to be self-motivated in a highly autonomous environment, in a collaborative team

  • You have strong presentation and facilitation skills and you have attention to detail

  • You can adapt your communication style to different stakeholders (senior clients, technology vendors, engineering functions) and you are comfortable dealing with ambiguity

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

description:
Jaký bude tvůj tým

Jsme tým zkušených účetních, kteří se specializují na účetnictví dceřiných společností velkých nadnárodních firem. Pomáháme klientům plnit požadavky české účetní a daňové legislativy, vedeme jejich účetnictví a sestavujeme zákonné účetní závěrky.
Často spolupracujeme přímo na straně klienta a denně komunikujeme v angličtině, takže u nás zažiješ skutečně mezinárodní prostředí.
Zároveň jsme nadšenci do automatizace, digitalizace a AI – chceme být o krok napřed a postupně eliminovat rutinní manuální práci.
Můžeš se těšit na přátelský a podporující tým, který sdílí know-how a pomáhá si navzájem.

Jaká bude tvoje role v týmu

  • Kompletní vedení účetní agendy klientů (měsíční reporting, roční účetní závěrky, DPH).

  • Řešení komplexních účetních případů a přímá komunikace s klienty.

  • Optimalizace procesů a spolupráce se stávajícími i novými klienty.

  • Nastavování převodových můstků mezi českými a zahraničními účetními pravidly.

  • Možnost zapojení do projektů přímo u klienta, často i netradičních.


Co by ti nemělo chybět

  • Min. 4 roky praxe v účetnictví a VŠ vzdělání.

  • Znalost podvojného účetnictví a českých účetních standardů (výhodou IFRS nebo US GAAP).

  • Plynulá čeština a angličtina (němčina je bonus).

  • Pokročilá práce s Excelem, analytické a logické myšlení.

  • Zkušenost s outsourcingem účetnictví výhodou.

  • Samostatnost, pečlivost, odolnost vůči stresu a týmovost.

  • Zájem o nové trendy v účetnictví, daních a technologiích.


Čím tě potěšíme my

  • Koncentrovanou zkušenost a rychlý kariérní růst. Může ti to znít jako fráze, ale tak to skutečně je.

  • Férovou mzdu a roční bonus odpovídající tvému výkonu.

  • Flexibilní pracovní doba a možnost občasné práce z domova.

  • Placené volno 30 dní, 3 Wellbeing days a 2 dny volna navíc od firmy na konci roku.

  • Špičkový Ultrabook a iPhone s neomezenými daty.

  • Benefit program s 45.000 body, který můžeš využít na dovolenou, vzdělávání, stravenky, sport, zdraví... Prostě na to, co tě baví.

  • Podporu Vašeho osobního i profesního rozvoje, včetně možnosti získat profesní kvalifikace jako RTA (Registered Tax Advisor) nebo ACCA a širokou nabídku soft skills školení.

  • Mimopracovní aktivity a Away Days (team building, ski weekend apod.).

  • Buddy systém a pravidelná zpětná vazba na tvoji práci, také konzultace s koučem, se kterým můžeš řešit svůj další rozvoj i kariérní směr.

PwC, to je největší auditní tým v České republice, ale i poradenské týmy, které se zaměřují na strategie, fúze & akvizice, restrukturalizace, finanční poradenství, daně, právo, technologie, data nebo forenzní analýzu. Zjisti, jak snadné je kombinovat tyto znalosti, když jsi na správném místě. Máme více než 364 000 kolegů ve 151 zemích. V PwC vytváříme inkluzivní pracovní prostředí, kde každý může být sám sebou a najde si své místo a příležitost k rozvoji. title: Fund Finance - Secondaries & Primaries Analyst | Germany
description: Role: The Analyst will be part of the Fund Finance Secondaries & Primaries team and will be responsible for the financial control, operational management, performance analysis, and investor reporting of investment vehicles, including Customized Solutions and Ardian commingled funds. The team is based across multiple offices in Europe and Canada and works closely together to ensure consistent financial control, reporting, and investor servicing across geographies. Ardian Customized Solutions provide investors with tailored portfolios in private market asset classes allowing a precise definition of their investment horizon and targets, as well as governance structure and service depth that fit their individual needs. Ardian commingled funds pool capital from multiple investors into diversified private market strategies, offering standardized fund structures with clearly defined investment objectives, governance frameworks, and reporting designed to serve a broad institutional investor base. Working closely with Front Office, Investor Relations, Treasury, Legal, Tax, Compliance, and external service providers, the Analyst will ensure the accuracy, consistency, and timeliness of financial information throughout the lifecycle of the funds and tailored investment solutions. Key responsibilities include: Oversee and control the accounting, financial statements, and quarterly reporting of private equity funds and tailored investment vehicles, in coordination with external administrators and fund accountants. Monitor, analyze, and report portfolio and investor performance, including quarterly valuations and key performance indicators (IRR, DPI, TVPI). Manage and control fund and SPV cash flows at both investor and portfolio levels, including capital calls, distributions, syndications, reallocations, and exits. Prepare and monitor debt-related activities (fund- and SPV-level), including covenants, reporting, interest calculations, repayments, and interactions with lenders. Support new deal set-ups and product launches by ensuring financial modeling consistency with legal documentation and integrating structures into internal systems. Prepare dashboards, cash flow projections, and ad-hoc analyses to support investment decisions, stress testing, and active portfolio management. Coordinate investor operations, including fee calculations, late interest, investor notices, and responses to investor queries, in collaboration with IR and onboarding teams. Contribute to investor, management, and governance reporting (e.g., valuation committees, advisory boards, client presentations). Act as a key point of contact for internal and external stakeholders (Front Office, IR, Legal, Tax, Treasury, Compliance, administrators, banks, auditors, regulators) in various jurisdictions. Ensure compliance with legal, regulatory, and governance frameworks (AIFMD, FCA, CSSF, SEC) and contribute to process improvements and transversal projects. Utilize and enhance internal systems and tools (e.g. eFront, reporting platforms) to improve data quality, controls, and operational efficiency. Profile: Master’s degree (or equivalent) in Finance, Accounting, Business, or related quantitative field. 0–3 years of relevant experience (asset management, audit, financial institutions, …); prior exposure to private equity is a strong plus. Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, multi-product, and international environment. Proactive, curious, and able to handle multiple priorities simultaneously. Fluent in German and English; French, Spanish or another foreign language is considered as a plus Required Skills: Strong knowledge of financial and accounting principles, with a solid analytical and numerical mindset Advanced Excel and MS Office skills; strong IT affinity (Business Objects experience a plus) Ability to prepare dashboards, analyses, and reports to support fund operations, performance monitoring, and decision-making Detail-oriented, well-organized, and able to manage multiple tasks efficiently in a fast-paced environment Effective communicator with strong interpersonal skills, able to interact confidently with internal stakeholders and external counterparties Proactive, results-driven, client-focused, and collaborative, delivering high-quality outputs in a multicultural setting

Vi tilbyder en rolle, der giver dig et bredt ledelsesrum og en central position i udviklingen af Fritid og Landdistrikt. Du får ansvar for et område med stor betydning for kommunens sammenhængskraft og livskvalitet – fra idrætsfaciliteter, folkeoplysning og foreningsliv til landdistriktsudvikling, borgerinddragelse og lokale partnerskaber. Rollen kombinerer strategisk indflydelse med et konkret ansvar for drift, økonomi, projekter og anlæg. Hos os i Aalborg Kommune bliver du en del af Klima, Kultur og Sundhed og et velfungerende, fortroligt ledelsesfællesskab af forvaltningschefer. Fritid og Landdistrikt er præget af høj faglighed, stærkt engagement og en tydelig vi-følelse. Organisationen rummer både administrative, udviklingsorienterede og driftsmæssige miljøer, og kulturen er kendetegnet ved kreativitet, samarbejde og lysten til at gøre en forskel. Du møder en organisation med mange idéer og stærke fagligheder, hvor der er behov for en nærværende og tydelig chef, der kan skabe fælles retning uden at svække engagementet. Som den nye fritids- og landdistriktschef refererer du til direktøren og får ledelsesmæssigt ansvar for fem afdelingsledere – fire med driftsansvar og én med fokus på projekter og udvikling. Du bliver en væsentlig brobygger mellem den politiske dagsorden, organisationens drift og de mange borgere, foreninger, frivillige og professionelle aktører, der er tæt knyttet til området. Dine centrale opgaver bliver at: Skabe et klart strategisk og økonomisk overblik over drift, projekter, puljer, anlæg og udviklingsindsatser. Prioritere en omfattende projektportefølje og sikre, at ressourcer, kapacitet og ambitionsniveau hænger sammen. Udvikle samarbejdet på tværs af Fritid og Landdistrikt, kommunens øvrige forvaltninger og eksterne aktører. Sikre tydelig ledelse, klar arbejdsdeling og systematisk opfølgning, så organisationen balancerer sikker drift med udvikling. Fra ambitioner til indsatser – og med fælles ledelse Stillingen er placeret i en organisation med både stærke muligheder og betydelig kompleksitet. De store faciliteter, herunder Aalborg Stadion, Gigantium, Haraldslund og Sofiendal, er for nylig samlet under fælles ledelse og skal fortsat konsolideres. Samtidig skal du være med til at styrke bosætning og lokal udvikling gennem blandt andet eksisterende pilotprojekter, arbejde med den kommende folkesundhedslov og videreudvikle Aalborgs position som idrætsby. Det kalder på en chef, der kan omsætte politiske ambitioner og mange interesser til realistiske, prioriterede indsatser med synlige resultater. Om dig Du har erfaring med at lede et bredt og komplekst område – gerne gennem ledelse af ledere – og trives med at skabe fremdrift i krydsfeltet mellem politiske mål, drift og udvikling. Du er relationelt stærk, men også tydelig i dine prioriteringer, og du har dømmekraften til at fastholde aftaler og økonomiske rammer, når interesserne er mange. Du kan formentlig genkende dig i følgende: Dokumenteret erfaring med økonomi-, ressource- og porteføljestyring Evne til at skabe fælles retning, klare roller og stærk opfølgning på tværs af enheder Erfaring med organisationsudvikling eller forandringsledelse og med at balancere udvikling med sikker drift Stærke samarbejds- og kommunikationsevner på tværs af politiske, administrative og lokale fora Interesse for og gerne kendskab til området Yderligere information For uddybende information om stillingen kan du række ud til Mercuri Urval via direktør og partner Jesper Lund på +45 4045 3435 eller konsulent Peter Debel Jacobsen på +45 5076 1200. Du er også velkommen til at kontakte direktør for Klima, Kultur og Sundhed Jesper Carlsen på +45 2520 1920. Ansøgningsfristen er den 18. september 2026 kl. 10:00. We hire critical thinkers. People who thrive in a collaborative culture like ours where we solve real problems while building the future of finance. You Are excited to be part of a vibrant engineering community that values diversity, hard work, and continuous learning. Love solving complex real-world business problems. Recognize that cross-functional collaboration is a core component of success for the team. Believe there are multiple ways to solve most technical problems and are willing to debate the trade-offs. Have become a stronger engineer by making mistakes and learning from them. Are a doer, someone who wants to grow their career and gain experience across technologies and business functions. We Continuously invest in a high-performance and inclusive culture, in which a diversity of backgrounds, experiences and viewpoints are celebrated and valued. Encourage career mobility, so you can benefit from learning different functions and technologies, and we gain the benefits of your experience across teams. Run technology pro bono programs that help the non-profit community and give our engineering community opportunities to volunteer and participate. Offer education reimbursements and ongoing training in technology, communication, and diversity & inclusion. Embrace knowledge sharing through lunch-and-learns, demos, and technical forums. Consider our people to be our greatest asset—we will help you learn what PIMCO Technology has to offer so you can participate in activities that benefit your career while delivering impactful technology solutions. JOB DESCRIPTION Our Trading and Risk technology estate is entering a multi-year period of structural change. We are modernising our infrastructure, moving core systems to the public cloud, and re-platforming the applications that produce the firm's positions, P&L and risk - all while those systems continue to run in full production every day. In parallel, we are replacing a core book-of-record accounting capability and re-wiring how Risk consumes that data. We are seeking a senior Program Manager to own delivery across these two interlocking programs: a hands-on, outcome-oriented leader who has run large cross-functional transformation in a trading and risk context, is comfortable at the intersection of infrastructure, application engineering and the business, and can pull disparate teams toward hard, time-boxed goals. Cloud Transition (Trading & Risk): The Program Manager will drive two tightly-coupled challenges as our applications move to the cloud. First, materially reducing our legacy on-premise database footprint - both hardware and, above all, the volume of stored data - by coordinating the application-team cleanup, rationalisation and data-tiering effort that infrastructure teams cannot deliver alone. Second, managing the performance implications of a hybrid operating model, where applications move to the cloud ahead of certain data stores: the PM will lead the program to get application teams to profile and optimise their data interactions so they remain performant through the transition, against a backdrop of continuous production use and no tolerance for service degradation. Book-of-Record Replacement & Risk Integration: Over a multi-year horizon the firm is replacing a core accounting book-of-record capability and standing up new position and accounting services, while retiring legacy tooling. The Program Manager will ensure our Risk systems integrate cleanly with the new platform and transition off the incumbent solutions as the source of intraday and end-of-day positions and P&L; coordinate against the provider's technology roadmap and its regulatory milestones; and manage the sequencing and reconciliation risk of running this replacement in parallel with related front- and middle-office tooling changes. A firmwide middle-office modernisation effort will be driving this forward; this role provides the delivery leadership from the Risk & Reporting side to keep the two in lockstep. title: Cybersecurity Consultant
location: Brno, Česká republika · Praha, Česká republika
description:
About the Team

Threat Management team consists of cybersecurity professionals focused on prevention of the cyberattacks via detection and responding to cyber threats. The key pillars consist of incident response, threat hunting, threat intelligence, security monitoring, vulnerability management, engineering and consulting services.

About your Manager

Lubomír has over 10 years of cyber security experience with different projects related to mainly cyber security managed services, building and operating Security Operation Centers (SOC), Threat Hunting & Intelligence and Vulnerability Management. Lubomír is also responsible for team leading, project management, designing of cyber security managed services, creation and development of training plans and is a proven coach to train other team members or client staff. Outside of work, he is involved in teaching, science, and research at the University of Hradec Králové, where he guarantees and teaches the course Surveillance Systems and Forensic Analysis.

Job Description & Summary

As a manager, you will lead the newly established TDR delivery team. Your primary responsibility is to ensure the team delivers high-quality technical services that significantly impact the client's security posture. You will be the main contact for clients, a mentor for Senior Associates, and a key player in developing service offerings and business development. However, you’re expected to still “get your hands dirty” – this isn’t a pure project manager role, but a technical delivery leader.

Delivery Leadership & Client Relationship (35% of Time)

  • Lead client engagements from scoping through delivery to closure.

  • Serve as the main point of contact for the client, communicating with security leadership and management.

  • Conduct workshops at executive and technical levels.

  • Manage scope, priorities, escalations, and client expectations.

  • Take ownership of the quality of deliverables (assessment reports, roadmaps, solution proposals).

  • Present outputs at the C-level/CISO level.

Technical Contribution (30% of Time)

  • Engage in hands-on work in at least two areas: SIEM (Splunk/Sentinel), Threat Hunting, Incident Response, Detection Engineering.

  • Conduct technical reviews of team outputs to ensure quality and consistency.

  • Provide architectural advice in detection & response areas (SIEM architecture, log management strategies, use case framework).

  • Actively monitor the threat landscape and its implications for clients.

  • Ability to jump into technical work when needed – you are not just a "people manager."

Business Development, Mentoring & Service Development (35% of Time)

  • Lead and mentor 2 Senior Associates in their technical and professional growth.

  • Actively support business development by identifying opportunities, presales presentations, and preparing proposals.

  • Define and develop service offerings - decide what we sell, how we deliver it, and how we scale it.

  • Collaborate with other practice areas (e.g., GRC, Cloud Security, Identity) on cross-sell opportunities.

  • Conduct labor estimation, pricing, and resource planning.

  • Build internal knowledge base, reusable assets, and delivery frameworks.

What This Role Is NOT:

⚠️ To avoid misunderstandings:

  • This is NOT purely a managerial role. We expect you to contribute technically 30% of the time.

  • This is NOT a pure project manager role. You need to understand content, not just the process.

  • This is NOT a strategic advisory role without delivery responsibility. You deliver, not just advise.

  • This is NOT a role with a large team of 10+ people. You lead a small, senior team – you need to be a "playing coach."

  • This is NOT a "slide factory." We do real work with real impact.

Requirements of the Role

  • 6–10+ years of experience in cybersecurity, including at least 2 years in consulting/professional services or a role with client responsibility.
