title: Cheføkonom og analysedirektør til Akademikerne (AC)
description: Kan du lede gennem komplekse problemer og drive kreative løsninger frem, som vinder dagsordenen både på den politiske scene og i forhandlingslokalerne? Så kan du være Akademikernes nye cheføkonom og analysedirektør. I Akademikerne har vi fart på i en verden under forandring. Vi skal vise akademikeres centrale position som Danmarks vigtigste råstof - også midt i en AI-revolution – skabe rammerne for de rigtige og bedste uddannelser og læring gennem hele livet samt tage ansvar for at udvikle forslag til tidssvarende arbejdsmarkedsinitiativer, bl.a. modernisering af pensionssystemet, knække stresskurven og se broen til det bedste arbejdsmarked med arbejdsliv, som både medarbejdere og ledere kan og ønsker at være i. Og så skal Akademikerne være med til at forme fremtiden for den danske model, hvor arbejdsmarkeds parter og fagbevægelsen forbliver den vigtigste aktør i udviklingen af vores arbejdsmarked. Alt sammen i tæt samarbejde med vores 27 medlemsorganisationer, som tilsammen organiserer mere end 525.000 medlemmer. Hvad ligger der på bordet? Du kommer til at drive og lede Akademikernes analyser, som vores politikudvikling står på, og som vores public affairs-indsatser bygges henover, ligesom du sammen med dit område står for at formilde fakta og viden videre til omverdenen og vores medlemsorganisationer via indlæg i medier, workshops mm. Du har også det overordnede ansvar for det teknisk/økonomiske fundament for Akademikerne under overenskomstforhandlingerne i den offentlige sektor, næste gang ved OK29, og for støttefunktion i den private sektor. Du er derfor del af bl.a. det Offentlige Lønstatistikudvalg og Danmarks Statistiks rådgivende udvalg for økonomisk statistik. Vi leder derfor efter en profil, der balancerer to vigtige egenskaber: Den tunge faglighed og garant for høj kvalitet: Du har en dyb forståelse for økonomisk tænkning og metodisk stringens. Du kan gennemskue komplekse økonomiske modeller og udfordre dine medarbejdere på det metodiske plan, ligesom du selv har mod på at sætte pen til papir med faglige indlæg eller udtale dig i medierne som Akademikernes cheføkonom. Den kreative nerve: Du ser mulighederne for forandringer og forbedringer for landets akademikere og kan sammen med dit område prioritere i temaerne, udarbejde analyserne og give dem liv. Samtidig skal du have en god fornemmelse af medlemsorganisationernes behov, og hvordan Akademikerne kan understøtte dem. Du vil referere til Akademikernes adm. direktør. Som analysedirektør har du direkte ledelse af 3 AC-medarbejdere og en student, og herudover vil du få faglig ledelse af projektledere på tværs af organisationen. I Akademikerne sættes samarbejdet på tværs og projektarbejde i højsædet frem for at have fokus på individuelle præstationer og siloer. Organisationen er langt med en bevægelse fra monofaglighed til tværfaglighed, som kræver stort ledelsesmæssigt fokus på godt arbejdsmiljø, klar arbejdstilrettelæggelse og prioritering af dialog og sparring med Akademikernes erfarne og meget kompetence medarbejderhold, ledelseskolleger og adm. direktør. En arbejdsplads i hjertet af København Stillingen skal besættes hurtigst muligt og gerne allerede 1. november 2026. Tests vil være en del af forløbet. Du tilbydes attraktive individuelle vilkår og høj grad af fleksibilitet, som vil afspejle dine faglige og ledelsesmæssige kvalifikationer og opgaveportefølje. Akademikerne har til huse i St. Kongensgade 40 H, 1264 København. Er du nysgerrig og vil gerne vide mere, så kontakt administrerende direktør Sofie Nilsson på 2249 5869. Ansøgning, CV og eksamensbeviser sendes til Akademikerne på mail : ac@ac.dk Mærket cheføkonom/analysedirektør. Behandling af persondata Information om Akademikernes behandling af personoplysninger ifbm ansøgninger til ledige stillinger finder du her https://www.akademikerne.dk/persondatapolitik/ Alle Akademikernes mailadresser kan modtage sikker mail. Om Akademikerne Akademikerne er hoved- og forhandlingsorganisation for 27 medlemsorganisationer, der repræsenterer mere end 525.000 akademikere i Danmark. Vi arbejder for et attraktivt akademisk arbejdsmarked og for at styrke Danmark som et konkurrencedygtigt videnssamfund. Som hovedorganisation varetager vi medlemsorganisationernes interesser i spørgsmål om blandt andet arbejdsmarked, uddannelse, forskning og erhvervspolitik og overenskomster.

description:
About the role:

Within London Audit, you'll have the opportunity to work across a diverse portfolio of clients, from owner managed businesses, private equity backed companies, through to large multinational and listed groups. You’ll gain in-depth knowledge into how businesses run, gain direct access to internal stakeholders and clients and work with an unrivalled range of organisations we audit. A rewarding career path awaits, join our team to develop yourself as a professional and benefit from the wide range of development opportunities available at PwC.

  • Building connections across teams and specialist areas within PwC to help bring insight to the organisations we audit. This includes managing a variety of views and consulting where appropriate;

This role is for you if:

  • Must possess a Chartered Accountant / ACA / ACCA / ICAS qualification (or an international equivalent) or have equivalent work experience. This includes international candidates who qualify through experience in their home country;

  • Experience of IFRS (essential) and UK GAAP (desired) and international standards on auditing (ISAs);

  • Strong project management skills and experience managing an audit from planning to completion including managing remote teams;

  • Confident in challenging yourself and others to complete high quality testing and documentation;

  • Takes pride in their work and in the Audit profession. Shows resilience and demonstrates dedication to self-development including being agile and innovative in the digital world.

What you'll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

title: Transfer Pricing Manager (Compliance and Transformation)
description: Job description Tax Manager - Transfer Pricing (Compliance and Transformation) Base Location : Birmingham or Manchester Why Join KPMG as a Transfer Pricing Manager? Transfer Pricing is a rapidly expanding field within International Tax, and at KPMG, we're at the forefront of this exciting growth area. Our dedicated Transfer Pricing team is committed to helping multinational groups navigate the complexities of global transfer pricing compliance, including the preparation of master files, local files, TP returns, and benchmarking. We leverage our market-leading technology, structured processes, and a team of dedicated UK based TP compliance specialists to deliver exceptional results. This is a unique opportunity to join a high-growth area within our business and contribute to a key strategic investment in our people. We are looking for talented Managers to join our UK TP Compliance practice. If you're passionate about Transfer Pricing and eager to join our specialist compliance team, we encourage you to explore this exciting career path with KPMG. What will you be doing? This role involves working on a range of projects. The work involves: · Lead global transfer pricing compliance projects where we prepare transfer pricing local files, master files and TP returns for clients across multiple jurisdictions. This role involves leading on a range of compliance projects across a varied client base in both size of business and industry. · Developing and maintaining client relationships for global transfer pricing compliance projects · Project management in relation to the provision of our services · Performing/attending functional interviews with clients to understand activities and value drivers for our clients’ businesses to prepare transfer pricing analyses · Determining key industry features across varied industries that influence the pricing of transactions and preparing transfer pricing analyses · Prepare/review benchmarking analyses across industries and transaction types (TNMM and CUP) · Reviewing and documenting transfer pricing policies · Understand and implement KPMG’s transfer pricing technology for preparation of local files · Review transfer pricing local files using KPMG’s transfer pricing technology · Supporting clients with tax authority enquiries · Coordinating with KPMG’s transfer pricing, international tax, indirect tax and other teams across the business and across multiple jurisdictions on a range of topics relating to transfer pricing compliance · Coaching and developing junior members of the team · As part of the TP Compliance team actively contribute to leadership discussions and help to implement continuous improvement to processes within the team. · Lead or assist with business development and project scoping process as necessary for new global transfer pricing documentation proposals including preparing scope and fee quotes and presenting in client pitches/demos. What will you need to do it? We are looking for candidates with the following skills/experience: Qualifications and experience: · Either a CTA, CA, ACA, ACCA qualification or attained a Bachelors or Masters degree in economics, finance, law, accounting or equivalent qualification. · At least 5 years of transfer pricing experience, preferably including experience of preparing and reviewing transfer pricing documentation and local files, conducting/participating in functional interviews, preparing/reviewing functional analyses, preparing and reviewing benchmarking, supporting with tax authority enquiries, project. Skills: · Strong project management/co-ordination skills and experience (e.g. on global transfer compliance outsourcing engagements, tax/accounting outsourcing programmes or similar projects); · Experience in process design and implementation · Experience in transition, change management and stakeholder management; · Sound judgement, including the ability to identify and evaluate risk issues and know when to involve others · High level of analytical skills and a commercial approach to resolving issues and providing advice · High level of drive and enthusiasm with a positive attitude · Good commercial awareness and a desire to develop a technical specialism · Ability and willingness to keep up to date technically with global transfer pricing compliance obligations · An appreciation of and/or understanding of ethical/risk issues within a client service environment · Strong people skills for engaging with our clients and team members

title: Forklift Operator
location: Wichita, Kansas, United States of America
description:
DHL Supply Chain is Hiring! At DHL, you will play a part in one of the world’s most essential industries. There has never been a better time to join DHL Supply Chain. In a global business like ours, the opportunities are endless. So, join us. Work with us. Grow with us.

The core responsibilities of this role include: -The position is a combination of equipment operator (30-90% depending on production peak times) but will also require the employee to perform material handling and loading/unloading duties.

Position: Forklift Operator
Shift: 3rd shift
Pay: $19.50 per hour plus $1 shift diff.

In addition to the general job description below, the ideal candidate will also possess the following skills and/or experience:

-A minimum of 6 month’s experience operating stand-up material handling equipment is required. This position requires safe and efficient operation of a stand-up Dock Stocker and Reach Truck, and first preference will be given to applicants with this experience. Experience operating other material handling equipment such as Order (Cherry) Picker, Sit-down, Clamp, Electric Pallet Jack is also a plus.

Be part of the world’s largest logistics company!DHL Supply Chain hasbeen certified as a Great Place to Work® in the US and Canada! Our excellent benefits packages includes:
- Affordable medical, dental, and vision coverage available beginning on your 30thday
- PTO program for all associates, including paid holidays and vacation
- 401(k) with generous company match
- Tuition reimbursement program
- Excellent training and career advancement opportunities

Grow your skills. Shape your world.


Role Purpose:

What will you do in this role? Our Forklift Operators are responsible for moving stock from one area to another within our warehouse environment. You’ll load and unload shipments of various sizes, and you may use certain types of equipment such as stand-up, sit-down, or clamp forklifts and electric pallet jacks.Our environment is team oriented, fast paced and safety focused. We move products that people need and want. At DHL, YOU will be an essential part of everyday life.

Key Accountabilities:

  • Load, unload, move, stock, and stage products and materials using various types of forklifts or other power equipment 80% of specified shift.
  • Pull and prepare product for shipment ensuring the exact number and types of product is loaded.
  • Keep appropriate records and reports for inventory accuracy.
  • Comply with all OSHA and MSDS standards.
  • Verify load accuracy; check the load count, stability, and product damage, report variances as necessary.
  • Change equipment battery or LP tank and monitor power source as necessary.
  • Maintain the facility’s equipment and materials in a neat, clean, and orderly fashion.
  • Assist in physical inventories.
  • Complete daily inspection of equipment.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Education and Experience:

  • Forklift operator certificate or satisfactory completion of a forklift-training program within the first 30 days of employment
  • High School Diploma or Equivalent, preferred
  • Six months warehouse experience, preferred
  • Six months forklift operation experience

Our Organization is an equal opportunity employer.

description: Amring AB söker en CFO / Ekonomichef En nyckelroll i ett entreprenörsdrivet bolag med internationell förankring Vill du ta ett helhetsansvar för ekonomifunktionen i ett bolag som präglas av entreprenörskap, stark framåtanda och korta beslutsvägar? När vår nuvarande CFO nu går i pension söker vi en affärsorienterad CFO som vill leda och vidareutveckla vår ekonomifunktion. Du får en central roll i bolaget och blir en viktig partner till VD, ledningsgruppen och verksamheten. Amring i Sverige omsätter drygt 1 miljard och har 90 anställda. Om rollen som CFO Amring ingår i Global Automotive Group, en av Europas största däckdistributörer, men vår vardag präglas av det mindre bolagets närhet, engagemang och handlingskraft. Här är beslutsvägarna korta, tempot högt och möjligheterna att påverka stora. I rollen som CFO ansvarar du för att leda, utveckla och kvalitetssäkra bolagets ekonomiarbete. Tillsammans med ditt ekonomiteam på två engagerade medarbetare säkerställer du att redovisning, rapportering, analys och ekonomiska processer håller hög kvalitet och stödjer verksamhetens utveckling. Rollen kombinerar ett strategiskt helhetsperspektiv samtidigt som du deltar i ekonomifunktionens dagliga arbete vad gäller månadsrapportering, bokslut m.m.Som medlem i ledningsgruppen bidrar du med analyser, beslutsunderlag och affärsmässiga perspektiv i frågor som rör lönsamhet, ekonomisk styrning och bolagets fortsatta utveckling. Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden Leda och aktivt delta i ekonomifunktionens dagliga arbete. Ansvara för månadsrapportering, bokslut och finansiell uppföljning till den svenska ledningen och vår nederländska moderorganisation. Analysera resultat samt identifiera trender, avvikelser, risker och förbättringsmöjligheter. Leda arbetet med budget, prognoser och kassaflödesanalyser. Samordna interna och externa revisioner samt ansvara för kontakten med revisorer. Samarbeta nära övriga funktioner för att säkerställa tillförlitliga beslutsunderlag och ett verksamhetsnära ekonomiarbete. Ansvara för ekonomifunktionens medverkan i övergången till ett nytt ERP-system. Administration av årsstämma och årsredovisning . Vem är du? Du är en trygg, erfaren och affärsorienterad ekonom som trivs i en entreprenörsdriven miljö där initiativ uppskattas och beslut snabbt omsätts i handling. Du har förmågan att kombinera struktur, noggrannhet och god kontroll med flexibilitet och förståelse för verksamhetens behov. Du ser helheten, är nyfiken på affären och bidrar med tydliga analyser som hjälper organisationen att fatta välgrundade beslut. Som person är du prestigelös, handlingskraftig och lösningsorienterad. Du uppskattar ett nära samarbete med verksamheten och motiveras av att bidra där det behövs. Som ledare skapar du engagemang och tydlighet och ger ditt team förutsättningar att utvecklas. Vi tror att du har Högskole- eller universitetsutbildning inom ekonomi, redovisning, finans eller motsvarande. Minst fem års erfarenhet från liknande befattning med personalansvar Gedigen erfarenhet av finansiell rapportering, budgetering, prognosarbete, ekonomisk analys och revision. God kunskap om svenska redovisningsregler och internationella redovisningsstandarder. Erfarenhet av ERP-system och integrerade affärssystem. Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift. Meriterande: Erfarenhet av Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations och Oracle Fusion. Erfarenhet från en internationell koncern. Vi erbjuder Hos oss får du en central roll i ett bolag med stark framåtanda, korta beslutsvägar och en kultur där engagemang, ansvarstagande och initiativ gör skillnad. Du blir en viktig del av den svenska ledningsgruppen och får möjlighet att påverka både ekonomifunktionens utveckling och bolagets fortsatta affärsmässiga resa. Samtidigt erbjuder koncerntillhörigheten ett internationellt sammanhang och samarbete över landsgränserna. Tjänsten är på heltid med placering i Göteborg . Vill du vara med och utveckla vår verksamhet? Välkommen med din ansökan via ansökningsknappen, vi kan ej hantera ansökningar via mail på grund av GDPR. Vi tillämpar löpande urval, så vänta inte med att höra av dig. Har du några frågor kring tjänsten kontaktar du vår HR ansvarig Anna-Carin Lindberg på 070-090687, ac.lindberg@amring.se. Om oss Amring grundades 1952 i Göteborg, vilket gör Amring till ett historiskt däckgrossistföretag med över 70 år i branschen. 2018 förvärvades Amring av Europas största däckdistributör Van den Ban tillsammans med den svenska däckgrossisten Europadäck. Van den Ban Group ingår i Global Automotive koncernen som är en ledande aktör inom europeisk däck- och hjuldistribution, med en koncernomsättning på drygt 1 miljard euro per år och med en stark ambition att växa ytterligare på den europiska marknaden. Bolagen inom koncernen är verksamma inom olika delar av fordonsförsörjningskedjan såsom internationell grossisthandel, regional distribution, tillverkning, detaljhandel och tjänster .

title: Privatrådgivare
description:
Swedbank arbetar för att skapa en trygg och hållbar ekonomi för våra kunder. Med hög tillgänglighet, stort engagemang och affärsfokus kan du vara med att forma fram framtidens kundmöten. Tillsammans med kollegor skapar vi en attraktiv och positiv arbetsplats.

Hos oss på Swedbank har du en möjlighet att:

  • Bidra som en central del i ett engagerat team där vi tillsammans arbetar för att skapa långsiktiga kundrelationer genom rådgivning, försäljning och engagemang i kundens ekonomi

  • Säkerställa att varje kundmöte, oavsett kanal, håller hög kvalitet och är behovsbaserat – med målet att skapa värde, förtroende och en positiv kundupplevelse i varje kontakt

  • Samarbeta nära kollegor och specialister för att hitta de bästa lösningarna för kunden, driva försäljning på ett ansvarsfullt sätt samt aktivt bidra till kontorets gemensamma mål och framgång

I denna roll behöver du: 

  • Swedsec-rådgivarlicens, Bolånelicens och IDD (försäkringsdistributionsrätt) som grund för att kunna ge kvalificerad rådgivning och säkerställa hög regelefterlevnad

  • Driv och affärsfokus med förmåga att identifiera kunders behov och omvandla dem till hållbara finansiella lösningar – oavsett om mötet sker fysiskt, digitalt eller via telefon

  • Erfarenhet av att genomföra både fysiska och digitala rådgivningsmöten där du skapar förtroende, lyssnar in kundens situation och vägleder till rätt beslut

  • En stark laganda där du aktivt bidrar till teamets gemensamma mål, delar med dig av kunskap och stöttar kollegor i vardagen

  • Ett lyhört, pedagogiskt och relationsskapande arbetssätt som bygger förtroende och trygghet i alla kundkontakter

  • En genuin vilja att kontinuerligt utvecklas, hålla dig uppdaterad om bankens produkter, marknadstrender och rådgivningsmetoder för att alltid kunna ge bästa möjliga kundvärde

Hos oss kan du uppleva:

  • Personlig och professionell utveckling genom självledarskap och kontinuerlig utveckling.

  • Meningsfullt arbete som positivt påverkar vår arbetsplats, våra kunder och samhället.

  • En öppen och samarbetsinriktad kultur som uppmuntrar tvärfunktionellt teamarbete och erbjuder nätverksmöjligheter.

  • En stöttande och inkluderande miljö som främjar en balanserad och hållbar arbetslivssituation, med flexibla arbetsförhållanden när det passar rollen.

Inled din utvecklingsresa inom våra kundmötande tjänster. Du får jobba i direkt kundkontakt och hjälpa människor nå lösningar på sina ärenden. Du är Swedbanks ansikte utåt och en oerhört viktig del av vår verksamhet. Vi tror att du kan vara dig själv och samtidigt utvecklas till en framgångsrik kundrådgivare. location: Berlin, DEU · Düsseldorf, DEU · Frankfurt a. M., DEU · Hamburg, DEU · München, DEU
description:
Für unseren Geschäftsbereich Risk & Regulatory suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als Praktikant Anti-Financial Crime Compliance (w/m/d).

Das erwartet dich

Spannende Themen – Du erhältst interessante Einblicke in den vielseitigen Bereich Anti-Financial Crime. Du unterstützt unsere namhaften Mandanten bei der Verhinderung von Geldwäsche/Terrorismusfinanzierung und der Abwehr sonstiger strafbarer Handlungen in abwechslungsreichen Beratungs- und Prüfungsprojekten. Du hilfst bei der Analyse und Umsetzung der gesetzlichen Pflichten und Anforderungen, beispielsweise auf europäischer Ebene.

Teamarbeit – Du wirst direkt in die Mandats- und Projektarbeit eingebunden und unterstützt deine erfahrenen Teamkolleg:innen bei allen Themen zur Geldwäsche- und Betrugsprävention.

Umfassende Einblicke – Bei uns lernst du die Vielfalt der Beratung und Prüfung nationaler und internationaler Finanzdienstleistungsunternehmen, insbesondere Banken und Versicherungen, kennen.

Keep in Touch – Als Praktikant:in oder Werkstudent:in profitierst du neben spannenden Aufgaben zudem von Angeboten aus unserem Praktikant:innenprogramm KIT (Keep in Touch).

Das bringst du mit

  • Du studierst mindestens im dritten Semester Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Rechtswissenschaften beziehungsweise eine vergleichbare Fachrichtung oder befindest dich in einem Gap Year zwischen Bachelor und Master.
  • Spaß an der Arbeit in wechselnden Teams und bei unterschiedlichen Mandanten zeichnet dich aus.
  • Analytische Fähigkeiten, ganzheitliches und prozessuales Denken, Kommunikationsstärke und Eigeninitiative zählen zu deinen Stärken.
  • Du möchtest unser Compliance Team sowie unsere Mandanten in der digitalen Transformation unterstützen.
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie gute MS Office-Kenntnisse runden dein Profil ab.
  • Du möchtest uns in deinem Praktikum über einen Zeitraum von mindestens 3 Monaten unterstützen.

Deine Benefits

Kultur – Wir möchten, dass du dich bei uns wohl fühlst. Deshalb pflegen wir eine offene und moderne Unternehmens- sowie Führungskultur, in der wir geleistete Arbeit gemeinsam anerkennen und feiern.

What sets you apart is that you enjoy working in changing teams and with different clients. Analytical skills, holistic and procedural thinking, strong communication skills and initiative are among your strengths. You would like to support our compliance team and our clients in digital transformation. Very good written and spoken German and English skills as well as good MS Office skills round off

As part of the team, you will support the full journey — from preparation, coordination and creative development to market execution and performance review This means you can clearly see the results of your work in the market, learn from what works and what does not, and build practical marketing experience through close collaboration with local, regional and global teams. Impact You’ll Own Support the marketing agenda for the combustible products portfolio in the Czech Republic, covering product launches, product discontinuations, limited editions, packaging and product updates, communication materials and engagement activities for adult smokers, always within the applicable legal and regulatory framework. Support the development and execution of brand communication across multiple channels by adapting global and regional materials for local market needs or by helping create local solutions where global materials are not available. Coordinate day-to-day tasks across brand and portfolio projects, working closely with local, regional and central support teams to help ensure smooth and timely market execution. What You’ll Do Support the combustible products portfolio by preparing inputs, tracking project progress, coordinating materials, following up on agreed actions and helping maintain portfolio-related information. Coordinate the development and delivery of point-of-sale and trade communication materials, including key visuals, leaflets, brochures, retailer materials, trade presentations, price communication materials, product dummies and other printed or digital assets. Work with agencies and internal teams to prepare, review and update marketing materials in line with brand guidelines, project briefs and approval requirements. Support communication and engagement materials for adult smokers and retail partners, including digital trade engagement content and, where relevant, digital consumer-facing solutions, in line with legal requirements and company standards. Help coordinate online and offline market communication to ensure that materials are delivered on time, in the right scope and with consistent execution across channels. Prepare market, competitor and performance inputs to support business discussions, project decisions and performance review. Cooperate with global, regional and local stakeholders, agencies and demand planning teams to support timely delivery of products, campaigns, marketing assets and portfolio updates. Support marketing budget administration for assigned projects, including purchase order creation, forecast updates and invoice follow-up. Skills & Capabilities A motivated marketing professional who wants to build hands-on experience in brand communication, retail execution, consumer engagement and portfolio management. Someone who is structured, reliable and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage several tasks at the same time, coordinate stakeholders and agencies, and keep delivery on track. A candidate with curiosity, good communication skills and willingness to learn how marketing projects are developed and delivered in a complex business environment. A collaborative team player with ownership, accountability and openness to feedback, able to follow through on tasks and contribute to a culture built on trust, inclusion and shared success. Basic understanding of brand communication, retail execution, consumer engagement or fast-moving consumer goods is an advantage. Good English is required, as the role involves cooperation with international teams and work with global or regional materials. description: Du denkst nicht in Problemen, sondern gehst lösungsorientiert jede neue Herausforderung an? Dann kannst Du Dich hier einbringen: Als (Senior) Consultant (m/w/d) Treasury Accounting & Commodity / Energy Trading bist Du vom ersten Tag an in der fachlichen Beratung und Prüfung von Industrieunternehmen, Handelskonzernen und Energieversorgern aktiv. Du betreust eine Vielzahl unserer Mandant:innen gesamtheitlich vom Risikomanagement in Bezug auf Zins-, Währungs- und Rohstoffpreisrisiken, über die Risikoidentifikation, Risikomodellierung und Risikosteuerung bis hin zur optimalen bilanziellen Abbildung nach IFRS und HGB. Du analysierst originäre und derivative Finanzinstrumente sowie Verträge im Rohstoff- und Energiemanagement im Hinblick auf ihre bilanzielle Abbildung nach IFRS und HGB. Hierbei kannst Du unter anderem lernen, wie durch den Energiewandel induzierte Instrumententypen (bspw. Power Purchase Agreements) in der Industrie Einzug nehmen. Des Weiteren berätst Du aufstrebende Unternehmen im Rahmen von IPO's bei der Umstellung auf die Vorgaben der internationalen Rechnungslegung sowie der Ausgestaltung von anteilsbasierten Vergütungsprogrammen. Du erbringst Strategie- und Fachberatung im Hinblick auf die prozessuale und methodische Aufbau- und Ablauforganisation im Treasury sowie die Neuausrichtung des Energie- und Rohstoffhandels, insbesondere im Hinblick auf erneuerbare Energien und ESG-relevante Aspekte. Darüber hinaus hast Du die Möglichkeit, in die finanzmathematische Bewertung von Derivaten, Finanzierungen und anteilsbasierten Vergütungsformen sowohl aus Sicht eines Beraters, als auch aus der Sicht eines Prüfers einzusteigen. Zudem wirkst Du bei der Ausgestaltung von spezifischen ESG-Komponenten in der Welt der Finanzinstrumente mit.
description_en: Do you not think in terms of problems, but rather approach each new challenge in a solution-oriented manner? Then you can get involved here: As a (Senior) Consultant (m/f/d) Treasury Accounting & Commodity / Energy Trading, you will be active in providing technical advice and auditing to industrial companies, trading groups and energy suppliers from day one. You provide comprehensive support to a large number of our clients, from risk management in relation to interest rate, currency and raw material price risks, to risk identification, risk modeling and risk control, to optimal accounting in accordance with IFRS and HGB. You analyze original and derivative financial instruments as well as contracts in raw materials and energy management with regard to their accounting in accordance with IFRS and HGB. Among other things, you can learn how types of instruments induced by the energy transition (e.g. power purchase agreements) are finding their way into industry. You also advise aspiring companies in the context of IPOs on the transition to international accounting requirements and the design of share-based compensation programs. You provide strategic and specialist advice with regard to the procedural and methodological structure and workflow organization in treasury as well as the realignment of energy and raw materials trading, especially with regard to renewable energies and ESG-relevant aspects. In addition, you have the opportunity to get involved in the financial mathematical valuation of derivatives, financing and share-based forms of remuneration from both the perspective of a consultant and an auditor. You will also be involved in the design of specific ESG components in the world of financial instruments.

description: Manager, Deal Finance & M&A Location: Cambridge UK Introduction to the Role: AstraZeneca continues to pursue value-enhancing transactions that supplement its product portfolio and development pipeline, and to deliver maximum value from existing assets through the partnerships, collaborations, out- licences and divestments that create value and share risk. AstraZeneca Business Development is a globally integrated organisation with world-class capabilities in strategic planning, search & evaluation, transaction execution and alliance & integration management. It is varied, fast-moving work that offers an unrivalled opportunity to ‘make a difference ’. Within it, Deal Finance leads the financial aspects of Business Development and M&A — valuation, financial analysis and deal structuring — and provides dedicated support in the negotiation and execution of transactions globally. As a valued member of Deal Finance, the Manager provides dedicated financial support in evaluating and executing M&A, licensing, spin-out, collaboration and other structured transactions, working closely with senior Deal Finance colleagues. It is an ideal move for someone with a keen interest in the pharmaceutical industry who thrives in a fast-paced environment — whether taking their first step into industry or broadening their finance business-partnering skills — and who is genuinely excited about using AI to work smarter. Deal Finance is reimagining valuation and deal analysis for the AI era. You’ll use generative AI and automation to accelerate research, due diligence and modelling — freeing you to focus on judgment, insight and the relationships that close great deals. Here, technical skill and sharp commercial judgment are amplified by AI. Main responsibilities Support the construction of business cases, ensuring that all key issues, sensitivities and risks are evaluated and accurately reflected. Build accurate valuation and transaction models, using automation and AI-assisted tooling, that reflect the expected financial statement implications of potential transactions. Use generative AI and advanced analytics to accelerate industry research and company and product analysis, drawing insight from large, unstructured datasets. Provide input into deal structuring, supporting the assessment of transaction value and financial terms, including review of contracts and term sheets for their financial implications. Support financial due diligence, coordinating with AZ tax, accounting and treasury experts as required . Present findings, alongside a senior Deal Finance colleague, to AZ senior management and other internal decision-making bodies, and support the preparation of financial sections of papers and briefings. Work across multiple deals at different stages of the deal cycle, using excellent time management and prioritisation. Help embed AI and automation within Deal Finance, sharing what works and building reusable tools and templates. Essential requirements A strong academic and professional foundation — degree from a leading university, plus ideally a relevant quantitative or financial qualification (ACA, CFA, MBA or equivalent), or working towards one . Financial fundamentals — a solid understanding of cash vs. profit and of value-based cashflow metrics, plus a working knowledge of relevant technical accounting principles. Financial analysis and modelling — strong financial analysis, valuation and financial-modelling skills (particularly MS Excel), with confident, clear storytelling. Data analysis — the ability to collate, clean and analyse large datasets to surface the key drivers of value and risk . AI curiosity — comfort adopting new technology using AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, research and modelling, paired with the judgment to challenge and validate their output. A compelling communicator — able to convey financial recommendations to both financial and non-financial audiences in a concise, collaborative and impactful way. An advisory and team-oriented mindset - you take ownership of workstreams, mentor junior team members, foster innovative thinking, and contribute to a culture of excellence. Comfort working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, both independently and as part of cross-functional, international teams. Fluent English (written and spoken) is required; German, French, or any additional language is a strong plus. A commitment to expanding our global business network and leveraging your personal and professional relationships to create opportunities and deepen client trust.   • Transaction tax advice on deals

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

title: Consultant - Technology Consulting - Financial Sector
description:
Jaký bude tvůj tým

V oblasti technologického poradenství u PwC nejde jen o to být součástí velké firmy; jde o to vidět, jak věci fungují v různých společnostech. Obvykle jsme přímo v centru dění, pracujeme v projektových týmech, které zajišťují vše od návrhu po dodání skvělých, špičkových řešení v oblasti byznysu a technologií nejen v České republice. Neustále rozvíjíme své dovednosti, nejen prostřednictvím projektů pro klienty, ale také díky jiným zajímavým aktivitám. Máme šest úžasných komunit, kde se věnujeme tématům jako jsou New Technologies, Digital Strategies, Business Intelligence, Self Mastery, SAP, Agile, ESG.

Na koho se můžeš spolehnout

Irina Stoianova je manažerka v týmu Technology Consulting se zaměřením na post merge integrace, business operations a strategii finančních institucí. Na projektech funguje jako projektový manažer a business analytik, klientům vytváří a napočítává business cases a je také zodpovědná za jejich realizaci v implementační fázi, čímž pomáhá klientům dosahovat úspor a provozní efektivity. Irinu před práci nebo po ní můžete potkat ve fitku nebo v bazénu. Volno ráda tráví ve společnosti svých přátel nebo doma u knížky se svými dvěma kočkami.

O čem bude tvoje role

Jako konzultant budeš klíčovým hráčem v projektech pro klienty, budeš brainstormovat a implementovat tyto inovativní řešení v oblasti byznysu a technologií po celé České republice a Evropě pro klienty z finančního sektoru.

  • Budeš se přímo podílet na projektech pro naše klienty

  • Ponoříš se do analýzy a mapování podnikových potřeb

  • Pomůžeš s návrhem a realizací řešení

  • Budeš prezentovat implementovaná řešení zákazníkům

  • Budovat a řídit vztahy s klienty každý den

Co by ti nemělo chybět

  • Máš vysokoškolský titul? Skvělé!

  • Zkušenosti? Fajn, pokud je máš, ale není to nutnost (max 2 roky)

  • Máš skutečnou lásku k technologiím a jejich vlivu na business svět

  • Dobrá znalost ekonomiky a managementu

  • Jsi vždy připraven hledat inovativní řešení

  • Máš chuť se učit nové nástroje a řešení

  • Máš silné sociální dovednosti a komunikační schopnosti – super důležité pro každodenní život, práci s klienty a tvým týmem

  • Jsi motivovaný, ambiciózní a pracovitý

  • Samostatný, s pozitivním přístupem

  • Plynulá znalost češtiny/slovenštiny a angličtiny (oba jazyky jsou nutností)

Čím tě potěšíme my?

  • Kariérní zkušenost z Big4

  • 30.000 benefitních bodů na sport, stravenky, do lékárny nebo na kulturní zážitky

  • Počítač a iPhone s neomezenými daty

  • Placené volno 25 dní, 3 wellbeing days a až 2 dny "vánočního" volna navíc

  • Můžeš si nastavit flexibilně svůj pracovní rozvrh nebo občas pracovat z domova

  • Máme pravidelné odborné vzdělávání v různých oblastech – byznysové, technické i soft skills, pomocí Digital Upskilling Academy nebo našich Technology komunit, v rámci kterých pořádáme různá školení

  • Dostaneš podporu zkušenějších kolegů v týmu, nebo i buddyho, abys na to nebyl/a sám/a

  • Network zajímavých lidí a zábavu – každý měsíc se v PwC konají akce (např. Closing Semester party, Lunch Breaks a další)

  • Každý měsíc máme TC statusy, na kterých si povíme, jak to vypadá na našich projektech a poté vyrazíme na společnou aktivitu (např. karaoke, indoor mini golf apod.) - určitě se podívej, jaká je práce u nás v Technology Consulting

PwC, to je největší auditní tým v České republice, ale i poradenské týmy, které se zaměřují na strategie, fúze & akvizice, restrukturalizace, finanční poradenství, daně, právo, technologie, data nebo forenzní analýzu. Zjisti, jak snadné je kombinovat tyto znalosti, když jsi na správném místě. Máme více než 364 000 kolegů ve 151 zemích. V PwC vytváříme inkluzi

This is a rare seat for a leader who pairs deep investment acumen with proven engineering leadership. As Vanguard evolves rules-based toward next-generation, risk-optimization-driven portfolio construction, this leader will build in-house capability—not simply integrate vendors—and shape a multi-year transformation at scale. A CFA or comparable industry certification is a strong plus and a valued signal of deep investment capability (not required). Proven experience leading large application engineering organizations, including managing managers and developing senior leaders. Track record of building high-performing teams in complex, matrixed environments with significant cross-functional dependency. Deep experience leading large-scale technology programs and platform transformations, with strong grounding in modern engineering practices, distributed systems, and platform architecture. Ability to balance operational reliability with long-term transformation. Experience integrating or building alongside industry platforms (e.g., Aladdin, Charles River, MSCI, InvestCloud, Advisor Engine, Orion, Envestnet) is a plus and shortens ramp time. Demonstrated ability to operate in ambiguity, set clear direction, and balance innovation, cost, risk, and speed while ensuring disciplined execution. Exceptional stakeholder management; comfortable partnering with senior business and investment leaders and influencing without direct authority. title: Pflichtpraktikum Financial Accounting - General Ledger
description: Mit weltweit über 12 000 Mitarbeitenden verfolgen wir bei Bosch Global Business Services ein gemeinsames Ziel: die Bereitstellung erstklassiger Dienstleistungen, die einen echten Mehrwert für Bosch schaffen. Fortschrittliche Technologie und weltweite Zusammenarbeit sind unsere Treiber, durch die wir jeden Tag einen Unterschied machen. Durch unser einzigartiges Set-up bündeln wir alle kaufmännischen Prozesse unter einem Dach. Das ermöglicht dir, in die spannende Welt von Bosch einzutauchen. Deine Arbeit trägt maßgeblich zur Wettbewerbsfähigkeit von Bosch bei und gibt unseren Geschäftsbereichen den nötigen Freiraum, Technik fürs Leben zu entwickeln. Im Rahmen deines Praktikums bearbeitest du einzelne Themenfelder in der Hauptbuchhaltung von der Bewertung und Bilanzierung bis zur Buchung in SAP und der Erstellung der zugehörigen Dokumentation. Regelmäßig erstellst du Auswertungen zu unterschiedlichen Inhalten im Accounting in unterschiedlichen SAP R/3- und S/4-Systemen. Du leitest erforderliche Anpassungen ein und präsentierst die Ergebnisse. Du überwachst die unterjährige Entwicklung verschiedener Sachverhalte anhand von Sachkonten und/oder Rückstellungen nach HGB und IFRS in SAP R/3 und S/4HANA. Des Weiteren identifizierst du Verbesserungspotentiale bei bestehenden Prozessen, erstellst Wirksamkeitsanalysen, unterstützt bei deren Umsetzung und bei der Kommunikation an unsere Kunden. Sonderaufgaben, wie die Erarbeitung von Prozessdokumentationen, der Aufbau inkl. der Optimierung von Excel-Lösungen und die zielgruppenorientierte Aufbereitung unterschiedlicher Daten und Sachverhalten gehören ebenfalls zu deinem Aufgabenbereich. Deine Mitarbeit bei Tests für die Tool-Weiterentwicklungen als auch bei Automatisierungsprozessen und der Digitalisierung ist gefragt. Ausbildung: Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbar Erfahrungen und Know-how: sicherer Umgang mit MS Office (insbesondere Excel); Basiskenntnisse der Bilanzierung nach HGB und IFRS; Grundkenntnisse in der Administration von Applikationen und Datenbanken (IT-automatisierte Datenverarbeitungskenntnisse VBA, KNIME, RPA BOT); SAP-Kenntnisse und praktische Vorerfahrungen in der Buchhaltung von Vorteil Persönlichkeit und Arbeitsweise: dir gelingt es, dich schnell in neue Prozess- und Systemlandschaften einzuarbeiten, dabei komplexe Sachverhalte zu abstrahieren und logisch zu durchdenken, während du deine Aufgaben strukturiert und selbstständig angehst und dich aktiv ins Team einbringst Arbeitsalltag: deine Präsenz vor Ort ist erforderlich Begeisterung: für automatisierte Prozesse und die daraus resultierende Zahlenverarbeitung Sprachen: verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und sehr gutes Englisch

title: IT-Architektur-Spezialist*in für EAM & Service Portfolio Management (m/w/d)
description: Die sieben Kunst- und Musikhochschulen des Landes Nordrhein-Westfalen (NRW) suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine/einen IT-Architektur-Spezialist\*in für EAM & Service Portfolio Management (m/w/d) (EG 11 bis EG 13 TV-L) für die gemeinsame „Geschäftsstelle für IT und digitale Unterstützungsprozesse“ in Vollzeit und unbefristet. Wer wir sind: IT-Transformation und Digitalisierung gemeinsam gestalten Die sieben Kunst- und Musikhochschulen in Nordrhein-Westfalen sind Orte der Kreativität, Vielfalt und individuellen Profile. Gleichzeitig stehen sie vor der gemeinsamen Aufgabe, ihre IT-Landschaften auf die zukünftigen landesweiten IT-Dienstleistungen auszurichten.Dafür haben sie die gemeinsame Geschäftsstelle für IT und digitale Unterstützungsprozesse (GDU) gegründet. Unser Ziel ist es nicht, zentrale Vorgaben zu verwalten, sondern die Hochschulen aktiv dabei zu unterstützen, neue gemeinsame IT-Dienste erfolgreich einzuführen und nachhaltig nutzbar zu machen. Dabei arbeiten wir eng mit den lokalen IT-Abteilungen, den Fachbereichen der Hochschulen sowie den landesweiten IT-Dienstleistern zusammen. Deine Mission: Architekturen und Zielbilder entwickeln und realisieren Du unterstützt die Kunst- und Musikhochschulen dabei, ihre IT-Landschaften schrittweise auf gemeinsame IT-Basisdienste und zukünftige Cloud-Services auszurichten. Dafür machst Du zunächst sichtbar, wie die IT-Landschaften der Hochschulen heute aussehen: Welche Systeme und Abhängigkeiten gibt es? Welche Gemeinsamkeiten und Unterschiede bestehen? Welche lokalen Besonderheiten und gewachsenen Kooperationen sind zu berücksichtigen? Auf dieser Grundlage entwickelst Du gemeinsam mit den Hochschulen ein belastbares Zielbild für ihre zukünftige IT-Landschaft. Dabei geht es nicht um ein einheitliches Zielbild um seiner selbst willen, sondern um tragfähige Perspektiven und abgestimmte Wege dorthin. Für jede Hochschule kann der Weg anders aussehen – das gemeinsame Ziel und die langfristige Perspektive auf Standards, gemeinsame Dienste und eine stärkere Nutzung zentraler Services bleiben dabei im Blick. Ein besonderer Schwerpunkt Deiner Tätigkeit liegt auf der Vorbereitung und Begleitung des Weges in die HITS-MultiCloud. Architektur mit HITS entwickeln Du arbeitest gemeinsam mit HITS.NRW und den Architekt\*innen anderer Hochschulen daran, die Möglichkeiten der MultiCloud und weiterer zentraler IT-Dienste effektiv nutzbar zu machen und in die bestehenden IT-Landschaften zu integrieren. Dabei bringst Du die Anforderungen und gemeinsamen Positionen der Kunst- und Musikhochschulen ein und wirkst fachlich verbindlich an tragfähigen Lösungen und Architekturen mit. Transformation gemeinsam gestalten Du begleitest die Hochschulen bei der technischen und organisatorischen Transformation ihrer IT-Landschaften – zunächst mit einem besonderen Schwerpunkt auf dem Weg in die HITS-MultiCloud. Dabei bewertest Du bestehende Systeme und ihre Abhängigkeiten, entwickelst gemeinsam mit den IT-Teams sinnvolle Migrations- und Modernisierungswege und identifizierst technische, organisatorische und fachliche Voraussetzungen. Du erkennst, wo individuelle Lösungen sinnvoll sind, wo Konsolidierung oder gemeinsame Lösungen Vorteile schaffen und welche Kompetenzen dafür aufgebaut werden müssen. IT-Abteilungen operativ unterstützen Du bleibst nicht bei Konzepten stehen, sondern unterstützt die lokalen IT-Abteilungen auch bei der konkreten Umsetzung – etwa bei Migrationen, Konsolidierungen, Pilotierungen und beim Aufbau notwendiger Kompetenzen. Unser Ziel ist es, die lokalen IT-Abteilungen im Transformationsprozess spürbar zu entlasten und gemeinsam mit ihnen tragfähige Lösungen umzusetzen. Serviceportfolio Mit dem Ausbau gemeinsamer IT-Dienstleistungen entwickelst Du gemeinsam mit dem Team auch das hochschulübergreifende Serviceportfolio weiter. Du beobachtest die vorhandenen und entstehenden Angebote, ordnest sie in die Zielarchitekturen der Hochschulen ein und identifizierst gemeinsam mit den Beteiligten Bedarfe, Lücken und mögliche neue gemeinsame Services. Dein Profil: Architektonisch stark, kommunikativ überzeugend Wir suchen eine Persönlichkeit, die Freude daran hat, komplexe IT-Landschaften zu verstehen, sichtbar zu machen und gemeinsam mit unterschiedlichen Menschen weiterzuentwickeln. Dein Fundament Ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung oder eine gleichwertige Qualifikation durch mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung. Deine Erfahrung Du verfügst über praktische Erfahrung in der IT-Architektur, Enterprise Architecture oder der Planung und Umsetzung komplexer IT-Transformationen. Idealerweise hast Du bereits Erfahrungen gesammelt mit der strukturierten Aufnahme und Visualisierung von IT-Landschaften, der Entwicklung von Zielarchitekturen und Transformationspfaden, Cloud-Architekturen und Cloud-Migrationen, IT-Infrastrukturen, Netzwerken und modernen Sicherheitskonzepten, Virtualisierung und idealerweise Container-Technologien, Architektur- oder EAM-Werkzeugen wie ADOIT oder vergleichbaren Lösungen sowie IT-Service-Management und Serviceportfolio-Management. Erfahrungen in der Hochschul-IT oder im öffentlichen Sektor sind von Vorteil. Deine Arbeitsweise Du analysierst komplexe IT-Landschaften strukturiert und kannst technische Zusammenhänge so darstellen, dass daraus gemeinsame Entscheidungen entstehen. Du verbindest den Blick für das große Ganze mit einem ausgeprägten Pragmatismus und verlierst auch bei komplexen Transformationsvorhaben die konkrete Umsetzbarkeit nicht aus den Augen. Du kannst fachliche Positionen entwickeln, vertreten und innerhalb eines abgestimmten Rahmens eigenständig Entscheidungen treffen. Dein Mindset Du begegnest unterschiedlichen Ausgangslagen mit Offenheit und Respekt. Du verstehst Standardisierung nicht als Ziel um ihrer selbst willen, sondern als einen Weg zu besserer Qualität, Wirtschaftlichkeit und gemeinsamer Handlungsfähigkeit. Du weißt, dass Veränderung Zeit braucht und dass nicht jede Hochschule denselben Weg gleichzeitig gehen kann. Gleichzeitig hast Du die gemeinsame Perspektive stets im Blick und schaffst durch Transparenz, Wissen und gute Lösungen die Voraussetzungen dafür, dass aus unterschiedlichen Ausgangslagen schrittweise mehr Gemeinsamkeit entsteht. Du hast Freude daran, Menschen mitzunehmen, Wissen zu teilen und gemeinsam mit anderen die Digitalisierung der Kunst- und Musikhochschulen voranzubringen. Wir bieten Impact: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit den sieben Kunst- und Musikhochschulen tragfähige IT-Architekturen und Zielbilder und gestaltest deren Realisierung auf dem Weg in die zukünftige Cloud- und IT-Landschaft. Gestaltungsspielraum: Du arbeitest an einer Schnittstelle, an der Architektur nicht nur dokumentiert, sondern gemeinsam mit HITS.NRW und den Hochschulen tatsächlich gestaltet wird. Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie großzügige Möglichkeiten zum mobilen Arbeiten gehören für uns selbstverständlich dazu. Kultur: Ein engagiertes hochschulübergreifendes Team und ein vertrauensvolles Miteinander. Entwicklung: Eine langfristig angelegte Aufgabe mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum, in der Du zunächst die Cloud-Transformation und perspektivisch das gemeinsame IT-Serviceportfolio maßgeblich mitgestalten kannst. Sicherheit & Extras: Unbefristete Beschäftigung nach TV-L (bis EG 13), betriebliche Altersversorgung (VBL) sowie ein inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld an den Kunst- und Musikhochschulen Nordrhein-Westfalens. Dienstort und Arbeitsplatz: Der Dienstort ist die Folkwang Universität der Künste in Essen. Zurzeit befinden sich die Büros der Geschäftsstelle am Campus Welterbe Zollverein. Es ist eine Prüfung möglich, ob der Arbeitsplatz auch an einer der sechs anderen Kunst- und Musikhochschulen eingerichtet werden kann, so dass als weitere Standorte Detmold, Düsseldorf, Köln und Münster in Betracht kommen. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen aller Interessierten, unabhängig von Herkunft, Erscheinungsbild, Beeinträchtigung, sozialem Status, Religion, Alter, geschlechtlicher und sexueller Identität. title: Internship for Thesis Advanced Data Analytics for Functional Safety Validation
description: You will join the Bosch Application team in Turin, working in a dynamic automotive environment on advanced engine control systems. Supported by experienced engineers, you will gain hands-on experience in data analysis applied to real vehicle development projects, contributing to innovation in Functional Safety validation. You will work with real measurement data (vehicle and test bench) and advanced tools, with the opportunity to transform raw data into structured insights supporting safety validation processes. Thesis Objectives The goal of the thesis is to develop a data-driven methodology for Functional Safety validation of Engine Control Units (ECUs) , leveraging advanced data analytics and automated reporting tools (e.g. EATB). The main activities include: Define a methodology to structure and label data analysis results from vehicle validation, ensuring traceability to Functional Safety requirements Perform root-cause analysis of availability and robustness issues identified during vehicle testing Develop KPI-based metrics and data-driven validation criteria (e.g. adaptive thresholds, signal envelopes) to assess safety performance Build a data-driven decision framework to automatically classify safety requirements (validated / not validated / uncertain) based on real measurement data Analyze large datasets to identify hidden patterns and critical safety-relevant scenarios via machine learning techniques Design a scalable data storage concept to enable reuse of analysis results and support statistical monitoring. Related Activities During the thesis, you will also: Gain understanding of ECU software and diesel engine control systems Study Functional Safety functions (ISO 26262 context) Collaborate with Bosch experts across different domains Contribute to tool development for data analysis and reporting Analyze existing validation procedures and propose improvements based on data-driven insights What you will learn (value for the candidate) How to apply data analytics in real automotive development projects How Functional Safety validation is performed using real-world data How to move from raw data to: KPIs thresholds engineering decisions Exposure to industry tools such as INCA, MATLAB/Python Experience in system-level thinking and cross-domain engineering Education: Degree in Engineering (Computer Engineering, Mechatronic, Automotive, or similar) Languages: English (min. B2), Italian (min. B2) Technical skills: Strong Programming skills (Python, MATLAB) Basic knowledge of databases (SQL / NoSQL) Experience & interest in data analysis, machine learning and automotive systems Soft skills: Structured and analytical mindset Curiosity and interest in innovation Teamwork and communication skillscaaa

description:
Please note: This is a 6 Month Fixed Term Contract. This vacancy is being advertised for both immediate and future opportunities. As a Resourcing Officer, you’ll support the Business leadership and play an important role in the implementation and delivery of Resource Management (RM) services to provide operational excellence. Resource Management works collaboratively with our business to deliver successful people deployment solutions and build quality client teams with suitable skills and experience. What you’ll receive from us:


No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.


We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

description: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. What you will do At Volvo Financial Services you will contribute to the transformation of our company, the transport industry and society at large. The Collections & Recovery Specialist plays an important role in supporting portfolio quality and minimizing credit losses across Lithuania, Latvia, and Estonia. The role combines analytical, operational and decision-support responsibilities by monitoring collections performance, preparing portfolio and overdue debt reporting, reviewing contract modification requests, and providing recommendations to support sound credit and collections decisions. The position reports to the Credit Manager at Volvo Financial Services Baltics. Main activities and core responsibilities: • Monitor collections and recovery performance across the Baltic portfolio. • Work with soft collections providers and directly with customers, as needed, to determine cause of delinquency and negotiate payment arrangements. • Prepare and maintain overdue debt (OVD), delinquency and collections performance reports for management. • Ensure data quality and consistency within collections and portfolio management reporting. • Analyze portfolio trends, identify risk areas and recommend corrective actions. • Review customer requests for contract modifications, payment extensions and restructurings. • Perform financial and risk assessment of modification requests and prepare recommendations for approval. • Initiate and handle termination of contracts due to default. • Coordinate Repossession and support Remarketing functions as required. • Support decision-making by providing portfolio, collections and recovery insights. • Monitor recovery performance and support actions aimed at maximizing recovered amounts. • Lead periodic collection meetings to discuss individual accounts and action items. • Drive continuous improvements in collections, recovery and contract administration processes. • Support implementation of new tools, products and business initiatives impacting collections activities. Who are you? In this role, you will bring: • University degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration or a related field. • Minimum 3 years of experience in collections, credit, risk management, accounts receivables or financial analysis. Experience in a customer service or similar environment is an advantage. • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. • Ability to assess financial risks and identify appropriate mitigation actions. • Good understanding of leasing and loan products. • High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities. • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. • Experience working in an international and multicultural environment is an advantage. • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel. • Fluency in Lithuanian or Latvian and advanced level of English. What’s in it for you? We offer a solid package of compensation and benefits, plus you will enjoy: • Joining a global and diverse team of highly skilled professionals who make customers win. • Opportunity to grow both personally and professionally. • Space to initiate and implement improvements that create value for customers and the business. • Environment where we work with passion, trust each other and embrace change to stay ahead. • Package of company benefits such as trainings, additional health insurance and more. Salary level: from 2.900€ to 3.600€ per month gross (before withholding taxes) depending on skills and experience. Also, annual bonus program will be applied in accordance with the Company policy. description:

  • Contributing to data strategy, architectural roadmaps, and platform evolution, helping clients modernise their data landscape and strengthen their analytics and AI capabilities

This role is for you if:

  • Proven experience in enterprise architecture, including:

  • Full lifecycle experience designing and delivering platform agnostic data architectures, leading cross-functional teams to build data models, pipelines, and semantic layers that drive business value

  • Strong commercial awareness, with the ability to link data modelling decisions to business outcomes, sector-specific challenges, and broader market trends

  • Experience selecting data and integration technologies at project or enterprise level, and confidence in articulating pros, cons, and ROI to client stakeholders

  • Deep understanding of data governance, lineage, quality frameworks, and master data management, and their role within a modern data platform

  • A track record of delivering high-quality client engagements and building trusted relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.

  • Strong consulting foundations: impactful communication, structured problem-solving, adaptability, and the ability to navigate ambiguity and deliver under pressure.

  • Design expertise in core data architecture disciplines including data modelling (proficient in at least one data modelling tool e.g. Erwin or ER Studio), metadata management, data migration and master data management

  • Well versed in data architecture approaches to ingest, model and serve data from various sources including ERP (Oracle, SAP etc.), CRM (Salesforce, etc.) and HR systems (Workday etc) incl

description:
Job Description

About the role:

At PwC, we help organisations transform how they attract, develop, engage and manage their people. Workday is often a key enabler of this transformation, but our work goes beyond technology implementation. We help clients simplify processes, improve employee experience, strengthen data foundations and realise measurable value from their workforce technology investments.

As a Workday Manager within our Workforce Transformation practice, you will play a delivery-focused role on Workday programmes, leading client delivery teams while also contributing hands-on to the work. You will manage complex workstreams, guide and support Workday teams, shape practical solutions and remain close enough to the detail to review design decisions, resolve delivery issues and help ensure high-quality outcomes across the programme lifecycle.

This is a role for someone who enjoys working with and leading Workday delivery teams, building trusted client relationships and developing others, while continuing to deepen their own hands-on expertise in Workday, HR technology and workforce transformation.

What your days will look like:

  • Lead Workday delivery teams and workstreams across HCM, Talent, Recruiting, Learning, Compensation, Payroll, Absence, Time, Reporting, Integrations, Security and Data Migration, while providing hands-on input to solution design, configuration, testing and issue resolution.

  • Act as a Functional, Solution or Workstream Lead, owning delivery planning, quality, stakeholder engagement, risks and issues to ensure successful programme outcomes.

  • Facilitate client workshops, challenge requirements constructively and help design future-state processes that improve ways of working rather than replicate existing practices.

  • Translate business requirements into practical Workday solutions that support strategic objectives, enhance user experience and deliver measurable business value.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and guide clients through all programme phases—from discovery and design to deployment, adoption and optimisation—bringing strong problem-solving skills and delivery discipline throughout.

This role is for you if:

  • Current Workday certification with strong delivery experience across one or more Workday product areas and a proven track record in implementation, optimisation or transformation programmes.

  • Experience leading Workday workstreams or teams, with responsibility for delivery quality, project planning, risk management and successful outcomes.

  • Strong understanding of HR processes and the ability to translate business needs into practical technology solutions that deliver business value.

  • Excellent facilitation, communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge requirements constructively and influence decision-making.

  • Commercially aware team player who is passionate about developing others, building high-performing teams and contributing to practice growth and business development.

What you will get from us

You will join an established Workday and Workforce Transformation practice with access to challenging client work, experienced colleagues and the wider PwC network. You will have opportunities to develop your consulting, technology, leadership and commercial skills while contributing to work that helps clients transform the way their people experience work.

We offer a range of benefits designed to support you at work and outside work, including empowered flexibility, hybrid working across office, home and client site, private medical cover, access to wellbeing support and volunteering days.

title: Lean Portfolio Management Expert
description: Om oss På Techrytera AB börjar rekryteringen med dig. Vi är ett bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag med spetskompetens och ett tydligt fokus inom IT och Engineering. Med vår branschkunskap och nära dialog med både kandidater och kunder skapar vi träffsäkra matchningar där rätt kompetens möter rätt behov. Vi tror att en riktigt bra matchning inte bara handlar om en rollbeskrivning – utan om dina erfarenheter, din potential och vad du faktiskt vill utvecklas inom. Därför utgår vi alltid från individen. Genom att förstå din bakgrund, dina drivkrafter och dina ambitioner kan vi koppla ihop dig med uppdrag och roller hos våra kunder där du får rätt förutsättningar att utvecklas och göra skillnad. Vårt mål är att bygga långsiktiga och meningsfulla samarbeten – både för dig som kandidat och för våra kunder. Arbetsbeskrivning Vi söker en erfaren Lean Portfolio Management (LPM) expert som ska ingå i coreteamet i ett transformationsprojekt för agil förflyttning. LPM experten ska driva arbetet med att utveckla och etablera ett mer flödesorienterat, strategiskt och värdeskapande arbetssätt för portföljstyrning där kopplingen mellan strategi, prioritering, finansiering, genomförande och uppföljning skapar förutsättningar för agil utveckling i våra digitala initiativ. Transformationen befinner sig i ett skede där grundläggande förståelse och praktisk förmåga behöver byggas parallellt, vilket kräver någon som kan växla mellan att utbilda, coacha och stötta strategiskt beslutsfattande. Du kommer att arbeta nära projektledning, portföljägare, produkt- och projektorganisationer, arkitektur, ekonomi och andra nyckelintressenter för att säkerställa att investeringar och initiativ riktas mot rätt värden och genomförs med god transparens. Uppdraget passar dig som har gedigen erfarenhet av portföljstyrning i agila eller hybrida miljöer och som kan kombinera strategisk rådgivning med praktiskt införande av styrmodeller, forum, arbetssätt och beslutsunderlag. Uppdrag · Stödja etablering och vidareutveckling av Lean Portfolio Management som arbetssätt i organisationen. · Utforma och implementera strukturer för strategisk prioritering, portföljstyrning och värdeflödesbaserad uppföljning. · Bidra till att koppla samman strategiska mål, initiativ, finansiering, kapacitet och genomförande. · Facilitera portföljforum, prioriteringsmöten och beslutsprocesser på lednings- och portföljnivå. · Stödja framtagning av portföljbacklogg, epic-hantering, roadmap och investeringsunderlag. · Införa och förbättra principer för kapacitetsplanering, beroendehantering och resursprioritering. · Utveckla nyckeltal, rapportering och visualiseringar som ger ledningen bättre beslutsstöd. · Coachning av portföljägare, ledare, produktorganisationer och andra intressenter i Lean Portfolio Management. · Identifiera förbättringsområden i nuvarande portföljstyrning och driva förändringar i arbetssätt. · Säkerställa att styrningen stödjer både strategisk riktning, snabbare värdeleverans och effektiv hantering av risker och beroenden. Krav · Flerårig erfarenhet av portföljstyrning, programledning, strategisk styrning eller liknande roll i större organisation. · Dokumenterad erfarenhet av Lean Portfolio Management, gärna inom SAFe eller motsvarande ramverk. · God förståelse för agila, hybrida och traditionella styrmodeller samt hur dessa kan samverka i komplexa organisationer. · Erfarenhet av att arbeta med strategisk prioritering, portföljbacklogg, epic-hantering, roadmap och investeringsbeslut. · Förmåga att omsätta strategiska mål till styrbara initiativ, beslutsunderlag och uppföljningsstrukturer. · Erfarenhet av att facilitera ledningsforum, portföljforum och workshops med seniora intressenter. · Mycket god förmåga att analysera beroenden, kapacitet, risker, nyttor och prioriteringar på portföljnivå. · Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt. · Vana att ta fram tydliga presentationer, rapporter och rekommendationer för ledning och styrgrupper. Meriterande erfarenhet · Erfarenhet från energi-, infrastruktur-, elnäts- eller annan samhällskritisk verksamhet. · Certifiering eller utbildning inom SAFe, Lean Portfolio Management, Agile Leadership, PMI, IPMA eller motsvarande. · Erfarenhet av större IT-transformationer, digitaliseringsprogram eller verksamhetsnära förändringsportföljer. · Erfarenhet av nyttorealisering, värdestyrning och ekonomisk uppföljning av investeringar. · Erfarenhet av verktyg som Azure DevOps, Jira, eller liknande portfölj- och rapporteringsverktyg. · Erfarenhet av att etablera governance-strukturer, beslutsforum och portföljprocesser i organisationer under förändring. · Erfarenhet av att arbeta nära både IT, verksamhet, ekonomi och ledning i tvärfunktionella sammanhang. Ansökan När du söker via Techrytera AB söker du inte bara ett jobb – du påbörjar en dialog om din fortsatta karriär. Vi vill lära känna dig, din erfarenhet och dina ambitioner för att kunna matcha dig med rätt möjligheter hos våra kunder. Låter det intressant? Skicka in din ansökan eller hör av dig till oss så berättar vi mer. Vi ser fram emot att hitta nästa steg i din karriär tillsammans med dig.

title: Analyst, Real Estate Asset Management
description: Over the last 20 years, Ares’ success has been driven by our people and our culture. Today, our team is guided by our core values – Collaborative, Responsible, Entrepreneurial, Self-Aware, Trustworthy – and our purpose to be a catalyst for shared prosperity and a better future. Through our recruitment, career development and employee-focused programming, we are committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive work environment where high-performance talent of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can build careers within this exciting and growing industry. Job Description Role Overview The Analyst – Asset Management (Multi-Asset Class) will support the Asset Management team in driving value creation, monitoring performance, and executing business plans across a diversified portfolio spanning multiple asset classes. The role will partner closely with senior asset managers, investment teams, finance, and third-party operators/servicers to ensure high-quality analysis, reporting, governance, and disciplined execution throughout the asset lifecycle. While reporting to a designated Vice President (VP) or above, the Analyst will work day-to-day with different senior members of the Asset Management team across the portfolio. Based in London, this position supports assets across Europe, working across the full range of strategies and structures (direct holdings, joint ventures, and Co-Invest vehicles). The Analyst will contribute to acquisitions onboarding, ongoing asset oversight, financing and refinancing processes, and exit execution, with a focus on rigorous financial analysis, data integrity, and clear communication to internal and external stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Asset Management Support & Value Creation Support senior asset managers in developing, tracking and updating asset-level business plans, including identification of performance gaps and value creation initiatives. Monitor operating and financial performance versus plan (e.g., revenue, costs, NOI/EBITDA, IRR or equivalent KPIs by strategy) and prepare concise variance analysis and commentary. Coordinate and support annual budgeting and periodic IRR reforecasting cycles, ensuring timely inputs, consistency of assumptions, and clear audit trails. Maintain and enhance asset/deal financial models (cash flow, debt, scenarios, sensitivities), and support hold/sell analysis and decision-making materials. Track key initiatives (commercial actions, capex programmes, remediation plans) and maintain action logs, timelines, and milestone reporting for internal governance. Third-Party Management, Data & Governance Collect, validate and consolidate reporting from property managers, operating partners, and other third parties; follow up on data gaps and inconsistencies. Prepare materials for weekly/monthly operating reviews and quarterly business reviews, including dashboards, KPI packs, and meeting minutes/action trackers as required. Support the standardisation of reporting templates and definitions across asset classes to enable consistent portfolio aggregation and performance comparisons. Assist with contract and fee tracking (where applicable), ensuring key terms are captured and reflected in models and forecasts. Maintain core asset documentation (business plans, budgets, valuations, insurance and compliance items, key correspondence) to support audit readiness and efficient execution. Market, Commercial & Portfolio Analytics Conduct market research and benchmarking (rents/pricing, vacancies, supply pipeline, cap rates, comparable transactions) and translate findings into actionable insights for business plans. Support valuation processes by compiling inputs, updating cash flow assumptions, and coordinating with third-party valuers where relevant. Maintain portfolio dashboards and performance attribution (drivers of return, leverage impacts, FX impacts where applicable) for internal stakeholders. Track key macro, regulatory and sector-specific developments relevant to the portfolio and summarise implications for asset strategy and risk management. Prepare ad hoc analysis in support of asset-level decisions (capex prioritisation, leasing/commercial strategies, restructuring options, hedging considerations as applicable). Reporting & Stakeholder Management Prepare recurring asset and deal level reporting packs for internal committees and senior management, including performance highlights, risks, and required decisions. title: Quality Control Technician - Inspector - 2nd Shift
location: Pinetops, North Carolina, United States of America
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Quality Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities (Mandatory)
In this role, you will have the opportunity to assist the Quality team in implementing and maintaining a quality system, including conducting audits, establishing controls, training on tools and methodologies. Each day, you will support activities related to quality management within the organizational unit. You will also showcase your expertise by reporting quality Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and customer cases and maintaining process documentation.
The work model for the role is: onsite at the Pinetops, NC facility.

You will be mainly accountable for:
  • Reporting quality issues data, ensuring adherence to quality management system at all stages.
  • Acquiring and reporting quality metrics and KPIs accurately and in a timely manner to facilitate the analysis and management of local processes.
  • Utilizing measurement systems to produce data that reflect the accurate characteristics of materials, products, systems, and processes.
  • Training local operational teams on relevant elements of quality management, supporting implementation, and promoting opportunities for improvement.
Qualifications for the role (Mandatory)
  • 2+ years of working in a manufacturing environment
  • High school diploma or equivalent required
  • Legal authorization to work in the US is required
  • Knowledge and use of tools – tape measure, calipers, grinders, or other hand tools, as needed.
  • Ability to safely use a ladder while performing the job, as needed
  • Ability to lift, push and pull up to 40lbs
Working conditions
Manufacturing plant environment requires a combination of hands-on and technical tasks. Work may involve occasional lifting of materials, climbing stairs/ladders, and walking. Employees may be required to bend, twist, or stand for extended periods.
Frequent use of computers is necessary for data entry, monitoring, and communication. Employees will also handle a variety of tools and equipment, from hand tools to machinery, requiring technical skills and adherence to safety protocols.
Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), such as safety glasses, gloves, and steel-toed shoes, is required to ensure a safe working environment. Adhering to safety guidelines is essential for all team members.
The work environment requires physical endurance, technical proficiency, and a commitment to maintaining safety standards to contribute to a productive and rewarding workplace.
More about us (Mandatory)

ABB's Distribution Solutions Division facilitates the efficient and reliable distribution, protection and control of power by improving electric power quality while strengthening the resilience of the grid. The Division offers segment-specific products and solutions that largely serve utilities, industry and infrastructure segments, often providing the requisite medium voltage link between high-voltage transmission systems and low-voltage users. With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions at its core, the offering includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (1 to 66 kilovolts), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, reclosers, fuses, contactors, relays, instrument transformers, sensors, motor control centers, as well as low-voltage switchgear for the ANSI standard markets.

description: Senior Manager Bewertung und Portfoliomanagement (m/w/d) Über uns Mit über 70 Jahren Erfahrung gehört die Bayerische Hausbau Real Estate zu den führenden Immobilienunternehmen in Deutschland.
