Dabei stehen wir für hochwertige und wegweisende Architektur sowie stadtbildprägende Quartiere. Als Immobilienmanager mit Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Leidenschaft sind Kundenfokussierung sowie kontinuierliche Investitionen in Nachhaltigkeit und Innovation zentrale Bestandteile unserer Strategie. Bei allem Wachstum ist die Bayerische Hausbau Real Estate stets ein Familienunternehmen geblieben. Unsere Unternehmenskultur ist geprägt von Wertschätzung gegenüber unseren Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern, von Offenheit und Vertrauen, von traditionellen Werten ebenso wie vom Geist des Wandels. Hinter unserem Erfolg stehen Menschen, die sich an ihrem Arbeitsplatz wohl fühlen und engagiert im Team unsere Ziele vorantreiben. Zur Verstärkung der Abteilung Portfoliomanagement & Research suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Senior Manager Bewertung & Portfoliomanagement (m/w/d). Ihre Aufgaben Sie sind verantwortlich für die laufende Bewertung eines substanziellen Teils unseres nationalen/internationalen Portfolios, und bewerten dieses selbstständig nach DCF und Ertragswertverfahren für gängige Nutzungsarten und Projektentwicklung. Sie sind zuständig für die Prozessorganisation und -dokumentation sowie die Sicherung der Qualität der Arbeitsergebnisse innerhalb der Abteilung. Sie koordinieren und überprüfen die Arbeit externer Immobiliengutachter gemäß internen und marktüblichen Standards. Sie sind im laufenden Austausch mit unserem Asset-Management und dem Vermietungsteam, um Marktentwicklungen zu diskutieren. Sie sind aktiv bei der Beschaffung und Analyse des strategischen Sekundär-Researchs (Schwerpunkt Immobilienmärkte) und darauf basierender Weiterentwicklung der Anlagestrategie eingebunden. Sie erstellen dabei quantitative Analysen deutscher/europäischer Immobilienmärkte in Zusammenarbeit mit der Research-Abteilung. Sie sind darüber hinaus in die daraus abgeleiteten Handlungsempfehlungen bezüglich attraktiver Investitionsstandorte, Timing von Marktein- und Marktaustritt und geforderter Renditen eingebunden. Sie unterstützen bei der Modellierung von Szenario- und Sensitivitätsanalysen zur Bewertung und Risikobeurteilung sowie bei der Erstellung von Business- und Budget-Plänen. Sie begleiten gewerblichen Immobilientransaktionen innerhalb Europas. Zudem arbeiten Sie aktiv an Sonderprojekten mit. Ihr Profil Abgeschlossenes (Fach-) Hochschulstudium (Bachelor/ Master), idealerweise ergänzt um eine immobilienspezifische Zusatzausbildung. Sie bringen idealerweise mindestens 5 Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der Immobilienbewertung, als HypZert/RICS-zertifizierter Gutachter, oder haben bereits in einem Sachverständigenbüro für Immobilienbewertung gearbeitet. Darüber hinaus haben Sie bereits Erfahrung im Portfoliomanagement gesammelt. Fundierte Kenntnisse des Immobilien- und Kapitalmarktes sowie internationaler und nationaler Bewertungsverfahren. Erfahrung im nationalen/internationalen Projektmanagement und Interesse an Trends wie Digitalisierung und Nachhaltigkeit. Selbstständig agierende, präzise arbeitende, leistungsorientierte Persönlichkeit mit souveräner Kommunikations- und Durchsetzungsstärke. Bereichsübergreifendes Handeln ist für Sie selbstverständlich. Sie kommunizieren gerne mit internen und externen Ansprechpartnern. Entscheidungsfreude, Belastbarkeit, Flexibilität und Gewissenhaftigkeit zeichnen Sie aus. At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Country Trade Compliance Manager (CTCM)

__

Your role and responsibilities

The Senior Leader, U.S. Trade Compliance Program will be responsible for supporting the Country Trade Compliance Officer (CTCO) in the management, governance, and execution of the ABB's U.S. Trade Compliance Program. This role provides strategic oversight of trade compliance risks, policies, controls, and operational processes while partnering with business stakeholders to ensure compliance with applicable U.S. import, export, sanctions, and customs regulations. The position serves as a key leader within the U.S. trade compliance function, driving program excellence, continuous improvement, and regulatory compliance across the organization.

This role is contributing to the Country Trade Compliance group in the United States.

Trade Compliance Program Leadership

  • Support the Country Trade Compliance Officer (CTCO) in developing, implementing, and executing the U.S. Trade Compliance Program strategy.

  • Lead key program initiatives to ensure compliance with U.S. import, export, sanctions, and other trade regulations.

  • Drive continuous improvement of the Country’s trade compliance processes.

  • Serve as a senior advisor to Local Trade Compliance Officers (LTCOs) on trade compliance risks and regulatory requirements.

Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management

  • Identify, assess, and mitigate trade compliance risks through proactive monitoring and controls.

  • Support the CTCO with investigations of potential compliance concerns and support corrective and preventive action plans.

  • Escalate significant compliance risks, violations, and regulatory developments to the CTCO.

Governance & Internal Controls

Training & Awareness

title: FINANCE MANAGER TILL INTERNATIONELL KUND
description: Vill du ta ett helhetsansvar för ekonomi och finans på ett internationellt bolag som ingår i en global koncern med stark tillväxt, och leda utvecklingen av en modern och effektiv finance-organisation? Vi söker för en av våra kunders räkning flera Finance Managers som vill kombinera strategiskt och operativt ansvar i komplexa och dynamiska miljöer. Du kommer att spela en central roll i att utveckla bolagets finansiella styrning, effektivisera processer och säkerställa fortsatt stabilitet i en tid av förändring och tillväxt. Kunden tillsätter flera liknande roller där placering kan vara aktuell i olika länder, vilket innebär att du behöver vara redo att flytta från Sverige. Denna tjänst genomförs på uppdrag av ett ledande och välrenommerat företag inom servicesektorn. På grund av rekryteringens affärskritiska och strategiska karaktär har företaget valt att förbli anonymt i detta inledande skede. OM ROLLEN Som Finance Manager får du det samlade ansvaret för redovisning, rapportering, controlling, skatt och kreditfrågor i ett av koncernens operativa bolag. Du leder en erfaren och kompetent finansorganisation som består av medarbetare inom redovisning, controlling och kredit, där delar av funktionerna är lokaliserade i andra länder. Rollen har ett brett ansvarsområde som spänner från daglig finansiell uppföljning till långsiktig planering och organisationsutveckling. Du blir en nyckelperson i bolagets lokala ledningsgrupp för ekonomi där du bidrar till det övergripande förändringsarbete som pågår inom ekonomifunktionen. Finance-funktionen befinner sig i ett spännande utvecklingsskede där nya krav på effektivitet, transparens och systemstöd driver förändring. Ett viktigt fokus framåt är att utvärdera och vidareutveckla befintliga system och processer, samt att driva en gradvis övergång mot en mer integrerad och modern finance-organisation. DITT UPPDRAG Du har det operativa och strategiska ansvaret för att säkerställa en korrekt, effektiv och affärsnära ekonomifunktion. Rollen omfattar både ledning av den dagliga verksamheten och att initiera och driva förbättringar som stärker struktur, kvalitet och affärsstöd. Du kommer att: Leda och utveckla en mångfacetterad ekonomiavdelning med medarbetare inom redovisning, controlling, skatt och kredit. Ansvara för bokslut, rapportering, budget och prognos, samt säkerställa att arbetet följer IFRS och andra relevanta regelverk. Säkerställa effektiva processer för kund- och leverantörsreskontra samt internkontroll. Arbeta med frågor som rör strategisk planering, riskhantering och kapitalstruktur. Delta i och driva utvecklingsinitiativ kopplade till uppgradering eller ersättning av ekonomisystem och relaterade processer. Stödja ledningen med analyser och beslutsunderlag som bidrar till affärsmässig styrning och lönsam tillväxt. Initiera förbättringsarbete inom organisation och struktur, inklusive omfördelning av resurser och utveckling av Shared Service-funktioner. Rollen kräver både operativ förmåga och ett tydligt strategiskt perspektiv. Du förväntas arbeta nära verksamheten, förstå affären och kunna omsätta finansiella insikter till konkreta förbättringar i den dagliga driften. DIN PROFIL Vi söker dig som har en solid grund inom redovisning och revision, kombinerat med erfarenhet av att leda team och driva förändring i en internationell kontext. Erfarenhet av Business Controll är ett plus. Du trivs i en roll där du får kombinera struktur och analys med ledarskap och affärsnärvaro. Du är trygg i din yrkesroll, har hög integritet och förmåga att bygga förtroende både internt och externt. Du har lätt för att navigera i en mångkulturell miljö och motiveras av att utveckla människor, processer och arbetssätt. Vi tror att du har: Akademisk examen inom ekonomi, redovisning eller finans. Flerårig erfarenhet av kvalificerat arbete inom redovisning, revision eller controlling Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att leda och utveckla team. God förståelse för IFRS och internationella redovisningsprinciper. Erfarenhet av processförbättring eller implementering av nya finansiella system. Förmåga att kombinera strategiskt tänkande med operativt ansvarstagande. Flytande i Svenska, både tal och skrift. Rollen erbjuder goda möjligheter till långsiktig karriärutveckling inom koncernen. För rätt person finns potential att på sikt ta ett bredare ledaransvar i ett av koncernens bolag. VILL DU VETA MER? Välkommen att kontakta Patrik Jensen, patrik.jensen@nexergroup.com eller Artan Bitiqi, artan.bitiqi@nexergroup.com. Vi arbetar med löpande urval, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt! title: Group Accountant till Danir AB
description: Vill du arbeta med koncernredovisning i en internationell, ägarledd och entreprenörsdriven koncern där långsiktighet, samhällsengagemang och decentraliserat ansvar präglar verksamheten? Nu söker Danir AB en Group Accountant till huvudkontoret i Malmö. Rollen passar dig som har en trygg redovisningsgrund, ett genuint intresse för koncernredovisning och som vill bidra i en komplex koncernmiljö med cirka 250 dotterbolag i omkring 30 länder. Om tjänsten Som Group Accountant blir du en viktig del av Danirs koncernekonomifunktion. Rollen har fokus på löpande koncernredovisning, konsolidering och uppföljning av rapportering från dotterbolag. Du arbetar nära teamet och rapporterar till Finance Director. Uppdraget innebär att säkerställa kvalitet, struktur och punktlighet i koncernens finansiella rapportering. Då det händer mycket inom koncernen och förändringstakten är hög kommer du också att involveras i olika projekt och utvecklingsinitiativ där du ytterligare kan bredda din kompetens. Du blir också ett stöd till dotterbolagen i både rapporteringsfrågor och systemfrågor, med ett hjälpsamt och professionellt förhållningssätt. Ansvarsområden Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter: • Löpande koncernredovisning och konsolidering • Inrapportering och uppföljning av rapportering från dotterbolag • Stöd till dotterbolag i rapportering och systemfrågor • Underhåll och utveckling av rapportmallar • Framtagande av årsredovisning • Löpande kontakt med dotterbolag bland annat i samband med förvärv, avyttringar och andra transaktioner Lämplig bakgrund Vi söker dig som har akademisk bakgrund inom ekonomi och har erfarenhet av redovisning och rapportering i en koncernstruktur. Alternativt har du erfarenhet, åtminstone 4–5 år, från revision och har arbetat i uppdrag med relevant exponering mot koncernredovisning. Du har mycket goda kunskaper i Excel och erfarenhet av IFRS. Danir arbetar i Cognos och erfarenhet i något de vanligaste förekommande koncernredovisningssystem är meriterande. Rollen kräver god svenska och engelska eftersom du har kontakt med internationella dotterbolag. Personliga egenskaper För att trivas och lyckas i rollen är du trygg i din redovisningskompetens och har ett genuint intresse för koncernredovisning. Du är analytisk, noggrann och strukturerad, samtidigt som du kan hantera tydliga deadlines med bibehållen kvalitet. Du har lätt för att samarbeta, är prestigelös och trivs i ett team där man hjälps åt och täcker upp för varandra vid behov. Eftersom rollen innebär många kontaktytor mot dotterbolag behöver du vara kommunikativ, serviceinriktad och tydlig i din uppföljning på ett respektfullt sätt. Vi ser gärna att du har driv och en vilja att utvecklas över tid, men också stabilitet och tålamod att bygga förtroende och förståelse för en komplex koncernstruktur. Vad erbjuder vi Hos Danir får du möjlighet att arbeta i en komplex och internationell koncern med verksamhet i cirka 30 länder och cirka 250 dotterbolag. Du kommer in i en händelserik organisation där koncernredovisningsfunktionen är central för att skapa struktur, kvalitet och kontinuitet. Danir präglas av en jordnära, prestigelös och decentraliserad kultur och ett öppet klimat. Rollen erbjuder goda möjligheter att utvecklas inom koncernredovisning. Placering är på Danir AB:s huvudkontor i Malmö. Om företaget Danir AB är ett entreprenörsdrivet företag ägt av familjen Dan Olofsson. Bolaget bildades 1986 och har som roll att äga och utveckla sina bolag samtidigt som man bidrar till ett bättre samhälle genom entreprenörskap, långsiktighet och samhällsengagemang. Koncernen verkar internationellt och präglas av ett entreprenöriellt, decentraliserat arbetssätt där dotterbolagen i hög grad driver sina verksamheter självständigt. Ansökan I denna rekrytering samarbetar Danir AB med SJR. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan. Ansvarig rekryteringskonsult är Tomas Vinnersten, 0766–471614, välkommen om du har några frågor eller funderingar. Notera att vi inte tar emot ansökningshandlingar via e-post med hänvisning till GDPR.   • Process shipments through various online portals for submission to FDA and US Customs to obtain proper clearance

About the role

PwC’s Asset and Wealth Management practice is a market-leading audit and assurance business, with a national team of over 600 people supporting clients across the sector.

As a Non-Financial Assurance Manager, you’ll work with clients across asset management, private markets, real estate funds and investment operations, helping them strengthen governance, risk management and operational effectiveness.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys leading teams, building trusted client relationships and delivering high-quality assurance work in a collaborative, inclusive and purpose-led environment.

  • Build trusted relationships with senior clients and provide practical insight on emerging industry challenges.

title: Head of M&A - BA Life Science
description: Are you an experienced M&A professional with a passion for building long-term value through entrepreneurial companies? This is a unique opportunity to drive acquisition growth within one of Indutrade’s business areas. About Indutrade Indutrade is an international technology and industrial business group founded in 1978 and listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. The group consists of over 220 companies across some 30 countries, primarily in Europe, with net sales of SEK 32.5 billion in 2024. Indutrade’s business philosophy is built on entrepreneurship, decentralisation and sustainable, profitable growth – the group acquires and develops owner-managed, profitable companies with significant technical content in selected niches. The Business Area Life Science includes both technical trading companies and companies with proprietary products. Companies sell components, medical technology products, diagnostics equipment, production equipment and system solutions to customers within the pharmaceutical, healthcare and life science industries across Scandinavia, the UK and Ireland, Germany, the Netherlands, Italy, Poland, the Czech Republic and Spain. About the roleAs Head of M&A within the Life Science Business Area, you will serve as the overall project leader for the BA’s proactive acquisition deal flow. You will be responsible for the full M&A process — from identifying and contacting prospects, conducting initial and follow-up meetings, and building the internal business case. This includes managing NBO offers, due diligence, SPA negotiations, closing and onboarding. This does not mean you execute all steps alone, you are accountable for ensuring they are carried out in a timely and professional manner using the right resources across the organisation. The Business Area has executed 6-8 acquisitions per year in recent years, split between standalone acquisitions and add-on acquisitions with the ambition to further increase deal flow. The role is an important platform position with significant internal and external interaction, and you will report to the Head of BA. You will collaborate closely with Business Segment Leaders, MD:s of subsidiary companies, Indutrade’s central M&A team and country-based M&A resources across Europe. A key part of the role is building a strong internal network and ensuring that sourcing activity is continuously driven forward across all markets. Key responsibilities: Drive and optimise the BA’s proactive M&A deal flow and ensure a continuous pipeline of acquisition candidates across all markets Manage and take overall responsibility for all stages of the acquisition process, from prospect identification through to closing and onboarding Lead SPA negotiations and ensure professional execution of due diligence processes Coordinate and leverage internal resources including Business Segment Leaders, BA MDs, central M&A team and country-level M&A resources Build and maintain a strong internal and external network to support deal sourcing and execution across Scandinavia, UK & Ireland, Germany, the Netherlands, Italy, Poland, Czech Republic and Spain Prepare and present internal evaluations, investment proposals and IC materials in line with Indutrade’s decision-making processes About you You are a commercially minded, structured and relationship-oriented professional who thrives in a high-paced, entrepreneurial environment. You are comfortable working independently, managing multiple processes in parallel, and navigating both strategic and operational challenges. You have a natural ability to build trust with business owners and entrepreneurs, and you understand how to tailor your approach to different cultures and markets. Important for the role: At least 6-8 years of experience in M&A, corporate development or private equity, with a strong track record of managing transactions end-to-end Solid experience in deal sourcing, financial analysis and valuation, due diligence and contract negotiation (SPA) Strong project management skills and ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders and geographies simultaneously Excellent relationship-building and communication skills – you are comfortable engaging with entrepreneurs and business owners as well as senior internal stakeholders Experience from or interest in the life science sector is a merit Experience from working in an international context outside the Nordics is a plus Fluency in English is required, proficiency in additional European languages is an advantage Other Start: According to agreement Scope: Full-time Location: Stockholm Do you find the opportunity as Head of M&A at Indutrade interesting? Submit your application today – we at Needo look forward to hearing from you!

title: AI QA Tester
description: AI QA Tester We are currently recruiting for an AI QA Tester with automation testing experience to join one of our Insurance clients on a 6-month contract. Inside IR35 Remote Key responsibilities Own and maintain the test strategy for the agentic platform, spanning the agent orchestration layer, the data APIs, the retrieval pipeline and the underlying Azure services. Build and curate golden test datasets and expected-outcome sets with input from business subject-matter experts, covering happy paths, edge cases, ambiguous questions and out-of-scope requests. Design and automate LLM evaluation: groundedness/faithfulness, answer relevance, retrieval precision and recall, citation correctness, task completion, tone and consistency - using Azure AI Foundry evaluation, LLM-as-judge and deterministic checks as appropriate. Wire evaluations into CI/CD as release gates, so prompt, model, index or code changes cannot regress quality unnoticed; report trends over time. Carry out adversarial and red-team testing: prompt injection, jailbreaks, indirect injection via knowledge-base content, data-exfiltration attempts, tool misuse and privilege escalation through agent tool calls. Validate the safety and monitoring controls - Azure AI Content Safety categories and thresholds, refusal and escalation behaviour, and Azure AI Anomaly Detector signals - including deliberate false-negative and false-positive probing. Test authorisation rigorously: confirm that agents and APIs never return member or document data outside the requesting user's entitlement, including via retrieval or summarisation side channels. Build automated functional and contract test suites for the Agent Data API and Member Data API (for example pytest, Playwright, Postman/Newman, RestSharp) and for the end-to-end conversational flows. Run non-functional testing: latency and response-time budgets, throughput and concurrency, token cost per interaction, rate-limit and failover behaviour, and resilience when BCUK or a dependency degrades. experience Strong QA engineering background with hands-on test automation, not manual Scripting alone. Automation coding ability in Python, C# and/or JavaScript/TypeScript. API testing experience, including contract testing, authentication, negative testing and mocked dependencies. Demonstrable experience testing AI, machine learning or LLM-based systems, or a clear grasp of how to assure non-deterministic output using evaluation metrics and statistical thresholds. Understanding of RAG architectures and where they fail - retrieval misses, stale indexes, chunk boundary loss, hallucination, ungrounded citations. Awareness of LLM security risks (for example the OWASP Top 10 for LLM applications) and practical adversarial testing technique. CI/CD integration of automated test suites (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps). Test data management, including handling of personal data safely in test environments. Confidence challenging engineers and stakeholders on release readiness. Experience with Azure AI Foundry evaluations, Azure AI Content Safety testing or PyRIT/other red-teaming tooling. Performance and load testing tools (k6, JMeter, Azure Load Testing). Azure Monitor/Application Insights and KQL for investigating failures from telemetry. Accessibility and conversational UX testing experience. Familiarity with UK GDPR, DPIA processes or regulated-sector assurance evidence. description: Vil du være med i maskinrummet, hvor der udarbejdes politik og strukturelle løsning på flere af de største velfærdsområder? Er du klar til at tage fat, og er du god til at tænke selvstændigt og analytisk i løsningen af opgaver? Og motiveres du af at arbejde i et dynamisk miljø og være en del af et ambitiøst, engageret og socialt team? Du vil få indsigt i, hvordan finansloven bliver til og Finansministeriets centrale rolle heri. Du vil samtidig bidrage til at understøtte regeringens politikudvikling og økonomiske politik på centrale velfærdsområder samt fornyelse af den offentlige sektor. Du vil samtidig blive en integreret del af et hold, der vægter stærk faglighed, engagement, godt humør og samarbejde højt. Det er vigtigt for os, at du udvikler dig både fagligt og personligt ved ansættelse som student i Finansministeriet. Jobbet vil dermed give dig en række kompetencer og forudsætninger, som du kan bruge, når du er færdig med dit studie. Derudover skal du være nysgerrig, selvstændig og tænke konstruktivt med i løsningen af opgaver. Om os Velfærdspolitisk Center har en central rolle i koordineringen af regeringens større velfærdspolitiske indsatser og arbejdet med udvikling, styring og modernisering af den offentlige sektor. Centerets ansvar vedrørende kommunerne omfatter de borgernære velfærdsområder, som bl.a. omfatter ældre, socialområdet og udsatte grupper. I forhold til regionerne omfatter centerets arbejdsområder primært sundhedsområdet, herunder sygehuspolitik og medicinområdet samt den primære sundhedssektor i form af bl.a. almen praksis, forebyggelse og psykiatri. Centeret består af en kontorchef, 10 akademiske medarbejdere og tre studenter. Du vil blive en del af et stærkt studenterteam, der indgår i de fleste af centerets arbejdsgange. Den studenteransvarlige i centeret vil desuden have fokus på, hvordan du bedst kan udvikle dig fagligt og personligt. Finansministeriet som arbejdsplads Finansministeriet indtager en central rolle i det politiske maskinrum på Slotsholmen og spiller en vigtig og koordinerende rolle i udarbejdelsen af regeringens politik. description:
At PwC, our people in workforce consulting focus on providing consulting services related to human resources, talent management, and organisational development. They analyse client needs, develop people and organisation strategies. These individuals offer guidance and support to help clients optimise their workforce, enhance employee engagement, and drive organisational effectiveness. In change management and communications at PwC, you will focus on helping clients navigate organisational change and effectively communicate with stakeholders. You will work closely with clients to develop change management strategies, assess change readiness, and design communication plans to support successful change initiatives. Your work will provide guidance on employee engagement, training, and cultural transformation to drive organisational adoption and minimise resistance.

Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team member’s unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.

Examples of the skills, knowledge, and experiences you need to lead and deliver value at this level include but are not limited to:

  • Analyse and identify the linkages and interactions between the component parts of an entire system.
  • Take ownership of projects, ensuring their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion.
  • Partner with team leadership to ensure collective ownership of quality, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Develop skills outside your comfort zone, and encourage others to do the same.
  • Effectively mentor others.
  • Use the review of work as an opportunity to deepen the expertise of team members.
  • Address conflicts or issues, engaging in difficult conversations with clients, team members and other stakeholders, escalating where appropriate.
  • Uphold and reinforce professional and technical standards (e.g. refer to specific PwC tax and audit guidance), the Firm's code of conduct, and independence requirements.

About the role

Our client base covers a breadth of organisations spanning: Traditional and Alternative Fund Managers, Sovereign Wealth Funds, Fund Service Providers (Administrators, Transfer Agents, Depositaries), Prime Brokers and Custodians. These are primarily large multinational organisations who are leaders in their respective markets.

Sample engagements include:

  • Design and build of the world’s largest Private Equity Fund (awarded the Management Consulting Association’s Change Project of the Year)

  • Design and build of a target operating model for a newly established Sovereign Wealth Fund, with the objective of diversifying state wealth away from depleting oil and gas revenues

A typical day: -

Client Engagement & Management:

  • Lead workstreams within engagements to design enterprise operating models and deliver enterprise transformation change projects to a high standard.

  • Build relationships with our clients, identify their needs, and help propose solutions to them.

Team Leadership:

  • Act as a role model and coach for more

title: Praktikum KI-System-Entwicklung und Data Analytics im Supplier Quality Management
description: Möchtest du modernste KI-Technologien in die industrielle Praxis der Halbleiterindustrie überführen und an innovativen Lösungen mitarbeiten, die einen direkten Einfluss auf Qualitätsprozesse und Automatisierung haben? Während deines Praktikums konzentrierst du dich auf das Projekt „Automatisierung der 8D-Report-Generierung“ und gestaltest Qualitätsprozesse durch moderne KI- und Softwarelösungen effizienter. Dabei entwickelst du eine benutzerfreundliche Oberfläche (User Interface) basierend auf den Anforderungen des Process Owners und unterstützt die Umsetzung in produktive Anwendungen. description_en: Would you like to transfer state-of-the-art AI technologies into industrial practice in the semiconductor industry and work on innovative solutions that have a direct impact on quality processes and automation? Then you've come to the right place. During your internship, you will focus on the “Automation of 8D report generation” project and make quality processes more efficient through modern AI and software solutions. title: Maintenance Manager
location: Fort Smith, Arkansas, United States of America
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Plant Manager

__

The work model for the role is: Onsite #LI-Onsite

Your role and responsibilities:

The Maintenance Manager leads all maintenance, reliability, and asset management activities for the Fort Smith manufacturing facility, driving equipment reliability, operational excellence, and manufacturing performance through a comprehensive Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) strategy. This role oversees the development and execution of Operator Preventive Maintenance (OPM), Preventive Maintenance (PM), Predictive Maintenance (PdM), and Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM) programs, leveraging technologies such as condition monitoring, vibration analysis, thermal imaging, oil analysis, and CMMS tools to proactively prevent equipment failures.

The position fosters a reliability-focused culture by driving continuous improvement in key performance indicators including MTBF, MTTR, OEE, uptime, and maintenance costs. The Maintenance Manager leads Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA) efforts and collaborates cross-functionally to improve safety, quality, delivery, and cost performance while ensuring sustainable asset reliability and operational excellence.

Our Team Dynamics

Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters - because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Lead and continuously improve maintenance, reliability, and TPM programs by implementing proactive, preventive, predictive, and operator-driven maintenance strategies that maximize equipment performance and uptime.
  • Drive asset reliability and operational excellence through CMMS analytics, reliability metrics (MTBF, MTTR, OEE), root cause failure analysis, lifecycle planning, and Industry 4.0 technologies.
  • Manage maintenance operations, resources, and budgets by optimizing planning and scheduling, developing technical talent, controlling costs, and ensuring effective support for capital projects and facility growth.
  • Ensure safe, compliant, and efficient plant operations by meeting regulatory and corporate requirements, supporting plant performance objectives, and leading maintenance response to critical equipment and operational issues.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor’s Degree with minimum 10 years OR Associate’s Degree with minimum 12 years OR High School Diploma with minimum 14 years of maintenance experience working in a manufacturing environment. Including hands-on troubleshooting of PLCs, industrial controls, electrical and mechanical systems, and automated production equipment.
  • Demonstrated expertise in TPM, Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM), asset management, and proactive maintenance programs, including OPM, PM, PdM, and Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA).
  • Strong knowledge of predictive maintenance technologies and reliability methodologies, including vibration analysis, thermography, ultrasound, oil analysis, condition monitoring, and reliability KPI management (MTBF, MTTR, OEE, uptime).
  • Experience utilizing CMMS platforms (SAP preferred) for maintenance planning, scheduling, resource management, reliability analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Proven leadership in automated manufacturing environments, with the ability to develop teams, drive cultural change, manage budgets and capital projects, and deliver operational excellence.
  • Excellent communication, coaching, project management, and cross-functional collaboration skills; Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, TPM, CMRP, CRL, or related certifications preferred.
  • Candidates must already have work authorization that would permit them to work for ABB in the US.

title: Redovisningsansvarig till Flexit Sverige AB
description: Vill du ha en nyckelroll i ett stabilt och växande nordiskt företag där du får kombinera redovisning, analys och verksamhetsutveckling? Flexit Sverige AB söker nu en engagerad och strukturerad Redovisningsansvarig som vill ta ett helhetsansvar för redovisningen i vårt svenska bolag och samtidigt vara en viktig del av vår nordiska ekonomifunktion. Hos oss får du en varierad roll med stort eget ansvar, nära samarbete med kollegor i både Sverige och Norge samt möjlighet att påverka och utveckla ekonomiarbetet framåt. Om Flexit Flexit är ett norskt familjeägt företag med rötter tillbaka till 1974. Under mer än 50 år har vi utvecklat och levererat ventilations- och inneklimatlösningar för bostäder och kommersiella byggnader i Norden. Vårt fokus är att skapa hälsosamma inomhusmiljöer, lägre energiförbrukning och hållbara lösningar för framtiden. Flexit har egen verksamhet i flera nordiska länder och är en ledande aktör inom inneklimat och ventilation för nordiska förhållanden. På Flexit blir du en del av en verksamhet som präglas av hög kompetens, korta beslutsvägar, samarbete över landsgränserna och en stark vilja att utvecklas. Din roll Som Redovisningsansvarig ansvarar du för att säkerställa korrekt och effektiv redovisning samt att bolagets ekonomiska rapportering håller hög kvalitet. Du arbetar nära ekonomichefen och är en viktig stödperson för verksamheten i ekonomiska frågor. title: Accounting Manager
description: Want to shape the future of waterborne transport and join a world-class team? Candela is the global leader in electric hydrofoil vessels . Since 2014, we’ve gone from building our first premium electric speedboat in a small Stockholm workshop to delivering game-changing vessels around the globe. The Candela P-12 is our latest innovation - the world’s first electric hydrofoil ferry is not just operating in Stockholm, but now attracting orders from around the world. Our boats “fly” thanks to computer-guided underwater wings under the hull made out of lightweight carbon fiber. The wings lift the vessel above the water, which results in cutting energy use by up to 80%, while offering zero emissions and a far better passenger experience than traditional diesel vessels. And that’s exactly why we do this. Our mission is clear: to speed up the transition to fossil fuel–free lakes and oceans . You can be part of the amazing team in Candela now! We are looking for Accounting Manager to support Candela’s future growth ambitions. As an Accounting Manager, you will have responsibility to lead and drive future accounting, taxes and financial reporting at Candela. Driving and developing the sustainability reporting for Candela is also a key part of the role. You have a strategic contribution in developing new ways of working in our Finance function as we grow. You will play a crucial role in our continued expansion phase to ensure that we maintain high-quality in our financial reporting processes. Parts of accounting and payroll is outsourced to an external supplier and therefore you need to ensure consistent quality and interfaces with the external supplier. Your core responsibilities will include: · Lead the group reporting and consolidation process, assuring correct and on-time delivery in the group’s monthly, quarterly, and yearly closings. · Transition Candela from K3 to a IFRS and set up an internal control framework · Develop sustainability reporting and professionalize monthly and quarterly reporting to board of directors as well as external stakeholders · Drive and lead projects within the finance function to create a best practice including quality assurance of any new accounting standards · Structure and align our processes and ensure that we work scalable and have an accurate presentation of the financial data · Support the external audit firm with interim and year-end audit requests as well as other ongoing audit requirements. · Responsible for accounting staff and coordination of accounting outsourcing partner Requirements: · Bachelor’s degree within Business Administration, preferably with focus on accounting · Several years of relevant experience in the field, preferably from working with group accounting at a multinational company and/or big four audit firm · Strong K3 and IFRS skills and interest in complex accounting issues · Experience in sustainability reporting, preferably including CSRD/ESRS · Knowledgeable in accounting, group accounting/consolidation, financial reporting · Good communication skills in both Swedish and English, both verbal and written We believe that you have a solid team working ethic, takes a positive approach to resolving issues and can deliver outstanding financial analysis. You like problem-solving and want to be a part of a fast-growing company. You have excellent attention to detail with ability to multi-task and prioritize in a dynamic, fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment. You also have the ability to work independently and manage different projects at the same time. Form of employment : Full-time with initial 6 month probation period Start date: ASAP Location/base : Frihamnen Team : FLIT Reporting to : Chief Financial Officer Why people love working at Candela? At Candela, we’re not just building electric vessels - we’re creating a whole new category of clean, efficient waterborne transport. You get the chance to work with cutting-edge technology , solving complex challenges, and seeing the results in action - sometimes literally, when we organize test rides for our newcomers! We’re a diverse and ambitious team of over 50 nationalities, united by a revolutionary spirit and kindness . That means we work hard, but always with humility and while having fun - whether it’s solving a manufacturing challenge, improving processes, or cheering each other on during Candela Months , our year-round calendar of bonding activities and events. We’re office-first but not office-only . We believe collaboration is most powerful when we build together, in person - but we also trust our team to work in ways that fit their life. At Candela, you’ll find a place where bold ideas are welcomed, great people are celebrated, and the ride is just as important as the destination. Recruitment process: We aim to keep our recruitment process as straightforward and efficient as possible. As an international company with English as our corporate language, the entire process is conducted in English. Therefore, please submit your application in our corporate language as well. Kindly note that we cannot process applications sent via email due to GDPR so please use our career website for you application. We welcome the opportunity to meet you!

description:
About the role:

Our team is a leading corporate tax and international tax practice working with the largest multinational companies in the UK. We operate nationally with parts of the team based in more than 10 of our offices including London, the South East (e.g. Reading), the Midlands (e.g. Birmingham), the North West (e.g. Manchester) and Scotland (e.g. Glasgow).

We are seeking a Manager who excels in technical challenges and enjoys building client relationships and developing teams. Candidates should have a strong track record in managing complex international and corporate tax projects within multidisciplinary teams. You can be based in any of our offices providing flexibility to apply whatever your location in the UK.

The role is varied and challenging, offering significant career development opportunities. As a Manager, you will work with and learn from Senior Managers, Directors, and Partners, including renowned practitioners. A coach will oversee your performance, well-being, and development and you will have peers based with you whichever office you work from.

What your days will look like:

  • Advising large corporate clients on UK and international tax matters.

  • Sustaining long-term client relationships and managing and building new business through referrals, networking, and identifying client opportunities.

  • Working collaboratively in managing our clients compliance obligations, including corporate tax return submissions and tax accounting and reporting requirements.

  • Leading and developing teams and colleagues

  • Collaboratively and creatively solving complex issues for our clients

This role is for you if:

  • You possess a tax professional qualification (e.g. ACA, ATT, CTA,CA, ACCA (or an international equivalent) or have equivalent work experience. This includes international candidates who qualify through experience in their home country.

  • You have previous advisory experience with UK and international large corporate tax clients.

  • You hold strong UK corporate tax knowledge including the ability to review UK tax computations and tax accounting and group reporting calculations and disclosures for accuracy, completeness, and to identify broader opportunities and risks for the client.

  • Your experience includes sound accounting knowledge and the ability to interpret statutory accounts.

  • You have leadership experience with senior stakeholders both internally and externally, including building and maintaining relationships within large teams

  • You have business development experience through referrals, networking, and identifying client opportunities.

  • You can demonstrate a strong understanding of broader UK and global business issues, and confidence in discussing these with clients.

What you’ll receive from us

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

title: Rigsrevisionen søger samfundsvidenskabelig medarbejder til revision af virksomheder uden for statsregnskabet
description: Vil du være med til at sikre en ansvarlig og effektiv offentlig forvaltning? Trives du i et arbejdsmiljø med fokus på formidling, faglig fordybelse, tæt samarbejde og analytisk tænkning? Så er du måske vores nye kollega. Om jobbet Rigsrevisionens opgave er at føre kontrol med regeringen på vegne af Folketinget. Det gør vi ved at undersøge, om Folketingets beslutninger bliver til virkelighed. Vi søger en kollega til 6. kontor, som har lyst til nye udfordringer med analyse og revision i krydsfeltet mellem offentligt og privat. I kontoret har vi ansvaret for at revidere de statsejede offentlige virksomheder uden for statsregnskabet, fx Energinet, DSB og DR. Vi reviderer flere af virksomhederne i samarbejde med private revisionsfirmaer, som udfører den finansielle revision af årsregnskaberne, mens vi udfører juridisk-kritisk revision og forvaltningsrevision. Vi afgiver desuden årligt en beretning om revisionen af virksomheder uden for statsregnskabet . Denne opgave er forankret i 6. kontor, og du vil som ny medarbejder være med til at skrive beretningen. Opgaven består i, at du i samarbejde med dine kolleger i kontoret skal omsætte de gennemførte revisioner af virksomheder uden for statsregnskabet til en samlet beretning, hvor revisionernes resultater og konsekvenser kommunikeres klart og enkelt til Statsrevisorerne. Du bliver en del af et kontor, hvor vi sætter pris på at have et tæt samarbejde på tværs. Vi er 19 medarbejdere i kontoret, der har forskellige uddannelses- og erhvervsmæssige baggrunde. Det betyder, at vi udnytter, at vi har forskellige styrker og præferencer. Vi arbejder altid i teams, som bliver sammensat alt efter opgaven. Du kan læse mere om Rigsrevisionen på www.rigsrevisionen.dk . Om dig Vi forestiller os, at du har en samfundsvidenskabelig uddannelse. Det er en fordel, hvis du har arbejdet inden for centraladministrationen eller i en større offentlig virksomhed. Det kunne fx være i en tilsyns- eller controllerfunktion. Vi lægger vægt på, at du: har et højt fagligt niveau og gode analytiske evner er en skarp formidler, der kan formidle komplicerede problemstillinger i et klart sprog både mundtligt og skriftligt er processtærk og evner at prioritere og bevare overblikket bidrager til et godt samarbejdsklima i relation til interne og eksterne samarbejdspartnere er selvstændig, engageret og bidrager til kontorets fællesskab. Hvis du vil vide mere, kan du kontakte kontorchef Glenn Elton Hvidt på tlf. 33 92 83 45 eller souschef Mads Christian Grimmig Kobbernagel på tlf. 33 92 84 97. Rigsrevisionen Gennemsnitligt har vi en 37-timers arbejdsuge (inkl. frokost), men der vil være perioder med ekstra travlhed. Vi har flekstid, så du har gode muligheder for at skabe balance mellem karriere og fritid. Vi prioriterer kompetenceudvikling højt og tilbyder gode efteruddannelsesmuligheder. Du kommer bl.a. til at indgå i vores kompetenceudviklingsforløb, som strækker sig over de første 3 år af din ansættelse. Det giver dig et solidt kendskab til Rigsrevisionen og den offentlige forvaltning. Dine kompetencer vil løbende blive udbygget. Dine løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er efter overenskomst og kvalifikationer. Ved ansættelse skal du sikkerhedsgodkendes, kunne opretholde godkendelsen gennem hele din ansættelse og fremvise en straffeattest. Ansøgning Send din ansøgning, så vi har den senest mandag den 14. september 2026 . Hvis du ikke modtager en bekræftelse på din ansøgning, er du velkommen til at kontakte os på tlf. 33 92 83 76. Vi afholder jobsamtaler tirsdag den 22. september 2026 og indhenter referencer på den, vi ønsker at ansætte. Der vil indgå en case i forbindelse med samtalen, som du vil få tilsendt fredag den 18. september kl. 14.00 . Din casebesvarelse skal sendes senest mandag den 21. september kl. 10.00. Rigsrevisionen opfordrer alle uanset alder, køn, religion og etnisk baggrund til at søge. Rigsrevisionen fører kontrol med regeringen på vegne af Folketinget. Det gør vi ved at belyse, om Folketingets beslutninger bliver til virkelighed. Vi ser især på områder, hvor statens midler ikke forvaltes ordentligt, eller hvor den politisk aftalte indsats og service ikke bliver leveret. Vi udfører revision af offentlige regnskaber og større undersøgelser. Vi har en unik position i det danske samfund. Vores mandat giver os uindskrænket adgang til alle offentlige informationer og data i forbindelse med udførelsen af vores opgaver.

description: Are you a highly capable finance professional who wants to build and manage the financial backbone of a rapidly growing deep-tech and medical technology company? Ascilion is now recruiting a Financial Controller to the company. The position is full-time and based at our headquarters in Kista. At Ascilion we are singularly focused on solving one of medicine’s big challenges: providing real-time access to molecular biomarkers. Ascilion’s proprietary, industry-leading microneedle technology enables quick, reliable, and painless access to molecular biomarkers. Ascilion is entering a phase of significant international growth with substantial investor involvement, increasing reporting requirements, expanding operations, and likely future subsidiaries and / or international sales entities. Depending on profile and experience, the role may develop into a CFO position and become part of the senior management team with responsibility for strategic financial planning and board-level reporting. This is an excellent opportunity for you to join a dedicated and highly competent team and a growing company with an exciting journey ahead. If this sounds interesting to you, please contact us using the details below! We will interview candidates continuously for the position and welcome your application today. Responsibilities As our Financial Controller, you will drive the company’s financial success by ensuring reporting accuracy, robust compliance, and strategic control over day-to-day financial operations. You will report directly to the CEO. You have strong communication and collaboration skills, and you are comfortable operating close to both management and technical teams and presenting financial information clearly to both investors and engineers. Importantly, you thrive in an ambitious, high-performance environment and want to help build a globally significant company, not just manage spreadsheets At Ascilion, you will have the opportunity to make an impact not only in your own area of responsibility, but also on the development of the company as a whole. About Ascilion Ascilion was founded in 2012 with a mission to solve the problem of sampling dermal interstitial fluid in an efficient and pain-free way. A team of engineers with deep experience in MEMS technology and microfluidics took on the challenge of solving what turned out to be a very complex problem. We exist to bridge the worlds of precision engineering and biomarker science, creating innovative microneedle technologies that make dISF accessible, reliable, and painless; empowering researchers, clinicians, and companies to unlock the full potential of health monitoring and diagnostics. We are currently in a very exciting expansion phase where we grow all aspects of the organization from R&D to sales. Our customer base is increasing with numerous close collaborations in Europe, the US, and Asia. Come, join our journey! title: Digital & Cyber Resilience – Senior Manager
description:
About the role:

As part of PwC’s Risk business, the Digital & Cyber Resilience team supports organisations in building resilience across increasingly complex technology environments. With hybrid cloud, on‑prem infrastructure, evolving cyber threats and expanding regulatory requirements, resilience is now a strategic business imperative.

In this Senior Manager role, you’ll work at the intersection of technology, cyber security and operational resilience, helping clients design and embed “resilience by design” approaches. You’ll support organisations to prepare for, respond to and recover from cyber incidents, major technology failures and large‑scale disruption scenarios, ensuring their critical services remain secure, available and recoverable.

  • Leading and shaping complex digital and cyber resilience engagements across multiple client sectors
  • Solutioning and structuring work across cyber security, IT architecture, operational resilience and business continuity

  • Supporting and overseeing disaster recovery testing, scenario exercises and resilience assessments
  • Translating technical risks into clear, business‑focused insights for boards and executive leaders
  • Mobilising, leading and developing teams, while driving high‑quality delivery and thought leadership

The role is for you if:

  • You bring deep experience across cyber security, IT operations and digital resilience
  • You have a strong technology and architecture background, spanning cloud, hybrid and on‑prem environments
  • You understand recovery planning, including DR testing, RTO/RPO design and crisis preparedness
  • You’re comfortable operating in a client‑facing, advisory role, influencing at senior and C‑suite level
  • You’re motivated by leadership, continuous learning and delivering impactful outcomes in a fast‑paced professional services environment

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

title: Verksamhetsnära Business Controller till Verisure
description: Vill du vara med och driva affären i ett av Europas snabbast växande tjänstebolag? Verisure är marknadsledande inom professionella säkerhetslösningar för hem och företag och präglas av en stark entreprenörsanda, högt tempo och ett tydligt fokus på resultat. Samtidigt värnar vi om en familjär kultur där engagemang, innovation och samarbete står i centrum. Nu söker vi en Business Controller som vill ta en central roll i vår fortsatta tillväxtresa. I rollen blir du en viktig partner till verksamheten och arbetar nära ledning, affärsansvariga och andra nyckelfunktioner. Du kommer att bidra med analys, insikter och rekommendationer som hjälper organisationen att fatta bättre affärsbeslut och driva lönsam tillväxt. Om rollen Som Business Controller ansvarar du för att analysera verksamhetens utveckling, identifiera affärsmöjligheter och skapa beslutsunderlag som bidrar till ökad lönsamhet och effektivitet. Du arbetar i en dynamisk miljö där du får möjlighet att ta stort eget ansvar och driva utvecklingsinitiativ som skapar verkligt affärsvärde. Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden Analysera verksamhetens resultat och identifiera trender, avvikelser och förbättringsmöjligheter. Utmana verksamheten genom datadrivna insikter och rekommendationer. Driva och utveckla arbetet inom Performance Management tillsammans med Business Controlling-teamet. Ta fram kvalificerade analyser och beslutsunderlag för ledning, styrelse och ägare. Ansvara för budget-, prognos- och uppföljningsprocesser. Delta aktivt i bokslutsarbetet samt kommunicera utfall och avvikelser på ett tydligt och pedagogiskt sätt. Initiera och leda tvärfunktionella projekt för att förbättra processer, effektivitet och lönsamhet. Arbeta nära verksamheten för att säkerställa att finansiella mål omsätts till konkreta aktiviteter och resultat. Vi söker dig som har Akademisk examen inom ekonomi, finans, redovisning eller industriell ekonomi. Erfarenhet från Business Controlling, Financial Controlling, revision, transaction services eller liknande analytiska roller. Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att arbeta projektorienterat och driva initiativ från analys till genomförande. Mycket goda kunskaper i Excel och PowerPoint. Mycket god förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet från abonnemangsbaserade verksamheter eller andra datadrivna tjänstebolag. Vem är du? För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du kombinerar stark analytisk förmåga med ett genuint intresse för affären. Du trivs i en miljö där du får utmana, påverka och samarbeta med många olika intressenter. Vi tror att du: Har en stark analytisk och numerisk förmåga. Kommunicerar komplex information på ett tydligt och pedagogiskt sätt. Är nyfiken, resultatorienterad och motiveras av att skapa förbättringar. Trivs i en verksamhet med högt tempo och höga ambitioner. Om oss Verisure är Sveriges ledande leverantör av professionellt övervakade säkerhetstjänster. Sedan 1988 har vi hjälpt familjer och småföretag att känna sig trygga genom innovativa säkerhetslösningar och marknadsledande service. Idag skyddar vi över 6,3 miljoner kunder i 18 länder och är ett av världens snabbast växande företag inom konsumenttjänster. Med över 35 års erfarenhet fortsätter vi att utveckla framtidens säkerhetslösningar och skapa trygghet för människor varje dag. Vår framgång bygger på entreprenörskap, innovation och ett starkt resultatfokus. Samtidigt värnar vi om en familjär kultur där samarbete, engagemang och utveckling står i centrum. Hos oss får du möjlighet att vara med och påverka i en internationell organisation med höga ambitioner och stora möjligheter att växa. Vi erbjuder Hos Verisure får du möjlighet att bli en del av ett framgångsrikt och internationellt bolag med stark tillväxt. Du får arbeta nära affären, påverka viktiga beslut och utvecklas tillsammans med kompetenta kollegor i en organisation där egna initiativ uppskattas och uppmuntras. Det här är en roll för dig som vill ta nästa steg i karriären och kombinera analys, affärsförståelse och påverkan i en miljö där dina insatser gör skillnad. description: Business Analyst - Financial Crime/KYC & CDD Location: London/Hybrid Outside IR35 - Up to £500 per day We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst to support a Financial Crime change programme within a regulated financial services environment. The key requirement is someone who can demonstrate strong, hands-on experience of mapping end-to-end business processes and translating those processes into clear, practical policy and procedural documentation. Experience within a Financial Crime, KYC or CDD environment would be highly desirable, alongside an understanding of the UK regulatory landscape. Key Responsibilities Create detailed end-to-end process maps, documenting current-state and future-state processes. Analyse existing processes, identify gaps, inefficiencies, risks and control weaknesses, and recommend improvements. Work closely with Financial Crime, Compliance, Operations and other stakeholders to understand and document business requirements. Develop and maintain policies, procedures, process documentation and operating models. Translate regulatory and policy requirements into clear, workable operational processes. Document roles, responsibilities, controls, decision points, hand-offs, exceptions and escalation routes. Support the implementation of revised processes and controls, ensuring documentation accurately reflects the target operating model. Facilitate workshops with business and subject-matter experts to elicit requirements and validate process designs. Produce high-quality BA artefacts including process maps, requirements, procedures, control documentation and gap analyses. Ensure processes and supporting documentation are consistent with relevant regulatory and internal policy requirements. Essential Experience Proven experience working as a Business Analyst within a complex, regulated environment. Strong, demonstrable experience of creating end-to-end process maps from discovery through to implementation. Excellent experience of writing and maintaining policies, procedures and operational documentation. Strong stakeholder management and workshop facilitation skills. Ability to take complex or ambiguous requirements and turn them into clear, structured processes and documentation. Experience analysing current-state vs. future-state processes and identifying improvements, risks and control gaps. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Desirable Experience Experience within Financial Crime/AML/KYC/CDD. Understanding of Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), KYC and beneficial ownership. Exposure to the UK regulatory framework, particularly the Money Laundering Regulations, FCA Financial Crime Guide and/or JMLSG guidance. Experience documenting processes relating to customer onboarding, periodic reviews, KYC remediation or ongoing monitoring. Experience working with Compliance, Financial Crime, Risk or Operations teams. Financial services, banking, payments, fintech or other regulated-sector experience. What we're looking for This role would suit a pragmatic, delivery-focused Business Analyst who is comfortable getting into the detail of how processes actually work, rather than someone whose experience is primarily requirements gathering. The strongest candidates will be able to demonstrate examples of where they have taken an existing process, mapped it end-to-end, identified gaps or risks, redesigned it and then produced the policy/procedure documentation needed to operationalise the new approach. Financial Crime experience is preferred, but candidates with strong regulated-sector BA experience and excellent process/documentation skills will also be considered. The FCA's recent CDD review specifically highlights policies and procedures, CDD/EDD processes, and compliance controls as key areas of focus.

Dank Ihrer hohen Zahlenaffinität gelingt es Ihnen, komplexe Zusammenhänge schnell zu erfassen, verständlich aufzubereiten und in konkrete Maßnahmen zu übersetzen. Eine ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke im Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit in einem internationalen Umfeld runden Ihr Profil ab. Was wir bieten? Erläutern wir im Gespräch! Getreu dem Motto so individuell wie möglich, so flexibel wie nötig. Wir freuen uns drauf. title: Senior Manager - Tax Technology
description:
Job Description

About the role:

As a Senior Manager in the wider Tax Transformation and Technology team you will play a pivotal role in advancing our tax solutions to meet the complex needs of our clients.

Increasing complexity of business arrangements, new legislative requirements such as e-invoicing and making tax digital are creating significant challenges for organisations. In order to meet these challenges, organisations are looking to improve their tax processes through a combination of new technology, AI and finance system change. As a result, there is significant opportunity to support businesses with these changes.

It is an exciting time to join the team which combines skills from across tax with a clear objective: to work with clients to improve the delivery of tax through technology, process improvement and compliance. We work collaboratively with deep technical specialists across a broad spectrum of areas to deliver to our clients.

This role requires:

  • Knowledge and experience across various taxes, tax functions and opportunities for transformation including the application of technology.

  • A strategic vision, technical expertise, and the ability to lead and develop a team of specialists.

You will be responsible for overseeing engagements, building client relationships, and driving innovation in tax technology.

What your days will look like:

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, understanding their tax needs, their business strategy and provide innovative technology-drive solutions.

  • Maintain relevant tax knowledge, remain up to date with technical developments including changes in tax law and legislation, as well as technological developments such that you can advise clients and internal stakeholders, including delivering sessions at client / knowledge events.

  • Oversee large-scale tax transformation projects from inception through to delivery, ensuring alignment with client objectives and regulatory requirements.

  • Mentor and guide a team of tax professionals covering both technology and advisory services, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.

This role is for you if:

  • You have experience in tax, technology and transformation. For example, one or more of the following: ERP configuration for tax, tax determination engines, tax operating model, tax automation and process improvement.

  • You have in-depth knowledge of tax processes, methodologies, and technology solutions.

  • You have demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong client relationships, with a focus on understanding client needs and delivering value-added solutions.

  • You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to leverage data and technology to drive decision-making.

  • You have excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex tax technology concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.
